HGR_DegrBaseDrop_tt: Base amount of wear applied to internal parts when a degradation event occurs, before applying weighting and Maintenance skill modifiers.
HGR_DegrChanceFactor_tt: Multiplier applied to the base degradation probability. Higher values increase how often weapon parts are damaged during use.
HGR_DegrChanceMax_tt: The maximum possible probability (in percent) that degradation may reach after calculation.
HGR_DegrChanceMin_tt: The minimum possible probability (in percent) that degradation may occur after calculation.
HGR_EnableDegradation_tt: Enables Hybrid Gun Repair's advanced per-part degradation system. If disabled, only the vanilla degradation behavior is used.
HGR_InitPreserveCondition_tt: If enabled, when weapon parts are initialized for the first time, all parts are set to match the weapon's current condition. This prevents the weapon from losing condition after its internal parts are created.
HGR_MaintDropScale_tt: How much the Maintenance skill reduces total degradation. Larger values make Maintenance more protective against part wear.
HGR_SwingEveryN_tt: Determines how often degradation checks occur. Higher numbers reduce degradation frequency.
MailboxStories_EnableLetters_tooltip: Adds readable letters, cards, notes, paperwork, and tickets to mailbox tiles supported by Mailbox Stories.
MailboxStories_EnableParcels_tooltip: Adds mail bags and parcel containers to supported mailbox tiles, then fills parcels with themed loot by item display category.

MarriageCompanion_ConsoleNoiseSuppressio: Suppresses routine TDDUP/WolfBond status lines. Errors, warnings, exceptions, crashes, and missing-data diagnostics are always kept.
MarriageCompanion_DialogueAlertProtectio: Non-urgent one-off lines wait briefly instead of cutting off active conversations.
MarriageCompanion_DialogueConversationPa: Spacing between lines in spouse conversations.
MarriageCompanion_DialogueDisplayMode_to: Choose how spouse dialogue appears in this save.
MarriageCompanion_DialogueMaxVisibleLine: How many recent lines stay visible in the subtitle box.

MarriageCompanion_DialogueTextDuration_t: How long dialogue text stays visible.
MarriageCompanion_DialogueTextScale_tool: Default size for subtitle and floating dialogue.
MarriageCompanion_EnableBringMeAlong_too: Adds a manual rescue command for stuck spouses.
MarriageCompanion_FamilyImmersionEnabled: Adds spouse memories, neighbor recognition, aftermath, and bond dialogue.
MarriageCompanion_MedicalCustomHealthcar: Allows TDDUP custom medical supplies in treatment and custom loot injection. Vanilla supplies and clean water remain available where supported.
MarriageCompanion_MedicalDownedMechanic_: Allows near-fatal injuries or five open non-fatal substantial injuries to put the spouse into the recoverable DOWNED state.
MarriageCompanion_MedicalInjurySystem_to: Records evidence-based spouse injuries and enables the custom medical ledger. Turning this off stops new custom injuries; existing ledger data is preserved.
MarriageCompanion_MedicalNonCombatCondit: Enable evidence-driven non-combat ailments such as dehydration, thermal exposure, GI illness, common cold, airborne irritation, and recovery fatigue. No random ailments.
MarriageCompanion_RadioSpouseCommsEnable: Adds long-range commands on matching powered radios.
MarriageCompanion_RelaxActivityFrequency: Controls optional Relax leisure, media opportunities, and casual spouse chatter. 0 disables optional leisure/chatter, 50 is roughly the HF07 rhythm, and 100 is about twice as eager. Survival needs, cold/fire care, security, sleep, and emergencies ignore this setting.
MarriageCompanion_TraitRecognitionDialog: Enables supportive spouse/player comments about each partner's traits. Turn off if this feature causes trouble.
MarriageCompanion_TraitTalk_tooltip: Enables supportive spouse/player comments about each partner's traits. Turn off if this feature causes trouble.
MarriageCompanion_WeddingRingEffectsEnab: Subtle effects when both partners are wearing wedding rings.
MarriageCompanion_tooltip: Settings for spouse dialogue, commands, and immersion.
PortraitCharacterImages_tooltip: When off, Portrait Chat keeps the movable text boxes but hides the live character face panels.
SN_BaseZombieCount_tooltip: How many zombies attack on your very first siege. Later sieges grow bigger based on the Growth Rate setting below. Example: 50 means about 50 zombies on siege #1.
SN_BreakerPercent_tooltip: The chance each zombie has to be a Breaker (wall smasher). 10%% means roughly 1 in 10 zombies will be a breaker. Breakers wear construction gear and destroy barricades and walls faster than normal. Set to 0 to disable breakers.
SN_DirectionalAttacks_tooltip: When ON, zombies mostly attack from one direction each siege (North, South, East, or West). The direction is announced when the siege starts. Makes defending your base more strategic since you know which wall to fortify.
SN_Enabled_tooltip: Master switch. Turn this OFF to completely disable all siege events.
SN_FirstSiegeDay_tooltip: Which in-game day the very first siege happens. Example: 5 means your first siege is on Day 5.
SN_FrequencyDaysMax_tooltip: The most days between siege nights. Leave at 0 to always use the Min value exactly (no randomness). Set higher than Min for unpredictable timing. Example: Min=3, Max=7 means a siege every 3 to 7 days.
SN_FrequencyDays_tooltip: The fewest days between siege nights. Example: 5 means at least 5 days between each siege. If you also set the Max value above 0, the gap will be random between Min and Max.
SN_MaxActiveZombies_tooltip: The most siege zombies that can be alive at the same time. When this limit is reached, new zombies stop spawning until you kill some. Lower values = smoother performance and steadier action. Higher values = more overwhelming but can cause lag. Default: 400. If your game stutters during sieges, try lowering this.
SN_MaxZombies_tooltip: The absolute maximum number of zombies that can appear in a single siege night, no matter how far you've progressed. Once this many have spawned, the siege is over. Think of this as the siege length cap. Example: 800 means the siege ends after 800 zombies total.
SN_MiniHorde_ActivityScaling_tooltip: When ON, mini-hordes are bigger when you've been busy (killing zombies, shooting, running generators). If you've been quiet, mini-hordes are smaller.
SN_MiniHorde_CooldownMinutes_tooltip: How many in-game minutes must pass after a mini-horde before another one can trigger. Prevents back-to-back attacks. Default: 60 minutes.
SN_MiniHorde_Enabled_tooltip: Adds small zombie attacks between siege nights, triggered by noise you make. Running generators, firing guns, driving vehicles, and being generally loud can attract nearby zombies to your location. Disabled by default.
SN_MiniHorde_EstablishmentScaling_toolti: When ON, the more built-up your base is (generators, loot, defenses), the bigger your sieges and mini-hordes become. Building a bigger base attracts more attention.
SN_MiniHorde_MaxPerDay_tooltip: The most mini-hordes that can happen in one in-game day. Resets at midnight. Set to 0 for no daily limit. Default: 2.
SN_MiniHorde_MaxZombies_tooltip: Maximum zombies in one mini-horde (at maximum noise). Default: 35.
SN_MiniHorde_MinZombies_tooltip: Minimum zombies in a mini-horde (at threshold noise). Default: 8.
SN_MiniHorde_NoiseThreshold_tooltip: How much noise you need to make before a mini-horde shows up. Lower numbers = mini-hordes come more easily (even quiet activity triggers them). Higher numbers = only very loud activities like gunfire and vehicle crashes attract them. Default: 100.
SN_MiniHorde_PlayerScaling_tooltip: Multiplayer only. When ON, more online players means bigger mini-hordes.
SN_SafehouseMergeDistance_tooltip: Only matters when Zombie Target is set to Safehouse. If two safehouses are closer together than this distance, they're treated as one target. Prevents zombies from awkwardly splitting between buildings that are right next to each other. Default: 50.
SN_SafehouseSearchRadius_tooltip: Only matters when Zombie Target is set to Safehouse. How far away the mod looks for your claimed safehouse. If your base isn't being targeted during sieges, try increasing this. Default: 300.
SN_ScalingMultiplier_tooltip: How much harder each siege gets compared to the last. At 1.5: Siege 1 = 50 zombies, Siege 2 = 75, Siege 3 = 112, Siege 4 = 168, and so on. Set to 1.0 if you want every siege to stay the same size. In multiplayer, more players also means more zombies.
SN_SharedSpawnRadius_tooltip: Multiplayer only. Players within this distance of each other fight the SAME siege together. If players are farther apart than this, each group gets their own separate siege. Default: 200. Increase if your group is spread across a large compound.
SN_SiegeEndHour_tooltip: What hour the siege ends and any remaining zombies are cleared, using 24-hour time. Default: 6 (6:00 AM). The siege can also end early if you kill all the zombies before this time.
SN_SiegeMode_option1: Per-Base: Each player group fights their own siege
SN_SiegeMode_option2: Unified: Everyone shares one big siege
SN_SiegeMode_tooltip: How sieges work in multiplayer. Per-Base: each group of nearby players fights their own independent siege with separate waves and kills. Unified: ALL players share one global siege — waves, kills, and progress are combined. The unified siege targets wherever the most players and infrastructure are concentrated.
SN_SiegeStartHour_tooltip: What hour the siege begins, using 24-hour time. Default: 20 (8:00 PM). Set to 22 for a late-night start, or 18 for early evening.
SN_SiegeWeatherEnabled_tooltip: Adds spooky weather during siege nights — fog rolls in before the siege, rain and wind pick up during combat, and everything clears at dawn. This is purely visual and does NOT affect gameplay difficulty.
SN_SiegeWeatherIntensity_tooltip: How dramatic the weather effects are. 1.0 = normal. 0.5 = subtle effects. 2.0 = thick fog and heavy rain. Set to 0 to effectively disable weather without turning off the setting above.
SN_SpawnAnchor_option1: Players: Zombies chase you wherever you go
SN_SpawnAnchor_option2: Safehouse: Zombies attack your claimed base, even if you leave
SN_SpawnAnchor_tooltip: What zombies focus on during a siege.
SN_SpawnDistance_tooltip: How far from your position zombies appear when the siege starts. Higher values give you more time to see them coming. If you have a large base, increase this so zombies don't appear inside your walls. Default: 45. Most bases work well between 40-60.
SN_SpecialZombiesEnabled_tooltip: Adds tougher zombie types to siege nights: Sprinters (fast runners), Breakers (smash through walls), and Tanks (huge and hard to kill). These spawn mixed in with regular zombies.
SN_SpecialZombiesStartWeek_tooltip: Which siege number special zombies start appearing. Example: 3 means your first two sieges are normal zombies only, and specials show up starting on siege #3. Gives new players time to get ready.
SN_SprinterPercent_tooltip: The chance each zombie has to be a Sprinter (fast runner). 5%% means roughly 1 in 20 zombies will sprint at you. Sprinters look like regular zombies but move much faster. Set to 0 to disable sprinters.
SN_StripSiegeZombieLoot_tooltip: Removes extra items from siege zombies (they keep their clothes). Turn this ON if siege zombies are dropping too much loot, especially if you have mods that add items to zombie inventories.
SN_TankCount_tooltip: How many Tank zombies appear each siege night. Tanks wear military gear, move slowly, but take many hits to kill. They show up during the last third of the night. Set to 0 to disable tanks.
SN_TankHealthMultiplier_tooltip: How many times tougher a Tank is compared to a regular zombie. At 5.0, a Tank takes about 5 times as many hits to kill. Increase for a real bullet sponge, decrease if tanks feel impossible.
SN_WarningSignsEnabled_tooltip: When ON, your character will mutter and you'll hear distant sounds during the day before a siege night. This gives you time to prepare and get back to base.
SN_WaveBreakSeconds_tooltip: How long (in seconds) the longest pause between attack waves can be. Leave at 0 for automatic pacing (5-12 seconds between waves). Set a specific number to cap it, e.g. 5 means waves always come within 5 seconds. Note: zombies still trickle in during pauses.

Sandbox_AVZ_ChildDamage_tooltip: Scales direct body-part health loss from child attacks while retaining vanilla scratch, laceration, bite, and infection rolls. Default 0.50.
Sandbox_AVZ_ChildEnabled_tooltip: Allows newly classified zombies to become child variants. Existing saved variants keep their age type.

Sandbox_AVZ_ChildSpeed_tooltip: Multiplier relative to the zombie's original movement speed. Default 1.10.
Sandbox_AVZ_ChildVenueChildWeight_toolti: Any nonzero value makes eligible existing zombies in toy stores, pediatric facilities, youth centers, and other child-specific civilian venues convert in place; zero disables it.
Sandbox_AVZ_ChildWorldPercent_tooltip: Baseline percentage of the loaded public zombie population that will be children. Location weights still raise or lower particular areas. Default 9.09 is about one child per ten adults; zero disables new children unless Childpocalypse is enabled.
Sandbox_AVZ_Childpocalypse_tooltip: Converts every newly encountered zombie into a child, including zombies in normally excluded facilities. Off by default. Existing children are not reverted when this is disabled.
Sandbox_AVZ_ClinicChildWeight_tooltip: Scales the public child ratio in hospitals, clinics, and civilian medical spaces.
Sandbox_AVZ_DebugLogging_tooltip: Writes namespaced classification, damage, asset-fallback, and network diagnostics to the Lua console.
Sandbox_AVZ_ElementaryChildWeight_toolti: Any nonzero value makes eligible existing zombies in elementary schools and daycares convert in place; zero disables child conversion there.
Sandbox_AVZ_FallbackChildWeight_tooltip: Safe fallback multiplier when a custom map exposes no recognized semantic metadata.
Sandbox_AVZ_HomeChildWeight_tooltip: Multiplies the base child chance in residential buildings.
Sandbox_AVZ_MixedSchoolChildWeight_toolt: Any nonzero value makes eligible existing zombies convert in place when a map labels a school without a grade level; zero disables it.
Sandbox_AVZ_ParkChildWeight_tooltip: Scales the public ratio in ordinary parks. Any nonzero value makes eligible existing zombies in explicit playgrounds convert in place; zero disables it.
Sandbox_AVZ_SecondaryChildWeight_tooltip: Any nonzero value makes eligible existing zombies in middle and high schools convert in place; zero disables child conversion there.
Sandbox_AVZ_ShopChildWeight_tooltip: Multiplies the base child chance in shops and malls.
Sandbox_AVZ_StreetChildWeight_tooltip: Multiplies the base child chance in tagged streets and civilian town areas.

Sandbox_AWS_EnableBackpackWear_tooltip: When disabled, backpacks stop accumulating new AWS wear. Existing wear and backpack failure settings are preserved.
Sandbox_AWS_EnableBloodWear_tooltip: When disabled, blood remains visual and washable, but no longer increases AWS wear.
Sandbox_AWS_EnableBurningDamage_tooltip: Fire exposure causes heavy AWS wear and marks items as burned.
Sandbox_AWS_EnableDirtSystem_tooltip: Tracks dirt buildup from time, movement, combat, corpses, and bad weather.

Sandbox_AWS_WeatherImpactMultiplier_tool: Controls how much rain, humidity, and exposure increase AWS wear.

Linked to color when there is zero bloom on crosshair. Pick a color value from 0 to 255 and divide it by 255, must be from 0 to 1.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorycrosshairGree: Linked to color when crosshair is out of range. Pick a color value from 0 to 255 and divide it by 255, must be from 0 to 1.
Linked to crosshair color. Pick a color value from 0 to 255 and divide it by 255, must be from 0 to 1.
Linked to color when there is zero bloom on crosshair. Pick a color value from 0 to 255 and divide it by 255, must be from 0 to 1.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorycrosshairRedL: Linked to color when crosshair is out of range. Pick a color value from 0 to 255 and divide it by 255, must be from 0 to 1.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorycrosshairRedM: Linked to crosshair color. Pick a color value from 0 to 255 and divide it by 255, must be from 0 to 1.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorycrosshairRed_: Linked to color when there is zero bloom on crosshair. Pick a color value from 0 to 255 and divide it by 255, must be from 0 to 1.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorycrouchCounter: Time it takes to crouch (don't mess with this)
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorycrouchExpoRec: Multiplier that affects how much bloom is added depending on the previous bloom value the player shot at. Lower means less added bloom as you continue spraying.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorycrouchFocusLi: Crouch Buff: Reduce minimum bloom limit
Reduces minimum bloom limit by a percentage; lower means smaller crosshair
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorycrouchPenalty: Flat value of bloom added when Switching Crouch Stance
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorycrouchReduceS: When crouching, your crosshair reduces bloom faster. Helpful after intense cardio.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorycrouchTurnEff: Bloom addition rate when turning while crouch
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorydistanceFocus: Affects when the penalty will be applied. The lower the value, the lesser the distance that the crosshair needs to be from the player to activate the penalty.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorydrunkActionEf: Bloom amplifier on Turning/Moving (Drunk Moodle Scaling)
This value amplifies move and turning effect, which means more bloom when performing those actions. Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorydrunkMaxBloom: Multiplier that increases your maxaimnum or max bloom. Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryenableAutoAim: Check this if you don't want ot manually set which Z level you want to shoot at. Be aware that this will reduce FPS a lot when aiming.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryenableBulletI: Bullets ignore cars below when shooting from a higher level
If enabled, bullet will ignore car when shooting from a higher level.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryenableCarAimL: Limit aiming to a cone in car
Nerfs shooting in cars. Player aim is limited to a cone.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryenableDistanc: Player loses accuracy when trying to shoot targets past their distance limit. Uncheck to disable.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryenableHitOrMi: If enabled, player will have a chance of missing depending on bloom. Bullet will pass through zombies without damaging them.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryenduranceBrea: Bloom addition rate when inhaling (Exhaustion/Endurance Moodle)
Value affects the rate of bloom added when inhaling. Set to 0 to disable the whole endurance mechanic.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryexhaleModifie: Endurance level 1: Exhale time modifier (affects counter to how long char exhales)
Value determines how long the characters exhales (reduces bloom). Links to exhaleModifier1. Higher value means shorter timer, lower means longer.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryfocusCounterS: Multiplier that determines how much focus counter/timer should be shorten based off of aiming level.

Driving part of the focus mechanic. Determines time it takes for the crosshair to begin its process of reducing aimnum to 0 (max accuracy). This is a flat value. Set to 0 to disable if you want to remove ability to gain max accuracy without waiting.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryfocusLevel_to: Aiming level in which player unlocks the focus mechanic.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryfootShotDmgPl: Multiplier on base damage for footshot
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryfootShotDmgZo: Multiplier on base damage for footshot
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryfootShotIncCh: If dealt footshot, increase chance of wounding legs/groin. (ex. 10 means percentage of wounding foot is 20%% (10 + 10))
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryfractureChanc: Chance that a gunshot wound will cause a fracture
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryheadShotDmgPl: Multiplier on base damage for headshot
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryheadShotDmgZo: Multiplier on base damage for headshot
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryheadShotIncCh: If dealt headshot, increase chance of wounding head. (ex. 20 means percentage of wounding head is 30%% (20 + 10))
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryheavyLoadModi: Bloom amplifier on Crouch Switching (Heavy Moodle Scaling)
This value adds more bloom when switching stances between stand and crouch depending on heavy moodle level.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryheavyMaxBloom: This value increases max bloom limit dpeending on heavy moodle level.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryheavyTurnEffe: Bloom amplifier on Turning/Moving (Heavy Moodle Scaling)
This value adds more bloom when walking or turning (Heavy Moodle Scaling)
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryhitLevelScali: Affects how much aiming level will decrease the chances of not missing. Higher means lower chance of missing per level.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryhyperHypoModi: Slower bloom reduction rate (Hyper/Hypo Moodle Scaling)
Multiplier that affects how slow your crosshair reduces bloom.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryinhaleModifie: Endurance level 1: Inhale time modifier (affects counter to how long char inhales)
Value determines how long the characters inhales (adds bloom). Links to exhaleModifier1. Higher value means shorter timer, lower means longer.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryisoCursorBlue: Linked to iso cursor color. Pick a color value from 0 to 255 and divide it by 255, must be from 0 to 1.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryisoCursorGree: Linked to iso cursor color. Pick a color value from 0 to 255 and divide it by 255, must be from 0 to 1.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryisoCursorRed_: Linked to iso cursor color. Pick a color value from 0 to 255 and divide it by 255, must be from 0 to 1.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryisoCursorTran: Linked to iso cursor transparency. Must be from 0 to 1.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorymaxBulletDist: After certain distance, bullet will be removed from the world. Purpose is to prevent error when bullet is removed in an unrendered tile/chunk
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorymaxDefenseRed: Max Defense (Max Damage Reduction Multiplier | PVP)
ex. 0.9 means reduces incoming damage by 90%% when armor is maxed; applies to armor
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorymaxFocusSpeed: Part of the focus mechanic. Determines speed of crosshair reducing aimnum to 0 once process has begun.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorymaxShotgunPro: Shotgun has a max independent projectile cone.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorymaxaimnum_too: Value that limits how much bloom is added to crosshair. Higher means larger possible bloom.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryminDamageToGe: Minimum Damage for Zombie to React to Projectile Hit
Minimum damage that needs to be done to zombie for it to react to projectile hit.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryminaimnumModi: Value that affects crosshair's minimum bloom. Characters with low aiming level (0-2) will never be accurate (always has bloom). Set to 0 if you want to be OP or unlock focus mechanic at level 3.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorymissMax_toolt: Must be greater than min. Bullet misses if currentBloom > rand(minMiss + buff + aimLevel*hitScaling, maxMiss)
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorymissMinTransp: Makes crosshair slightly transparent when bloom reaches "Min Miss" value so players know when they'll start having a chance of missing.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorymissMin_toolt: Must be less than max. Bullet misses if currentBloom > rand(minMiss + buff + aimLevel*hitScaling, maxMiss)
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorymoveeffect_to: Value that adds bloom when moving.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorypainModifier_: This value must be very small as it affects how slow your crosshair reduces bloom.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorypanicPenaltyM: Multiplier that determines how much panic increases the penalty affect when aiming at farther targets.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorypenDamageRedu: Ex: 0.1 means nerf bullet damage by 90%% after penetrating through first zombie/player.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorypointBlankMax: Max distance for point blank to register when projectile detects zombie in its proximity. Set to 0 to pretty much disable it.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryproneExpoReco: Multiplier that affects how much bloom is added depending on the previous bloom value the player shot at. Lower means less added bloom as you continue spraying.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryproneFocusCou: When proning, you gain max accuracy faster (applies when focus mechanic is unlocked).
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryproneFocusLim: Prone Buff: Reduce minimum bloom limit
Reduces minimum bloom limit by a percentage; lower means smaller crosshair"
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryproneReduceSp: When proning, your crosshair reduces bloom faster. Helpful after intense cardio.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryproneTurnEffe: Bloom addition rate when turning while prone
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryrecoilDelayMo: Linked to Focus Counter Speed. Part of the focus mechanic. Weapon's recoil delay affects how long it takes for character to recover from recoil and this is a multiplier of that. Set to 0 to ignore weapon's recoil delay stat.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryrecoilModifie: Multiplier of gun's max dmg added as recoil to crosshair (adds bloom when shooting).
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryrecoilScaleMo: Affects exponential growth of recoil (how much bloom is added depending on the previous bloom value the player shot at). Lower means less added bloom as you continue spraying.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryreducespeed_t: Value that affects how fast your crosshair tightens. Higher means faster.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryreloadEffectM: Value affects how much bloom is added when reloading and racking firearm.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryrunNGunBuff_t: Multiplier that reduces penalty for moving and turning. 0.25 means 75%% reduction to penalty.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryrunNGunLv: Level with Run and Gun Unlocked
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryshotgunDistan: Multiplier on base stat (range) of shotgun. Default value is 0.75 which means 75%% of vanilla's range.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryshotgunHitBuf: A flat value that gives a flat increase in chances of hitting zombies with a shotgun.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryshotgundivisi: Value affects shotgun spread. The lower the value, the more narrow the spread.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorystaminaCrawlS: Stamina Consumption when Switching Crawl Stance (Overall)
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorystaminaCrouch: Stamina Consumption when Switching Crouch Stance (Overall)
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorystaminaHeavyC: Stamina Consumption when Switching Crawl Stance (Heavy Moodle Scaling)
Multiplier that scales off of heavy moodle level
Stamina Consumption when Switching Crouch Stance (Heavy Moodle Scaling)
Multiplier that scales off of heavy moodle level
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorystressBloomMo: Multiplier that affects how much is added to minaimnum or minimum bloom.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorystressVisualM: Affects how intense the crosshair shaking affect is. Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorythroughChance: Chance that a gunshot wound will not inflict a lodged bullet
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectorytiredModifier: Slower bloom reduction rate (Fatigue/Tired Moodle Scaling)
Multiplier that affects how slow your crosshair reduces bloom.
Sandbox_Advanced_trajectoryturningeffect: Value that adds bloom when physically turning your feet, not hips.
Sandbox_AegisAirdropCount_tooltip: Number of zombies dropping from the sky.
Sandbox_AegisAirdropHeight_tooltip: Height in levels the zombies fall from.
Sandbox_AegisAirdropRadius_tooltip: Spread of the zombies around your position.
Sandbox_AegisAmbushCount_tooltip: Number of crawlers appearing around you.
Sandbox_AegisAmbushRadius_tooltip: Spread of the crawlers around your position.
Sandbox_AegisAmbushRain_tooltip: Rain starts when the ambush triggers.

Sandbox_AegisFirestormHours_tooltip: Duration of the triggered storm in hours.
Sandbox_AegisFirestormThunder_tooltip: Number of thunder strikes in the volley, 0 disables it.
Sandbox_AegisFirestormWaves_tooltip: Number of burning groups, each from its own direction.
Sandbox_AegisHeliCount_tooltip: Size of the approaching horde, 0 keeps it helicopter only.
Sandbox_AegisHeliDistance_tooltip: Distance of the approaching horde in tiles.
Sandbox_AegisHeliRadius_tooltip: Spread of the zombies around the start point.
Sandbox_AegisPlayerAutoAdminPowers_toolt: Whether godmode, invisibility and noclip switch on by themselves the moment a character gains an admin access level (vanilla behaviour). Turn off to keep them off until you enable them yourself. The full heal and hunger/thirst reset that comes with the same promotion cannot be prevented, that part is engine internal.
Sandbox_AegisPlayerClaims_tooltip: Lets players claim a zone at their own safehouse within their role budget. Off blocks every claim regardless of roles.
Sandbox_AegisPlayerHealthInfection_toolt: Whether the player area's health page tells a player outright if they carry the real zombie infection. Vanilla keeps that uncertain on purpose, turn this off to keep the suspense. Wound infection and other injuries still show either way.
Sandbox_AegisPlayerKits_tooltip: The kits page in the player area, booster redeeming included. Off hides it for everyone; the kit editor for admins keeps working.
Sandbox_AegisPlayerPanel_tooltip: Off: nobody gets the blue player panel, admins included. The golden admin panel is untouched.
Sandbox_AegisPlayerStatsForAdmins_toolti: Whether kills, deaths, distance and best life get recorded for characters currently on an admin access level. On by default, turn off so admin testing does not skew the numbers.
Sandbox_AegisPlayerVehicles_tooltip: How many vehicles a player may keep on the vehicles page of the player area. 0 turns remembering off. Ignored where Knox Claim runs, that mod brings its own limit. Vehicles already remembered are never dropped when you lower this.
Sandbox_AegisSiegeCrawlers_tooltip: Waves consist of crawlers (sprinters take precedence).
Sandbox_AegisSiegeDistance_tooltip: Distance of the first wave in tiles. Very high values are outside the loaded area, nothing spawns there.
Sandbox_AegisSiegeGap_tooltip: Additional tiles of distance per further wave.
Sandbox_AegisSiegeGunshot_tooltip: An audible gunshot marks the start.
Sandbox_AegisSiegeLureMinutes_tooltip: Minutes the noise lure keeps pulsing at the activation spot. The horde walks there, not after the admin.
Sandbox_AegisSiegeRadius_tooltip: Spread of the zombies around the wave start point.
Sandbox_AegisSiegeWaves_tooltip: How many horde waves the siege sends out.
Sandbox_AegisStormHours_tooltip: Duration of the triggered storm in hours.
Sandbox_AegisStormThunder_tooltip: Number of thunder strikes in the volley, 0 disables it.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropAllowAmmoLoot_: Allows ammunition boxes in the weighted loot tables.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropAllowFoodLoot_: Allows food and water in the weighted loot tables.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropAllowMedicalLo: Allows bandages, disinfectants and medical supplies.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropAllowMilitaryL: Allows weapons, military accessories and military clothing in the weighted loot tables.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropAllowRareLoot_: Allows controlled rare items. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropAllowSurvivalL: Allows survival items such as matches, tarps, knives and water purification tablets.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropAllowToolsLoot: Allows useful tools such as hammers, saws, crowbars and hand axes.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropCraterDecorati: Adds scorched floor tiles/overlays around the crate, with a safe fallback if a sprite fails.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDeadBodyMax_to: Maximum number of dead bodies created near the airdrop when decorations are enabled.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDeadBodyMin_to: Minimum number of dead bodies created near the airdrop when decorations are enabled.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDirectionArrow: When enabled, only the direction arrow points to the exact crate. The world-map circle remains approximate.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropFixedPointSear: Radius, in tiles, used around each fixed point to find a loaded valid square if the exact point is not valid.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropIntervalHours_: Real server hours between automatic attempts to create an airdrop.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropLifetimeMinute: Real minutes before the server removes the container, timer and marker.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropLocationMaxAtt: Maximum number of candidate points tested around the player before canceling the spawn attempt.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropLootDifficulty: Multiplies the world-difficulty adjustment applied to airdrop loot.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropLootLevel_tool: Controls the default loot quality and category weights for each airdrop.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropMarkerApproxRa: Radius, in tiles, of the approximate circle shown only inside the world map. It does not reveal the exact crate.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropMarkerColor_to: Color used by the blinking map circle and direction arrow.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropMaxActiveEvent: Kept at 1 for safety: the server should never have more than one active airdrop at a time.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropMaxDistanceFro: Maximum distance, in tiles, used when searching for a valid location around the selected player.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropMaxItems_toolt: Maximum number of items generated inside the airdrop container. Ignored when level defaults are enabled.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropMaxSameItemRep: Maximum number of times the same item can appear in one airdrop.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropMinDistanceFro: Minimum distance, in tiles, between the selected player and the airdrop location.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropMode_tooltip: Mode 1 picks one player and sends a private marker. Mode 2 uses fixed map points and sends the marker/timer to every online player.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropShowDirectionA: Shows a world direction arrow pointing toward the airdrop marker.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropShowMapMarker_: Shows an approximate circle only inside the world map. It does not create a ground circle.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropSpawnDecoratio: Adds bodies, blood and scorched marks around the airdrop. It does not cause real map damage.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropTriggerChopper: When enabled, the server asks an online admin client to execute /chopper after a successful airdrop spawn.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropUseLootLevelDe: When enabled, the selected loot level controls item count and category weights. Zombie settings stay manual unless the option below is enabled.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropUseLootLevelZo: When enabled, the selected loot level overrides the manual zombie count, spawn radius and sprinter chance.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropZombieMax_tool: Maximum number of zombies created around the airdrop. Ignored only when loot-tier zombie settings are enabled.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropZombieMin_tool: Minimum number of zombies created around the airdrop. Ignored only when loot-tier zombie settings are enabled.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropZombieSpawnRad: Radius, in tiles, used to distribute event zombies around the container. Ignored only when loot-tier zombie settings are enabled.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropZombieSprinter: Chance that each event zombie becomes a sprinter. Set to 0 to disable sprinters from airdrops.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_Debug_tooltip: Logs spawn, location validation, loot, zombies and cleanup details to the server log.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_Enabled_tooltip: Enables or disables the server-side airdrop event scheduler.

Sandbox_AlwaysKnowRoads_tooltip: New Characters start with knowledge of their immediate location and Kentucky's Roads.
Sandbox_AmbientCityLights.ActiveLightsPe: Controls how many supported city lights stay lit after the power grid shuts down. The selection is not rerolled when loading the game and is the same for every player in multiplayer. At 100%%, the full city lighting remains.
Sandbox_AmbientCityLights.Enabled_toolti: Allows streetlights, illuminated signs, and supported outdoor lights to keep lighting urban areas at night after the power grid shuts down. Homes, appliances, and fuel pumps remain unpowered.
Sandbox_AmbientCityLights.FlickeringLigh: Allows every supported light to develop a rare fault. Most only flicker briefly, while some may go dark for several in-game hours. The pattern is the same for every player in multiplayer.
Sandbox_AmbientCityLights.LightDecay_too: Allows more lights to fail over time after the power grid shuts down. The selected period determines when the amount set under “Lights Remaining” is reached. Existing worlds never count earlier days retroactively. Switching this option off temporarily restores the amount set under “Active Lights”. Switching it back on continues the previous failures.
Sandbox_AmbientCityLights.MinimumActiveL: Controls the minimum number of lights that remain working as more lights fail. If this value is higher than Active Lights, the lower value is used.
Sandbox_AmingEffectMultiplier_tooltip: Scales how strongly the Aiming skill impacts upgrade success and accuracy bonuses.

Sandbox_ArcadiaQOLSafehouse_AllowAdminSa: Allow full admins to grant safehouses above the ownership limit

When enabled, only a role with full B42 admin power may deliberately grant additional safehouses above Maximum safehouses owned per player. This applies to staff-approved requests, manual-zone owner assignment and admin ownership transfers. Player self-claims always remain capped, including for admins. Moderators cannot override the limit. Default: On.
Sandbox_ArcadiaQOLSafehouse_ClosedSafeho: How long closed safehouse review requests remain visible in the active staff request list before automatic cleanup. Open requests are never auto-removed. Default: 30 days.
Sandbox_ArcadiaQOLSafehouse_EnableCustom: Enable wilderness claim management and review tickets

Controls Arcadia's staff-reviewed Request Wilderness Claim, Expand Safehouse Claim, My Requests, and staff ticket actions. Turning this Off pauses ticket submission and management without deleting existing requests. Residential and verified RV Interior claims, existing safehouses, membership, ownership, and native safehouse functions remain available. Default: On.
Sandbox_ArcadiaQOLSafehouse_EnableMultiS: Enables validated membership in multiple safehouses through the normal Add Player (Online / Offline) picker. Online, offline, first, and additional safehouse memberships use the same server-authoritative add route. Turning this option Off blocks only additional memberships. Default: On.
Sandbox_ArcadiaQOLSafehouse_EnableOfflin: Enables the offline route in the normal Add Player (Online / Offline) faction picker. Online targets still receive Build 42's native invitation; remembered offline targets use the validated server workflow. Vanilla's one-faction-per-player rule remains enforced.
Sandbox_ArcadiaQOLSafehouse_EnableSafeho: Adds every safehouse the player owns or belongs to directly to Build 42's normal post-death spawn-location screen. Players may instead choose Default Map Spawn Locations to use B42's normal map respawn choices before character creation. Safehouse choices are validated by the server and become that player's only active safehouse respawn. Default: On.
Sandbox_ArcadiaQOLSafehouse_FixMapAllKno: When enabled together with the vanilla MapAllKnown option, the large world map shows discovered roads, buildings and cities instead of hiding them behind Hide Unvisited Areas. Existing exploration data and map annotations are not erased or changed. Default: On.
Sandbox_ArcadiaQOLSafehouse_KeyRingsNeve: Key rings never drop on death

Keeps vanilla and decorative Base.KeyRing variants with the player through death when possible, including the keys stored inside them. Server-wide setting. Default: Off. Requires a server restart after changing.
Sandbox_ArcadiaQOLSafehouse_MaxOwnedSafe: Maximum number of safehouses one player may claim or own. A first residential claim uses Build 42's native workflow; additional residential and RV Interior claims use Arcadia's validated server workflow. Membership in other players' claims is separate. Full admins may deliberately grant additional ownership above this limit; moderators and players cannot. Default: 3.
Sandbox_ArcadiaQOLSafehouse_ShowAllPlaye: Continuously show all players on the minimap

Global multiplayer setting. When enabled, every client continuously displays all server-supplied remote players and their names on the minimap. The dedicated-server MapRemotePlayerVisibility option must be 4 so all positions are supplied. Native invisible-staff privacy is still respected. Default: Off.
Sandbox_ArcadiaQOLSafehouse_ShowDiscover: When enabled together with the vanilla MapAllKnown option, the minimap shows the discovered map instead of covering it with unexplored-area fog. This does not rewrite exploration data or map annotations. Default: On.

Sandbox_AutoDrop_ContextualBagFilter_too: Context menu allows to filter what item category is allowed in each bag.
Sandbox_AutoDrop_ContextualInhibiter_too: Context menu allows to inhibit any kind of container.
Sandbox_AutoDrop_ContextualPriority_tool: Context menu allows set a priority for each bag.
Sandbox_AutoDrop_LootMode_tooltip: Allows to override Mod Options client selection
Sandbox_AutoFitness_ShowMuscleStiffness_: Removes Debug Requirement to See Muscle Stiffness
Sandbox_AutoForage_Context_tooltip: Turn on if you want to control through context
Sandbox_AutoForage_UI_tooltip: Turn on to have UI added to search manager
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_CatchUpOnChunkLo: When a chunk loads, immediately reconcile any timer-configured lights so they match their schedule. Disable if this causes performance issues.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_DefaultOffHour_t: Hour (0-23) prefilled in the timer dialog for newly-configured lights.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_DefaultOffMin_to: Minute (0-59) prefilled in the timer dialog for newly-configured lights.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_DefaultOnHour_to: Hour (0-23) prefilled in the timer dialog for newly-configured lights.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_DefaultOnMin_too: Minute (0-59) prefilled in the timer dialog for newly-configured lights.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_Enabled_tooltip: Master toggle for the mod. Disable to revert to vanilla behavior.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_MotionSensorDefa: Minutes (1-60) prefilled in the motion-sensor dialog. Controls how long the light stays on after the last detected motion.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_MotionSensorDete: When enabled, motion sensors trigger on zombies in addition to players — useful for spotting an intruder from a distance, but adds per-square scanning cost. Disable to reduce CPU load on busy servers or if you find it gives away too much.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_MotionSensorEnab: Master toggle for the motion-sensor switch feature. When off, installed sensors stop reacting to players (and craft recipes still work but installs are blocked).
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_MotionSensorPoll: How often motion sensors check for nearby players, in game-tick frames. Lower = snappier response, higher = lower CPU cost. Default 10 ≈ 6 polls per second at 60 FPS.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_MotionSensorSkil: Minimum Electrical skill to install or configure a motion sensor when the item requirement above is off. Set to 0 for no gate.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_OutdoorMotionSen: Tile radius (1-20) within which an Outdoor Motion Sensor will detect players. Indoor sensors ignore this and use room boundaries instead.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_RequireMotionSen: When enabled, players must craft and install an Indoor or Outdoor Motion Sensor item to motion-enable a light. When disabled, the skill gate below applies instead.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_RequireTimerItem: When enabled, players must craft a Light Timer item and install it on a light before they can set a schedule. When disabled, any light can be configured directly, gated only by the Required Electrical skill below.
Sandbox_AutoLightTimers_RequiredElectric: Minimum Electrical skill to configure a light timer. Only applies when "Require Timer item" is off — otherwise the skill cost is in crafting the Timer. Set to 0 for no gate.
Sandbox_AutoLoot_ContextualAddRemove_too: Context menu allows to add/remove an item type.
Sandbox_AutoLoot_ContextualBagFilter_too: Context menu allows to filter what item category is allowed in each bag.
Sandbox_AutoLoot_ContextualInhibiter_too: Context menu allows to inhibit any kind of container.
Sandbox_AutoLoot_ContextualPriority_tool: Context menu allows set a priority for each bag.
Sandbox_AutoLoot_LootMode_tooltip: Allows to override Mod Options client selection
Sandbox_AutoMechanics_ConditionLossPerce: Accepted risk percentage of losing part condition. <LINE> 0 (recommended for public servers) will protect your vehicles parts conditions. <LINE> 100 let players do whatever they want (recommended for private servers). <LINE> Only active on multiplayer clients or solo users with Verbose on.
Sandbox_AutoPick_tooltip:
ENABLED - mod picks the best available bandage and offers it in the context menu.
DISABLED - mod shows a submenu with all available bandages for manual selection.
Sandbox_AutoSearch_tooltip:
ENABLED - mod searches for bandages in all containers (inventory, backpacks, nearby items, etc.).
DISABLED - mod searches for bandages in the inventory only.
Sandbox_AutoTranslate_tooltip:
ENABLED - mod tries to translate context menu actions to your local language using in-game translations.
DISABLED - mod uses the translations that come in a package.
Note: might not work the best for all languages.
Sandbox_AutomaticRefueling_CanPumpBeDama: Whether a pump can be damaged by driving off without having stopped the refuel process
Sandbox_AutomaticRefueling_CanPumpBeRepa: Whether a damaged pump can be repaired. Only relevant if "Pumps can be damaged" is enabled
Sandbox_AutomaticRefueling_LitersPerMinu: How much liters of fuel the pump will provide per ingame minute
Sandbox_AutomaticRefueling_MaxDistance_t: The maximum distance a vehicle can move away from the pump, before it cuts off
Sandbox_AutomaticRefueling_PumpRepairDur: How many seconds in real-time it takes to repair a damaged pump. Only relevant if "Pumps can be damaged" is enabled
Sandbox_AutomaticRefueling_PumpSoundRadi: The tile-radius in which the fuel pump sound will attract zombies (0 disables the sound)
Sandbox_AutomaticRefueling_RemoveOrigina: Remove original and tsarslib (Autotsar) fueling options
Whether to remove the original pump-refuel and tsarslib option where you have to wait by the car
Sandbox_AutomaticSensorDoor_TerminalFloo: Maximum floor difference above or below the terminal for pairing and live status. 0 means the same floor only. Existing registrations are retained if this value is reduced. Default: 0.
Sandbox_AutomaticSensorDoor_TerminalRang: Maximum horizontal tile distance for sensor pairing and live terminal status. Existing registrations are retained if this value is reduced. Default: 40.
Sandbox_AxeMaul_SpawnRate_tooltip: Sets the extra spawn rate of Axe-Mauls
Sandbox_AxeUpgradeCap_tooltip: For option 2 of Max Upgrade Handling - applies to Axe category weapons
Sandbox_BAM.min_success_chance: Enforce: Minimum Vehicle Part Success Chance
Sandbox_BAM.min_success_chance_tooltip: Parts with a success chance below this value will be skipped during training. <LINE> At '-1' this setting is not enforced, any value over '-1' is enforced server-wide. <LINE>  <LINE> 0%% -> All parts will be worked on. Parts will break at lower skill levels. <LINE> 30%% -> Default setting for a good balance. <LINE> 100%% -> Only parts that are guaranteed to succeed will be worked on. Completely safe at all skill levels.
Sandbox_BCGRareWeapons_KatanaMinDays_too: The katana will not spawn in loot until this many days have been survived in the current world. Zero leaves vanilla untouched, which has no day limit on containers.
Sandbox_BCGRareWeapons_ReinforcedBasebal: Reinforced Baseball Bat minimum days survived
The Reinforced Baseball Bat will not spawn in loot until this many days have been survived in the current world. Zero means it can appear from the start.
Sandbox_BCGRareWeapons_VikingAxeMinDays_: The Viking Axe will not spawn in loot until this many days have been survived in the current world. Zero means it can appear from the start.

Sandbox_BEP.Bounties: Hidden Stash Network: the Captain drops buried arsenal coordinates
Sandbox_BEP.Dialogues: Bandits shout when hurt, reloading or when an ally falls
Sandbox_BEP.FakeSurrender: Bandits may fake a surrender and then betray you
Sandbox_BEP.HordeBait: Bandits lure zombie hordes onto you
Sandbox_BEP.Loot: Bandits carry background notes and letters

Sandbox_BEP.MarketRarity: MaurinBombin Market rarity (higher = shows up far less often)
Sandbox_BEP.Meds: Wounded bandits patch themselves up mid-fight
Sandbox_BEP.Morale: Squad morale: bandits flee once their group takes heavy losses
Sandbox_BEP.Negotiator: Bandits demand your gear instead of shooting on sight
Sandbox_BEP.Radio: Bandits call in reinforcements by radio
Sandbox_BEP.Roadblock: Evaristo's Toll: abandoned roadblocks and their ambush
Sandbox_BEP.Sidearm: Bandits switch to a sidearm at close range
Sandbox_BEP.SmokeAmbush: Bandits use smoke bombs to flank
Sandbox_BEP.TeamPVC: Team PVC: the unique named elite squad
Sandbox_BEP.TeamPVCDebut: Guarantee Team PVC shows up within the first 15 days
Sandbox_BEP.Torch: Bandits use a flashlight at night
Sandbox_BF_EnableDefecationTraits_toolti: Toggle whether this save permits defecation related traits.
Sandbox_BF_EnableFecalFootprints_option1: Neither players nor zombies can track poop when walking on poop.
Sandbox_BF_EnableFecalFootprints_option2: Players (no zombies) can track poop if they stand on it. Should be optimized.
Sandbox_BF_EnableFecalFootprints_option3: Both players and zombies can track poop if they stand on it. May be unoptimized.

Sandbox_BF_PoopOnGroundRequirement_toolt: Bowel fullness to poop on ground.
Sandbox_BF_PoopOnSelfRequirement_tooltip: Bowel fullness to intentionally poop self.

Sandbox_BGD_SandboxOptions_MaxSize: Maximum allowed garage door size, in tiles
Sandbox_BGD_SandboxOptions_MaxSize_toolt:
Set the maximum allowed size for garage doors

Example:
3 mean only 3-tiles doors are allowed (left, middle, right)
4 mean 3-tiles and 4-tiles are allowed (left, middle, right) and (left, middle, middle, right)

Sandbox_BLTRandomZombies_Frequency_toolt: [ADVANCED OPTION] The interval in milliseconds between two updates. Higher number means less CPU usage, lower number means less correctness issues

Sandbox_BVD_EnginePower_tooltip: Scales how much pulling force every engine makes. Below 1 feels gutless; above 1 makes hills and ramming trivial.
Sandbox_BVD_GripLevel_tooltip: Overall traction budget. Lower means the car steps out and spins up more readily.
Sandbox_BVD_KeylessTow_tooltip: When off, easy-tow needs keys in the ignition or the parking brake released.
Sandbox_BVD_LoadAffectsFuel_tooltip: Carrying a heavy load burns extra fuel while driving.
Sandbox_BVD_LoadAffectsHandling_tooltip: A heavily loaded vehicle is slow to pull away from a stop, as if the engine is straining against the weight.
Sandbox_BVD_LoadMaxPenalty: Max launch penalty when fully loaded
Sandbox_BVD_LoadMaxPenalty_tooltip: Biggest drop in launch force for a fully loaded vehicle (0.50 = up to 50%% less force from a stop). Fades out as the vehicle speeds up. Requires 'Load affects handling'.
Sandbox_BVD_LowSpeedGrunt_tooltip: Extra pulling force available at very low wheel speed — the force used to push wrecks and shove through crowds. Lower it for a weaker, more cautious low-end.
Sandbox_BVD_Mode_tooltip: Custom keeps every slider below as you set it. The other presets snap drivetrain, grip and shove values to a curated profile when the world loads.
Sandbox_BVD_OffroadFloor_tooltip: Minimum off-road grip multiplier any tire family can fall to. Without this, sports-tire profiles can drop off-road grip so low a high-HP car barely moves on grass. Default 0.55 keeps brute-force motion possible (the car will slip and chew tires, but it moves).
Sandbox_BVD_OffroadGrip_tooltip: Off-road grip strength. HIGHER = more grip (less tire slip) on dirt, grass and gravel. Default 0.85 = moderate slip; 1.5 = near-paved feel. Does not change rolling drag - tune that via Rolling drag off-road.
Sandbox_BVD_RealismHPWeight_tooltip: Replaces engine force and mass for the covered vanilla vehicles with Better Vehicle Dynamics' own researched reference figures (see BVD_VehicleData.lua; modded vehicles can register their own via the public API).
Sandbox_BVD_RollResistanceOffroad_toolti: Extra rolling resistance when off sealed road.
Sandbox_BVD_RollResistance_tooltip: Resistance from tires on sealed surfaces. Affects coasting and steady-state speed.
Sandbox_BVD_ShoveCorpses_tooltip: Force imparted to bodies and gibs on the ground.
Sandbox_BVD_ShoveFoliage_tooltip: Force the body transfers into bushes and small plants on contact.
Sandbox_BVD_ShoveZombies_tooltip: Force imparted to living zombies struck by the vehicle.
Sandbox_BVD_SkidMarks_tooltip: Leaves a ground decal when a tire breaks loose under power or hard braking.
Sandbox_BVD_SkidSound_tooltip: Plays a tire-screech sound when a vehicle is sliding. Independent of the tire-marks visual. Disable if the sound is bothering you or if a sound mod conflicts.
Sandbox_BVD_SnowGrip_tooltip: Fraction of normal grip on snow-covered ground.
Sandbox_BVD_StabilityGuardSinkTiles_tool: How far below its own level's floor a vehicle must sink before the guard re-seats it, measured in floor levels (0.75 = three-quarters of one level). Lower reacts sooner; raise it if a custom map ever triggers it wrongly. Requires 'Vehicle ground-clip guard'.
Sandbox_BVD_StabilityGuard_tooltip: Safety net for multiplayer: if a vehicle sinks far below the floor of the level it is on (the 'sucked into the ground' desync), it is snapped back onto that floor. Only acts on a state that is never reached by normal driving, so ramps, basements and multi-level parking are unaffected.
Sandbox_BVD_SteeringCenteringHighSpeed_t: Multiplier on how quickly the wheels return to center at high speed.
Sandbox_BVD_SteeringCenteringLowSpeed_to: Multiplier on how quickly the wheels return to center at low speed.
Sandbox_BVD_SteeringFactorHighSpeed_tool: Multiplier on how quickly the wheels turn at high speed.
Sandbox_BVD_SteeringFactorLowSpeed_toolt: Multiplier on how quickly the wheels turn at low speed.
Sandbox_BVD_SteeringHighSpeed_tooltip: Speed (km/h) at which steering uses the high-speed response and centering values instead of the low-speed ones.
Sandbox_BVD_SteeringSnapback_tooltip: Multiplier on how quickly the wheels turn while a drift is held.
Sandbox_BVD_ThrottleStart_tooltip: When off, the engine must be started deliberately (start key or the engine icon) rather than by pressing accelerate.
Sandbox_BVD_TireGripModel_tooltip: Different tire types (worn / standard / modern) get distinct grip on road, rain, snow and off-road instead of one flat value.
Sandbox_BVD_TireSlipWearRate_tooltip: Multiplier on how fast tires degrade while slipping. 1.0 is the default (a few minutes of hard slipping noticeably degrades them). Set to 0 to disable wear without disabling the model.
Sandbox_BVD_TireSlipWear_tooltip: When the engine is forcing the wheels faster than the surface can grip (e.g. flooring it on grass) tires lose condition over time. Lets you brute-force through low-grip surfaces - at the cost of bald tires later.
Sandbox_BVD_TrunkCar_tooltip: Multiplier on this body type's reference storage. 1.0 keeps the reference value.
Sandbox_BVD_TrunkScaling_tooltip: Scales each vehicle's storage by a per-body-type factor instead of overwriting it. Auto-disabled when 'isoContainers' is present.
Sandbox_BVD_TrunkTrailer_tooltip: Multiplier on this body type's reference storage. 1.0 keeps the reference value.
Sandbox_BVD_TrunkTruck_tooltip: Multiplier on this body type's reference storage. 1.0 keeps the reference value.
Sandbox_BVD_TrunkVan_tooltip: Multiplier on this body type's reference storage. 1.0 keeps the reference value.
Sandbox_BVD_WetGrip_tooltip: Fraction of normal grip while it is raining.
Sandbox_BWOA.AngelProximity_tooltip: Extra help in discovering unique points of interest.
Sandbox_BWOA.ArkGeneratorFuelConsumption: Controls how much fuel the Ark generators consume.
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_option1: Very fast rise + Very slow decay
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_option5: Very slow rise + very fast decay
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_tooltip: Controls the rise and decay speed of the fallout period
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutEnds_tooltip: Impacts radiation and weather conditions duration as well as the duration of the storyline.
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutStarted_tooltip: Impacts initial radiation and weather conditions.
Sandbox_BWOA.HostileGroupSize_tooltip: Determines the typical size of hostile survivor groups.
Sandbox_BWOA.MemoryRegain_tooltip: Player can regain some skills over time or by interacting with certain objects.
Sandbox_BWOA.ResidueScrap_tooltip: Controls how much scrap materials exist in the world.
Sandbox_BWOA.RetroRadiation_tooltip: Player inventory can get radiated from ground items.
Sandbox_BWOA.ShelterOccurance_tooltip: Impacts how often random procedurally generated basements will occur. These are independent from normal basements.
Sandbox_BWOA.SkeletonReanimation_tooltip: (MAY LEAD TO GAME CRASH!) Skeletons have some chance of reanimation.
Sandbox_BWOA.TemperatureDrop_tooltip: Controls how cold the nuclear winter is.

Sandbox_BagBottomWeaponAttach_EnablePosi: Enable bottom attachment debug adjust UI
Allows right-clicking inventory items currently attached to bag-bottom slots to open a live offset/rotation adjustment window.
Sandbox_BagBottomWeaponAttach_EnableSmal: Enable small belt-type items on bag bottom
Allows belt-sized items such as knives, hammers, radios, and holstered sidearms to use bag-bottom attachment slots. These positions are generic and may need per-user adjustment with the debug UI.
Sandbox_BagUpgradePlus_UpgradedBagSpawnC: Controls how often zombies carry upgraded bags. 0 = Never, 100 = Always. Default: 10 (Rare)
Sandbox_BalancePreset_tooltip: Quickly applies a tuned set of values for toxic and attack events.
Sandbox_BallisticHelmetsOptions_Ballisti: Off by default, since modern ballistic helmets are anachronistic for 1993. When disabled, the Ballistic Helmets never spawns in loot or on military zombies - the period-accurate Pro-Tec/Delta helmets are unaffected either way.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_BackupDelayBadMax_: Increased maximum delay during poor visibility (Night/Rain/Fog).
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_BackupDelayBadMin_: Increased minimum delay during poor visibility (Night/Rain/Fog).
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_BackupDelayMax_too: Maximum seconds until backup arrives under normal conditions.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_BackupDelayMin_too: Minimum seconds until backup arrives under normal conditions.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_BackupSquadSize_to: Determines the number of bandits (1 to 10) that will arrive as reinforcements after a radio call.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_EnableExecution_to: If disabled, executioners won't approach and say lines; they will just shoot the surrendered bandit from a distance.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_EnableRadioSystem_: Master switch. If disabled, bandits will not drop radios or call for backup.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_EnableRadioText_to: Enables floating 3D text above dropped radios.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_EnableSurrender_to: Master switch. If disabled, bandits will fight to the death and never surrender.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_EnableWeaponDrop_t: Bandits will drop their equipped weapons on the ground when killed.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_RadioDropChance_to: Chance (0-100%%) for a killed bandit to drop an active radio.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_RadioVolume_toolti: Controls the volume level of the active walkie-talkie audio static and effects (0 to 100).
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_SurrenderLootAmoun: Determines how much loot (food, meds, ammo) is generated in the bags dropped by surrendered bandits.
Sandbox_Bandits.Addon_UseVanillaBackupAI: Addon: Use Vanilla AI for Backup

If enabled, reinforcements will use standard bandit AI programs from the base mod instead of custom search/CQB programs (they will still move to the radio coordinates initially). Enable this if backup bandits behave buggy.
Sandbox_Bandits.ArrivalIcon: Icon marker leading to bandit spawn point
Sandbox_Bandits.ArrivalIcon_tooltip: When ON, a red (raid) or green (friendly) marker appears near screen edge when a new NPC group arrives at your position. When OFF, no early warning.
Sandbox_Bandits.ArrivalWakeUp: Attacking bandits wake up targeted player
Sandbox_Bandits.BaseSpawnHourlyChance: Bandit base/camp hourly spawn chance (if location allows) [%%]
Sandbox_Bandits.BleedOut: Hurt Bandits may bleed and die
Sandbox_Bandits.BleedOut_tooltip: When ON, NPCs bleeding heavily may die minutes after combat ends without medical care. When OFF, NPCs stabilize automatically after combat.
Sandbox_Bandits.BuildBridge: Bandits may build bridges on water
Sandbox_Bandits.BuildBridge_tooltip: When ON, hostile Strangers mod clans may construct wooden bridges over rivers. Rare feature. When OFF, bridges are not built.
Sandbox_Bandits.BuildRoadblock_tooltip: When ON, hostiles may build small ambush roadblocks (cars, debris, snipers) on highways. When OFF, no roadblocks spawn.
Sandbox_Bandits.Captions_tooltip: When ON, colored text captions appear above NPC heads during combat ('Take cover!', 'Reloading!', 'Argh!'). Green=friendly, Red=hostile. When OFF, no captions.
Sandbox_Bandits.CarryTorches_tooltip: When ON, NPCs auto-equip flashlights/torches at night for visibility. When OFF, they walk in darkness.
Sandbox_Bandits.CorpseSwapper: Attempt to remove frozen standing corpses
Sandbox_Bandits.CorpseSwapper_tooltip: When ON, killed NPC corpses stay visible on ground with correct clothing/gear. When OFF, corpses may despawn or lose visual details.
Sandbox_Bandits.DefenderLootAmount_toolt: Rarity of items dropped when you kill a hostile NPC (guarding a base). 1=poor, 5=medium, 10=rich. Higher = more/rarer items on corpse.
Sandbox_Bandits.DefenderMaxOccupants: Maximum number of bandit defenders in a buidling
Sandbox_Bandits.DensityScore: Bandit spawn rate boosted in towns and lowered in secluded areas
Sandbox_Bandits.DensityScore_tooltip: When ON, NPCs spawn MORE often in cities/towns and LESS in wilderness. When OFF, spawn rate is uniform everywhere.
Sandbox_Bandits.DestroyDoor_tooltip: When ON, hostile NPCs raiding your base will break down locked doors. When OFF, doors are impenetrable to NPCs.
Sandbox_Bandits.DestroyThumpable: Bandits may destroy player build structures
Sandbox_Bandits.DestroyThumpable_tooltip: When ON, hostiles can smash player-built walls, gates, and thumpable objects. When OFF, your builds are indestructible to NPCs (only zombies attack them).
Sandbox_Bandits.EnableHostileSurvivors_t: When ON, hostile NPC clans (Strangers, Criminals, Bikers, Mentals, etc — 16 hostile groups) spawn and attack you on sight. When OFF, ALL NPCs behave as neutral/friendly (no raids, no hostile encounters). Default ON for full apocalypse experience.
Sandbox_Bandits.EnemyBehaviour_option2_t: Dangerous Bandits able to track you in any location.
Sandbox_Bandits.EnemyBehaviour_option4_t: Stationary Bandits that acivate when see players.
Sandbox_Bandits.EnemyBehaviour_option5_t: They steal and never attack first.
Sandbox_Bandits.EnterVehicles_tooltip: When ON, NPCs (companions + hostiles) can enter cars and use them (drive, ride shotgun, follow you in vehicles). When OFF, they stay on foot only.
Sandbox_Bandits.FirstDay_tooltip: The number of days the player has survived after which the spawn starts
Sandbox_Bandits.FriendlyChance_tooltip: Chance of a bandit group to be friendly toward players
Sandbox_Bandits.GeneratorCutoff_tooltip: When ON, hostiles may turn off your generator during a raid (leaving base dark/without power). When OFF, generator is safe.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option1:
Desperate Citizens                                                     
 First survivors of the apocalypse. They they owe their lives more to chance than to skill.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option10:
Hunters                                                                          
 A group that welcomed the new hunting season with pleasure, with no need for hunters license.

 A religious sect with a brand new set of 10 commandments.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option13:
Doomrider Clan                                                            
 A well-organized gang focused on mainly looting, with no remorse if someone dies along the way.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option14:
Private Militia                                                          
 Deserted from the army just before the government collapse, with access to unlimited weapons and ammo.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option15:
Death's Legion                                                            
 The most numerous, danegerous and best equipped clan around, supported by the richest man in Louisville.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option2:
Psychopaths                                                                   
 Incapable of feeling any fear or pain, simply left the Louisville hospital while others died in panic.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option3:
Cannibals                                                                       
 Survived mainly by having high skill in wielding a cleaver, later by having access to high-protein food.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option4:
Criminals                                                                       
 Without unnecessary conscience nor moral constraints, easily adapted to the new conditions after the outbreak of the pandemic.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option5:
Inmates                                                                           
 After the outbreak in Knox prison they managed to flee and resocialize with the new community.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option6:
Police                                                                             
 Called to serve and protect, having access to weapons from the first day, quickly seized the opportunity to form a gang.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option7:
Preppers                                                                         
 Lunatics who apparently were right about the end of the world, actually welcomed the first day of the apocalypse.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option8:
Veterans                                                                         
 The patriots, hardened by war, knew how to deal with the new enemy, and how not to lose their honor.
Sandbox_Bandits.GroupName_option9:
Boozehounds Brigade
