Sandbox_Bandits.HasRifleChance_tooltip: Chance that the bandits will carry a loaded rifle
Sandbox_Bandits.Infection: Bandits may become infected and zombify
Sandbox_Bandits.Infection_tooltip: When ON, NPCs bitten by zombies get infected and eventually turn into zombies themselves. When OFF, NPCs are immune to infection (they only die from wounds).
Sandbox_Bandits.KillCounter_tooltip: When ON, kills you make on NPCs (Survivors + Hostile NPCs) are counted in your player stats. When OFF, killing NPCs doesn't add to any counter.
Sandbox_Bandits.LastDay_tooltip: The number of days the player has survived after which the spawn ends
Sandbox_Bandits.LimitedEndurance_tooltip: When ON, NPCs' movement/attack speed drops as endurance depletes (like players). When OFF, NPCs have infinite stamina.
Sandbox_Bandits.Loadout_tooltip: NPCs from this wave will select weapons from the following table.
Sandbox_Bandits.LostRestore_tooltip: When ON, recruited companions who wander too far or get stuck are automatically teleported back to you. When OFF, you must retrieve them manually (or lose them if they die off-screen).
Sandbox_Bandits.NPCLimitPerPlayer_toolti: Maximum number of NPCs one player can recruit as companions. 0 = no limit. Higher = larger crews possible but heavier CPU load.
Sandbox_Bandits.OriginalBandits: Only LOCAL and other mod bandits allowed to spawn
Sandbox_Bandits.OriginalBandits_tooltip: When ON, only NPCs from HDX Strangers + other installed NPC mods spawn (no vanilla Strangers mod NPCs). When OFF, all NPC sources are allowed.
Sandbox_Bandits.OverallAccuracy_option2: Can't Hit the Broad Side of a Barn
Sandbox_Bandits.PistolMagCount_tooltip: The number of extra magazines bandit will carry for a pistol
Sandbox_Bandits.RandomAmmo_tooltip: Minimum amount of spare magazines carried if random ammo enabled
Sandbox_Bandits.RandomHealthMax_tooltip: Maximum value for random health if enabled. Higher values may produce unexpected results
Sandbox_Bandits.RandomHealthMin_tooltip: Minimum value for random health if enabled
Sandbox_Bandits.RemoveBarricade: Bandits may remove planks or metal sheets from windows and doors
Sandbox_Bandits.RemoveBarricade_tooltip: When ON, hostiles can tear down wooden planks / metal sheets covering windows and doors. When OFF, barricades block them permanently.
Sandbox_Bandits.RifleMagCount_tooltip: The number of extra magazines bandit will carry for a rifle
Sandbox_Bandits.RunAway_tooltip: When ON, hostile NPCs at low HP or outnumbered may drop weapons and flee. When OFF, hostiles always fight to death (no retreat).
Sandbox_Bandits.RunningBreathVolume_tool: Volume of exhaustion breathing from 0 to 100. This no longer plays continuously during ordinary running.
Sandbox_Bandits.RunningBreath_tooltip: Play quiet breathing only when a nearby running NPC is almost exhausted. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_Bandits.SabotageCrops_tooltip: When ON, hostiles may trample/uproot your farming plots during raids. When OFF, crops are safe.
Sandbox_Bandits.SabotageVehicles_tooltip: When ON, hostiles may damage your parked vehicles (flat tires, broken engine, drained battery). When OFF, your vehicles are safe.
Sandbox_Bandits.SizeMultiplier: Modifies the global number of spawned bandits
Sandbox_Bandits.SizeMultiplier_tooltip: When an NPC group spawns, how many members it has. 1.0 = clan config default, 2.0 = twice as many NPCs per spawn event.
Sandbox_Bandits.SmashWindow_tooltip: When ON, hostile NPCs can break windows to enter buildings. When OFF, they use doors only.
Sandbox_Bandits.SneakAtNight_tooltip: When ON, NPCs enter stealth mode at night — quieter movement, harder for zombies to detect. When OFF, they walk normally 24/7.
Sandbox_Bandits.SpawnDistance_tooltip: How far the bandits will spawn from the player[squares]
Sandbox_Bandits.SpawnHourlyChance_toolti: Chance of the clan to spawn in a given hour
Sandbox_Bandits.SpawnMultiplier: Modifies the global chance of bandit spawn
Sandbox_Bandits.SpawnMultiplier_tooltip: Global multiplier for how often NPC groups spawn in the world. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = twice as many spawn events, 0.5 = half. Affects both friendly Survivors and Hostile NPCs equally.
Sandbox_Bandits.SpecialWeapons_tooltip: Some loadouts may feature special weapons (automatics, machine guns). Choose how likely they are to appear.
Sandbox_Bandits.StunlockHitSpeed: Player hit animation speed (higher value means less stunlock)
Sandbox_Bandits.StunlockHitSpeed_tooltip: How quickly the player's animation resets after being hit. HIGHER value = less time stunlocked = you recover faster. 1.0=slow (heavy stun), 3.0=near instant. Default 2.4.
Sandbox_Bandits.Surrender_tooltip: When ON, hostile NPCs at low HP may drop weapons and surrender. You can then execute or spare them (see Execution option). When OFF, hostile NPCs always fight to death.
Sandbox_Bandits.Theft: Bandits may steal items from your base
Sandbox_Bandits.Theft_tooltip: When ON, hostiles can open your storage crates/lockers and take items during raids. When OFF, they ignore containers.
Sandbox_Bandits.Unified_ALifeSimulationR: Detailed NPC simulation radius around players (tiles)
Sandbox_Bandits.Unified_FullScaleRaidGro: NPCs per Full Scale Raid group
Sandbox_Bandits.Unified_FullScaleRaidMin: Full Scale Raid minimum survival day
Sandbox_Bandits.Unified_NaturalOutpostCh: Natural outpost chance per ten-minute check (%%)
Sandbox_Bandits.Unified_SurvivorGroupsPe: Maximum survivor settlement groups per city
Sandbox_Bandits.Unified_SurvivorSettleme: Enable avoidant survivor groups and settlements
Sandbox_Bandits.Unified_SurvivorSpawnCha: Survivor arrival chance per six-hour city attempt (%%)
Sandbox_Bandits.Unified_WarfareEnabled: Enable offline faction battles and base capture
Sandbox_BanditsFixPlus_MapBandits_toolti: -1 leaves it to each player, 0 forces it off for everyone, 1 forces it on. Default is -1, which changes nothing.
Sandbox_BanditsFixPlus_MapCompanions_too: -1 leaves it to each player, 0 forces it off for everyone, 1 forces it on. Default is -1, which changes nothing.
Sandbox_BanditsFixPlus_MapSymbols_toolti: -1 leaves it to each player, 0 forces it off for everyone, 1 forces it on. Default is -1, which changes nothing.
Sandbox_BanditsFixPlus_MinimapBandits_to: -1 leaves it to each player, 0 forces it off for everyone, 1 forces it on. Default is -1, which changes nothing.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_AffinityMult_tooltip: Multiplier on affinity / affection changes from conversation and quests. 1.0 = default.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_AllowZombification_to: When ON, a recruited companion that gets bitten builds up infection and eventually TURNS into a zombie, permanently - for players who want that risk. When OFF (default), companions never zombify. Either way, the false zombification bug (companion turning after a reload for no reason) is always prevented.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_CompanionsCloseDoors: Companions close doors behind them at base
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_CompanionsCloseDoors_: When on, a companion who opens a door inside a base area pulls it shut once she is clear of it. Only simple single-leaf doors; double and garage doors are never touched.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_CompanionsEnterVehicl: When ON, a following companion hops into your vehicle when you drive off (they board and are safely stowed - not physically seated) and step out next to you when you exit. Works with modded vehicles. This does not require the Bandits mod's own 'may enter vehicles' checkbox.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_DbgTrace_tooltip: Writes a detailed record of what every companion decides and does to TrueCompanions_trace.txt in the Lua sub-folder of your Zomboid folder (the same place as your saves and Logs). Leave this OFF for normal play - it costs performance and the file grows steadily. Turn it ON only when you are reproducing a bug on purpose, then send the file with your report: it is the difference between a guess and an answer.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_DbgWatchdog_tooltip: ON by default. When a companion holds a walk order but has not moved for about nine seconds her task queue is cleared to force a fresh path, and at about twenty seconds she is stepped directly to her destination. This is what stops a companion standing against a wall forever. Turn it OFF only while bug-hunting: if she still freezes with this off, the freeze is real and the watchdog was only reacting to it - if instead she frees herself, the watchdog was making things worse.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_ImmortalCompanions_to: When ON, a recruited companion that would die is instead KNOCKED DOWN - it lies incapacitated until you open the V window and press 'Help up companion'. They still take damage, bleed, and get hungry/tired. Turn OFF for normal mortality (they can die for good). Zombification is a separate option below.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_InfiniteAmmo_tooltip: When ON, a companion carrying a firearm never runs out: their reserve is quietly topped up so they keep reloading without you handing over magazines. When OFF (default), they only fire what you actually give them.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_NPCPortrait3D_tooltip: Show a real head-and-shoulders 3D render of the NPC's face in the V window's profile tab and in conversation. EXPERIMENTAL - this uses the engine's character model widget, which had GPU trouble in an earlier build; test it before relying on it. Off = no portrait.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_NeedsCritical_tooltip: A need at or above this value makes the companion break off to take care of it (if a matching routine spot is assigned).
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_NeedsRateMult_tooltip: How fast companion Hunger / Fatigue / Boredom / Hygiene rise. 1.0 = default, 0 = needs never rise.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_PauseNearPlayer_toolt: When on, neutral wanderers stop and face you when you stand close, so you can talk before they move on.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_ProtectCompanions_too: When on, the player cannot hurt or kill a recruited companion.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_RestoreLostCompanions: If PZ's save/load loses a recruited companion, bring it back at its post (Stay tile / Guard spot / where it was). EXPERIMENTAL - it respawns the companion from a saved roster; test it on a backup save first. Off = no auto-restore (duplicates are still cleaned up regardless).
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_UIScale_tooltip: Scales the companion dialog/UI window and its text. 1.0 = default. Raise it if the UI looks too small on a high-resolution screen (e.g. 1.25 or 1.5). Reopen the window after changing.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_WildSpawnCap_tooltip: Spawning pauses while at least this many un-recruited neutral survivors are already near you (a LOCAL throttle, not a total limit - explore and you'll keep finding more). 0 = no throttle.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_WildSpawnClan_tooltip: Spawn recruitable companions ONLY from the clan(s) you name here. Enter the clan's name EXACTLY as it appears in the Bandit Creator (the 'Name' field shown when you create or edit a clan, e.g. Survivors). For more than one clan, separate names with commas: Survivors, Recon. Leave EMPTY to use any friendly/companion clan. Names are case-insensitive. (A clickable clan checklist is also available in-game: right-click the ground -> NPC Core Editor -> Spawning tab.)
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_WildSpawn_tooltip: How often a lone neutral survivor (recruitable) wanders into the area off-screen. Base Bandits almost never spawns friendly groups, so this fills that gap. Off disables it.
Sandbox_BanditsWeekOne.StartRide: Start with a ride (possibility depends on spawn location)
Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.BaseSpawnRadi: Define a radius around a player base that bandits cannot spawn inside. Recommended to keep low if playing Week One
Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.DefenderCoold: How many days before any building you've visited for more than 10 minutes of game time can be occupied by defenders
Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.GeneratorSett: Adjust when bandit safehouses will spawn with generators
Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.Incognito: Spawn icons do not show hostility
Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.MeleeBalance_: Prevent bandits from performing new melee attacks before their previous one has finished
Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.RandomLoot_to: Percentage of normal chance for each loot item to spawn, 100 = normal
Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.SpawnMultipli: Percentage multiplier for the chance that any NPC group will appear; 50 = half, 100 = normal, 200 = double
Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.TimePersists: Bandits progress based on world age
Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.ZoneBoost_too: Percentage chance for bandit waves to spawn in forage zones they do not prefer
Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptionsWeek1.Trespass: Time before you recieve a violent response for trespassing
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_BarrelDefaultCap: Maximum liquid units for newly initialized barrels. Existing barrels keep their saved capacity.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_BarrelEmptyWeigh: Base weight used for empty barrels and carried barrel items.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_CraftedWeightBle: Relative chance for world-crafted barrels to contain bleach. Player-crafted barrels always start empty.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_CraftedWeightEmp: Relative chance for world-crafted barrels to be empty. Player-crafted barrels always start empty.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_CraftedWeightGas: Relative chance for world-crafted barrels to contain gasoline. Player-crafted barrels always start empty.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_CraftedWeightTai: Relative chance for world-crafted barrels to contain tainted water. Player-crafted barrels always start empty.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_CraftedWeightWat: Relative chance for world-crafted barrels to contain clean water. Player-crafted barrels always start empty.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_IndustrialWeight: Relative chance for industrial barrels to contain bleach. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Relative chance for industrial barrels to be empty. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Relative chance for industrial barrels to contain gasoline. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Relative chance for industrial barrels to contain tainted water. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Relative chance for industrial barrels to contain clean water. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_MaxInteractionDi: Maximum distance, in tiles, for barrel interactions.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_MilitaryWeightBl: Relative chance for military barrels to contain bleach. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_MilitaryWeightEm: Relative chance for military barrels to be empty. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_MilitaryWeightGa: Relative chance for military barrels to contain gasoline. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_MilitaryWeightTa: Relative chance for military barrels to contain tainted water. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_MilitaryWeightWa: Relative chance for military barrels to contain clean water. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_OpenBarrelRequir: Full item types, separated by commas or semicolons, that can open sealed barrels. Invalid or empty lists fall back to the default tools.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_RequireFunnelToP: If enabled, players need a funnel to pour liquids into barrels.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_RequireHoseToExt: If enabled, players need a rubber hose to fill containers from barrels.
Sandbox_BarricadesHurtZombies_BaseDamage: The default value of 18 removes 0.18 fixed zombie HP per confirmed structure event before material and object multipliers. It is not 18%% of that zombie's health. Build 42.20 counts real ThumpFrame events; BHZ applies one damage unit per callback. Existing saves may retain an older saved value, so set this to 18 if you want the current default balance.
Sandbox_BarricadesHurtZombies_BloodEffec: If enabled, zombies will create blood splatters when taking damage. More blood appears with stronger materials and armor types.
Sandbox_BarricadesHurtZombies_DamageMode: Which types of objects will damage zombies when hit
Sandbox_BarricadesHurtZombies_DebugMode_: Enables debug logging for general mod operations. Use only when troubleshooting issues.
Sandbox_BarricadesHurtZombies_HeavySpike: How much extra damage heavy spiked vehicle armor deals. 1.75 means 75%% more damage than wood. Applies to heavy spiked protection and spiked plows.
Sandbox_BarricadesHurtZombies_LightSpike: How much extra damage light spiked vehicle armor deals. 1.5 means 50%% more damage than wood. Applies to light spiked protection and basic bullbars.
Sandbox_BarricadesHurtZombies_LogLevel_t: Controls how much information is logged. Higher levels produce more output and may impact performance.
Sandbox_BarricadesHurtZombies_MetalHeavy: How much extra damage heavy vehicle armor deals. 1.4 means 40%% more damage than wood. Applies to non-spiked heavy protection.
Sandbox_BarricadesHurtZombies_MetalMulti: How much extra damage metal barriers and basic vehicles deal compared to wooden structures. 1.25 means 25%% more damage than wood.
Sandbox_BarricadesHurtZombies_Reinforced: How much extra damage reinforced vehicle armor deals. 2.0 means double damage compared to wood. This is the strongest armor type.
Sandbox_BarricadesHurtZombies_ThumpDamag: Deprecated compatibility option. This setting is not used; structure damage is tied to actual vanilla thump world-sound events.
Sandbox_BarricadesHurtZombies_VehicleBas: A value of 15 removes 0.15 fixed zombie HP per vehicle hit before material multipliers. A basic metal vehicle therefore removes 0.1875 HP per confirmed hit. It is not 15%% of that zombie's health.
Sandbox_BarricadesHurtZombies_VehicleDam: Deprecated compatibility option. This setting is not used; vehicle damage is tied to actual vanilla vehicle thump signals.
Sandbox_BarricadesHurtZombies_VehicleDeb: Enables detailed debug logging for vehicle interactions. May impact performance when enabled.
Sandbox_BaseChangeToDamageTool_tooltip: Base percentage chance to damage your tools during disassembly/repair before modifiers.
Sandbox_BaseChangeToGetParts_tooltip: Base percentage chance to recover parts when disassembling firearms before modifiers.
Sandbox_BathTowelsOverhaul_AvailableEven: If True, the towel can be used with DrySelf even if it grimed. If False, it will become unusable if it is too dirty. <LINE> <RED> Note: Using a grimes towel will make it even grimer and increase your unhappiness.
Sandbox_BathTowelsOverhaul_DustClothSpaw: This value is a divisor for the Sponge value. 1 is the same probability as a bath towel. 2 is half the probability.
Whether dust cloth spawn in the world. It spawns in the same place as Sponge.
Sandbox_BathTowelsOverhaul_HandTowelsSpa: This value is a divisor for the Bathtowel value. 1 is the same probability as a bath towel. 2 is half the probability.
Whether hand towel spawn in the world. It spawns in the same place as Bath Towel.
Sandbox_BathTowelsOverhaul_MoreRandomAbs: The absorbency of bath towels is further randomized. <LINE> (Only work if Bath Towel Quality is True)
Sandbox_BathTowelsOverhaul_RandomBathTow: Bath Towel Quality Name (not work in MP)
Whether to overwrite the display name according to the bath towel's absorbency. <LINE> (Only work if Bath Towel Quality is True)
Whether to give a random wet absorption when generating bath towels. If False, all bath towels will have a absobency of 30.
Sandbox_BathTowelsOverhaul_TowelConditio: Whether the towels likely to deteriorate with use. <LINE> (The rate and chance of deterioration is very low.)
Sandbox_BathTowelsOverhaul_WetnessDecrea: Decreases the multiplier for how quickly the player's wetness dries naturally. <LINE> True = 0.002, False = 0.01 (vanilla)
Sandbox_BathTowelsOverhaul_WetnessIncrea: Increases the multiplier of how quickly the player gets wet from rain or sweat. <LINE> True = 0.025, False = 0.015 (vanilla)
Sandbox_BathTowelsOverhaul_WipesBloodAnd: Whether the towel absorbs blood and dirt on the body during Dry Self.
Sandbox_BathingClearsMuscleStrain_toolti: A finished bath removes all accumulated muscle strain (stiffness) on every body part.
Sandbox_BathingTakeOffBackpack_tooltip: Auto-unequip backpacks and fanny packs before entering the tub.
Sandbox_BathingTakeOffClothes_tooltip: Auto-unequip jackets, shirts, pants, shoes, etc. before entering the tub.
Sandbox_BathingTakeOffHeadwear_tooltip: Auto-unequip hats, masks, and eyewear before entering the tub.
Sandbox_BathingTakeOffUnderwear_tooltip: Auto-unequip undergarments before entering the tub. Off by default.
Sandbox_BathingWaterCost_tooltip: Liters of water drained from the tub per bath. Set to 0 for free bathing. Default 40.
Sandbox_BatteryLifeMultiplier_tooltip: How many times longer supported battery-powered light sources last. 1 = vanilla drain, 5 = default, values above 10 are accepted for old server configs but capped to 10.
Sandbox_BetterContainers_AllowSwitchMode: Allows players to switch between all-containers mode and corpse-only mode.
Sandbox_BetterContainers_AllowToggleAuto: Allows players to enable or disable Auto-Lock via mod options.
Sandbox_BetterContainers_AllowToggleProx: Allows players to enable or disable Proximity Inventory via keybind or mod options.
Sandbox_BetterContainers_AutoLockEnabled: Enables the Auto-Lock feature. When active, Proximity Inventory will snap back to the selected container unless intentionally changed.
Sandbox_BetterContainers_ForceCorpseOnly: Forces Proximity Inventory to operate in corpse-only mode. Players cannot switch modes.
Sandbox_BetterContainers_ProximityEnable: Enables the Proximity Inventory system for this server.
Sandbox_BetterItemInfo_FoodLevelRequirem: If Cooking levels are required to see extra food and liquid nutrition information.
Sandbox_BetterItemInfo_MaintenanceLevelR: If Maintenance levels are required to see extra weapon and item condition information.
Sandbox_BetterItemInfo_WeaponLevelRequir: If weapon skill levels are required to see extra melee weapon information.
Sandbox_BetterPushLineDistance_tooltip: How close zombies must be to each other (front to back) to continue falling in the chain.
Sandbox_BetterPushLineWidth_tooltip: How wide the lateral tolerance is when finding the next zombie in the domino chain.
Sandbox_BetterPushMaxChance_tooltip: The maximum chance to trigger the domino push effect when at or above the maximum strength.
Sandbox_BetterPushMaxStrengthLevel_toolt: The player Strength level at which the maximum push chance applies.
Sandbox_BetterPushMaxZombies_tooltip: The maximum number of zombies in the domino chain knocked down when at maximum strength.
Sandbox_BetterPushMinChance_tooltip: The base chance to trigger the domino push effect when at or below the minimum strength.
Sandbox_BetterPushMinStrengthLevel_toolt: The player Strength level at which the minimum push chance applies.
Sandbox_BetterPushMinZombies_tooltip: The base number of zombies in the domino chain knocked down when at minimum strength.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_AdminsCanRelease: Maximum admin powers: release any safehouse
Allows admins to remove/release a safehouse without changing its owner first.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_AdminsFreeAddToS: Allows admins to add any player to a safehouse via the UI, without restrictions.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_CustomClaimEnabl: Enables custom claim BY ITEM. Incompatible with 'Custom claim anywhere (no item)'. Enable only one mode.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_CustomClaimFreeA: Allows custom claim WITHOUT an item anywhere. Choose a single preset, 'Custom (sandbox)', or 'All' to unlock 15x15, 30x30, 60x60 and Custom. Incompatible with item mode (enable only one).
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_CustomClaimItemC: In item mode, add CUSTOM size option

Only works when item-based custom claims are enabled and 'Custom claim anywhere (no item)' is disabled. Adds the CUSTOM option using the size defined in Sandbox and requires the 'customsafehouse' item.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_CustomClaimRestr: Used only when location restriction is enabled. Blocks claims within this many tiles of roads/streets and existing safehouses.
Restrict custom claim locations (buildings, roads, safehouses)
If enabled, blocks claiming inside existing safehouses, on roads/streets (tiles starting with 'blends_street') and nearby (distance set below).
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_CustomSafehouseS: Used when 'Custom Safehouse (sandbox)' is selected in free mode, and for the CUSTOM option in item mode (if enabled).
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_EnableSafehouseV: Allows players to toggle a blue ground overlay showing their safehouse area.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_EnableSubOwners_: The safehouse owner can promote members to Sub-owner. Sub-owners can add and remove regular members, but cannot remove the owner, remove other sub-owners, change the owner or release the safehouse.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_EnhancedInvites_: Allows inviting players even if they already own or belong to another safehouse.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionAllowed: Roles that can freely expand and shrink. Comma-separated, example: Apoiador,VIP. The user role is ignored here.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionBlockRo: When enabled, any expansion over configured road tiles is blocked.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionBlocked: Comma-separated road floor sprites. Only used when Block roads is enabled.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionEnabled: Enables or disables the Better Safehouse expansion module.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionMaxTota: Hard cap for the final safehouse area after expansion (W*H tiles). Applies only to supporter/user expansion. 0 = no total size cap.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionRoleMax: Extra-tile limit above the original safehouse for supporter/roles.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionRoleSte: How many tiles each supporter/role click changes. Does not affect user.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionUserBor: Enables the independent user system. It does not depend on allowed roles.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionUserMax: How many tiles user can push outward on each border from the original safehouse. Example: 1 turns 10x10 into 12x12.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_MaxJoinedSafehou: Maximum number of safehouses a player can join with Enhanced invites ON. 0 = unlimited.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_MaxSubOwners_too: Maximum number of Sub-owners each safehouse can have. 0 = unlimited.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_PhunZones2NoSafe: Block safehouse inside PhunZones 2 no-safehouse zones (works only if PhunZones 2 is active)
Only works when the PhunZones 2 mod is active. If PhunZones 2 is not loaded, this option has no effect whether enabled or disabled.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_SingleRespawnSaf: When a player enables respawn in one safehouse, Better Safehouse removes that player from the respawn list of all other safehouses.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_VanillaSafehouse: Maximum building area (W*H tiles) allowed for vanilla safehouse claim. 0 = no limit.
Minimum building area required for vanilla safehouse claim. 0 = no minimum.
Minutes a player must wait before claiming a new vanilla safehouse. 0 = no cooldown.
If disabled, the 'Claim Safehouse' option will be blocked for all players. Use Custom Claim instead.
Sandbox_BetterVanillaFiltersAndUI_Filter: Scales down real drain on equipped filtered gas masks and respirators while keeping the HUD bar normalized to 0-100%%. RealismV4 and vanilla still control when drain happens.
Sandbox_BetterWalkTo_EnableSounds_toolti: Whether Better Walk To may play click sounds when a valid Walk To destination is selected.
Sandbox_Bicycle_AllowTransferToInventory: Allow bicycles to be transferred into the player inventory instead of only the floor or vehicle trunk.
Sandbox_Bicycle_ImmersiveMode_tooltip: When enabled you will be slower on rough surfaces unless the bicycle has a full offroad wheel setup.
Sandbox_Bicycle_LoadPenaltyEnabled_toolt: When enabled, attaching containers makes the bike harder to turn and heavy cargo slows it down. Disable for vanilla bike handling regardless of load.
Sandbox_Bicycle_MaxSpeedPenalty_tooltip: Maximum reduction in bike speed at 20kg of cargo inside containers. Heavy cargo slows both pedal speeds proportionally; fast pedal stays faster than slow. 0 = no speed penalty.
Sandbox_Bicycle_MaxTurnPenalty_tooltip: Maximum reduction in turn rate when all 6 containers are attached. 0 = no turning penalty. Capped at 75%% to keep the bike usable.
Sandbox_Bicycle_RunSpeedMultiplier_toolt: Set your player speed when riding the bicycle and holding SHIFT.
Sandbox_Bicycle_SidecarSpawnRate_tooltip: Percent-based multiplier applied to sidecar spawn chances - both for sidecars found loose in garages, storage units, and sheds, and for sidecars rarely pre-attached to a newly spawned bicycle. Set to 0 to disable sidecar spawns entirely.
Sandbox_Bicycle_SpawnRate_tooltip: Percent-based multiplier applied to bicycle spawn chances. Set to 0 to disable bicycle spawns entirely.
Sandbox_Bicycle_WalkSpeedMultiplier_tool: Set your player speed when riding the bicycle and not holding SHIFT.
Sandbox_Bicycle_ZombieContactSensitivity: How close a zombie must be to count as touching. Higher widens the contact range slightly so zombies count from a touch further out; 0 requires true body overlap.
Sandbox_Bicycle_ZombieSlowdownEnabled_to: When riding, zombies that physically press against you slow the bike - a single bump bleeds off a little speed, and being surrounded slows you toward a near-stop. Sustained contact from a full surround also knocks you off the bike.
Sandbox_Bicycle_ZombieSlowdownStrength_t: Scales how hard contacting zombies slow you. 100 = default curve (1 zombie ~85%% speed, 4+ near stop). Lower is gentler, higher is harsher. Does not affect the knock-off.
Sandbox_BinksScooperMaxPerAction: Bink's Scooper: max scoops per action
Sandbox_BinksScooperMaxPerAction_tooltip: Cap on how many dung items a single scoop action can clear. Higher values let one click clean a denser farm yard but cost more time. Range 10-60. Default 30.
Sandbox_BinksScooperRadius_tooltip: Radius around the player searched for dung when using the scoop option. Range 1-6. Default 3.
Sandbox_BlackoutPredators_AmbientSpawnCh: Chance for each normal zombie encountered at night to become a roaming Volatile. 0 disables ambient Volatile spawns. Default: 9%%.
Sandbox_BlackoutPredators_DayStartHour_t: Hour when outdoor Volatile spawning stops and they return to their nests. The fixed 2× XP bonus also ends at this hour. Default: 06:00.
Sandbox_BlackoutPredators_NestCountMax_t: Maximum number of Volatiles assigned to each nest. Default: 7.
Sandbox_BlackoutPredators_NestCountMin_t: Minimum number of Volatiles assigned to each nest. Default: 4.
Sandbox_BlackoutPredators_NightStartHour: Hour when Volatiles begin spawning and hunting outdoors. The fixed 2× XP bonus also begins at this hour. Default: 00:00.
Sandbox_BlackoutPredators_VolatileHealth: Total health assigned to each Volatile. Default: 12.
Sandbox_BlackoutPredators_VolatileHearin: Distance at which each Volatile can hear players and sounds. Does not change ordinary zombies. Default: Pinpoint.
Sandbox_BlackoutPredators_VolatileMemory: How long each Volatile remembers a player after seeing or hearing them. Does not change ordinary zombies. Default: Long.
Sandbox_BlackoutPredators_VolatileSight_: Distance at which each Volatile can see players. Does not change ordinary zombies. Default: Eagle.
Sandbox_BlackoutPredators_VolatileSpeedS: Direct animation and movement scale. Normal Sprinter: 0.80. Default: 0.96 (about 20%% faster). Range: 0.40-1.60.
Sandbox_BlackoutPredators_VolatileStreng: Damage inflicted by each Volatile per attack. Does not change ordinary zombies. Default: Superhuman.
Sandbox_BleedingZombies_BluntHeadScale_t: How much of a blunt weapon's damage rating converts into bleed damage when a critical hit lands on the head specifically -- a solid crack to the skull can draw blood even without a blade. Always rolls as a Normal wound with no skill scaling. Any other blunt hit (body or a non-critical head hit) never bleeds (0.0 = disabled, 0.02 = default).
Sandbox_BleedingZombies_CosmeticBleedDur: Only used when Cosmetic Mode is on. How many real seconds a zombie keeps visually bleeding after a qualifying hit before it stops on its own (10 = short trail, 20 = default, 60 = a long trail).
Sandbox_BleedingZombies_CosmeticMode_too: When on, a qualifying hit only makes the zombie visually bleed (a growing blood trail) for a fixed duration. All damage, wound-tier, skill-scaling, and clot mechanics below are turned off entirely -- purely cosmetic, zombies still only die from normal combat damage.
Sandbox_BleedingZombies_CritMultiplier_t: How much stronger a Graze or Normal bleed is when the hit that caused it was a critical hit (the game's own 'good hit' roll, already unique per weapon). Does not affect Devastating wounds, which are already always fatal (1.0 = no bonus, 2.5 = default).
Sandbox_BleedingZombies_DebugMode_toolti: Prints detailed bleed calculations to the console/log. Only enable for troubleshooting or development. For in-game feedback while playing, use the Toggle Bleed Debug Text key instead (Settings -> Controls, defaults to V).
Sandbox_BleedingZombies_DevastatingBleed: A Devastating wound is always fatal. This is the percentage of the zombie's remaining health removed each second once that happens -- higher kills faster. A hard time limit still forces death a few seconds after a Devastating wound regardless of this setting (0.05 = slowest, 0.35 = default, 1.0 = fastest).
Sandbox_BleedingZombies_Enabled_tooltip: A solid hit from a bladed weapon, piercing tool, or firearm can make a zombie bleed out over time on top of the normal damage it takes -- it keeps fighting while it happens. Every qualifying hit rolls how deep the wound is (see the Devastating/Graze Chance options below).
Sandbox_BleedingZombies_GrazeBleedBefore: Graze Wound Time Before Clot Check

How many real seconds a Graze wound bleeds unconditionally before it's even eligible for the one-time clot roll below. Prevents a Graze from resolving itself away almost immediately and being pointless (0 = eligible instantly, 10 = default).
Sandbox_BleedingZombies_GrazeClotChance_: Once a Graze wound has bled for the time above, this is the one-time percentage chance it clots shut and stops for good. If it fails, it keeps bleeding at the low Graze rate until the zombie dies -- no further clot rolls happen for that wound (0%% = every Graze eventually kills, 35%% = default, 100%% = every Graze clots after the time limit).
Sandbox_BleedingZombies_GrazeDamageScale: How much of a weapon's own damage rating converts into bleed damage per second for a hit that rolled as a Graze. Deliberately weak -- a Graze alone should rarely kill without stacking more hits (0.0 = no bleed, 0.004 = default, 0.5 = maximum).
Sandbox_BleedingZombies_HeadDevastatingC: Percentage chance that a qualifying hit to the head rolls as a Devastating wound. Higher than the torso equivalent by default -- a solid hit to the head is more likely to be lethal (0-100%%, 20%% = default).
Sandbox_BleedingZombies_HeadGrazeChance_: Percentage chance that a qualifying hit to the head rolls as a minor Graze. Lower than the torso equivalent by default -- a head hit is less likely to be a shrug-off (0-100%%, 40%% = default).
Sandbox_BleedingZombies_MaxPerTick_toolt: Caps how much bleed damage per second a single zombie can accumulate from Graze wounds, and separately from Normal wounds, even from repeated hits, so stacking wounds of the same depth can't produce an absurd instant kill. Does not cap Devastating wounds (2.0 = default).
Sandbox_BleedingZombies_NormalBleedBefor: Normal Wound Time Before Clot Check

How many real seconds a Normal wound bleeds unconditionally before it's even eligible for its own one-time clot roll below. Much longer than the Graze equivalent by default -- a Normal wound is meant to usually kill (0 = eligible instantly, 30 = default).
Sandbox_BleedingZombies_NormalClotChance: Once a Normal wound has bled for the time above, this is the one-time percentage chance it clots shut and stops for good. Low by default -- most Normal wounds are still meant to kill, this just allows a rare few to clot given enough time. Devastating wounds never clot regardless of this setting (0%% = every Normal wound eventually kills, 5%% = default).
Sandbox_BleedingZombies_NormalDamageScal: How much of a weapon's own damage rating converts into bleed damage per second for a hit that rolled as a Normal wound -- the 'solid hit' case, usually enough to bleed a zombie out on its own given time (0.0 = no bleed, 0.03 = default, 1.0 = maximum).
Sandbox_BleedingZombies_SkillDevastating: Of the percentage shifted out of Graze chance by skill level, the fraction that goes to Devastating chance instead of Normal chance (0.0 = all goes to Normal, 0.4 = default, 1.0 = all goes to Devastating).
Sandbox_BleedingZombies_SkillScalingEnab: A more skilled attacker gets better odds of a Normal or Devastating wound instead of a Graze. Only the one real skill governing the weapon actually in hand matters -- a Short Blade 6 / Aiming 1 character gets the Short Blade 6 bonus with a knife, but only the Aiming 1 bonus with a pistol.
Sandbox_BleedingZombies_SkillShiftPerLev: Percentage points moved out of the Graze chance per skill level (0-10) in the relevant weapon skill, split between Normal and Devastating below (0.0 = skill has no effect, 2.5 = default, 10.0 = a single level can shift a third of a typical Graze chance).
Sandbox_BleedingZombies_TorsoDevastating: Percentage chance that a qualifying hit to the torso rolls as a Devastating wound -- always fatal, ignores the per-tick cap, can't clot (0-100%%, 5%% = default).
Sandbox_BleedingZombies_TorsoGrazeChance: Percentage chance that a qualifying hit to the torso rolls as a minor Graze -- weak bleed that can clot shut on its own. Whatever's left after this and the Devastating chance rolls as a Normal wound (0-100%%, 70%% = default).
Sandbox_BlockLootAll: Block Loot All and Transfer All before searching
Sandbox_BlockLootAll_tooltip: When enabled, bulk transfer buttons will not move items from unsearched containers.
Sandbox_BloodlustTrait_BloodinessDamageL: The limit for the damage boost when bloody.\n\nSet as multiplier, e.g. 0.5 means 50%% more damage at max.
Sandbox_BloodlustTrait_BloodinessDamageM:
How much your bloodiness impacts your damage.

The damage is added via formula:
weapon damage * (bloodiness * BloodinessDamageMultiplier))
Bloodiness is calculated by summing up body, clothing and weapon bloodiness.
Sandbox_BloodlustTrait_BloodinessImpactO:
Bloodiness impact factor on bad moodle reduces when killing a zombie.

The multiplier formula:
1 + (bloodiness * BloodinessImpactOnReduces)

Set 0 to always reduce exactly the set values
Sandbox_BloodlustTrait_BodyBloodinessFac:
How impactful body bloodiness is.

It's calculated by summing up bloodiness from all body parts, then dividing it by the total count of body parts.

Set 0 to not consider body bloodiness
Sandbox_BloodlustTrait_BoredomGain_toolt: How much boredom to add every 10 ingame minutes in the state of bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustTrait_BoredomReduce_too: Minimum boredom to reduce with every kill.
Sandbox_BloodlustTrait_CigarStressReduce: Minimum cigarette stress to reduce with every kill.
Sandbox_BloodlustTrait_ClothingBloodines:
How impactful clothing bloodiness is.

It's calculated by summing up relative bloodiness from all worn items, then dividing it by the total count of body parts.
(The relative bloodiness is calculated by multiplying clothing bloodiness by the count of body parts it covers.)

Set 0 to not consider clothing bloodiness
Sandbox_BloodlustTrait_DisablePanic_tool: Disable panic in the state of bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustTrait_EarnBloodinessThr:
How bloody your character must be for a kill to be considered bloody.

Character bloodiness is calculated by summing up body, clothing and weapon bloodiness.
It can be higher than 1.

Set 0 to consider every single kill.
Sandbox_BloodlustTrait_EarnDecreaseBlood:
Whatever to decrease bloody kills every 10 ingame minutes if your character is not bloody enough.

Note that this also happens when sleeping.
Sandbox_BloodlustTrait_EarnIt_tooltip: Enable the ability to earn the trait.
Sandbox_BloodlustTrait_EarnKiilsThreshol:
How many bloody* kills your character must do to earn the trait.

* A kill is considered bloody if your overall bloodiness is higher than the set threshold.
Note that a kill must also be performed in melee combat.
Sandbox_BloodlustTrait_MassiveDamageOnBl: Make your first hit after a long break deal a lot of damage (Basically an instant kill)
Sandbox_BloodlustTrait_MaxMinutesNoKill_:
Maximum ingame minutes your character can be fine without killing anyone.

The time is decreased by multiplying it with 'cleanliness' (1 - bloodiness)
Bloodiness is calculated by summing up body, clothing and weapon bloodiness.
It can be higher than 1, in which case MinHoursNoKill is used.
Sandbox_BloodlustTrait_MinMinutesNoKill_: Minimum ingame minutes your character will be fine after a kill.
Sandbox_BloodlustTrait_StressGain_toolti: How much stress to add every 10 ingame minutes in the state of bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustTrait_StressReduce_tool: Minimum stress to reduce with every kill.
Sandbox_BloodlustTrait_UnhappinessGain_t: How much unhappiness to add every 10 ingame minutes in the state of bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustTrait_UnhappinessReduce: Minimum unhappiness to reduce with every kill.
Sandbox_BloodlustTrait_WeaponBloodinessF:
How impactful held weapon bloodiness is.

It just gets the primary hand weapon bloodiness. This means if the weapon is 100%% bloody, it's valued the same as if every single part of your body was 100%% bloody, so you might want to set this modifier lower.

Set 0 to not consider weapon bloodiness
Sandbox_Bloodslick_CooldownSeconds_toolt: Minimum real-time delay before the same player can slip again. Set to 0 to disable. Default: 4 seconds.
Sandbox_Bloodslick_EnableFallBlood_toolt: A full fall on blood stains the character's body and the clothing covering the areas that hit the floor.
Sandbox_Bloodslick_EnableReactions_toolt: Makes the character react with a surprised line after stumbling or falling.
Sandbox_Bloodslick_Enabled_tooltip: Allows running and sprinting characters to slip on visible floor blood.
Sandbox_Bloodslick_NimbleReductionPerLev: Further reduces the slip chance by this percentage for each Nimble level. This multiplier combines with the Running multiplier. Default: 5%% per level.
Sandbox_Bloodslick_RunningFallChance_too: After a running slip occurs, chance for a full forward fall instead of a stumble. Default: 30%%.
Sandbox_Bloodslick_RunningSlipChance_too: Chance to slip when entering a blood-covered tile while running. Running and Nimble skills reduce the final chance. Default: 6%%.
Sandbox_Bloodslick_SprintingFallChance_t: After a sprinting slip occurs, chance for a full forward fall instead of a stumble. Default: 65%%.
Sandbox_Bloodslick_SprintingReductionPer: Reduces the base slip chance by this percentage for each Running level. At the default 5%%, level 10 applies a 50%% multiplier.
Sandbox_Bloodslick_SprintingSlipChance_t: Chance to slip when entering a blood-covered tile while sprinting. Running and Nimble skills reduce the final chance. Default: 14%%.
Sandbox_BobrMinigun_AimSpin: Enable or Disable the ability to spin the minigun while aiming (Will still spin when firing, even if disabled. Option works just on aiming).
Sandbox_BoltCutSuccessMultiplier_tooltip: Scales bolt cutter success chance. 1.0 = normal.
Sandbox_BoneTippedArrowRecovery_tooltip: Percent chance a Bone-Tipped Arrow survives hitting a zombie and lodges in the body, to be recovered by looting the corpse.
Sandbox_BonusExp_IsUseXpBoost: Use perks and professions boost when distributing skill points
Sandbox_BonusExp_IsUseXpMultiplyer: Use book multiplier when distributing skill points
Sandbox_BoolAutoThrown_tooltip:
Auto-Equip Thrown Weapons
- When Enabled, and using Thrown Weapons, the next Thrown weapon will automatically be equipped
- By order of : Secondary Hand, R-Belt, L-Belt, Back, Inventory
- When In-Game, [Auto-Equip Thrown Hot-Key] will toggle this option
Sandbox_BoolCIVammo_tooltip: Allow Core Game to add Associated Magazines and Loose or Box Ammo in Civilian Location containers
Sandbox_BoolDisplayAmmoCounter_tooltip:
Displays
- Ammunition Count
- Upper Left of Screen
- Hash marks represent 1 round where (+) represents 10
Sandbox_BoolDisplayMovementGauge_tooltip:
Displays
- Movement Gauge
- Widens & Narrows indicating
- Movement penalty when Shooting
- Recommend use with Dynamic Recoil / Reset Sight Picture
Sandbox_BoolDynamicRecoilSystem_tooltip:
Penalty
- Applies Movement Penalty to Hit-Chance
- Calculated based on Firearm Recoil Characteristics per shot
- To Simulate degrees of Recoil Force upon the shooter
- Increasing difficulty in instances of Rapid Successive Shots or Automatic Fire
Sandbox_BoolFireArmsNeverBreak_tooltip:
Function
- Prevent Firearm Condition from decreasing
Sandbox_BoolHNTammo_tooltip: Allow Core Game to add Associated Magazines and Loose or Box Ammo in Hunting Location containers
Sandbox_BoolLEOammo_tooltip: Allow Core Game to add Associated Magazines and Loose or Box Ammo in Police Location containers
Sandbox_BoolMILammo_tooltip: Allow Core Game to add Associated Magazines and Loose or Box Ammo in Military Location containers
Sandbox_BoolResetSightPicture_tooltip:
Penalty
- Applies Movement Penalty to Hit-Chance
- Calculated based on Firearm Aim-Time Characteristics
- Applied when Aiming is stopped, reloading, etc
- To Simulate having to Re-Aquire when Sight-Picture is lost
Sandbox_BoolSECammo_tooltip: Allow Core Game to add Associated Magazines and Loose or Box Ammo in Security Location containers
Sandbox_BoolSURammo_tooltip: Allow Core Game to add Associated Magazines and Loose or Box Ammo in Surplus Location containers
Sandbox_BoolShowHitRange_tooltip:
Displays
- Distance to Target (on hit)
- Hit Chance (approximate calculated) likely not accurate to current Core-Game calc
- But gives general idea of distance penalty when Dynamic Range is enabled
Sandbox_BoolSkipRemovals_tooltip:
Debugging
- Disable Mod function(s) which Remove vanilla Distribution
- This will result in vanilla items spawning despite Removal / Reduction options
- Removals serve to Zero-Out certain items so options control frequency
- It is NOT recommended to use this Skip Option
- If experiencing slow loading of removals, ensure you are not using OLD MODS that contain OLD Distro method
Sandbox_BoolUseVanillaShotSounds_tooltip:
Sound
- Select to use Vanilla Sound Bank files (for Compatibility)
- Where Core Game (FMOD system) does not apply Mod Sounds correctly
Sandbox_BoolVehiclePenalty_tooltip:
Penalty
- Applies Aim-Time Penalty for using Firearms in Vehicles
- Calculated based on the Overall Length and Weight of the Firearm
- Mitigated by Folded-Stocks and Sawn-Off configurations
Sandbox_BoolVisualEffects_tooltip:
Weapon Visual Effects
- Visible Cycling / Moving : Slide, Bolt, Pump, Bow-Arms, etc
- For Never-Before-Seen-Gun-Nut-Immersion
Sandbox_BoolZombieBodyParts_tooltip:
Zombie Body Parts
- Enable possbility of hitting ALL Zombie body parts
- Vanilla only allows hitting: Head or Torso
- Primarily done to allow visible Arrows / Bolts stuck in Limbs
- Enabling may make killing zombies more difficult
Sandbox_BowStrainFactor_tooltip: Scales how much arm muscle strain each bow shot causes. Heavier bows tire the arms faster, and a higher Archery level tires them slower. Set to 0 to remove bow strain entirely. Applied on top of the game's own Muscle Strain Factor setting.
Sandbox_BringSpouseToMe_tooltip: Adds a manual rescue command for stuck spouses.
Sandbox_BruiseSystem_ActivityPainMultipl: Additional multiplier for pain built by walking, running, sprinting, working and attacking. 0 prevents activity pain buildup.
Sandbox_BruiseSystem_BruiseChanceMultipl: Multiplies the chance that impacts create bruises and the escalation chance on repeated hits. 0 prevents new bruises; 1 is the default; 2 doubles the chance.
Sandbox_BruiseSystem_Enabled_tooltip: Turns bruise creation and effects on or off. When disabled, existing bruises are cleared by the server.
Sandbox_BruiseSystem_FromBluntHits_toolt: Allows blunt weapons and unarmed attacks from other players to create bruises.
Sandbox_BruiseSystem_FromFalls_tooltip: Allows ordinary falls and falls from height to create bruises.
Sandbox_BruiseSystem_FromFenceTrips_tool: Allows tripping while running or sprinting over low fences to create bruises.
Sandbox_BruiseSystem_FromObstacleImpacts: Bruises from wall, tree and obstacle impacts

Sandbox_BruiseSystem_FromVehicleCrashes_: Allows a survivor inside a vehicle to receive bruises when the vehicle crashes.
Sandbox_BruiseSystem_FromVehicleHits_too: Allows a vehicle striking a survivor to create bruises.
Sandbox_BruiseSystem_FromZombieHits_tool: Allows direct zombie strikes to create bruises in addition to any normal wound.
Sandbox_BruiseSystem_HealingTimeMultipli: Scales recovery time for current and new bruises. 0.5 halves the duration; 1 is the default; 2 doubles the duration.
Sandbox_BruiseSystem_ImpactDamageMultipl: Multiplies validated impact damage before bruise severity and damage-based chance are calculated. This does not alter normal Project Zomboid health damage.
Sandbox_BruiseSystem_PainMultiplier_tool: Multiplies all persistent and activity pain generated by bruises. 0 disables bruise pain; 1 is the default.
Sandbox_BruiseSystem_PainThreshold_toolt: Amount subtracted from each body-part bruise pain contribution before vanilla processes it. 0 applies no threshold.
Sandbox_BruiseSystem_PhysicalPenaltyMult: Scales limping, leg movement restrictions, arm attack delay and the ribcage endurance-recovery penalty. 0 disables these penalties; 1 is the default.

None keeps them out of world loot entirely (they can still be crafted), Normal is the mod default, Double makes them twice as common. Note: loot is rolled when an area is first generated, so changing this mid-save only affects places you have not visited yet.
Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnFishing_tooltip: Fishing hook, line and lure boxes in fishing, camping and outdoor supply stores. Inherit default follows the master setting above.
Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnFood_tooltip: Food and snack cartons in gigamarts, grocery shelves, produce stands and grocery back rooms. Inherit default follows the master setting above.
Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnJewelry: Jewelry and Precious Scrap spawn rate
Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnJewelry_tooltip: Gold and silver scrap sacks and jewelry pouches in jewelry stores, pawn shops and department stores. Inherit default follows the master setting above.
Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnLiterature_tooltip: Book, paperback, magazine and reading material bundles in bookstores, libraries and magazine racks. Inherit default follows the master setting above.
Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnMaterials_tooltip: Plank, sheet metal, pipe and bar bundles plus nail and screw boxes, in hardware stores and their store rooms. Inherit default follows the master setting above.
Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnMedical_tooltip: Bandage, pill and disinfectant boxes in pharmacies, medical storage and clinics. Inherit default follows the master setting above.
Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnScrap_tooltip: Scrap sacks and metal parts boxes in welding workshops and mechanic shops. Inherit default follows the master setting above.

Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnSupplies_tooltip: General supply boxes such as light bulbs, batteries, matches, glue, tissues and toiletries, in gigamarts, general stores and department storage. Inherit default follows the master setting above.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AbsorbBatchSize_too: How many skills/traits/recipes to absorb in a single action when using 'Absorb All'. Higher values complete faster but can cause heavy multiplayer/server desync on busy servers. Set to 1 for classic one-at-a-time behavior. Default: 15
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowAdaptiveTraits: Allow Adaptive Traits Managed Trait Recording

Compatibility toggle for Adaptive Traits (Mod ID: AdaptiveTraits). When disabled (default), AdaptiveTraits-managed traits are hidden from player journal recording and claiming while existing journal data is preserved.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowDebugCommands_: Master switch for BSJ debug commands and menus. The game's -debug launch flag does not enable them. Multiplayer access is controlled separately below.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowEvolvingTraits: Allow ETW Managed Trait Loot Generation

Compatibility toggle for Evolving Traits World (Mod ID: EvolvingTraitsWorld). When disabled (default), ETW-managed traits are excluded from newly generated worn, bloody, cursed, and yuletide journals while existing journal data is preserved.

Compatibility toggle for Evolving Traits World (Mod ID: EvolvingTraitsWorld). When disabled (default), ETW-managed traits are hidden from player journal recording and claiming while existing journal data is preserved.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowJournalAccessW: Let journal owners approve specific readers, writers, and claimers. Player lists cannot grant a permission disabled by the server.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowLifestyleMusic: Compatibility toggle for Lifestyle: Hobbies (Mod ID: LifestyleHobbies). When disabled (default), music like/dislike traits are excluded from recording, claiming, and loot journals to prevent stacked or conflicting preferences. Enabling this also consolidates restored preferences to one like and one dislike.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowMutualExclusio: When claiming a trait that conflicts with one you already have, the conflicting trait is automatically removed.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowNegativeTraits: If enabled, negative traits (like Clumsy, Slow Learner, etc.) can appear in journals and be recorded. Useful for modded traits or challenge runs. Default: OFF (only positive traits).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowOthersToClaimF: Allow Others to Claim from Personal Journals

If enabled, other players can claim skills/traits from personal journals they didn't create. Requires 'Allow Others to Open' to be enabled. If disabled, only the author can claim from their own journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowOthersToOpenJo: Allow Others to Open Personal Journals
If enabled, other players can open and view personal journals they didn't create. If disabled, only the journal's author can open it.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowOthersToWriteI: Allow Others to Write in Personal Journals
If enabled, journal owners can let other players record progress and edit Notes. This does not allow renaming, erasing recorded progress, or changing access.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowPerJournalShar: Let journal owners make an individual journal more private than the server-wide sharing rules. Individual journals can never grant access the server has disabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowPlayerJournalD: Controls whether 'Restored' journals (player journals created from worn/bloody blanks) dissolve after all contents are claimed. Restored journals always display their origin status. Default: OFF (restored journals persist forever like clean journals).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowTraitPurchaseS: Compatibility toggle for Traits Purchase System (Mod ID: TraitsPurchaseSystem). When disabled (default), its trait-currency skills (Traits/Traits1/Traits2/Traits3) are hidden from journal recording and claiming, while existing data remains preserved.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowVhsSkillRecord: Allows player journals to include TV/VHS skill XP. Claimed journal entries mark their recorded media lines as watched to prevent double-dipping.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineRecordingMo: When Only Record Earned Progress is enabled, this controls how player journals are recorded. Strict Earned Only excludes starting data. Legacy Full Current Data records everything. Vested Starting XP lets each eligible skill XP earned after spawning unlock one matching point of that skill's starting XP. Starting traits and recipes stay excluded. Ignored when Only Record Earned Progress is disabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsAu: Automatically captures snapshots when baseline data is registered, recovered, or debug-edited.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsCa: When enabled, baseline snapshot lineage is finalized with death metadata during death cleanup.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsPe: Maximum baseline snapshots kept per SteamID before old entries are pruned. Active snapshots are preserved.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsPr: Legacy safety mode. When enabled, applying a snapshot sets debugModified=true (requires manual unlock). Default is OFF for canon restore flow.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalForget: Chance for bloody journals to include a special forget slot when bloody forget slots are enabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMapSeg: Chance for a newly generated bloody journal to contain a point-of-interest map segment.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxMap: Maximum point-of-interest map segments generated in a bloody journal.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxRec: Maximum number of magazine recipes that can spawn on a single bloody journal (1-5).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxSki: Maximum skills in zombie-dropped bloody journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxTra: Maximum number of traits that can spawn on a single bloody journal (0-5).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxXP_: Maximum XP per skill in bloody journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMinSki: Minimum skills in zombie-dropped bloody journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMinXP_: Minimum XP per skill in bloody journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalNoteCh: Chance for newly spawned bloody journals to include a generated read-only note page.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalRecipe: Chance for bloody journals to spawn with recipes (0-100%%). Set to 0%% to prevent recipes from spawning on new journals. Bloody journals have a higher chance than worn.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalSpawnC: Chance for a zombie to drop a bloody journal (0.1-100%%).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalTraitC: Chance for bloody journals to spawn with traits (0-100%%). Set to 0%% to prevent traits from spawning on new journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_ConvertTime_tooltip: Time in seconds to convert a worn journal to a clean journal.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalExpira: In-game days before a cursed journal's curse goes dormant. Expired cursed journals still open into bloody reward journals, but no curse fires.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalForget: Chance for cursed reward journals to include a forget slot when cursed forget slots are enabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh: When enabled, survivors meeting the Exact insight threshold can identify the specific curse effect in item hover tooltips and Breaking the Seal confirmation prompts.
Foraging level used for exact curse insight when exact effect insight is enabled.
Foraging level that, with Cat's Eyes, Herbalist, or Park Ranger fieldcraft, gives Aware insight and reveals the curse's broad omen category.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalLoseSk: Relative weight for the severe cursed penalty that removes a skill level. Lower values make this punishment rarer.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMaxRec: Maximum recipes generated on cursed reward journals.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMaxTra: Maximum traits generated on cursed reward journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMaxXP_: Maximum XP per skill on a cursed reward journal.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMinSki: Minimum skills generated on a cursed reward journal.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMinTra: Minimum traits generated on cursed reward journals when trait roll succeeds.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMinXP_: Minimum XP per skill on a cursed reward journal.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalNegati: Relative weight for the softer cursed penalty that adds a negative trait. Higher values make it more likely when a cursed journal opens.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalNoteCh: Chance for newly spawned cursed reward journals to include a generated read-only occult note page.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalRecipe: Chance for cursed reward journals to include recipes (0-100%%).

After a recent severe curse, this is the percent of normal chance retained by severe penalties like losing positive traits or skill levels. Set to 0 to nearly hard-lock repeats, or 100 to disable this cooldown.
Extra percent of skill XP granted by a cursed reward journal when the applied curse was severe. Only applies when Cursed Severity Compensation is enabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalSeveri: When a cursed journal inflicts a persistent or severe penalty, guarantee a forget slot and (for severe curses) richer skill rewards to keep opening worthwhile.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalSpawnC: Chance for a zombie to drop a cursed journal (0-100%%). If this rolls, normal bloody drop is skipped for that zombie.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalTraitC: Chance for cursed reward journals to include traits (0-100%%).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_DebugCommandAccessL: Controls which multiplayer roles may use BSJ debug commands when enabled. Single-player remains available to the local player.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_DiminishingDecayRat: XP reduction for each subsequent read (0-50%%).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_DiminishingFirstRea: XP percentage on first read (50-100%%). Only applies with Diminishing Returns.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_DiminishingMinimum_: Floor percentage that recovery cannot go below (0-50%%).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_DiminishingTracking: How diminishing returns are tracked within each physical journal. Different journal UUIDs keep independent histories.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_DisguiseCursedJourn: When enabled, cursed zombie drops appear as ordinary bloody journals until first open. The curse springs immediately on that first open instead of showing a sealed warning prompt.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableAnimatedJourn: Allows animated journal backgrounds and future animated journal effects in the UI. Disable this to keep journal visuals static.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBaselineRestr: When enabled, journals only record XP earned through gameplay - not profession starting bonuses or trait skill boosts. This prevents exploits where players farm profession skills by creating multiple characters. Recommended ON for multiplayer servers.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBaselineSnaps: When enabled, BSJ stores SteamID-anchored baseline snapshots for admin recovery and rollback safety.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBloodyJournal: When enabled, bloody journals may spawn with a claimable forget slot.
When enabled, recipes can be claimed from bloody journals. When disabled, recipes tab will be hidden on bloody journals but existing recipe data is preserved for when re-enabled.
Allow zombies to drop bloody journals. These offer better rewards and rare traits.
When enabled, traits can be claimed from bloody journals. When disabled, traits tab will be hidden on bloody journals but existing trait data is preserved for when re-enabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal: When enabled, cursed journals older than the expiration age open safely without applying a curse.
When enabled, cursed reward journals may generate a claimable forget slot.
Allows perceptive survivors to notice disguised cursed journals and read escalating Hint, Aware, and Exact curse warnings from Cat's Eyes, Foraging, Herbalist, and fieldcraft backgrounds.
When enabled, opening a cursed journal reveals an omen hinting at the curse category (pain, ruin, or loss) and constrains the curse to that category.
When enabled, cursed reward journals can generate and allow recipe claims.
Allow zombies to rarely drop dormant cursed journals. The first opener is cursed, then the journal becomes a richer bloody reward.
When enabled, cursed reward journals can generate and allow trait claims.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableJournalCoverP: Allow clean blank and filled player journals to be painted with vanilla paint buckets and washed clean with water or a completed washing-machine cycle.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableJournals_tool: Master toggle for the entire survival journals system.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableLimitedClaimL: When enabled, worn, bloody, and cursed reward journals dissolve after a limited number of successful claims. Already-known or blocked claims do not consume the limit.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableLootJournalNo: Allow newly spawned loot journals to sometimes include read-only generated lore notes. Existing discovered journals are not retroactively given notes.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableLootJournalsF: Master toggle for fun loot journals. When disabled, cursed and Yuletide journal spawns and seasonal fun-journal hooks are turned off.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnablePassiveSkills: When enabled, Fitness/Strength can appear and be claimed on worn/bloody journals. When disabled, passive skill entries are hidden but preserved.
When enabled, Fitness/Strength can be recorded and claimed from player journals. When disabled, passive skill entries are hidden but preserved.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnablePlayerJournal: Allow crafting/restore conversion recipes for personal journals. Disable to prevent journal crafting while still allowing reading/claiming from existing player journals.
Allow players to build customizable note pages in personal journals. Existing notes remain readable when this is disabled.
Allow players to use personal journals for recording/recovering skills. Disable to block player-journal interactions entirely.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableRecipeRecordi: Allow players to record magazine-learned recipes in their personal journals. When disabled, the recipes tab will be hidden and existing recipes will be preserved but inaccessible.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableStatRecording: Master toggle for recording player stats (kills, survival time, etc.) in personal journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableTraitRecordin: Allow players to record traits in their personal journals. When disabled, the traits tab will be hidden in player journals and existing traits will be preserved but inaccessible.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableVanillaJourna: Allow BSJ to add crafting recipes for vanilla Notebook and Journal items. Disable to hide these recipes while keeping existing vanilla items usable.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableWornJournalFo: When enabled, worn journals may spawn with a claimable forget slot.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableWornJournalRe: When enabled, recipes can be claimed from worn journals. When disabled, recipes tab will be hidden on worn journals but existing recipe data is preserved for when re-enabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableWornJournalSp: Allow worn journals to spawn in world containers (shelves, desks, cabinets). These offer light XP rewards.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableWornJournalTr: When enabled, traits can be claimed from worn journals. When disabled, traits tab will be hidden on worn journals but existing trait data is preserved for when re-enabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableYuletideJourn: Allow Yuletide journals to roll the forget-slot reward.
When enabled, Yuletide journals can include claimable recipes.
Allow seasonal Yuletide journals to replace some worn and bloody journals when the Yuletide season is active.
When enabled, Yuletide journals can include claimable traits.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableYuletideKramp: Controls when newly spawned cursed journals use Krampus as their author identity. This is separate from Yuletide journal spawn timing.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EraseTime_tooltip: Time in seconds to erase a journal's contents.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_ExcludePassiveSkill: If enabled, journals will not record or grant traits automatically managed by Fitness, Strength, or body weight changes: Unfit, Out of Shape, Fit, Athletic, Puny, Weak, Feeble, Stout, Strong, Overweight, Obese, Underweight, Very Underweight, and Emaciated. Default: ON.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_JournalUIPagination: How many entries a journal tab can show on one page before pagination appears. Lower values reduce UI load but split long lists into more pages.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_JournalXPMultiplier: Multiplier for XP gained from journals (0.25 = 25%%, 1.0 = 100%%, 2.0 = 200%%). Applies to both worn and bloody journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_LearningTimeMultipl: Global multiplier for all learning times. 0.5 = twice as fast, 2.0 = twice as slow.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_LearningTimePerReci: Base time in seconds to learn each recipe from a journal.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_LearningTimePerSkil: Base time in seconds to learn each skill from a journal. Simulates reading/studying.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_MaxSkillsPerJournal: Maximum number of skills that can be recorded in a single journal. Set to 0 for unlimited. Vanilla game has ~30 skills.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_PenUsesPerLog_toolt: Pen durability consumed when logging skills (1-10).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_PersistDROnErase_to: When enabled, erasing/restoring and re-writing a journal keeps diminishing-returns read progress instead of resetting it.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_PlayerJournalNotesM: Maximum characters allowed on each personal journal note page. Longer pages increase saved journal payload size.
Maximum number of writable note pages in a personal journal. Higher limits allow longer roleplay notes but increase saved journal payload size.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_ReadingSkillAffects: Higher reading skill levels reduce learning time when absorbing from journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_ReadingSpeedBonus_t: Speed bonus per reading skill level (0.1 = 10%% faster per level, max 100%% at level 10).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_RecordHoursSurvived: Allow players to record their survival time in journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_RecordZombieKills_t: Allow players to record their zombie kill count in journals.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_RequireEraserToEras: Require an eraser to wipe clean journal contents.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_RequirePenToWrite_t: Require a pen or pencil to log skills in a clean journal.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_SpawnWithBlankPlaye: Give each new character a blank player journal, including replacement characters created after death.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalForgetCh: Chance for worn journals to include a special forget slot when worn forget slots are enabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMapSegme: Chance for a newly generated worn journal to contain a point-of-interest map segment.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMaxRecip: Maximum number of magazine recipes that can spawn on a single worn journal (1-5).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMaxSkill: Maximum skills in world-found worn journals.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMaxXP_to: Maximum XP per skill in worn journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMinSkill: Minimum skills in world-found worn journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMinTrait: Minimum number of traits that can spawn on a worn journal when traits roll succeeds (1-5).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMinXP_to: Minimum XP per skill in worn journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalNoteChan: Chance for newly spawned worn journals to include a generated read-only note page.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalRecipeCh: Chance for worn journals to spawn with recipes (0-100%%). Set to 0%% to prevent recipes from spawning on new journals. Worn journals have a lower chance than bloody.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalSpawnCha: Chance for worn journals to appear in world containers (0.1-100%%).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_YuletideBloodyRepla: Chance for an eligible bloody zombie drop to become a wrapped Yuletide journal during the active season after cursed roll precedence is checked.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_YuletideJournalForg: Chance for Yuletide journals to include a forget slot when Yuletide forget slots are enabled.

Sandbox_BusStop_BasePrice_tooltip: Base cost in currency items for any trip, regardless of distance.
Sandbox_BusStop_CurrencyItem_tooltip: Item type used as bus fare currency (e.g. Base.Money). Only used when Pay with Items is enabled.
Sandbox_BusStop_EnableRandomTrip_tooltip: When enabled, a Random Trip button appears in the travel panel. The destination is chosen randomly by the server from all available stops.

Sandbox_BusStop_PricePerTile_tooltip: Extra cost per tile of distance for dynamic pricing. Value is multiplied by 0.001 — default 1 means 0.001 per tile.
Sandbox_BusStop_RandomTripPrice_tooltip: Flat fare charged when a player uses the Random Trip button. Set to 0 for free random trips.
Sandbox_BusStop_ReturnTripHours_tooltip: How many in-game hours a return ticket remains valid after traveling to a destination. These are in-game hours, not real time — they advance based on the server's time speed multiplier. Default is 24 in-game hours.
Sandbox_BusStop_SpawnTicketInBuildings_t: When enabled, the Ticket Item is added to building loot distributions (schools, offices, houses) so it can be found while exploring.
Sandbox_BusStop_SpawnTicketOnZombies_too: When enabled, the Ticket Item is added to zombie corpse loot (any zombie, plus a few commuter-type outfits) so it can be found by looting zombies.
Sandbox_BusStop_TicketBuildingSpawnRate_: Relative chance weight used when adding the Ticket Item to building loot containers. Higher = more common. Only used when Spawn Ticket in Buildings is on.

Sandbox_BusStop_TicketZombieSpawnRate_to: Relative chance weight used when adding the Ticket Item to zombie corpse loot. Higher = more common. Only used when Spawn Ticket on Zombies is on.

Sandbox_BusStop_UseItemPayment_tooltip: When enabled, fares are deducted from the player's inventory (Currency Item). If both Pay with Items and Pay with Bank are active, items are deducted first.
