Sandbox_CHStatusHUD_RestrictStats_toolti: Off by default: every player decides for themselves which stats their HUD shows, and the options below do nothing. Turn this on to enforce the list below for everyone on the server - stats you disallow cannot be switched back on by the player.
Sandbox_CMR_ExemptPlayers_tooltip: Account usernames or SteamID64 values separated by commas. Exempt players keep their local CMR settings and ignore both forced panel restrictions. Co-op hosts and admins are always exempt. Use none for no additional players.
Sandbox_CMR_ForceDisableCraftingPanel_to: Removes the CMR Changes right-click option from supported crafting recipes for non-exempt multiplayer users.
Sandbox_CMR_ForceDisableWeaponPanel_tool: Removes More... > CMR Changes from supported weapons for non-exempt multiplayer users.
Sandbox_CMR_HideLocalOptions: Lock local CMR settings for players
Sandbox_CMR_HideLocalOptions_tooltip: Hides Options > Mods > Cye's Crafted Melee Rebalance from non-exempt multiplayer users. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_CMR_IntensityPercentage_tooltip: Used only while quick rebalance mode is disabled. 0 restores vanilla values, 100 keeps original CMR, and 200 doubles the difference between vanilla and CMR. Range: 0.00 to 200.00.
Sandbox_CMR_ProgressionMultiplier_toolti: Used only while quick rebalance mode is enabled. Enter the server's progression rate: x1 keeps original CMR, x2 applies 50%%, x3 applies 33.33%%, and x0.5 applies 200%% of CMR. Range: 0.50 to 10.00.
Sandbox_CMR_UseQuickAdjustment_tooltip: Enabled: CMR uses only the progression multiplier below. Disabled: CMR ignores that multiplier and uses only the precise percentage setting.
Sandbox_CODMW2.replaceVanilla_tooltip: Enable to remove vanilla firearms from the loot pool(mod attachments work on vanilla firearms)
Sandbox_CS2Firearms.replaceVanilla_toolt: Enable to remove vanilla firearms/attachments from the loot pool(mod attachments work on vanilla firearms)
Sandbox_CSP_XPAdvancedBase_tooltip: Base XP awarded by Advanced practice recipes.
Sandbox_CSP_XPIntermediateBase_tooltip: Base XP awarded by Intermediate practice recipes.
Sandbox_CSP_XPSimpleBase_tooltip: Base XP awarded by Simple practice recipes.
Sandbox_CSZ_Option_AllowRoomOnlyClaim: Allow claims with only non-residential rooms (no residential building)
Sandbox_CSZ_Option_BlockStreetTiles: Block street/highway floor tiles in safehouse selections
Sandbox_CSZ_Option_DrawAreaStreetBufferT: Allowed distance for street tiles around draw-area claim
Sandbox_CSZ_Option_MinSurvivedDays: Min. survived days to claim a safehouse
Sandbox_CTags_restrictSafehouse_tooltip: Restrict setting tags only to safehouses that players are members of (Multiplayer only)
Sandbox_CabinFilterHeaterBoost_tooltip: Additional multiplier applied when the vehicle heater is running. Lower values mean stronger filtering with a heater on.
Sandbox_CabinFilterStrength_tooltip: Maximum reduction applied when the cabin is fully sealed. 0 disables. 1 fully blocks corpse sickness gain in a perfect cabin.
Sandbox_CalmPhaseDuration_tooltip: Number of in-game hours the zombies will spend forming hordes before the storm phase.
Sandbox_CalmPhaseIcon_tooltip: Shows the icon for the calm phase when this phase is in place.
Sandbox_Camouflage_AllowHotKey_tooltip:
Allow toggling between walking like an infected and walking normally.
The hotkey can be configured in the mod options.
Sandbox_Camouflage_Legacy_tooltip:
Uses the original mod logic for zombies.
NOTE: It is recommended to set the minimum detection distance to 1.
Sandbox_Camouflage_MinDistance_tooltip:
Determines the distance that camouflaged Players must keep from zombies to remain camouflaged.
Set to -1 to disable this gameplay mechanic.
Sandbox_Camouflage_Nausea_tooltip:
Determines how much nausea Players receive after camouflaging.
Set to 0 to disable this gameplay mechanic.
Sandbox_Camouflage_NoClimbing_tooltip:
Zombies don't climb walls, and neither should you.
Climbing walls within sight of infected drastically reduces camouflage duration.
Sandbox_Camouflage_NoRunning_tooltip:
You should not run if you want to stay unnoticed.
Running within sight of infected reduces camouflage duration.
Sandbox_Camouflage_NormalWalk_hotkey_too: While camouflaged, press this key to toggle between walking normally and walking like a zombie.
Sandbox_Camouflage_StunDuration_tooltip: Determines how many seconds zombies remain confused while following the player's trail.
Sandbox_Camouflage_WalkLikeAZombie_toolt:
Pretend to be one of them! Walk like an infected while camouflaged.
NOTE: You can configure a hotkey in the mod options to toggle this state.
Sandbox_CanInjuryChance_tooltip: Chance of a cut when opening cans with a knife. 0.0 = disabled.
Sandbox_CanWellBeContaminated_tooltip: If enabled, wells can become contaminated if there are dead bodies nearby, making the water unsafe to drink. This adds a layer of risk to well placement and maintenance.
Sandbox_CapacityModifierBaseline_tooltip: Selects which capacity preset this modifier uses as its baseline.
Sandbox_CarPartsRepair_CyclicRepair_tool: Repairs will be performed until the condition of the part reaches the limit
Sandbox_CarPartsRepair_LevelForRepair_to: Changes the repair level of a vehicle part (Standard vehicles - level 4, heavy vehicles - 5, sports vehicles - 6)
Sandbox_CarPartsRepair_RandomRepair_tool: Repair efficiency can be worse by 1 or better
Sandbox_CarPartsRepair_RepairLimit_toolt: Set limits on what quality you can repair a part
Sandbox_CarPartsRepair_RepairMultiplier_: Multiplies the repair efficiency depending on the level of auto mechanics multiplied by 0.5
Sandbox_CarryCapacityTweak_ForceThisMods: Check carry capacity more frequently to reduce conflicts with other mods. Multiplayer remains server authoritative.
Sandbox_CarryCapacityTweak_MaxCapAtStr10: Select the maximum carry capacity a character reaches at Strength 10.
Sandbox_CarryWeightMultiplier_KeepTraitB: Off (default): every character gets exactly the multiplier above, whatever traits they picked. On: the Strong / Stout / Weak / Feeble carry bonus is applied underneath it, so a Strong character at 2.5 ends up on 3.75x. Only carry capacity is affected either way - the traits keep all of their other effects.
Sandbox_CarryWeightMultiplier_Multiplier: Carry capacity for every player, as a multiple of the normal amount. 2.5 means two and a half times the usual capacity. Both the displayed capacity and the hard limit on what will physically go in are scaled. Item weights are not changed. The game refuses to let the hard limit past 100, which is reached at a multiplier of 2.
Sandbox_CarryingCapacityTweak_ForceThisM: Check carry capacity more frequently to reduce conflicts with other mods. Multiplayer remains server authoritative.
Sandbox_CarryingCapacityTweak_MaxCapAtSt: Select the maximum carry capacity a character reaches at Strength 10.
Sandbox_CarvedArrowRecovery_tooltip: Percent chance a Carved Arrow survives hitting a zombie and lodges in the body, to be recovered by looting the corpse.
Sandbox_CatsMod_AffectionSeekThreshold_t: Cats ask for pets/attention only when Affection is BELOW this (0–100). High affection = content. Default 40.
Sandbox_CatsMod_AllowDebugSpawn_tooltip: Adds a right-click world option to spawn a stray cat (admin only in multiplayer).
Sandbox_CatsMod_CallAllKey_tooltip: Keyboard key to call all owned bonded cats to Follow (default Backspace). Same as ground Cats Mod → Call all. Remappable. Chat/text focus ignores this key.
Sandbox_CatsMod_CallKey_tooltip: Keyboard key to call one cat to follow (default F7): nearest owned bonded cat, or your active companion. Also ends free roam. Use Call all for every bonded cat. Context menu and ground Cats Mod → Call still work.
Sandbox_CatsMod_CatsInvincible_tooltip: Companion cats cannot be hurt by zombies (and stay roadkill-immune). They still never fight zombies.
Sandbox_CatsMod_FreeWillKey_tooltip: Keyboard key for free roam (default F9): the cat stops forced follow and wanders on its own. Press Call (F7), Call all (Backspace), or ground Cats Mod → Call to bring it back to follow. Toggle Free will again to return to follow.
Sandbox_CatsMod_HuntEnabled_tooltip: Companion cats may hunt rats, mice, rabbits, raccoons and similar small animals (never zombies). They often eat the catch.
Sandbox_CatsMod_MeowNearZombiesRadius_to: Tiles. How far companion cats scan for zombies before the warning meow. Default 24 so the cat alerts before typical player sight. Independent of Shoulder auto-dismount zombie radius. 0 disables warning meows. Rising-edge + long cooldown still apply.
Sandbox_CatsMod_MeowNearZombies_tooltip: When ON (default), companion cats meow once when zombies first enter the zombie-warning radius (see Meow near zombies radius; independent of shoulder dismount). Long cooldown and rising-edge only — no spam during a horde. Strays do not alert. If Meows attract zombies is also ON, the warning meow can pull zombies.
Sandbox_CatsMod_MeowsAttractZombies_tool: When OFF (default), cat meows and purrs are local cosmetic sounds only and do not alert zombies. When ON, meows (including zombie-warning meows) create world sound that can attract zombies. Leave OFF if you want warning meows to stay safe.
Sandbox_CatsMod_MoodReliefEnabled_toolti: Petting your cat reduces unhappiness, boredom, stress, and a little panic. Stronger with Cat Lover.
Sandbox_CatsMod_NaturalWaterDrinkEnabled: When ON (default), thirsty cats may drink from puddles, ponds, lakes, and rivers if no filled water/milk bowl is nearby. Stay may path within the Stay roam radius for water; Follow/Free may path within a short radius. Filled bowls are preferred when available.
Sandbox_CatsMod_NeedsRateMultiplier_tool: Multiplier for how fast companion cats get hungry and thirsty.
Sandbox_CatsMod_ShoulderZombieRadius_too: Tiles. When a zombie comes this close while the cat is on your shoulder, the cat jumps down and Follows. Independent of the companion zombie-warning meow radius. 0 disables threat dismount only. Fence vault, shoulder ride, and cat moodles are always on.
Sandbox_CatsMod_ShowCatOnMap_tooltip: When ON (default), companion cats appear on the world map and minimap with a cat-face icon so you can find them (especially useful in Free will).
Sandbox_CatsMod_ShowNameTags_tooltip: Draw each companion cat's name (or breed) floating above its head in the world.
Sandbox_CatsMod_SleepBondingEnabled_tool: Sleeping near your cat grants mood relief and a short rested buff.
Sandbox_CatsMod_SpawnRateMultiplier_tool: How often strays appear. 1.0 is normal; 0 pauses world spawns; 2.0 doubles them. World stray spawning itself is always enabled.
Sandbox_CatsMod_StayKey_tooltip: Keyboard key to tell your cat to Stay (default F8): outdoors it may wander near the Stay point; indoors it may roam the house. Context menu still works.
Sandbox_CatsMod_StayRoamRadius_tooltip: Tiles. Outdoors, Stay lets the cat wander within this radius of where Stay was issued (default 20). Indoors, Stay roams the building instead. Call still brings the cat back.
Sandbox_CatsMod_WildCatsCanBeRunOver: Wild cats can be run over
Sandbox_CatsMod_WildCatsCanBeRunOver_too: When ON (default), unowned stray cats can be killed by vehicles like other animals. Owned companion cats stay protected. When OFF, strays are also invincible.
Sandbox_CauseOfDeath_Enabled_tooltip: Turns the whole mod on or off. Off behaves exactly like vanilla, no death-screen line added.
Sandbox_CauseOfDeath_ShowBleachCause: Show bleach as its own cause
Sandbox_CauseOfDeath_ShowBleachCause_too: Shows "You drank bleach" instead of the generic "You were poisoned" when bleach was the cause.
Sandbox_CauseOfDeath_ShowCrashSpeed_tool: Includes the vehicle's speed in km/h when the cause of death was a crash.
Sandbox_CauseOfDeath_ShowKillerName_tool: Names the player who killed you instead of just saying another survivor did.

Sandbox_ChainsawB42_NoiseMod_tooltip: Noise radius modifier attracting zombies (50 = default)

Sandbox_ChairBarricade_DoorHealthMultipl: Sets how much stronger a door becomes when barricaded with a chair (1.0 = no change, 2.0 = double health, etc)
Sandbox_ChangeSandboxOptions_Pause_toolt: The action after sandbox options window has been opened.
Sandbox_CharcoalNeededPerLiter_tooltip: The amount of charcoal needed to clean one liter of water from the well. Higher values require more charcoal for cleaning water.
Sandbox_CheckAround_Radius_tooltip: Defines the radius in which the zombie needs to be around the square at the top of the stairs to be detected by the player.
Sandbox_CheckAround_ShowZombieNametag_to: This will show the zombie position by showing its name above.
Sandbox_CheckAround_loreNamePlurial_tool: The name of the zombie, in plurial, that is referenced to in the voicelines or the nametag of the zombie. By default, it's 'zombies', keep it empty to have the default name.
Sandbox_CheckAround_loreNameSingular_too: The name of the zombie, in singular, that is referenced to in the voicelines or the nametag of the zombie. By default, it's 'zombie', keep it empty to have the default name.
Sandbox_CheckUpstairs_Radius_tooltip: Defines the radius in which the zombie needs to be around the square at the top of the stairs to be detected by the player.
Sandbox_CheckUpstairs_ShowZombieNametag_: This will show the zombie position by showing its name above.
Sandbox_CheckUpstairs_loreNamePlurial_to: The name of the zombie, in plurial, that is referenced to in the voicelines or the nametag of the zombie. By default, it's 'zombies', keep it empty to have the default name.
Sandbox_CheckUpstairs_loreNameSingular_t: The name of the zombie, in singular, that is referenced to in the voicelines or the nametag of the zombie. By default, it's 'zombie', keep it empty to have the default name.
Sandbox_ChoppedVehicleSalvage_MaxPartsDr: Maximum number of installed parts that can be recovered.\n-1 means no limit. Zero disables part recovery entirely.
Sandbox_ChoppedVehicleSalvage_MinMechani: Minimum Mechanics skill level required to salvage a vehicle. Zero means no requirement.
Sandbox_ChoppedVehicleSalvage_MinPartsDr: Minimum number of installed parts guaranteed to be recovered.\n-1 means maximum eligible parts are always recovered.
Sandbox_ChoppedVehicleSalvage_MinWelding: Minimum Metal Welding skill level required to salvage a vehicle. Zero means no requirement.
Sandbox_ChoppedVehicleSalvage_SalvageDur: Multiplier applied to the base burnt vehicle removal time when salvaging a normal vehicle.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_AlertEnabled_tooltip: Show supply drop events as large centered text on screen (like admin server messages).
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_AlertMessageEnd_tool: Message shown on screen when a supply drop expires or is removed.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_AlertMessageStart_to: Message shown on screen when a supply drop is announced. Use {x} and {y} for drop coordinates.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_CallAirdropCooldown_: Minimum minutes after any supply drop ends before a player can call a new airdrop. Uses the same time mode as Event Frequency. Set to 0 for no cooldown.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_CallAirdropEnabled_t: Allow players to use a fully charged radio to call in an immediate supply drop. The radio is destroyed after use.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_ChopperLeaveRadius_t: How close a player must get to the crate for the helicopter to leave (5–50 tiles). Only used when 'Chopper Leaves on Arrival' is enabled. Smaller = chopper stays longer (player must be right on top of the crate). Larger = chopper leaves earlier (as soon as anyone is in visual range).
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_ChopperLeavesOnArriv: When enabled, the helicopter flies off the moment a player reaches the drop zone — rotor sound stops and zombies are no longer attracted to the area. The crate remains until despawn. Lets players push through the horde and reclaim the area instead of fighting an endless siren.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_ChopperPattern_toolt: How the helicopter sound moves at the drop site. Static keeps it fixed on the crate. Orbit makes it circle around the drop site, spreading zombies out instead of stacking them on one spot.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_DespawnTimer_tooltip: Minutes before an uncollected supply crate disappears. Uses the same time mode as Event Frequency.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_Enabled_tooltip: Master kill switch. When disabled, NO drops occur — random, radio, or admin.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_EventFrequency_toolt: Minutes between supply drop events. In Real Time mode this is wall-clock minutes. In Game Time mode this is in-game minutes.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_HelicopterVolume_too: Volume of the helicopter sound as a percentage. 100 = full volume, 0 = silent. The game's SFX slider scales on top of this. Lower if the helicopter is drowning out other game audio.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_LootQuantity_tooltip: Number of random items placed in each supply crate. Items are picked randomly from a large pool of weapons, armor, supplies, and consumables.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_MaxDistance_tooltip: Maximum distance from a player where a supply drop can appear. Too far and players may not reach it in time.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_MinDistance_tooltip: Minimum distance from a player where a supply drop can appear. Prevents drops on top of players.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_MinPlayers_tooltip: Supply drops only occur when at least this many players are online. Useful for skipping events during solo play.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_RadioCharges_tooltip: Number of times a radio can be used to Tune In before its battery is depleted and the radio is destroyed.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_RadioDropChance_tool: Percentage chance for a Chopper Drop Radio to appear on military zombie corpses. Higher values mean more radios in the world.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_RadioEnabled_tooltip: Enable or disable the Chopper Drop Radio item. When disabled, radios will not spawn and all radio features are inactive.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_RadioHeadStart_toolt: Seconds of advance notice radio holders get before the drop location is announced to everyone. Set to 0 to disable early intel.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_RandomEventsEnabled_: When disabled, the timer-based random drops stop. Radio (Tune In / Request Airdrop) and admin commands still work — drops only happen on demand. Useful for radio-only / pure on-demand setups.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_SoundRadius_tooltip: How far away players can hear the helicopter sound. Larger values let players hear it from further away.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_SpawnFailAlertMessag: Message shown on screen when a supply drop is cancelled due to a bad landing zone.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_SpawnFailAlert_toolt: Show a screen alert to all players when a supply drop is cancelled due to a bad landing zone (water, no walkable tile).
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_SpawnRetryDelay_tool: If the drop location lands on water or has no valid tile, the event is cancelled and retried after this many minutes.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_TimerMode_tooltip: How event timers are measured. Real Time uses wall-clock minutes. Game Time uses in-game minutes (affected by day length and game speed).
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_UseCustomLoot_toolti: Load the loot pool from ChopperDrop_Loot.cfg instead of the built-in item list. The config file is auto-generated in Zomboid/Lua/ on first server start. Edit it to add, remove, or comment out items. Requires server restart after changes.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_ZombieAttractionRadi: How far the helicopter noise attracts zombies. Larger values pull zombies from a wider area.
Sandbox_ChopperDrop_ZombieHordeSize_tool: Number of zombies spawned at the drop site when a player arrives. Set to 0 to disable horde spawning.
Sandbox_CityStandpipeBaseDuration_toolti: Base timed action duration in ticks for operating a standpipe.
Sandbox_CityStandpipeBaseMuscleStrain_to: Base muscle strain applied when operating a standpipe. Higher values increase fatigue.
Sandbox_CityStandpipeMinimumStrength_too: Minimum Strength level required to operate a fire hydrant standpipe.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_AllowOpenClose_to: Whether standpipes can be opened and closed with a pipe wrench.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_AllowWaterSource_: Whether opened standpipes become a dynamic water source.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_BaseDuration_tool: How many seconds the action takes for a character with Strength 0.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_BaseMuscleStrain_: How much muscle strain the action adds for a character with Strength 0.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_BlowTorchUseCost_: How many Blow Torch uses are consumed when building the city standpipe.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_EnableSounds_tool: Whether the mod hydrant interaction sounds are enabled.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_MetalBarAmount_to: How many Metal Bars are required.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_MetalPipeAmount_t: How many Metal Pipes are required.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_MetalWeldingSkill: Required Metal Welding skill to build the city standpipe.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_MinimumStrength_t: A character must have at least this Strength level to open or close a standpipe.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_ScrapMetalAmount_: How many Scrap Metals are required.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_SheetMetalAmount_: How many Sheet Metals are required.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_SmallSheetMetalAm: How many Small Sheet Metals are required.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_TirePumpAmount_to: How many Tire Pumps are required.
Sandbox_CityStandpipes_WeldingRodsUseCos: How many Welding Rod uses are consumed when building the city standpipe.
Sandbox_ClaimAdminsInvisible: Admins do not appear on members list
Sandbox_ClaimAdminsInvisible_tooltip: Admins still have full management rights, but their stealth/spectator activity is not echoed into row.membersCSV / audit log lines.
Sandbox_ClaimAuditLog_tooltip: Writes claim/release/transfer/invite/kick events to csr_claims_audit.txt and exposes the last 200 to the in-game audit viewer.
Sandbox_ClaimContainerProtect_tooltip: Block non-members from taking items out of containers and from picking up furniture inside a claim.
Sandbox_ClaimDissolveAction_tooltip: What to do with claims belonging to a faction that no longer exists. Transfer = promote highest-rank member to personal owner. Release = release the claim outright.
Sandbox_ClaimExpansionArchitectCarpentry: Minimum Carpentry level that satisfies the architect requirement when the player does not have a matching profession.
Sandbox_ClaimExpansionBlockNonMembersIns: When enabled, expansion fails if a non-member player is standing inside the newly added area.
Sandbox_ClaimExpansionCooldownMinutes_to: Minimum real-time minutes between successful expansions of the same claim by the same player. Set 0 to disable.
Sandbox_ClaimExpansionMaterialsPer10Tile: Construction material points consumed for every 10 newly added tiles. Raw planks, metal materials, pipes, bars, branches, rods, and CSR material bundles count.
Sandbox_ClaimExpansionMaxAddedTiles_tool: Maximum number of new tiles one expansion can add. Set 0 for no per-expansion added-tile cap.
Sandbox_ClaimExpansionMaxHeight_tooltip: Maximum final height, in tiles, for a player-expanded safehouse claim.
Sandbox_ClaimExpansionMaxWidth_tooltip: Maximum final width, in tiles, for a player-expanded safehouse claim.
Sandbox_ClaimExpansionMoneyPer10Tiles_to: Number of Base.Money items consumed for every 10 newly added tiles. Set 0 to disable the money cost.
Sandbox_ClaimExpansionRequireArchitect_t: When enabled, the expanding player must be an Architect-style profession, Carpenter, Construction Worker, Engineer, admin, or meet the configured Carpentry level.
Sandbox_ClaimExpansionRequirePlayerInsid: When enabled, the player must stand inside the current safehouse claim to expand it.
Sandbox_ClaimInviteCooldownMin_tooltip: Minimum minutes between two invites sent to the same target by the same inviter for the same claim.
Sandbox_ClaimPadlockBreakSeconds_tooltip: How long bolt cutters take to cut a CSR padlock.
Sandbox_ClaimPadlockEnabled_tooltip: Co-owners may install Padlock items on claimed containers and vehicles. Issues a matching key. Bolt cutters can break locks.
Sandbox_ClaimRaidAllowBuild_tooltip: Outsiders can build and dismantle structures inside the claim during the window.
Sandbox_ClaimRaidAllowLoot_tooltip: Outsiders can take items and drive claimed vehicles during the window.
Sandbox_ClaimRaidEnabled_tooltip: When active, outsiders may build/dismantle and/or loot inside claims during the configured hour window. Sleep prevention still applies outside the window.
Sandbox_ClaimRaidEnd_tooltip: Hour of day (0..23) when the raid window closes. If end is less than start the window wraps midnight.
Sandbox_ClaimRaidStart_tooltip: Hour of day (0..23) when the raid window opens.
Sandbox_Claymore_SpawnRate_tooltip: Sets the extra spawn rate of Claymores
Sandbox_CleaningLiquidMultiplier_tooltip: When using cleaning liquid, bleach or soap bars the items per cycle will be multiplied by this value.
Sandbox_Cleaning_tooltip: Rate at which Cleaning skill levels up.
Sandbox_CloseDefenseShove_tooltip: Allows local defensive shoves only when spouse is guarding at close range.
Sandbox_ColdWintersWIP_EnableBlizzards_t: If enabled, winter blizzards will occur more often (approximately a few times per month).
Sandbox_ColdWintersWIP_EnableFailures_to: If enabled, generators may occasionally shut down due to low temperatures during winter.
Sandbox_ColdWinters_EnableBlizzards_tool: If enabled, winter blizzards will occur more often (approximately a few times per month).
Sandbox_ColdWinters_EnableEaster: Enable extra events (restart required to apply changes)
Sandbox_ColdWinters_EnableEaster_tooltip: If enabled, different events may occur. They are not related to climate. Let it be surprise for you.
Sandbox_ColdWinters_EnableFailures_toolt: If enabled, generators may occasionally shut down due to low temperatures during winter.
Sandbox_CommonSense_CanWoundChance_toolt: Determines the chance of getting wounded if a Player fails to open a can with an improvised tool.
Sandbox_CommonSense_CanWoundIntensity_to:
Multiplies the damage dealt to a Player when they fail to open a can with an improvised tool.
Can be used to reduce or increase the damage to your liking.
Sandbox_CommonSense_ColorFilter_tooltip: Toggles friendly User Interface colors for those affected by color blindness.
Sandbox_CommonSense_GunStats_tooltip: Toggles a custom User Interface that displays a gun's ammunition type, current ammo, state, etc. when one is equipped.
Sandbox_CommonSense_OC_DisableLoot_toolt: Toggles whether removing obvious stuff off the ground such as twigs, rocks, weeds, bushes, etc. will grant the Player the item they just removed.
Sandbox_CommonSense_OC_LootMultiplier_to: Multiplies the amount of loot the Player receives when picking obvious stuff off the ground.
Sandbox_CommonSense_ObviousCollecting_to: Toggles the ability to pick up obvious stuff off the ground, such as twigs, rocks, weeds, bushes, etc.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PartsHighlighter_too: Toggles whether to display a Color representing the Condition of various Vehicle Parts in the Vehicle Dashboard.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PryAllDoors_tooltip:
Toggles whether all doors can be pried open or not.
By default, reinforced doors (Prison doors, metal grid doors, etc.) cannot be pried open up unless the Player has a Strength level equal to or higher than the Min. Reinforced Door Level.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PryBuildingDoors_too: Toggles whether Players can pry open building doors, such as doors on houses, apartments, etc.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PryGarageDoors_toolt: Toggles whether Players can pry open garage doors.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PrySafeDoors_tooltip:
Toggles whether Players can pry open reinforced doors (Prison doors, metal grid doors, etc.)
These doors cannot be pried open unless the Player has a Strength level equal to or higher than the Min. Reinforced Door Level.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PryVehicleDoors_tool: Toggles whether Players can pry open vehicle doors.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PryWindows_tooltip: Toggles whether Players can pry open building windows, such as windows on houses, apartments, etc.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PryingChanceMultipli:
Determines the difficulty of prying open objects with a crowbar.
A higher multiplier makes it more difficult to pry open objects successfully, while a lower multiplier makes it easier.
0 = Always Succeed.
1 = Default Difficulty.
5 = Highest Difficulty.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PryingMechanic_toolt: Toggles whether Players can pry open doors, windows, etc. using a Crowbar.
Sandbox_CommonSense_ReinforcedDoorLevel_: Determines the Minimum level of Strength at which Players can pry open reinforced doors (Prison doors, metal grid doors, etc.)
Sandbox_CommonSense_ReloadAllMags_toolti: Enables/disables the menu to automatically reload all selected magazines.
Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHand: Enable Remove Bullet by Hand Action
Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHandA: Reserved compatibility option. The experimental custom animation is disabled on Build 42.20.2 because it can invalidate the multiplayer animation checksum. The action above remains available without it.
Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHand_: Enables the action that removes lodged bullets by hand from the health panel. The action is disabled by default, returns a bloody bullet and worsens the wound.
Sandbox_CommonSense_ReplaceBandage_toolt: Enables/disables the menu to directly replace dirty bandages.
Sandbox_CommonSense_ShatterVehicleWindow:
Determines whether Players can accidentally smash Vehicle door windows when failing to pry them open.
If enabled, this can happen at random (Based on the Window Shatter Chance setting).
Sandbox_CommonSense_WashOnly_tooltip: Enables/disables the menu for washing only equipped or unequipped items.
Sandbox_CommonSense_WindowShatterChance_: Determines the chance of breaking the glass of a window when a Player fails an attempt to pry it open.

Sandbox_CompanionDogsBreedPack15_BeagleE: Allows Beagles to spawn around farms in the morning and late afternoon.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsBreedPack15_BeagleS: Multiplier for the normal Beagle spawn chance. 0 disables chance rolls; 1 is normal; 5 is five times normal.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsBreedPack15_Belgian: Allows Belgian Malinois to spawn around police and military buildings from early morning to evening.
Multiplier for the normal Belgian Malinois spawn chance. 0 disables chance rolls; 1 is normal; 5 is five times normal.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsBreedPack15_Bernese: Allows Bernese Mountain Dogs to spawn around farms during autumn and winter.
Multiplier for the normal Bernese Mountain Dog spawn chance. 0 disables chance rolls; 1 is normal; 5 is five times normal.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsBreedPack15_Bloodho: Allows Bloodhounds to spawn around police and military buildings from early morning to evening.
Multiplier for the normal Bloodhound spawn chance. 0 disables chance rolls; 1 is normal; 5 is five times normal.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsBreedPack15_BlueHee: Allows Blue Heelers to spawn around farms during daylight hours, except in winter.
Multiplier for the normal Blue Heeler spawn chance. 0 disables chance rolls; 1 is normal; 5 is five times normal.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsBreedPack15_Dachshu: Allows Dachshunds to spawn around residential buildings during daylight hours.
Multiplier for the normal Dachshund spawn chance. 0 disables chance rolls; 1 is normal; 5 is five times normal.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsBreedPack15_GreatDa: Allows Great Danes to spawn around large residential buildings with at least eight rooms during daylight hours.
Multiplier for the normal Great Dane spawn chance. 0 disables chance rolls; 1 is normal; 5 is five times normal.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsBreedPack15_Greyhou: Allows Greyhounds to spawn around gyms, fitness rooms, stadiums, tracks, and sports buildings during daylight hours.
Multiplier for the normal Greyhound spawn chance. 0 disables chance rolls; 1 is normal; 5 is five times normal.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsBreedPack15_JackRus: Allows Jack Russells to spawn around farms during daylight hours.
Multiplier for the normal Jack Russell spawn chance. 0 disables chance rolls; 1 is normal; 5 is five times normal.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsBreedPack15_Newfoun: Allows Newfoundlands to spawn around fishing, marina, harbor, and dock buildings during autumn and winter.
Multiplier for the normal Newfoundland spawn chance. 0 disables chance rolls; 1 is normal; 5 is five times normal.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsBreedPack15_SaintBe: Allows Saint Bernards to spawn around hospitals, clinics, emergency services, and fire stations during winter only.
Multiplier for the normal Saint Bernard spawn chance. 0 disables chance rolls; 1 is normal; 5 is five times normal.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsBreedPack15_Standar: Allows Standard Poodles to spawn around pet shops, veterinary clinics, animal shelters, and kennels during daylight hours.
Multiplier for the normal Standard Poodle spawn chance. 0 disables chance rolls; 1 is normal; 5 is five times normal.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_AllowDebugSpawn_to: Show a right-click ground option to spawn test dogs (admins only in multiplayer).
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_AutoProtectEnabled: Enables the per-dog Auto-protect toggle: when on, a dog stands guard anchored on you while you sleep, eat, read, sit or fish, then goes back to following. Turn this off to disable the feature entirely.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_BondingEnabled_too: Petting your dog and sleeping beside it ease your Bored and Unhappy moodles a little. Petting also calms the dog and nudges its loyalty.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_BreedChancePerDay_: Percent chance per in-game day that a nearby adult male and female of the same owner conceive on their own (rolled hourly). Same conditions as manual breeding: fed, loyal, healthy, off cooldown, a free dog slot, breeding not blocked on either. Only while loaded near you. 0 = off.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_BreedMoodlesEnable: Every breed grants its own moodle while a fed, loyal dog is nearby: Good Company, Courage, Keen Nose, Warmed and the rest. Turn this off and both the HUD icon and the bonus behind it go away. The dog's condition moodles (hunger, thirst, sick, weak) and Well Rested are not affected.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_BreedingEnabled_to: Allow companion dogs (a male and female with the same owner) to mate and have puppies. Disabling hides the breeding action.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_CargoCapacityBase_: Minimum cargo weight a saddlebag can hold before the dog's Strength gene adds more. A weak dog (caramelo) gets about this much; this is the floor.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_CargoCapacitySpan_: Extra cargo weight a maximally strong dog adds on top of the base capacity. A strong breed (German Shepherd) approaches base + this; a weak one adds little.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_CombatEnabled_tool: Allow companion dogs to attack nearby zombies.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_CountDogKillsForPl: When on, zombies killed by your dog also add to your own 'Zombie Kills' count on the character info screen. On by default. Your dog keeps its own kill count in its window either way. Only zombie kills count; hunting is tracked separately.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_DespawnOnOwnerOffl: Stash dogs while owner is offline

Multiplayer servers: when a player disconnects, their dogs are safely stored out of the world (state and needs preserved, frozen) and returned when they reconnect. The active dog in Follow comes back at the owner's side; dogs in Stay/Guard and passive dogs reappear where they were left once the area loads. On by default; turn it off to keep dogs of offline players in the world (invincible and idle).
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_DogDamageMultiplie: Scales how much damage companion dogs deal to zombies, on top of each breed's power, skill level and Strength gene. 1.0 is the tuned default; higher hits harder, 0 makes their bite harmless. The weak caramelo mutt still can't finish a zombie on its own no matter how high this is set. That is by design.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_DogNoiseAttractsZo: The dog's loud barking (stress barks and loud sentinel alerts) is real noise that draws nearby zombies (the symmetric cost). Quiet growls never attract. Turn off to bark without drawing zombies.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_DogSpawnMultiplier: Scales how often stray dogs appear in the world (caramelo strays, Golden Retrievers and police German Shepherds), keeping their relative rarity. 1.0 is the normal rate; 2.0 doubles all dog spawns, 0 disables them.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_FarmCareEnabled_to: Master switch for the farm care mode. When on, you can assign a dog to care for a designated animal pen: it stays in the pen, calms the herd (reducing stress that lowers milk and wool), and silently drives off nearby zombies, working on its own even when you are away.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_GestationDays_tool: How many in-game days a pregnant dog carries before giving birth.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_HuntEnabled_toolti: Master switch for assisted hunting. A dog in Hunt mode tracks wild game (rabbit, raccoon, deer...) and, once trained, chases and takes it for you. Hunting is rural: game lives in forests and the countryside, not in town.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_LoyaltyDecayPerDay: Loyalty points (0-100) a cared-for dog loses each in-game day. Decay is faster while it is hungry or thirsty.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_MaturityDays_toolt: How many in-game days a puppy takes to grow into an adult, keeping its bond, genes and skills. Puppies age only while loaded near a player; 'Pause growth' on a puppy overrides this.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_MaxCompanions_tool: Maximum number of dogs a player can keep bonded at once. 0 = no limit. At the cap, taming new strays is blocked (the befriend option turns red); releasing or losing a dog frees a slot.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_NeedsRateMultiplie: Scales how fast a companion dog gets hungry and thirsty. 1.0 is the tuned default: a well-fed dog goes from full to starving in about 3 days, and needs water roughly twice as often. Higher means more upkeep, lower means less. 0 freezes hunger and thirst entirely, so the dog never needs food or water again. Loyalty still decays, so it will still want your attention. To switch the whole care system off instead, use 'Needs & upkeep'.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_ObedienceFailure_t: An untrained dog sometimes ignores a direct order (follow, stay, guard, come, attack and tricks). The chance starts around 30 percent at Obedience 0 and reaches zero at level 10; repeating the order right away always works. Behaviour toggles, Bring, feeding and the saddlebag are never affected. Turn off for dogs that always obey.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_ProteinHours_toolt: How long a dog can go without protein before it turns Weak, in in-game hours. Default 72, three days. Lower it and meat becomes a daily chore; raise it and protein is an occasional top-up. Meals pay the clock back in proportion, so this rescales the whole thing: at 72 hours a steak or a bag of dog food still clears it in one go, and a scrap of bacon shaves about three and a half hours off. Does nothing while 'Dogs need protein' is off.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_ProteinNeedEnabled: A dog is a carnivore, so filling its belly is not enough. Go three days without protein (meat, fish, egg or dog food, fed by hand, taken from a bowl or hunted down) and the dog turns Weak: it bites for half damage and ignores orders far more often. Protein pays the clock back by the size of the meal: a steak or a bag of dog food clears the whole clock in one go, a scrap of bacon only shaves a few hours off, but scraps do add up. The clock stops while the dog is in the kennel, carried with you or on farm care duty. How long that clock runs is set by 'Hours without protein'.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_RestedBuffEnabled_: After you sleep next to your dog, you wake up Well Rested for a while: a gentle, temporary buff that eases panic, stress, sadness and boredom and lets you tire more slowly. Turn this off to disable it.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_RestedBuffHours_to: How many in-game hours the Well Rested buff lasts after waking up beside your dog. Default 2.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_SentinelEnabled_to: The dog watches a wide area and warns you about zombies: a quiet growl for distant or few, a loud bark for close, many, or visible ones.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_ShowMapMarker_tool: Mark your companion dog on the world map and minimap. The marker follows the dog while it's nearby and stays at its last seen spot when the dog is out of range, so you can find a dog you left behind or lost after dying.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_ShowNameTags_toolt: Draw each companion dog's name floating above its head in the world.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_SkillXPRate_toolti: Global multiplier on all skill XP gains (scent, combat, obedience, hunting). 1.0 is normal; higher trains faster.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_SkillsEnabled_tool: Companions learn skills (scent, combat, obedience...) by doing, improving their effectiveness over time.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_TameThreshold_tool: How much trust a dog must reach (by feeding) before it becomes your companion.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_TricksEnabled_tool: Master switch for the trick tree unlocked by the Obedience skill: send the dog to a spot (level 1), distract zombies (level 3), sniff out an item (level 5) and fetch what it sniffed while you sleep (level 10). Locked tricks still show in the menus so you can see what is coming.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_TripOverDogs_toolt: Running into your own dog can knock you down, the same as bumping into a zombie (while sprinting the fall is guaranteed). [Examples]
AK47_1;5 : The draw weight for AK47 is 5.
Enhancement_Point;10;1,20 : The weight for Enhancement Point is 10, granting 1~20 randomly when drawn.
M4A1_1|AK47_1|Base.Apple;8 : The weight for this custom pool is 8, randomly granting 1 of these 3 items when drawn.

[Notes]
Weight Calculation : Weight represents a 'relative proportion', not an absolute percentage (%%).
Groups & Amount : When an item pool/category tag (like @ammo) is paired with an amount range, the system will 'draw one item' first and then give that amount. It will not mix multiple items.
Empty Fields : Leaving a single field empty means 'disabling that slot'; if all 15 fields are empty, it will revert to default settings.
Disable Feature : To completely stop sending daily rewards, simply uncheck 'Send Daily Rewards' at the top.

Sandbox_CrisisAction_DailyBoxHelp_toolti:
Customize the contents and weights of the Daily Reward Box.
If set as an item pool, all items within the pool have an equal chance of being drawn.
Format : Item;Weight;Amount

Item : The 'CrisisAction.' prefix can be omitted for items from this mod; vanilla and other mod items require the full ID (e.g., Base.223Box).
Category tags supported: e.g., @partE / @partD (by part level), @ammo (ammo and magazines); or use A|B|C for custom item pools (equal chance).
Weight : Relative probability. Optional (default is 1), sum does not need to be 100.
Amount : Can be a fixed value N, or a random range min,max (inclusive). Optional (default is 1), values over 999 will be capped at 999.

Currently available category tags: @ammo / @partSS / @partS / @partA / @partB / @partC / @partD / @partE

Sandbox_DHBC_AlertRadius_tooltip: Radius of the world-sound alert generated when a herd zombie spots the player. Nearby ordinary zombies may also react.
Sandbox_DHBC_AlternativeRouteVariants: Alternative routes to the same towns
Sandbox_DHBC_AlternativeRouteVariants_to: Allows multiple corridor variants between the same towns so herds do not always take the same route. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_DHBC_CollapseThresholdPercent_to: If a living herd falls below this percentage of its generation target, the herd is considered destroyed. Remaining physical zombies become ordinary stragglers. Default: 10 percent.
Sandbox_DHBC_CollectiveAwareness_tooltip: When enabled, one herd zombie spotting the player can trigger the herd-wide alert and pull nearby zombies toward the player. When disabled, only zombies that notice the player themselves react; the rest of the herd keeps its normal movement.
Sandbox_DHBC_DebugMode_tooltip: Enables the world-map herd overlay and right-click herd debug controls. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_DHBC_EnableBCBaseZone_tooltip: This is a failsafe for horde spawning. Some enclosed spaces may not register because of a Project Zomboid map limitation. This lets you manually mark your safe zones. Use in walled areas.
Sandbox_DHBC_Enabled_tooltip: Master switch for the mod. When disabled, physical herd zombies are safely removed and all herd movement, regeneration and replacement timers pause. Re-enable to resume the same persistent herds.
Sandbox_DHBC_HerdConvergenceChance_toolt: When another living herd is already heading to or occupying the same town/route, this is the chance a herd still accepts that convergence. Default: 8 percent, so herd meetings remain possible but uncommon. 0 percent strongly separates herds; 100 percent allows unrestricted bunching.
Sandbox_DHBC_HerdCount_tooltip: Number of active persistent herd slots in the world. Range: 1-10. Default: 3. Higher values increase CPU/zombie pressure when multiple herds materialise near loaded areas.
Sandbox_DHBC_HordeShamblerPercent_toolti: Percentage of zombies physically spawned by Dynamic Hordes that are forced to use Build 42 shambler behaviour. Useful if your normal zombie settings use sprinters but you want some or all herd zombies to shamble. Existing vanilla zombies are not changed. The shambler roll takes priority; only zombies not selected as forced shamblers are eligible for the forced-sprinter roll.
Sandbox_DHBC_HordeSprinterPercent_toolti: Percentage of zombies physically spawned by Dynamic Hordes that are forced to use Build 42 sprinter behaviour. Existing vanilla zombies are not changed. 0 percent preserves normal zombie speed settings. If forced shamblers are also enabled, the sprinter percentage is rolled only for zombies that were not already forced to shamble.
Sandbox_DHBC_MainRoadPreferencePercent_t: Chance that a newly assigned migration leg attempts a B42 Nav road route. Default: 35 percent. 0 percent never requests a road route; 100 percent requests one on every connected town pair. If the game cannot provide a complete Nav connection, the herd safely uses an existing non-road corridor instead.
Sandbox_DHBC_MainRoadRoutes_tooltip: Adds road/highway route attempts to every connected town-to-town leg. Existing mapped road guides are used where available; other legs use B42 Nav with the normal corridor as a soft guide. Turn this off to use only the normal/non-road migration corridors.
Sandbox_DHBC_MaxHerdPopulation_tooltip: Maximum population rolled when a herd generation is created. If set below minimum, the minimum is used.
Sandbox_DHBC_MaxPhysicalPerHerd: Maximum physical zombies per herd (performance warning)
Sandbox_DHBC_MaxPhysicalPerHerd_tooltip: Maximum real IsoZombie representatives spawned for one herd at once. Range: 20-800. Default: 110. WARNING: very high values can cause severe FPS, CPU and memory load. At 800, a maximum-sized herd can materialise its full population; with several nearby herds this can create thousands of physical zombies and may freeze or crash the game.
Sandbox_DHBC_MidRouteRetargetChancePerDa: Approximate chance per in-game day that an eligible travelling herd changes to a different connected town. Default: 8 percent, so changes are occasional rather than constant. 0 percent disables natural changes even if the toggle is on.
Sandbox_DHBC_MidRouteRetargetMinHours_to: Minimum in-game hours after a destination is assigned or changed before that herd can change town direction again. Default: 24 hours.
Sandbox_DHBC_MidRouteRetargeting_tooltip: Allows a travelling herd to abandon its current town destination and turn toward a different connected town while already en route. Enabled by default. Does not apply during Onslaught, town roaming or player-alert pursuit.
Sandbox_DHBC_MinHerdPopulation_tooltip: Minimum population rolled when a herd generation is created.
Sandbox_DHBC_MovementSpeedPercent_toolti: Multiplier applied to abstract town-to-town herd movement. 100 percent is the original prototype speed.
Sandbox_DHBC_NavRoadFollowing_tooltip: When enabled, road routes must resolve as one continuous Project Zomboid B42 Nav path. Mapped guide coordinates assist the search but are never used as straight-line road fallbacks. If a complete Nav road cannot be found, the herd uses a normal non-road corridor instead.
Sandbox_DHBC_OnslaughtMode_tooltip: All living herds ignore normal town destinations and continuously migrate toward the player. Herd identities, populations and replacements remain active. Turning this off resumes normal named-town migration. Can be extremely dangerous with many herds.
Sandbox_DHBC_PlayerWarningCooldownHours_: Minimum in-game hours before the same herd can trigger another player warning line.
Sandbox_DHBC_PlayerWarnings_tooltip: The player character occasionally says a warning line when a herd first becomes physically active nearby.
Sandbox_DHBC_RegenerationDelayHours_tool: In-game hours after the most recent herd casualty before gradual recovery begins.
Sandbox_DHBC_RegenerationEnabled_tooltip: Living herds slowly recover toward the population they had when their current generation formed. A fully eliminated herd never regenerates.
Sandbox_DHBC_RegenerationPercentPerDay_t: Percentage of the herd generation target recovered per in-game day after the recovery delay. Default 8 percent means a 20 percent loss takes about 2.5 recovery days.
Sandbox_DHBC_RespawnEnabled_tooltip: If enabled, a completely eliminated herd slot forms a new generation after the configured cooldown.
Sandbox_DHBC_RespawnMaxHours_tooltip: Maximum in-game hours before an eliminated herd can be replaced.
Sandbox_DHBC_RespawnMinHours_tooltip: Minimum in-game hours before an eliminated herd can be replaced.
Sandbox_DHBC_SpawnBatchSize_tooltip: Number of horde members DHBC attempts to materialise in one spawn batch. Range: 1-100. Default: 16. Lower values spread spawning over more updates and can reduce sudden frame hitches; higher values make the physical herd appear faster but may cause a heavier hitch when each batch is created.
Sandbox_DHBC_TownActivationRadius_toolti: Radius around each vanilla route-town centre used to decide same-town encounter persistence after a herd has genuinely arrived. It does not pull a distant herd into the player's loaded area.
Sandbox_DHBC_TownMaterialisation: Keep arrived herds physical in the player's town
Sandbox_DHBC_TownMaterialisation_tooltip: If the player and an already-arrived physical herd occupy the same route-town region, keep that encounter physical while both remain in the town. A distant abstract herd must still reach proximity or the loaded-area fringe before spawning.
Sandbox_DHBC_TownRoamMaxHours_tooltip: Maximum in-game hours a herd spends roaming a town after arrival. Default: 72 hours. If below the minimum, the minimum is used.
Sandbox_DHBC_TownRoamMinHours_tooltip: Minimum in-game hours a herd spends roaming a town after arrival. Default: 24 hours.
Sandbox_DHBC_TownRoaming: Herds linger and roam in towns
Sandbox_DHBC_TownRoaming_tooltip: When a herd reaches a town waypoint, it wanders around that settlement before resuming its migration instead of immediately passing through.
Sandbox_DHBC_WaterAwareRouting_tooltip: Uses land/road corridor waypoints between vanilla towns instead of straight-line abstract travel, helping herds avoid major rivers and lakes. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_DO93_LootRarity_tooltip: Controls how frequently Drugs of '93 items appear in loot. Normal matches the default Drugs of '93 balance which is already pretty rare.
Sandbox_DO93_WeedGrowTime_tooltip: Controls how quickly Drugs of '93 weed plants grow. Normal matches the default Drugs of '93 grow time (90 days).
Sandbox_DO93_WeedSpawns_tooltip: Controls whether Drugs of '93 weed items, weed seeds, joints and blunts spawn in the world.

Sandbox_DarkPresence_AmbientSpawn_toolti: Taken trickle in on their own on dark ground around you during the dark hours. Off = Taken only from manuscript events / debug.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_DebugMode_tooltip: Turns on the mod's log output and the F6 Director panel (spawn/cleanse Taken, jump the clock, force a storm, hand yourself pages and the beacon, preview the credits) plus debug keys K/L/P/B/J. For testing and filming. Default off.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_DespawnInDaylight_t: When a clear day returns (not night/rain/fog/storm), still-shielded Taken dissolve away. Off = they linger as killable zombies. Default on.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_DrainSeconds_toolti: Seconds a Taken must spend under full light for its darkness shield to burn off completely. Higher = tougher Taken. Default 10.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_DreadMood_tooltip: Standing in darkness with Taken nearby steadily raises Panic; getting into the light or clear of them calms it. Off = no mood effect.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_FloodLightUnlock_to: How the Craft Flood Light recipe is unlocked. Blueprint = find a schematic in the world. Skill = reach Electricity level 3. Always = known from day 1.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_LeakEnabled_tooltip: As the manuscript is read, the days darken and shorten. Requires Story mode. Default on.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_NaturalStorms: Dark storms roll in on their own
Sandbox_DarkPresence_NaturalStorms_toolt: Once a day the dark may bring its own storm in the evening, not just when a manuscript page summons one. It never stacks: skipped if a storm is already running or the weather is already rainy/foggy/overcast. Off = storms only come from the story.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_NightStartHour_tool: The hour (24h) when Taken begin to spawn and roam on a clear night. Default 23 (11pm). Lower = the threat starts earlier in the evening. Storms/gloom still summon the dark any time.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_PostEnding_tooltip: What Knox County becomes once you win the finale (hold the beacon). The dark can leave for good, loosen its grip but stay, or carry on unchanged.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_PunishmentMax_toolt: Upper cap on how many Taken a manuscript page's curse can summon (the punishment escalates the deeper you read). Lower = gentler late game.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_RadioChance_tooltip: Chance the dark frequency (90.2) actually transmits during each eligible dead hour (00:00-03:00). Lower = rarer, more haunting. 0 = the radio never airs.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_RadioEnabled_toolti: A hidden station at 90.2 that airs in the dead hours (00:00-03:00). With Story mode on it dictates manuscript pages; with Story mode off it still broadcasts survivor chatter as atmosphere. Default on.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_RegenSeconds_toolti: Seconds in darkness to rebuild a full shield from nothing. Compare with Shield drain time: higher = light damage sticks for longer. Default 25.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_Secret_tooltip: I don't know what this does.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_ShieldRegen_tooltip: A Taken you burned but did not finish rebuilds its darkness shield once it is back in real darkness. Cleansing is still permanent -- a shield burned all the way off never comes back. Off = any damage you do to a shield is permanent.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_ShieldRing_tooltip: A faint white ring over a shielded Taken that tightens as your light burns its darkness away, so you can see how much shield is left. It shows while light is actually burning one and fades a few seconds after, so the night is not full of circles. Off = no rings; judge it by eye.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_StormDailyChance_to: Percent chance per day that a dark storm rolls in on its own. Default 15.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_StormFlicker_toolti: During a Dark Presence storm, nearby powered lights stutter and cut for a moment. Purely atmospheric. Off = steady lights.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_StoryMode_tooltip: Off = a combat-only sandbox: no manuscript pages, no Leak, no beacon finale. Just the Taken and the light-as-weapon fight. The dark frequency keeps broadcasting survivor chatter as atmosphere, but it will never hand out a page. (Off also forces the Leak option off.)
Sandbox_DarkPresence_TaintEnabled_toolti: Lingering outdoors near Taken slowly builds 'taint'; at thresholds the dark leaves eerie notes, and at max it draws a Taken to you. Rare by design (~10+ min of lingering). Off = no taint notes or spawns.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_TaintRate: How fast the dark notices you (%%)
Sandbox_DarkPresence_TaintRate_tooltip: Speed of the taint that builds while you linger outdoors near Taken, and drains in shelter. 100 = default (~11 real minutes of lingering to be fully noticed). Raise it to be hunted sooner and far more often - 400 makes the dark find you most nights. Lower it for a rarer, slower dread. Requires 'The dark notices you'.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_TakenTransform_tool: While it's Taken time (night / gloom), the darkness can possess ordinary zombies shambling outdoors in the dark near you, turning them into Taken. Shares the ambient Taken cap. Off = Taken only appear via spawning.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_TakenVariants_toolt: Spawn distinct Taken types that differ by SPEED only: sprinting Lurkers (icy rim) and shambling Anchors (violet rim) alongside normal Taken. Every variant takes the same light to burn, so only the pace of the thing coming for you changes. Off = all Taken are identical.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_TransformChance_too: Chance, per check, that the dark possesses a nearby ordinary zombie and turns it into a Taken (when 'The dark claims walkers' is on). Higher = more turn.
Sandbox_DarkSearchTimeMultiplier_tooltip: Search time multiplier when the container is in dark light. Default 3.
Sandbox_DeadMagic_LogLevel_tooltip: Controls non-critical Dead Magic logs. Errors always log.
Sandbox_DeadMagic_MagicTalentMagazineSpa: Magic Talent Magazine Spawn Rate Multiplier
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_ContainerSpawnRa: How often dossier pages spawn inside world containers (police lockers, military storage, hospital cabinets, fire dept lockers). This is separate from zombie drops.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_DropChance_Firef: Chance that a firefighter zombie drops a dossier page when killed. Firefighter dossier requires 2 pages to assemble. Rewards: axe, sledgehammer, crowbar, fireman gear, blow torch.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_DropChance_Medic: Chance that a doctor or nurse zombie drops a dossier page when killed. Medical dossier requires 2 pages to assemble. Rewards: antibiotics, bandages, painkillers, surgical tools.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_DropChance_Milit: Chance that a military zombie drops a dossier page when killed. Military dossier requires 3 pages to assemble. Rewards: assault rifles, ammo, camo gear, military backpack.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_DropChance_Polic: Chance that a police zombie drops a dossier page when killed. Police dossier requires 2 pages to assemble. Rewards: pistols, shotguns, ammo, police gear.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_DropChance_Range: Chance that a ranger zombie drops a dossier page when killed. Ranger dossier requires 2 pages to assemble. Rewards: hunting rifle, shotguns, knife, hatchet, ranger gear.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_ProximityRadius_: How close (in tiles) you must be to a stash location to collect the reward (5-50). Default: 15 tiles. Lower = harder to find, higher = easier. Players get color-coded proximity hints as they approach.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_RewardRarity_too: Multiplier applied to all stash reward drop chances. Generous doubles the chances, Minimal makes only the most common items drop.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_UseCustomRewards: When enabled, stash rewards are loaded from the config file at Zomboid/Lua/DeadMansDossier_Rewards.cfg instead of using the built-in reward tables. The config file is auto-generated with defaults on first server start. Edit it to add, remove, or change reward items and their drop chances. The Reward Rarity multiplier still applies on top.
Sandbox_DeadStash_AerialDanger_tooltip: Controls whether warned strafing passes can damage exposed survivors and how dangerous the corridor is.
Sandbox_DeadStash_AerialEventFrequency_t: Controls the server-authoritative interval between expanded aerial events.
Sandbox_DeadStash_AerialEvents_tooltip: Enables humanitarian drops, quarantine medical drops, reconnaissance passes and warned attack-aircraft events.
Sandbox_DeadStash_AmbientVehicleSpawns: Spawn the ambient Dead Stashes vehicle fleet
Sandbox_DeadStash_AmbientVehicleSpawns_t: Adds civilian cars, service vehicles, the tractor and cargo bicycle to vanilla vehicle zones. Disable for vehicle-overhaul servers. Unique expedition reward vehicles use their own setting.
Sandbox_DeadStash_AureliaRestoration_too: Allows the damaged original Aurelia V12 to spawn and enables its six server-validated restoration stages.
Sandbox_DeadStash_ChainChance_tooltip: Chance to add each extra clue until the maximum number of stages is reached.
Sandbox_DeadStash_CipherChance_tooltip: Chance checked after radio recordings. Exact encoded clues replace plain coordinates with a small arithmetic cipher.
Sandbox_DeadStash_ClueAccuracy_tooltip: Exact gives coordinates and distance; Approximate gives a distance band and floor; Cryptic gives only direction and container type; Mixed rolls per story.
Sandbox_DeadStash_CureCarrierChance_tool: Chance that a rare Dead Stashes hazmat courier carries one infection-clearing KX-7 ampoule. This setting is evaluated by the server.
Sandbox_DeadStash_CureSystem_tooltip: Allows KX-7 ampoules to clear Knox infection and appear on eligible couriers. Disable when another medical or infection overhaul should have exclusive control.
Sandbox_DeadStash_CurseEvents_tooltip: Allows players to open the Black Reliquary and voluntarily begin synchronized ashbound waves that collapse at dawn.
Sandbox_DeadStash_CurseIntensity_tooltip: Controls wave count and ashbound guardians per wave. The Ash-Ward Lantern reduces each wave by 40%%.
Sandbox_DeadStash_CycleUpgrades: Cargo bicycle upgrades and dashboard adaptation
Sandbox_DeadStash_CycleUpgrades_tooltip: Enables basket, rack and pannier installation plus the bicycle-specific dashboard treatment. Disable if another vehicle UI or bicycle system should own these interactions.
Sandbox_DeadStash_DebugLogging_tooltip: Writes stash creation, progression and missing-item diagnostics to console.txt. Leave disabled for normal play.
Sandbox_DeadStash_ExpeditionAbundance_to: Controls how often thematic infected carry an expedition lead and how likely their optional signature item is.
Sandbox_DeadStash_GeneratorFuelForecast_: Adds a remaining-hours estimate to the vanilla generator information window. Disable if a generator UI overhaul owns that panel.
Sandbox_DeadStash_GuardianChance_tooltip: Chance that thematic infected owners appear around the final hiding place. If direct spawning is unavailable, nearby zombies are attracted instead.
Sandbox_DeadStash_GuardianStrength_toolt: Controls how many thematic infected may guard the final destination.
Sandbox_DeadStash_HeritageAnimals_toolti: Allows the Bramble Reserve finale to introduce three unique named animals using Build 42 animal breeds and animations.
Sandbox_DeadStash_InvestigatorBonuses: Investigator starting and Search Mode bonuses
Sandbox_DeadStash_InvestigatorBonuses_to: Enables the Investigator profession's starting skills, equipment and Search Mode speciality. Disable when another profession overhaul should provide all occupation bonuses.
Sandbox_DeadStash_IrrigationEnabled_tool: Allows players to install recoverable intake pumps, connected pipe sections and emitters that water crops and fill rain barrels.
Sandbox_DeadStash_KeyChance_tooltip: Chance that the final stash requires the matching key found on the original corpse.
Sandbox_DeadStash_LegacyRecoveryPercent_: Percentage of recorded perk XP used as the next survivor's recovery target. A legacy can be consumed only once per world.
Sandbox_DeadStash_LegacyRestoreRecipes_t: Allows the next survivor to learn recipes recorded in a previous survivor's field journal.
Sandbox_DeadStash_LegacySystem_tooltip: Allows recording and restoring a dead survivor's experience and learned recipes. Disable for permadeath or XP-overhaul servers; previously recorded journals remain stored but cannot be consumed.
Sandbox_DeadStash_LifetimeDays_tooltip: Active stories expire after this many world days and release their reserved containers. Use 0 to disable expiration.
Sandbox_DeadStash_LootValue_tooltip: Controls the amount and rarity of the thematic reward. The reward is generated once by the server.
Sandbox_DeadStash_MaxActiveStashes_toolt: Limits unresolved stash stories in the world. New clues stop spawning at this cap until players complete an active stash.
Sandbox_DeadStash_MaxStages_tooltip: Limits a stash story to one, two or three destinations. Each additional stage is rolled separately using the chain chance.
Sandbox_DeadStash_NavigatorIntegration_t: Adds a route action when Navigator is installed. Navigator remains optional and is never required to load this mod.
Sandbox_DeadStash_NewInvestigationSpawns: Allows new clue chains to be generated from zombie deaths. Disable to stop new investigations without deleting active stories or items already stored in the save.
Sandbox_DeadStash_NoteChance_tooltip: A value of 250 means an eligible clue appears on average once per 250 zombie deaths. A clue is created only when suitable loaded containers are available nearby.
Sandbox_DeadStash_PhotoChance_tooltip: Chance checked after recordings and ciphers. Successful rolls create a marked photograph instead of a written note.
Sandbox_DeadStash_PopCultureFrequency_to: Controls original pop-culture-inspired leads in containers. The designs are homages without copied names, logos or third-party assets.
Sandbox_DeadStash_ReadingSpeedIntegratio: Lets the Dead Stashes Reading skill, Bookworm trait and reading equipment alter vanilla book duration and award Reading XP. Disable if another reading overhaul must have exclusive control.
Sandbox_DeadStash_RecordingChance_toolti: Chance checked first for each clue. Successful rolls create a damaged recorded transmission.
Sandbox_DeadStash_RelicGameplayEffects_t: Enables relic skill, XP, protection and utility effects. Disable to keep relics as collectible/crafting objects with no character bonuses.
Sandbox_DeadStash_RelicPower_tooltip: Cosmetic keeps relic skill bonuses but disables infection cures. Limited enables cures and seven-day Starfall protection. Mythic makes Starfall protection permanent.
Sandbox_DeadStash_SharedNotifications_to: When enabled, every player receives stash and clue discovery messages. When disabled, only the finder is notified.
Sandbox_DeadStash_SpecialZombieFrequency: Controls rare vanilla-clothed infected tied to expedition leads. No custom outfit mod is required.
Sandbox_DeadStash_StarterArchivePack_too: Gives each character one lightweight field journal, an opening dossier, a worn nailed bat, a crowbar and a pencil. Existing characters receive it once after upgrading.
Sandbox_DeadStash_TeamClues_tooltip: Allows a clue holder to broadcast the current lead. Every player may then follow that stage, including players who join later.
Sandbox_DeadStash_TrapChance_tooltip: Chance that the final stash triggers broken glass or a repeating improvised alarm capable of attracting zombies.
Sandbox_DeadStash_VehicleDossierUI_toolt: Adds an inspection dossier to unique Dead Stashes vehicles. Disable to avoid vehicle-context-menu integrations while keeping the vehicles fully drivable and repairable.
Sandbox_DeadStash_VehicleRewards_tooltip: Allows the Chronorunner, Wasteland Courier, Neon Interceptor and Red Sun Scout to spawn once when their expedition is completed. Disable for vehicle-restricted servers.
Sandbox_DeadStash_WeaponLootInjection: Inject Dead Stashes firearms into vanilla loot
Sandbox_DeadStash_WeaponLootInjection_to: Adds the vanilla-style firearm set and suppressor kits to gun, police and hunting containers. Has no effect when general loot injection is disabled.
Sandbox_DeadStash_WorldLootInjection: Inject Dead Stashes items into vanilla loot
Sandbox_DeadStash_WorldLootInjection_too: Adds books, tools, relic components and expedition leads to vanilla procedural containers. Disable for servers with a total loot overhaul; expedition rewards and existing items remain valid.
Sandbox_DeathZoneDurationHours_tooltip: How many real-world hours the block lasts after death. Set to 0 to block the area permanently.
Sandbox_DeathZoneEnabled_tooltip: Stops a player from using Spawn Selector to spawn back near where their previous character died, making it harder to immediately reclaim lost gear with a fresh character.
Sandbox_DeathZoneRadius_tooltip: How far, in tiles, the no-spawn zone extends around a player's death location.
Sandbox_DebugMinutesToUpdateConsole_tool: Updates every specified in-game minutes. This is for server owners wanting to prevent clutter from flooding the console.
Sandbox_Debug_DanceAnim_tooltip: Enabling this will make animation names appear above some of the new animations
Sandbox_Debug_Expressions_tooltip: Enables manual expressions in the admin context menu
Sandbox_Debug_MoodlePriority_tooltip: Enabling this will cause other modded moodles to appear above lifestyle moodles.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_CanopyDecayMulti_to: Determines decay speed when the vehicle is under a roof (protection from rain and UV).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayAutumnMulti_to: Adjusts decay speed during Autumn (baseline conditions).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayEngineExposedM: Minor penalty for engine bay when sheltered but the hood is open.
Multiplier for engine parts when the hood is open or missing outdoors.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayEngineProtecte: Decay reduction for engine parts when the hood is properly closed.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayExposedMulti_t: When enabled, interiors decay faster if windows/doors are missing or open.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayInteriorExpose: Minor decay penalty for open interiors even when sheltered (dust, humidity).
Multiplier for interior decay when exposed to outdoor elements like rain and UV.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayIntervalHours_: Frequency (in hours) at which the system calculates vehicle degradation. (435 = Every ~18 days, calibrated for full decay over 10-30 years in average conditions depending on part)
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierBatt: Decay rate for batteries (sulfation and discharge).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierBrak: Decay rate for brake discs and components.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierDoor: Decay rate for all doors and panels.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierEngi: Decay rate for the vehicle hood.
Decay rate for internal engine components.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierGasT: Decay rate for the fuel tank.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierGlov: Decay rate for the glove box compartment.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierHead: Decay rate for light lenses and bulbs.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierHeat: Decay rate for the heater core and cooling path.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierMuff: Decay rate for the exhaust system.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierRadi: Decay rate for electronics and radio components.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierSusp: Decay rate for suspension and bushings.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierTire: Decay rate for rubber tires (dry rot and UV damage).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierTruc: Decay rate for rear truck beds.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierWhee: Decay rate for wheel rims (oxidation and corrosion).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayMultiplierWind: Decay rate for tempered side glass.
Decay rate for laminated windshield glass.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayQualityMultipl: Decay speed multiplier for standard quality parts.
Decay speed multiplier applied to aged or worn parts.
Decay speed multiplier for premium/performance parts.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayRetroactive_to: If enabled, applies accumulated damage to vehicles based on the time elapsed since the apocalypse began.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecaySpringMulti_to: Adjusts decay speed during Spring (moisture and temperature swings).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecaySummerMulti_to: Adjusts decay speed during Summer (UV exposure and heat cycles).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayVehicleTypeHea: Decay speed multiplier for trucks and heavy vehicles.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayVehicleTypeSpo: Decay speed multiplier for performance and sport vehicles.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayVehicleTypeSta: Baseline decay speed for normal passenger cars.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_DecayWinterMulti_to: Adjusts decay speed during Winter (freeze-thaw and high humidity).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_IndoorDecayMulti_to: Determines decay speed when the vehicle is inside a room or garage. This should generally be lower than Shelter Effectiveness to reflect superior protection from humidity and temperature swings.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_ProtectionHours_too: Hours a vehicle remains exempt from decay after its last use. Set to 0 to disable protection.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_RustAccumulationRat: Base rate at which rust builds up on exposed metal parts.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_RustCosmeticDamage_: Base damage multiplier for metal parts when rust is in the cosmetic stage.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_RustDamageMultiplie: Scales how aggressively rust destroys parts after passing the threshold.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_RustDamageThreshold: Rust level (0-1) above which parts suffer accelerated structural damage.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_RustShelteredMultip: How much slower rust forms when the vehicle is sheltered.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_SunFadeEnabled_tool: If enabled, vehicles left exposed to the sun will gradually lose paint saturation due to UV damage (simulating 80s/90s paint).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_SunFadeMinSaturatio: The lowest color saturation limit (0.0 to 1.0) the vehicle paint can reach from sun fading. (Default: 0.50 = 50%% saturation).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_SunFadeRate_tooltip: Adjusts how quickly the vehicle paint fades over time. 1.0 simulates realistic fading over 10-15 years.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_TallGrassRustEnable: If enabled, vehicles parked on tall grass will accumulate rust faster due to trapped moisture.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_TallGrassRustMulti_: Multiplier for rust accumulation when parked on tall grass. (Default: 2.0x faster).
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_TireLowPressureDama: Accelerated decay multiplier applied when tires are underinflated.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_TirePressureDamageT: Pressure level below which tires suffer structural damage from the vehicle's weight.
Sandbox_DecayVehicle_TirePressureDecay_t: Rate of natural air loss over time.

Sandbox_DefaultEventDurationHours_toolti: Default duration in game hours when HTT starts an event.
Sandbox_Defecation_CanPooSelf_tooltip: Uncheck to disable the 'defecating yourself' function
Sandbox_Defecation_DefecateIncreaseMulti: How fast the defecate %% increases every ten minutes (default is roughly 66.6%% defecation per 24 hours if stomach is neutral)
Sandbox_Defecation_DefecateTimeMultiplie: How long it takes to defecate after you begin the process
Sandbox_Defecation_DefecatedBottomsMulti: How much stress and unhappyness you gain every ten minutes
Sandbox_Defecation_DiarrheaIncreaseMulti: How much having diarrhea can multiply your defecate %% increase
Sandbox_Defecation_FartNoiseRadiusMultip: How loud the noise can be after defecating (default is 15, but this only applies if you're sick, unlucky, and have a weak stomach)
Sandbox_Defecation_FecesPileUnhealthyMul: How much sickness and unhappyness the player gains from piles of feces nearby
Sandbox_Defecation_ShowNumericStatus_too: Uncheck to hide numbers shown on 'Defecation Status' window
Sandbox_Defecation_SickCaloriesRemovedMu: Amount of calories removed when you are sick
Sandbox_Defecation_SickThirstRemovedMult: Amount of thirst removed when you are sick
Sandbox_Defecation_ToiletNoiseRadiusMult: How loud the toilet can be (default is radius of 10 squares, so about 5 squares in each direction)
Sandbox_Defecation_VitaminMaxTimeMultipl: The maximum amount of time the vitamins can affect you if multiple are eaten (default is 6 hours)
Sandbox_Defecation_VitaminTimeMultiplier: How long the anti-diarrheal vitamins can affect you (default is 3 hours)
Sandbox_DenimFabric_MinConditionToRepair: Item must be at least this condition (0–1) to be eligible for repair. Set 0.0 to allow repairing from broken state.
Sandbox_DenimFabric_RequiredLevelToRepai: Minimum tailoring level required to repair denim items (0–10).
Sandbox_DenimFabric_T_CanRepairDenim_too: If enabled, the Electric Sewing machine can repair denim items.
Sandbox_DestoryStartAsh_Tooltip:

This option also affects artillery support

Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_CopperOreChance_t: Chance to drop copper ore when a boulder is destroyed.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_CopperOreMax_tool: Maximum copper ore dropped when its chance succeeds.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_CopperOreMin_tool: Minimum copper ore dropped when its chance succeeds.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_EnableCraftingAdd: When disabled, hides and blocks the crafting recipes added by Break Big Rocks, prevents its vanilla forge-recipe patches, and stops automatic Blacksmithing recipe unlocks. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_FlatStoneChance_t: Chance to drop a flat stone when a boulder is destroyed.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_FlatStoneMax_tool: Maximum flat stones dropped when its chance succeeds.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_FlatStoneMin_tool: Minimum flat stones dropped when its chance succeeds.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_FlintChance_toolt: Chance to drop flint when a boulder is destroyed.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_FlintMax_tooltip: Maximum flint nodules dropped when its chance succeeds.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_FlintMin_tooltip: Minimum flint nodules dropped when its chance succeeds.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_IronBloomChance_t: Chance to drop an iron bloom when a boulder is destroyed.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_IronBloomMax_tool: Maximum iron blooms dropped when its chance succeeds.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_IronBloomMin_tool: Minimum iron blooms dropped when its chance succeeds.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_IronOreChance_too: Chance to drop an iron ore chunk when a boulder is destroyed.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_IronOreMax_toolti: Maximum iron ore chunks dropped when its chance succeeds.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_IronOreMin_toolti: Minimum iron ore chunks dropped when its chance succeeds.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_LargeStoneChance_: Chance to drop a large stone when a boulder is destroyed.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_LargeStoneMax_too: Maximum large stones dropped when its chance succeeds.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_LargeStoneMin_too: Minimum large stones dropped when its chance succeeds.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_MiningSoundsAttra: When enabled, breaking a boulder generates a world sound that nearby zombies can hear. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_RocksMax_tooltip: Maximum number of rocks dropped per boulder.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_RocksMin_tooltip: Minimum number of rocks dropped per boulder.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_SharpenStoneChanc: Chance to drop a sharpening stone when a boulder is destroyed.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_SharpenStoneMax_t: Maximum sharpening stones dropped when its chance succeeds.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_SharpenStoneMin_t: Minimum sharpening stones dropped when its chance succeeds.

Sandbox_DownButNotOut_RespawnWithInjurie: Enabled will have the player revive with the wounds they had before dying. Bandaged, splinted and otherwise taken care of.
Sandbox_DownButNotOut_ReviveCureInfectio: Turned on will remove the Knox Infection from the player upon reviving.
Sandbox_DownButNotOut_SaveCooldownMin_to: Minimum wait between snapshots. 0 removes the cooldown.

Sandbox_DownButNotOut_WoundsHealingMin_t: How long it takes to lose one Wound, in minutes.
