Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyBaseCarryW: Sets the default body carry limit for colony workers before bag weight reduction is applied. Higher values let scavengers haul more before returning home.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyBaseWorkAm: Sets the total work required for a scavenger to finish one loot roll. Higher values make each scavenging roll take longer unless the worker has better speed multipliers.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyBaseWorkMu: Sets the base scavenging speed multiplier before archetype bonuses and equipment bonuses are applied. Higher values make scavengers complete work faster.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyDailyCalor: Sets the fixed daily hunger reserve consumed by colony workers. This value is also used as the hunger bar's full-day target.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyDailyHydra: Sets the fixed daily hydration reserve consumed by colony workers. This value is also used as the hydration bar's full-day target.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyDoctorHeal: Scales resting HP recovery when doctor treatment hours are available for the worker.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyFishingWor: Sets the total work required for a fishing worker to finish one catch roll. Higher values make each catch take longer unless the worker has better speed multipliers or active bait.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyHealthRege: Labour: Home Health Regen Per Hour
Sets how much HP a resting worker naturally recovers per in-game hour before infirmary and doctor bonuses are applied.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyInfirmaryH: Scales resting HP recovery for workers assigned to an infirmary bed.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyResearchWo: Sets the total work required to unlock one researched recipe before intelligence and extra samples accelerate it.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.ColonyScavengeTr: How many in-game hours a scavenger spends traveling to or from the assigned scavenging site.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.CompanionCommand: How many tiles away a commanded Travel Companion can be and still answer a radial command.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.PlayerOwnedNPCAm: If enabled, player-owned NPCs spend their tracked ranged ammo during combat and reloading. Non-player-owned NPCs always keep unlimited ammo.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.PlayerOwnedNPCTo: If enabled, colony-managed tools and drainable utility items assigned to player-owned NPCs can lose condition or charges from work. Disable it to freeze worker tool wear.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.PlayerOwnedNPCWe: If enabled, only player-owned NPCs consume weapon durability in combat. Non-player-owned NPCs always keep unlimited durability handling.
Sandbox_DynamicColonies.StarterWorkerCou: How many generated starter workers each player receives once. Multiplayer players each get their own grant before joining another colony faction.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmClou: Cloud intensity forced during cataclysm weather. Higher values make the storm look darker and heavier.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmDesa: Visual desaturation during cataclysm weather. Higher values make the world look more bleak and storm-heavy.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmFixe: Used only in Fixed days and hour mode. Uses the 24-hour clock: 22 means 10:00 PM.
Used only in Fixed days and hour mode.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmFogI: Fog intensity forced during cataclysm weather. 0 disables extra fog, 1 is maximum fog.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmMaxD: Used only in Random interval mode. The rolled deadline is persistent across restarts.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmMinD: Used only in Random interval mode. The rolled deadline is persistent across restarts.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmPurs: How many in-game hours cataclysm zombies should keep directly pursuing the selected player. After this, the mod stops reinforcing the direct target.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmSche: Random interval uses the minimum and maximum day settings. Fixed mode uses the fixed interval in days and fixed hour. The selected deadline survives save and server restarts.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmWeat: How long the cataclysm weather event should last. The mod first tries a tropical storm, then falls back to storm, rain, lightning, and custom weather calls if needed.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmWind: Wind intensity forced during cataclysm weather. 0 disables extra wind, 1 is maximum wind.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_DisableAtNigh: Disable normal horde events at night
Applies only to the normal horde. If its persistent deadline occurs during the configured night window, that occurrence is skipped and the next one is scheduled.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableCatacly: Force fog and wind during cataclysm weather
Adds climate overrides on top of the tropical storm: fog, strong wind, heavy clouds and desaturation. Overrides are reset after the cataclysm weather duration.
When a cataclysm horde event starts, the player character says a more intense random warning line above their head.
Enables a rare ultra-hardcore horde event with its own timer and warning indicator.
When enabled, zombies spawned by a cataclysm horde are forced to pursue the selected player directly. The cataclysm attraction sound is still emitted.
Attempts to force severe weather when a cataclysm horde starts.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableDirecti: Show direction indicators for all hordes
Controls the direction indicator for normal, wandering and cataclysm hordes. The all-notifications master switch can disable every player-facing warning at once.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableEventNo: Master switch for player-facing warnings from real events: direction indicators, warning audio, survivor lines and the cataclysm screen effect. Gameplay attraction sounds used by zombie AI are not disabled.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableMPActiv: In multiplayer, clamps normal and wandering horde spawn distance so freshly spawned zombies stay in the active simulation area and can hear the single attraction sound.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableNormalH: Requires normal horde target tracking. Periodically asks spawned normal horde zombies to rebuild a path to the selected player, which can help with high fences and different floors. This uses no extra sound pulses, but can make normal hordes more direct and slightly increase server AI work.

When enabled, zombies spawned by a normal horde keep periodically refreshing their target, aggro, and last-heard position to the selected player while they are alive. The normal attraction sound is still emitted, but this does not create extra sound pulses or cataclysm catch-up respawns.
When a normal horde event starts, the player character says a short random warning line above their head.
Enables the scheduled regular horde event. Cataclysm and wandering hordes have their own toggles and are not affected by this setting.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableWanderi: When a wandering horde event starts, the player character says a short random line about staying quiet or letting the horde pass.
Enables a separate passing horde event. The horde spawns on one side of the player and is attracted toward a point beyond the player area, so it may pass by if you stay quiet.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableWarning: Play warning sounds for all hordes
Controls audible player warnings for normal, wandering and cataclysm hordes. This does not disable the inaudible world-sound event used to attract zombie AI.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_Enabled_toolt: Master switch for Dynamic Horde Events. While disabled, persistent event timers are paused instead of being rerolled. Use the per-event toggles below to disable only one horde type.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_MPActiveSpawn: MP active spawn max radius, tiles

Maximum spawn distance for normal and wandering hordes in multiplayer when active spawn clamp is enabled. Higher values can spawn zombies outside active AI range, causing them to ignore the attraction sound.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_MPAttractionD: Delay before the single attraction sound is emitted after spawning zombies in multiplayer. Values below 6 seconds may fail to attract spawned MP zombies. Increase this if the server has high load
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_MaxSpawnHours: Used only in Random interval mode. The rolled deadline is persistent and is not rerolled when the save or server is restarted.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_MinSpawnHours: Used only in Random interval mode. The rolled deadline is persistent and is not rerolled when the save or server is restarted.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_NormalFixedHo: Used only in Fixed days and hour mode. Uses the 24-hour clock: 22 means 10:00 PM. The event runs on the first scheduler check at or after this hour.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_NormalFixedIn: Used only in Fixed days and hour mode. For example, 7 triggers a normal horde every seven in-game days.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_NormalSchedul: Random interval uses the minimum and maximum hour settings. Fixed mode uses the fixed interval in days and fixed hour. The selected deadline is stored in the save and survives restarts.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_ScalingInterv: How many days or months must pass before the horde size multiplier increases.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_ScalingMaxMul: Maximum total horde size multiplier. Example: 300 means the horde size can grow up to x3.Do not set 100. If you dont want scaling off disable it in scaling mode
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_ScalingMode_t: Controls whether horde size increases over time. 1 Off disables scaling. 2 Days survived scales by survived days. 3 Months survived scales by survived months.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_ScalingMultip: How much the horde size increases per scaling interval. Example: 25 means +25%% per interval.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingExit: How far beyond the player the attraction point is placed. Higher values make the horde try to pass farther through the area instead of stopping near the player.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingFixe: Used only in Fixed days and hour mode. Set this to 22 for 10:00 PM.
Used only in Fixed days and hour mode. Set this to 1 for one wandering horde every in-game day.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingMaxH: Used only in Random interval mode. The rolled deadline is persistent across restarts.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingMinH: Used only in Random interval mode. The rolled deadline is persistent across restarts.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingSche: Random interval uses the minimum and maximum hour settings. Fixed mode uses the fixed interval in days and fixed hour. The selected deadline survives save and server restarts.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingSpre: How wide the wandering horde spawn formation is. Higher values make the horde look less like a single clump.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.EscortIncident: After the minimum escort incident floor is satisfied, this percent chance adds one extra pending escort incident when eligible traders exist.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.MinimumEscortI: Guarantees at least this many pending escort incidents when eligible traders and rescue sites exist. If the floor cannot be met, debug logs explain why.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.MinimumResting: Guarantees up to this many resting quest families are available when eligible traders exist. Missing families are filled before optional extras are rolled.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.QuestDifficult: Global multiplier for encounter-based objective spawns. Higher values spawn more quest zombies and raise the required kill count.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.QuestExpiratio: Scales the base expiration for generated Dynamic Objectives quests. Set to 0 to disable quest expiration.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.QuestRewardMin: Minimum cash paid directly to the player when a Dynamic Objectives quest includes a money reward. Set to 0 to disable the floor.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.QuestRewardPoo: Allows Dynamic Objectives procedural quest rewards to include bag and backpack items from the Dynamic Trading item registry.
Allows Dynamic Objectives procedural quest rewards to include food and drink items from the Dynamic Trading item registry.
Allows Dynamic Objectives procedural quest rewards to include medicine and medical-tool items from the Dynamic Trading item registry.
Allows Dynamic Objectives procedural quest rewards to include weapon items from the Dynamic Trading item registry.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.RestingContrac: After the minimum resting quest family floor is satisfied, each remaining resting contract family gets this percent chance to appear as another available job.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.AllowHardcoreEven: If enabled, negative events like Famine, War, and Inflation can occur.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.AllowMetaEvents_t: If enabled, long-term world condition events can activate based on their conditions.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.AllowSeasonalEven: If enabled, events like Harvest (Autumn) and Deep Freeze (Winter) can occur.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.BanditAmbushChanc: Chance for each eligible ambush check to spawn a bandit group near an active player.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.BanditAmbushCoold: Minimum in-game hours between random bandit ambushes on the server.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.BanditAmbushDiffi: Controls random ambush group size. 1 = one bandit, 5 = five bandits.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.BanditHouseRoamer: Chance for each bandit roamer dispatch check to start a new occupied-house encounter when the faction is below its active roamer cap.
Percentage of alive Bandits faction members that are eligible to be selected for house-roamer runs.
Maximum percentage of alive Bandits faction members that can be active as house roamers at the same time.
Maximum tile distance from an active player when choosing a house/building for a Bandit roamer site.
Minimum tile distance from an active player when choosing a house/building for a Bandit roamer site.
How many in-game hours Bandit roamers hold a chosen house/building before abandoning the site and leaving the run.
How many in-game hours Bandit roamers spend traveling to and from their occupied-house encounter site.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.BanditRaidPartyPe: Percentage of resting hostile faction members that can join a raid, capped by Bandit Ambush Difficulty.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.BuildingMaterialM: Scales the material requirements used by faction building and upgrade systems.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.CategoryInflation: How fast prices rise when players buy out a specific category (Supply and Demand).
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.ColonyWealth_tool: Sets the colony wealth baseline used for faction economies and trader budget calculations.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.DisableNightScanG: If enabled, the radio scanner will be capable of acquiring trader signals at night (10PM to 5AM) instead of just static.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.EnableBanditAmbus: Allows no-base hostile bandit groups to ambush players and demand money or items. Debug/admin spawning still works when disabled.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.EnableBanditHouse: Allows true Bandits faction members to run dedicated house-roaming danger encounters instead of using normal trader trade runs.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.EventChance_toolt: Probability of an event starting when the frequency check occurs.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionConsumptio: Global multiplier applied to faction resource consumption during simulation.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionDailyConsu: Multiplier for daily food and meds consumption. Higher values make factions harder to sustain.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionDeathThres: How many days a faction can go without food before members start dying rapidly.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionFlashMaxAc: Maximum number of concurrent faction flash-event slots per faction.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionFlashMinAc: Minimum number of faction flash-event slots reserved per faction. Full multi-event logic is applied in the event-system runtime.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionGrowthChan: Daily chance for a stable faction to recruit a new member if recruits are available.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionRespawnBas: How long respawned factions should strongly avoid recently abandoned homes in the same town.
Small chance for a respawned faction to reclaim a recently abandoned base instead of taking a fresh one.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionRespawnCha: Daily chance for a new faction to arrive in a town if the number of existing factions is below the limit.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionRespawnDel: Minimum in-game days before a wiped town can receive a replacement faction again.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionStartPop_t: Initial number of members in a generated faction.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.GlobalRecruitCoun: Total number of new wanderers available for all factions to recruit each day.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.IndependentSpawnR: The maximum tile distance from an active player that an Independent (Nomadic) or wandering trader can spawn.
The minimum tile distance from an active player that an Independent (Nomadic) or wandering trader can spawn.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.InflationDecay_to:
Percentage of price inflation that recovers every day.
0.1 = 10%% Decay.
0.5 = 50%% Decay (Fast Recovery).
0.0 = Inflation never decays.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.MaxFactionsPerCou: How much room a county has for long-term system-generated replacement factions after wipes and collapse.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.MaxFactionsPerTow: How many factions each town tries to seed during new-game startup and player-driven town discovery.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.MaxGameplayLogs_t: The maximum number of gameplay log entries to keep in history.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.MaxLogs_tooltip: The maximum number of recent network logs to keep in history.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCBaseHealthMult: Scales the archetype base HP used by DT NPC custom health. 1.0 = default values, 2.0 = double base HP before skill bonuses.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCDamageDealtMul: Scales damage dealt by DT NPC melee and ranged attacks without changing their max HP.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCDamageTakenMul: Scales real damage applied to DT NPC virtual HP. Lower than 1.0 makes them tankier, higher than 1.0 makes them easier to kill.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCDepartureVisib: The minimum number of travel hours remaining before an NPC's departure is broadcasted on the network.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCMeleeStaminaCo: Base stamina cost for each melee swing at skill level 0. Higher melee skill lowers this cost, down to about 10%% at level 20.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCPlayerWounds_t: If enabled, DT NPC attacks can cause bleeding, cuts, scratches, and pain on players in addition to reducing overall health.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCRangedStaminaC: Base stamina cost for each shot at skill level 0. Higher shooting skill lowers this cost, down to about 10%% at level 20.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCStaminaRegenMu: Scales how quickly NPCs recover stamina when resting or active. 1.0 is default, higher values recover faster.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCStaminaThresho: The stamina percentage (0.05 to 0.95) at which an exhausted NPC can resume normal activity. Default is 0.40 (40%%).
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCTradeEligibleP: The percentage of a faction's roster that is allowed to participate in the automatic trading rotation at all. Player factions still require workers to be manually trade-approved first.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCTradePopPercen: The maximum percentage of a faction's population allowed to be on a trading mission (Away or Trading status) at once.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCTradingStayHou: How many hours the NPC stays at the trading location (Trading state).
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCTradingWalkHou: How many hours of travel time (Away state) the NPC takes to reach or return from a trading location.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCWeaponDurabili: If enabled, only player-roster NPCs consume weapon durability in combat. World NPCs never use this mechanic.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.PriceBuyMult_tool: Adjusts how expensive items are when buying from traders. Higher = More expensive.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.PriceSellMult_too: Adjusts how much traders pay you for items. Lower = Less profit.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.ProductionMult_to: Global multiplier applied to faction production and economic output.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.PublicNetwork_too: If enabled, radio scan results (Success/Failure) are shown to ALL players on the server. If disabled, only the scanning player sees the result.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.RadarScanElectric: How much Electricity XP a player earns each time a radar scan successfully discovers a new signal. Keep this low because scanning can happen often.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.RarityBonus_toolt: Increases or decreases the likelihood of rare items appearing. Positive values make rare loot more common.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.RestockInterval_t: How many days must pass before a trader refreshes their inventory.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.ReviveCostMax_too: Maximum number of bandages or ripped sheets required to revive a non-hostile incapacitated NPC.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.ReviveCostMin_too: Minimum number of bandages or ripped sheets required to revive a non-hostile incapacitated NPC.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.ScanCooldown_tool: Real-time minutes a player must wait between scanning attempts.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.SeasonImpact_tool: How strongly seasons affect prices (e.g. Winter making food expensive).
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.StockMult_tooltip: Adjusts the amount of items traders have in stock.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.TownTraderWanderC: The percentage chance that a town-based trader will decide to wander out of their home town and spawn near an active player instead.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.TraderBudgetPerce: The percentage of the total Colony Wealth that an individual trader will carry on a trading mission as their temporary budget.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.TraderStayHoursMa: Maximum in-game hours a trader stays connected before leaving.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.TraderStayHoursMi: Minimum in-game hours a trader stays connected before leaving.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.V2_FlashEventMaxD: Maximum duration for V2 faction flash events before they expire.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.V2_FlashEventMinD: Minimum duration for V2 faction flash events before they expire.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.WalkieDropChance_: The percentage chance (0-100) that a zombie will spawn with a Makeshift Walkie Talkie on death.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.WalletEmptyChance: Percentage chance a wallet contains nothing but junk.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.WalletJackpotChan: Chance to hit the 'Tax Return' tier, granting max cash + bonus.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.WalletMaxCash_too: The maximum amount of money found in a normal wallet. Jackpots can exceed this.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.WalletMinCash_too: The minimum amount of money found in a wallet (if not empty).
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.ZombieThreatMult_: Scales zombie pressure used by the faction simulation.
Sandbox_DynamicVehicleSnow_AccumulationM: Maximum temperature at which snow may accumulate. Stored in tenths of a degree: 0 = 0 °C, -20 = -2 °C, 15 = +1.5 °C.
Sandbox_DynamicVehicleSnow_EnableEngineW: Allows a running engine to reduce Snow3 to Snow2 after warming up.
Sandbox_DynamicVehicleSnow_EngineWarmupM: Game minutes the engine must run continuously at Snow3 before Snow3 → Snow2.
Sandbox_DynamicVehicleSnow_MeltingMinute: Melting time is doubled by default. Base setting: 180 minutes per stage. Temperature curve for Snow3 → Clean: +1 °C ≈ 540 min, +5 °C ≈ 420, +10 °C ≈ 270, +15 °C ≈ 140, +25 °C ≈ 120. Snow3 → Snow2 → Snow1 → Clean remains sequential.
Sandbox_DynamicVehicleSnow_MeltingStartT: Snow starts melting above this temperature. Value is in tenths of a degree: 10 = +1.0 °C. Default: +1 °C.
Sandbox_DynamicVehicleSnow_Snow1Minutes: Snow1: time to first stage (game minutes)
Sandbox_DynamicVehicleSnow_Snow1Minutes_: Time from the start of maximum snowfall to Snow1. Default: 60 minutes.
Sandbox_DynamicVehicleSnow_Snow2TotalMin: Snow2: total time to second stage (game minutes)
Total time from the start of maximum snowfall to Snow2. Default: 180 minutes (3 hours).
Sandbox_DynamicVehicleSnow_Snow3TotalMin: Snow3: total time to third stage (game minutes)
Total time from the start of maximum snowfall to Snow3. Default: 360 minutes (6 hours).
Sandbox_DynamicVehicleSnow_UseSnowfallIn: Enabled: configured Snow1/Snow2/Snow3 times are for maximum snowfall; lighter snowfall accumulates more slowly. Disabled: configured times are used without intensity slowdown.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientPlayerPulseBudge: How many zombies each player pulse may actively redirect.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientPlayerPulseEnabl: Enables the recurring player-centered movement pulse that keeps nearby zombies active.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientPlayerPulseMinSt: Minimum evolution stage required before the player pulse can affect a zombie.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientPlayerPulseRadiu: Radius around each player scanned by the pulse system.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientPlayerPulseScanB: Maximum zombies scanned globally by the player pulse each interval.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientWanderBaseChance: Base chance for an idle zombie to start a wander directive when its cooldown is ready.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientWanderCooldownMi: Base cooldown between ambient wander directives.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientWanderCooldownRa: Extra random cooldown added on top of the base wander cooldown.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientWanderDirectTarg: Chance to convert ambient pressure into direct pursuit when conditions are met.
Distance where ambient systems can switch from area pressure to direct player pursuit.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientWanderHomingRadi: Distance within which ambient systems can bias zombies toward the player.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientWanderMaxTravel_: Maximum travel distance for ambient wander paths.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientWanderMinTravel_: Minimum travel distance for ambient wander paths.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AmbientWanderPathBudget: Maximum ambient path requests issued per second. Lower values reduce CPU cost.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_CohesionDriftEnabled_to: Allows nearby zombies to drift toward local groups for denser movement.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_CohesionDriftPathBudget: Maximum cohesion-drift path requests issued per second.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_CoreBatchLeaderBudget_t: Maximum leader zombies processed per batch.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_CoreBatchProcessingEnab: Processes zombies in rotating batches instead of evaluating all of them continuously.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_CoreBatchZombieBudget_t: Maximum non-leader zombies processed per batch.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_CoreLeaderProcessInterv: Minimum interval between leader logic updates.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_CoreLeaderShardCount_to: How many scheduler shards leaders are split into. Higher values reduce leader CPU usage.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_CoreZombieProcessInterv: Minimum interval between non-leader logic updates.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_CoreZombieShardCount_to: How many scheduler shards passive zombies are split into. Higher values reduce per-tick load.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_EnableAmbientWander_too: Enables passive roaming pressure and player-centered movement logic.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_EnableDebugLogs_tooltip: Emits Dynamic Evolution Z diagnostic logs to the console/log files. This does not enable admin debug commands or overlays, and the quick preset will not override it.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_EnableDebugMode_tooltip: Allows Dynamic Evolution Z debug commands and admin overlay tools. This setting is not overridden by the quick preset.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_EnableLeaderNameText_to: Shows a local visual text label over nearby leaders with their archetype, using the zombie speech bubble style.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_EnableLeaderSounds_tool: Enables leader vocal cues and archetype sound events.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_EnableLeaders_tooltip: Allows rare leader promotions and influence pulses.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_EnableMigration_tooltip: Master switch for Dynamic Z migration and movement redirection systems.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_KillFactor_tooltip: World evolution gained from kills. Value 5 = 0.0005, value 10 = 0.0010.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_LeaderRadius_tooltip: Radius used by leaders to scan and influence nearby zombies.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_LeaderWorldThreshold_to: Minimum world evolution required before leaders can start appearing.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_LeaderZombiesPerLeader_: Approximate active zombie count required for one leader slot. Lower values create more leaders.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_MigrationCooldownHours_: Minimum hours before a leader can start another migration.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_MigrationDurationHours_: How long migration state remains active.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_MigrationIntensity_tool: Overall migration aggressiveness. Higher values favor stronger and faster movement.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_MigrationKillThreshold_: Recent kills required before a zone can become a migration target.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_MigrationKillWindowHour: How long kills remain valid for migration scoring.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_MigrationPercentage_too: Percent of eligible followers redirected during migration.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_MigrationRadius_tooltip: Chunk radius scanned around leaders for migration targets.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_PauseAIWhileDriving_too: Pauses Dynamic Evolution Z batch AI when every active player is travelling in a vehicle, plus local leader scans for the driver. Vanilla zombie AI remains active.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_PlayerPressure_tooltip: Builds territorial pressure around active players. Higher levels intensify local zombie response.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_PresetProfile_tooltip: Applies a full Dynamic Z preset over the sandbox values at load time. Select Custom to edit each value manually.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_TimeFactor_tooltip: Passive world evolution gained over time. Value 5 = 0.005, value 10 = 0.010.
Sandbox_EBFAdminFix_AdminMedicalCheck_to: Allows admins with medical cheat permission to inspect players without target confirmation.
Sandbox_EBFAdminFix_FastMoveFix_tooltip: Enables the admin Fast Move sync fix.
Sandbox_EBFAdminFix_GlobalMapControls_to: Enables the admin panel option that controls global map visibility for players.
Sandbox_EBFAdminFix_HideAdminNameTags_to: Hides admin/staff overhead tag and name from regular players.
Sandbox_EBFAdminFix_MapLightBypass_toolt: Allows admins and staff roles to use the map/minimap without light requirements.
Sandbox_EBFAdminFix_ScoreboardAdminContr: Enables the adjusted admin buttons in the player list.
Sandbox_EBFAdminFix_UserHudOptions_toolt: Adds GPS and version visibility checkboxes to the user panel.
Sandbox_EBFAdminFix_VHSItemList_tooltip: Adds the EBF VHS tab to the admin item list.

Sandbox_EHR_AHTREnabled_tooltip: Acute hemolytic transfusion reaction from incompatible blood transfusions. Dangerous and potentially lethal.
Sandbox_EHR_AllowFullPharmacyPackages_to: Allows pharmacies and drugstores to occasionally spawn full medication packages. Other locations are still capped below full.
Sandbox_EHR_AspergilliosisEnabled_toolti: Fungal lung infection from prolonged exposure to decaying corpses in damp environments. Progressive respiratory failure.
Sandbox_EHR_BlackoutChance_tooltip: Random chance per tick. Lower = more frequent. 50 = 1 in 50 chance.
Sandbox_EHR_BlackoutEnabled_tooltip: Allow character to black out from critical blood loss.
Sandbox_EHR_BloodLossMultiplier_tooltip: How fast blood drains from wounds. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = twice as fast.
Sandbox_EHR_BloodRegenDelayHours_tooltip: Hours without bleeding before regeneration begins. <LINE> <LINE> HOW IT WORKS: <LINE> - Timer resets every time you start bleeding again <LINE> - Simulates your body stabilizing before producing new blood <LINE> - Lower values = faster recovery start <LINE> - Higher values = more realistic (body needs time to recover) <LINE> <LINE> RECOMMENDED: 2.0 hours (default) for balanced gameplay.
Sandbox_EHR_BloodRegenEnabled_tooltip: Allow natural blood regeneration over time. <LINE> <LINE> HOW IT WORKS: <LINE> - Your body regenerates blood naturally when bleeding has stopped <LINE> - Regeneration only begins after a delay period (no active bleeding) <LINE> - Regeneration ONLY works if blood is above the minimum threshold <LINE> - Being fed, hydrated, and rested speeds up regeneration <LINE> <LINE> IMPORTANT: Transfusions are still the fastest way to restore blood in emergencies!
Sandbox_EHR_BloodRegenMinimumPercent_too: Minimum blood percentage required for regeneration to work. <LINE> <LINE> HOW IT WORKS: <LINE> - Below this threshold, your body is too weak to regenerate <LINE> - You MUST use blood transfusions to get above this level <LINE> - Simulates critical blood loss requiring medical intervention <LINE> <LINE> EXAMPLE (30%% default, 5000 mL max): <LINE> - Below 1500 mL = NO natural regeneration <LINE> - Need transfusion to reach 1500+ mL first <LINE> <LINE> Lower = more forgiving, Higher = more realistic/hardcore.
Sandbox_EHR_BloodRegenRatePerHour_toolti: Milliliters of blood regenerated per in-game hour. <LINE> <LINE> REFERENCE (5000 mL max blood): <LINE> - 50 mL/hr (default) = ~70 hours to fully recover from critical <LINE> - 100 mL/hr = ~35 hours to fully recover <LINE> - 200 mL/hr = ~17 hours (arcade mode) <LINE> <LINE> Real human regeneration is ~40-50 mL/hour. <LINE> Being well-fed and hydrated provides a 50%% bonus!
Sandbox_EHR_BloodThresholdHealthy_toolti: Blood percentage above which character is considered healthy.
Sandbox_EHR_BloodThresholdMild_tooltip: Blood percentage for mild blood loss effects.
Sandbox_EHR_BloodThresholdModerate_toolt: Blood percentage for moderate blood loss. Below this is CRITICAL.
Sandbox_EHR_BodyTemperatureEnabled_toolt: Enables custom body temperature tracking with gradual effects. <LINE> <LINE> FEATURES: <LINE> - Tracks body temperature in Celsius (37C = normal) <LINE> - Gradual cooling/warming based on environment <LINE> - Pre-disease effects (shivering, sweating) <LINE> - Smooth transition to hypothermia/heat exhaustion <LINE> <LINE> When disabled: <LINE> - Falls back to exposure-time-based disease triggering <LINE> - Vanilla temperature system is NOT suppressed <LINE> - Allows other temperature mods to work (e.g. Realistic Temps)
Sandbox_EHR_CadavericAspergillosisEnable: Fungal lung infection from decaying corpses in damp, rainy, wet or cold conditions. Progressive respiratory failure.
Sandbox_EHR_CellulitisEnabled_tooltip: Skin infection from poor wound closure or untreated wound spread. Can progress to sepsis if not treated.
Sandbox_EHR_CommonColdChanceMultiplier_t: Scales the final common cold contraction roll after exposure is ready. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_CommonColdEnabled_tooltip: Cold weather + wet exposure can cause common cold. Can progress to pneumonia.
Sandbox_EHR_CommonColdExposureMultiplier: Scales how quickly cold/wet exposure accumulates before common cold rolls. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_ConcussionEnabled_tooltip: Head trauma from serious falls and vehicle crashes. Causes headache, nausea, dizziness, and temporary impairment.
Sandbox_EHR_ConcussionFallChanceMultipli: Scales concussion rolls from serious height falls after trauma validation. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_ConcussionVehicleChanceMulti: Scales concussion rolls from severe vehicle crashes after trauma validation. <LINE> 1.0 = current balance.
Sandbox_EHR_CorpseDiseaseSpeed_tooltip: How fast corpse sickness progresses. 1.0 = normal.
Sandbox_EHR_CorpseSicknessEnabled_toolti: Acute sickness from corpse putrefaction gases. This controls ordinary corpse exposure illness; cadaveric aspergillosis has its own toggle.

Sandbox_ETW_AffinitySystemGainMultiplier: How much easier it is to gain perks that have Affinity System functionality (only affects perks you started with!). Setting it to 1 would mean that it doesn't make it easier to gain. Setting it to 2 means it'll take twice as fast to gain them. Setting it to 1.5 would make it 50%% faster, and so on. So if you start with a positive dynamic trait and later lose it, you'll get it back much faster. But it also affects negative traits!
Sandbox_ETW_AffinitySystemLoseDivider_to: How much harder it is to lose perks that have Affinity System functionality (only affects perks you started with!). Setting it to 1 would mean that it doesn't make it harder to lose. Setting it to 2 means you'll be twice as slow to lose them. Setting it to 1.5 would make it 50%% slower, and so on. So if you start with a positive trait that you can lose, it'll be much harder to lose it. But it also affects negative traits!
Sandbox_ETW_AffinitySystem_tooltip:
Defines if the Affinity System is enabled for some traits tied to systems and some complex ones (for example, Fear of Locations or Sleep System traits).
The Affinity system makes it easier to hold onto traits you picked during character creation, both negative and positive. With it enabled, you halve (modifiable) the speed at which you lose these traits, and double (also modifiable) the speed at which you earn these traits
Sandbox_ETW_AsthmaticCounter_tooltip: The value on the counter you should reach to lose the asthmatic trait. Running or exercising in cold temperatures decreases the counter; the colder it is, the faster the decrease. If you're outside, it decreases even faster. If you are a smoker, it decreases even faster. Additionally, being a smoker slowly decreases the counter when you run, even if the weather is fine. Reaching the counter removes the trait. The counter slowly increases by itself as long as you're not running or sprinting and breathing air warmer than 0 degrees Celsius. On top of that, it increases based on your Fitness level and current endurance level. Being a smoker halves the increase rate. Having the asthmatic trait halves it again

Sandbox_ETW_BloodlustMeterMaxCapMultipli: By how much you can overfill your Bloodlust Meter. This is a multiplier. 2 means you can fill your Bloodlust Meter to 200%%, for example

Sandbox_ETW_BloodlustMoodle_tooltip: If this option is disabled, the moodle won't show up. For single-player, leave this on and change moodles you see with Mod Options. If it's a server setting, players won't be able to enable the moodle client-sided
Sandbox_ETW_BloodlustMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplies the effect of bloodlust by this value. By default, unhappiness, stress, and panic are each reduced by 4%% for each kill. This multiplier is applied to those 4%%. So setting this to 0.5 would make those stats reduced by 2%% instead
Sandbox_ETW_BloodlustProgress_tooltip: How much total bloodlust progress you need to get the trait. Be aware that you also lose bloodlust if this meter ever falls below 50%%. So if you set it low, it's going to be easy to earn but also easy to lose the perk. Progress is capped at 2x the Bloodlust Progress value
Sandbox_ETW_Bloodlust_tooltip: This allows you to gain a benefit by filling and maintaining a bloodlust meter. The bloodlust meter is soft-capped at 72 hours and can be filled by killing zombies. The closer the zombies are, the more quickly the meter will fill. When you're above half of the meter, every hour it will give you progress towards the bloodlust perk; when it's below, it'll remove progress. The bloodlust meter naturally decays by 1 every hour. Having bloodied clothes helps the process
Sandbox_ETW_BodyBiteContribution_tooltip: Severity assigned to each current bite. The Injuries System adds this value every ten in-game minutes. The Healer System checks every minute and, if treatment stays unchanged, gains or loses this total value over ten minutes before applying its treatment multiplier. Any resulting wound infection is not counted separately.
Sandbox_ETW_BodyBurnContribution_tooltip: Severity assigned to each current burn. The Injuries System adds this value every ten in-game minutes. The Healer System checks every minute and, if treatment stays unchanged, gains or loses this total value over ten minutes before applying its treatment multiplier.
Sandbox_ETW_BodyDeepWoundContribution_to: Severity assigned to each current deep wound or stitched deep wound. The Injuries System adds this value every ten in-game minutes for active deep wounds. The Healer System checks every minute and, if treatment stays unchanged, gains or loses this total value over ten minutes before applying its treatment multiplier.
Sandbox_ETW_BodyFractureContribution_too: Severity assigned to each current fracture. The Injuries System adds this value every ten in-game minutes. The Healer System checks every minute and, if splint treatment stays unchanged, gains or loses this total value over ten minutes before applying its treatment multiplier.
Sandbox_ETW_BodyLacerationContribution_t: Severity assigned to each current laceration. The Injuries System adds this value every ten in-game minutes. The Healer System checks every minute and, if treatment stays unchanged, gains or loses this total value over ten minutes before applying its treatment multiplier.
Sandbox_ETW_BodyLodgedBulletContribution: Severity assigned to each currently lodged bullet. The Injuries System adds this value every ten in-game minutes. The Healer System checks every minute and loses this total value over ten minutes before applying its neglected-wound multiplier. This is counted in addition to any associated deep wound.
Sandbox_ETW_BodyLodgedGlassContribution_: Severity assigned to each currently lodged piece of glass. The Injuries System adds this value every ten in-game minutes. The Healer System checks every minute and loses this total value over ten minutes before applying its neglected-wound multiplier. This is counted in addition to any associated deep wound.
Sandbox_ETW_BodyScratchContribution_tool: Severity assigned to each current scratch. The Injuries System adds this value every ten in-game minutes. The Healer System checks every minute and, if treatment stays unchanged, gains or loses this total value over ten minutes before applying its treatment multiplier.
Sandbox_ETW_BodyworkEnthusiastRepairs_to: The percentage of car condition you have to repair to qualify for the perk. Works on every part of a car and is saved between all cars
Sandbox_ETW_BraverySystemKills_tooltip:
Here you set up how many kills you need to get to max out your bravery system. Melee kills count twice for progress. Progression is as follows: Cowardly -> Fear of Blood -> Pacifist -> Adrenaline Junkie -> Brave -> Desensitized
You need to have previous trait gone (if it's negative) or present (if it's positive) to earn/lose next trait In progression.
Amounts to reach each stage are as follows:
Cowardly: 10%% of max kills
Fear of Blood: 20%% of max kills
Pacifist: 30%% of max kills
Adrenaline Junkie: 40%% of max kills
Brave: 60%% of max kills
Desensitized: 100%% of max kills
Example: Max kills is set to 1000. You start with Cowardly. You need 100 kills to remove it. If you get 50 melee kills, it'll be removed. The same is true if you get 40 melee kills (x2 = 80 kills for the counter) and 20 firearms kills
Sandbox_ETW_BraverySystemRemovesOtherFea: Bravery System Removes Other Fear Perks
If enabled, getting desensitized through the Bravery system will also remove other fear perks like Pluviophile, Homichlophobia, Agoraphobic, and Claustrophobic, and prevent you from gaining them
Sandbox_ETW_BurglarSkill_tooltip: Mechanics + Electrical + Nimble. Please note that you need to have at least 2 levels in both Mechanics and Electrical
Sandbox_ETW_CatEyesCounter_tooltip: This allows you to gain points by seeing and observing squares within a certain radius of your character. The number of points you earn is influenced by factors such as the time of day, the darkness of the square, and whether you and the square are inside or outside. The more squares you see and the darker they are, the more points you will earn. Having Eagle Eyed doubles the gain. Making a kill at night triggers extra execution of function responsible for gaining progress (so instead of getting progress 1 time / minute you can get progress 3 times per minute, for example)
Sandbox_ETW_CookSkill: Keen Cook Cooking + Butchering Skill requirement
Sandbox_ETW_DelayedTraitsSystemDefaultDe: Default delay (in hours) for traits to appear/disappear. For example, if set to 240, when you qualify for a new trait, you'll have a 1 in 240 chance to gain/lose it in the first hour. If it fails, the chance becomes 1 in 239 the next hour, and so on
Sandbox_ETW_DelayedTraitsSystemDefaultSt: Additional delay (in hours) stacked on top of the default delay for 'free' traits obtained at the start of the game. For example, starting with 9 Strength would usually grant Hoarder for free. If the Delayed Traits system is enabled, with a Default Delay of 240 and Additional Delay for Starting Traits of 480, you won't get Hoarder at the start. Instead, it goes into the table with a maximum delay of 720 hours. So, you'll have a 1 in 720 chance to get it in the first hour, and so on
Sandbox_ETW_DelayedTraitsSystem_tooltip:
This system allows you to gain/lose traits in a more random and less predictable way. When you qualify to add/remove a trait, it doesn't happen instantly. Instead, it's added to a table with a delay in hours (based on sandbox settings below). Every hour, the game rolls to determine if you gain/lose each trait in this table (each trait is rolled separately). You have a 1 in X chance to gain/lose the trait every hour. If the roll fails, X is reduced by 1. So the longer you go, the higher the chances that the trait you earned will manifest.
Technical note: Traits that rely on skill levels will be unlocked as described above. However, traits that rely on internal counters added by this mod (e.g., Prone To Illness, Weak Stomach, Outdoorsman, Cat Eyes, etc.) will unlock the next time their internal counters increase. This is because coding a separate unlock mechanism for these specific traits would be complex and unnecessary. For example, if you qualify for Cat Eyes and it's added to the Delayed Traits Table, you won't get it immediately. Instead, you'll get it as soon as the Cat Eyes counter increases next time (e.g., the closest evening/night).
Sandbox_ETW_EagleEyedDistance_tooltip: At what distance must a zombie be to count this as a kill to Eagle-Eyed kill counter. For vanilla would recommend leaving at 20, for mods that add good firearms (Gunfighter + Brita for example), would recommend setting to 25 or so
Sandbox_ETW_EatingSpeedSystemCounter_too: Total base duration value from completed food-eating actions required to gain Fast Eater. Slow Eater can be lost after half this value. Interrupted actions do not count, and eating-speed traits do not change the amount recorded.
Sandbox_ETW_EatingSpeedSystem_tooltip: Tracks the base duration values of completed food-eating actions. Interrupted eating actions, drinking, and smoking do not count. At half of the configured counter you can lose Slow Eater; at the full counter you can gain Fast Eater.
Sandbox_ETW_FastEaterSpeed_tooltip: Percentage by which the Fast Eater trait reduces the time needed to eat food. Does not affect drinking or smoking. Set to 0 to disable the speed bonus.
Sandbox_ETW_FearOfLocationsExclusiveFear: If enabled, you will only ever have Claustrophobic OR Agoraphobic, whichever has the lower counter
Sandbox_ETW_FearOfLocationsSystemCounter: Fear Of Locations Counter Decrease Multiplier

Controls how fast the counter decreases when you are unhappy (50%%+) or stressed (50%%+). Since you are more often normal than unhappy or stressed, it's recommended not to set this value too low. The formula for how much the counter decreases every minute is: 1 * (1 + unhappiness(0-1)) + (1 * stress(0-1)) * multiplier. At minimum, you lose 0 * multiplier; at maximum, you lose 4 * multiplier

Counter = amount of minutes you need to spend outside/inside to lose the respective trait, Agoraphobic or Claustrophobic. Being outside/inside when stressed or unhappy will decrease the counter. Reaching a negative counter value will GAIN you the appropriate trait. Reaching a positive counter value will get rid of the appropriate trait, being in between -counter and +counter will result in no change. The lower boundary is -2x of the counter, and the upper boundary is 2x of the set value here
Sandbox_ETW_FearOfLocationsSystemPassive: Fear of Locations Passive Counter Decay

If you have an issue managing both Agoraphobic and Claustrophobic traits simultaneously, you can set up passive decay using this option. This slowly decays the opposite counter based on whether you're outside/inside every minute, regardless of your mental state. For example, setting this to 0.1 and being inside will gradually reduce your fear of outside by adding 0.1 to the outside counter every minute. Setting it to 0 will have no effect on counters. Recommended values range from 0.1 to 0.5
Sandbox_ETW_FirstAidSkill: First Aider First Aid Skill requirement
Sandbox_ETW_FogSystemCounterDecreaseMult: Adjusts the rate at which your counter decreases. See tooltip for details in Fog System Counter
Sandbox_ETW_FogSystemCounterIncreaseMult: Adjusts the rate at which your counter increases. See tooltip for details in Fog System Counter
Sandbox_ETW_FogSystemCounter_tooltip: You gain progress every minute you spend in fog. Being panicked can slow down the process or even revert it. If the counter is below -counter, you gain Homichlophobia; when reaching counter, you gain Homichlophile. If the counter is between these values, there is no effect. Making a kill at during fog triggers extra execution of function responsible for gaining/losing progress (so instead of getting progress 1 time / minute you can get progress 3 times per minute, for example)
Sandbox_ETW_FoodSicknessSystemCounter_to: Determines how much food sickness you need to accumulate to lose/gain Food Sickness-related traits, Weak Stomach and Iron Gut. Sickness can range from 0 to 1, where 1 can lead to death. Each minute, your current food sickness level is added to the counter.
Sandbox_ETW_FoodSicknessSystemNormalSick: Sickness gained specifically from food and general sickness are different things in the game. This multiplier allows normal sickness to count for gaining the Food Sickness System traits.
Sandbox_ETW_FoodSystemGainNegativeThresh: If your 31-day average food score drops to or below this value, you can gain Hearty Appetite. Lower values make the system more forgiving.
Sandbox_ETW_FoodSystemGainPositiveThresh: If your 31-day average food score rises to or above this value, you can gain Light Eater. Higher values make it harder to gain. Food scores range from 0 to 1, where higher is better.
Sandbox_ETW_FoodSystemLoseNegativeThresh: If your 31-day average food score rises to or above this value, you can lose Hearty Appetite. Higher values make it harder to recover from the negative trait.
Sandbox_ETW_FoodSystemLosePositiveThresh: If your 31-day average food score drops to or below this value, you can lose Light Eater. Lower values make the positive trait harder to lose.
Sandbox_ETW_FoodSystem_tooltip: Tracks your long-term eating habits using rolling averages, similar to the mental system. The mod stores a normalized food score over time, where higher is better. Staying reasonably fed over time helps you lose Hearty Appetite and eventually gain Light Eater. Frequently letting hunger stay high for long periods pushes you toward Hearty Appetite. Sleeping time is ignored so the system judges habits rather than sleep cycles.
Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystemCounter_tooltip: Sets both the positive and negative limit of the Healer System counter. Gain Slow Healer at -66%%, lose Slow Healer at -33%%, lose Fast Healer at +33%%, and gain Fast Healer at +66%%. Characters who start with Slow Healer or Fast Healer begin at the corresponding negative or positive maximum.
Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystemNeedsAttentionMu: Multiplies severity-weighted Healer System progress lost from wounds that need attention. The system checks every in-game minute and applies one tenth of the configured ten-minute total each time. Wound severity is configured with the shared Body Contribution settings.
Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystemProperlyTendedMu: Multiplies severity-weighted Healer System progress from properly tended wounds. The system checks every in-game minute and applies one tenth of the configured ten-minute total each time. Wound severity is configured with the shared Body Contribution settings.
Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystemSleepingMultipli: Multiplies Healer System counter changes while the player is asleep. The default greatly reduces changes caused by wounds that cannot be tended during sleep.
Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystem_tooltip: Controls Slow Healer and Fast Healer based on how consistently the character tends current wounds. Wound care is checked every in-game minute. Clean bandages, stitches, and valid splints add severity-weighted progress; dirty bandages, embedded glass or bullets, untreated bleeding, burns needing washing, uncovered wounds, and splintable fractures without a splint remove it. Contribution settings describe the total progress produced over ten in-game minutes when the wound state remains unchanged. Wound infection is not counted, and having no tracked wounds does not change the counter.
Sandbox_ETW_HearingSystemSkill_tooltip: Determines how many levels in Agility + Combat (excluding Maintenance) you need to obtain/lose hearing-related perks (Hard Of Hearing and Keen Hearing). You lose Hard of Hearing when you surpass half of the required levels and gain Keen Hearing upon reaching the specified number
Sandbox_ETW_HerbalistHerbsPicked_tooltip: Specifies how many herbs you need to pick up through foraging to gain the permanent Herbalist trait
Sandbox_ETW_HerbalistJournalCounterIncre: Determines the percentage of the maximum Herbalist counter added the first time a character reads The Herbalist journal. This bonus can only be received once. For example, if the maximum counter is 1000 and this is set to 50%%, reading the journal adds 500 points
Sandbox_ETW_HoarderCounter_tooltip: Determines how much inventory-fullness progress is required to gain Hoarder. Progress is added every in-game minute based on carried weight divided by maximum carry weight: a full inventory adds 1 point, while a half-full inventory adds 0.5 points
Sandbox_ETW_HoarderWeight: Hoarder Bonus weight per point of Strength
Sandbox_ETW_HomichlophileMultiplier_mult: Determines how much Homichlophile affects the player. The formula for stress and panic decrease every minute you're in fog is: 4%% * fogIntensity * Homichlophile Multiplier. Fog intensity ranges from 0 to 1, so the full 4%% decrease is rare
Sandbox_ETW_HomichlophileMultiplier_tool: Determines how much Homichlophile affects the player. The formula for stress and panic decrease every minute you're in fog is: 4%% * fogIntensity * Homichlophile Multiplier. Fog intensity ranges from 0 to 1, so the full 4%% decrease is rare
Sandbox_ETW_HomichlophobiaMultiplier_mul: Determines how much Homichlophobia affects the player. The formula for stress and panic increase every minute you're in fog is: 4%% * fogIntensity * Homichlophobia Multiplier. Fog intensity ranges from 0 to 1, so the full 4%% increase is rare
Sandbox_ETW_HomichlophobiaMultiplier_too: Determines how much Homichlophobia affects the player. The formula for stress and panic increase every minute you're in fog is: 4%% * fogIntensity * Homichlophobia Multiplier. Fog intensity ranges from 0 to 1, so the full 4%% increase is rare

Sandbox_ETW_InjuriesSystemBurnContributi: How much each current burn adds to the Injuries System counter every ten in-game minutes.

Sandbox_ETW_OutdoorsmanCounterDecreaseMu: Adjusts the rate at which you lose points from the outdoorsman counter. For example, multiplier of 0.25 means you'd be losing 25%% of points.
Sandbox_ETW_OutdoorsmanCounterIncreaseMu: Adjusts the rate at which you gain points in outdoorsman counter. For example, multiplier of 2.5 means you'd be gaining 250%% of points'.
Sandbox_ETW_OutdoorsmanCounter_tooltip: This allows you to earn/lose by spending time outdoors and being exposed to various weather conditions. The harsher the weather, the faster you'll accumulate points towards gaining the trait. Conversely, staying indoors gradually reduces progress. You gain the trait when the counter reaches its specified threshold, and lose it when dropping below the opposite threshold. Being inside will slowly start to decrease the counter, with maximum decrease being reached after being indoors/in-car for 900 min. Killing while outside will also progress the counter based on weather.
Sandbox_ETW_PainToleranceCounter_tooltip: Every 10 minutes your pain (0-100) is added to counter. Upon reaching counter you'll get Pain Tolerance trait
Sandbox_ETW_PainToleranceExerciseMultipl: Multiplies only the exercise-stiffness portion of pain added to the Pain Tolerance counter. Pain from wounds and other sources is unaffected.
Sandbox_ETW_PainToleranceThreshold_toolt: Sets the maximum pain level your character can reach while benefiting from this perk

Sandbox_ETW_PetTherapyMoodBoostMultiplie: Multiplier to Pet Therapy mood boost. By default, petting decreases Panic, Stress, Boredom and Unhappiness by 1%%. Setting this to, for example, 4 would make it so decrease is 1%% * 4 = 4%%
Sandbox_ETW_PetTherapyUniqueAnimalsPette: How many different animals you have to pet to qualify for gaining Pet Therapy
Sandbox_ETW_PluviophileMultiplier_toolti: Multiplies the effects of Unhappiness, Stress, and Boredom decreases
Sandbox_ETW_PluviophobiaMultiplier_toolt: Multiplies the effects of Unhappiness, Stress, and Boredom increases
Sandbox_ETW_RainSystemCounterDecreaseMul: Adjusts the rate at which your Rain System Counter decreases, detailed in Rain System Counter tooltip
Sandbox_ETW_RainSystemCounterIncreaseMul: Adjusts the rate at which your Rain System Counter increases, detailed in Rain System Counter tooltip
Sandbox_ETW_RainSystemCounter_tooltip: You gain progress every minute you spend in rain while outside. Being panicked can slow down the process or even revert it. If the counter is below -counter, you gain Pluviophobia; when reaching counter, you gain Pluviophile. If the counter is between these values, there is no effect. Sandbox_ETW_ReaderSystemCounter_tooltip: Determines how many pages you need to read to lose Slow Reader and gain Fast Reader. Upon reaching half of the counter value, you lose Slow Reader; upon reaching the full value, you gain Fast Reader. Books and magazines that must be read in one sitting are counted as 5 pages, matching vanilla behavior.
Sandbox_ETW_RestorationExpertChance_tool: %% chance to not increase the number of times an item was repaired after a repair
Sandbox_ETW_ServerLogs_tooltip: (MP ONLY) If enabled, prints some debug information into server console/logs. Should not be enabled unless there's incorrect mod behavior and you are reporting a bug
Sandbox_ETW_SewerUniqueClothesRipped_too: Amount of unique clothing you need to rip to qualify for Sewer. If you are running with modded clothes, increase this respectively. AuthenticZ or Brita Armor Pack all add A LOT of clothing to rip, as an example.
Sandbox_ETW_SleepMoodle_tooltip: If this option is disabled, the moodle won't show up. For single-player, leave this on and change moodles you see with Mod Options. If it's a server setting, players won't be able to enable the moodle client-sided
Sandbox_ETW_SleepSystemMultiplier_toolti: Determines how fast you increase/decrease the SleepHealthiness counter, which dictates if you get/lose Wakeful and Sleepyhead. Higher values mean faster gain and loss. Lower values mean slower gain and loss
Sandbox_ETW_SleepSystem_tooltip:
Enables obtaining/losing sleep-related traits, Wakeful and Sleepyhead.
---General description---
Mod tracks at which hours you like to sleep, and as long as you sleep within around those hours, you reinforce your healthy sleep schedule. If you sleep outside of it, you lose some schedule integrity. Not sleeping for more than 24 hours also starts to damage your sleep schedule. Mod tracks at which hours you like to sleep by checking the midpoint of your last sleep, so it's possible to shift your schedule to different hours.
---Technical description, don't read this if you don't want to meta-game much---
Every time you sleep, the mod tracks the midpoint of your sleep. For example, if you sleep between 23:00 and 05:30, the midpoint would be 03:45, and it would be your optimal sleeping hour. If you sleep within +-6 hours of this time, you gain progress to your SleepHealthiness bar, which ranges from -200 to 200. A check is made every 10 minutes, adding +0.167 to the bar if sleeping within the correct schedule, essentially giving +1 for every hour of correct sleep. Sleeping outside this schedule removes 0.167 from the bar every 10 minutes. After not sleeping for more than 24 hours, you start losing -0.167 every ten minutes. If your bar falls below -100, you get Sleepyhead. If it's above 100, you get Wakeful. Starting with either trait sets the starting value of the bar to its maximum or minimum point: +200 for Wakeful and -200 for Sleepyhead
Sandbox_ETW_SlowEaterSpeed_tooltip: Percentage by which the Slow Eater trait increases the time needed to eat food. Does not affect drinking or smoking. Set to 0 to disable the slowdown.
Sandbox_ETW_SmokerCounter_tooltip:
Upon reaching this value on the counter, you'll get the Smoker trait. When dropping to the opposite of it, you'll lose it. Counter boundaries are -2x the counter to 2x the counter.

How it works: Every smoke you take increases your addiction counter. The longer breaks you take between smokes, the less the increase. Smoking while being panicked or stressed increases the counter much faster, based on the level of panic and stress. Not smoking slowly decays the counter. Being panicked or stressed slows the decay rate
Sandbox_ETW_SmokingAddictionDecay_toolti: Determines how fast your addiction decays
Sandbox_ETW_SmokingAddictionMultiplier_t: Determines how fast your addiction increases

Sandbox_ETW_ThirstSystemGainNegativeThre: If your 31-day average thirst score drops to or below this value, you can gain High Thirst. Lower values make the system more forgiving.
Sandbox_ETW_ThirstSystemGainPositiveThre: If your 31-day average thirst score rises to or above this value, you can gain Low Thirst. Higher values make it harder to gain. Thirst scores range from 0 to 1, where higher is better.
Sandbox_ETW_ThirstSystemLoseNegativeThre: If your 31-day average thirst score rises to or above this value, you can lose High Thirst. Higher values make it harder to recover from the negative trait.
Sandbox_ETW_ThirstSystemLosePositiveThre: If your 31-day average thirst score drops to or below this value, you can lose Low Thirst. Lower values make the positive trait harder to lose.
Sandbox_ETW_ThirstSystem_tooltip: Tracks your long-term hydration habits using rolling averages, similar to the mental system. The mod stores a normalized thirst score over time, where higher is better. Staying reasonably hydrated over time helps you lose High Thirst and eventually gain Low Thirst. Frequently letting thirst stay high for long periods pushes you toward High Thirst. Sleeping time is ignored so the system judges habits rather than sleep cycles.
Sandbox_ETW_TraitsLockSystemCanGainNegat: If this is enabled, you can gain negative traits during gameplay. This mostly applies to systems that dynamically manage paired positive and negative traits
Sandbox_ETW_TraitsLockSystemCanGainPosit: If this is enabled, you can gain positive traits during gameplay. This applies to a lot of traits; you DO NOT want to have this disabled
Sandbox_ETW_TraitsLockSystemCanLoseNegat: If this is enabled, you can lose negative traits during gameplay. This applies to dynamic trait systems and a number of simple traits
Sandbox_ETW_TraitsLockSystemCanLosePosit: If this is enabled, you can lose positive traits during gameplay. This mostly applies to systems that dynamically manage paired positive and negative traits
Sandbox_ETW_UIPage_tooltip: Enables the Vitals, Permanent Traits, and Non-permanent Traits progress tabs on the ETW character page. The Help and Translations Status tabs remain available when this is disabled.
Sandbox_ETW_WildernessKnowledgeSkill_too: Foraging + Knapping + Maintenance + Carving. Additional requirement is to have at least 2 levels in each skill.
