Sandbox_EWFSettingsRCW_tooltip: Feature Enable setting For LAER EWF Firearm.  (Default is Off)
Sandbox_EWFSpawnSettingsLAER_tooltip: Default Is 0. <LINE> (When Enabled Set to 0.0003 or Rarer. For Best Effect )
Sandbox_EWFSpawnSettingsMusket_tooltip: Default Is 0. <LINE> (When Enabled Set to 0.0003 or Rarer. For Best Effect )
Sandbox_EWFSpawnSettingsRCW_tooltip: Default Is 0. <LINE> (When Enabled Set to 0.0003 or Rarer. For Best Effect )
Sandbox_EZRoof_RequireScaffold_tooltip: When enabled, placing ceilings requires a chair or stool as temporary scaffold.
Sandbox_EasyEngineRepair_CondPerPartMax_:
Highest amount of condition a single engine part can restore.
If the calculation gives a larger value, this number is used instead.
Sandbox_EasyEngineRepair_CondPerPartMin_:
Lowest amount of condition a single engine part can restore.
If the calculation gives a smaller value, this number is used instead.
Sandbox_EasyEngineRepair_CondPerPartMult: Multiplier per engine part and skill level

Multiplies your Mechanics level to get the condition each engine part restores.
Vanilla: 1 + ((skillLevel - skillLevelNeeded) / 2)
New: skillLevel * (thisValue)
Sandbox_EatSmart_NeedNutritionist_toolti: When enabled, calorie and protein options don't show up if you don't have the Nutritionist trait.
Sandbox_EatWhileDrivingMaxSpeed_tooltip: Above this speed the eat / smoke option is greyed out for safety. Set to 0 to require the vehicle to be fully stopped. Default 60.
Sandbox_Efficiency_ActionFilter_tooltip: Actions entered here will not be affected by the time modification applied by the mod.
Sandbox_Efficiency_DefaultTimeLimit_tool:
WARNING!
Setting this value too low may BREAK some actions. This is the minimum time an action must take to be affected by the mod. Example: smoking takes 460 time units. If you set this value to 470, smoking and faster actions won't be affected by efficiency.
Sandbox_EffortlessTowing42_HeavyDutyFact: Multiplier for the towing force applied by heavy duty vehicles. Set to 0 to disable the assist for this class.
Sandbox_EffortlessTowing42_SportFactor_t: Multiplier for the towing force applied by sport vehicles. Set to 0 to disable the assist for this class.
Sandbox_EffortlessTowing42_StandardFacto: Multiplier for the towing force applied by standard vehicles. Set to 0 to disable the assist for this class.
Sandbox_ElEternauta_AffectAnimals_toolti: If enabled, living animals will take damage during toxic days.
Sandbox_ElEternauta_AffectZombies_toolti: If enabled, living zombies will take damage during toxic days.
Sandbox_ElEternauta_AntiCopyrightPremoni: Designed for streamers and content creators. Replaces the original song with a cover track to avoid copyright issues.
Sandbox_ElEternauta_ClothingSelection_to: Applies a recommended spawn chance for protective suits and masks from this mod.
Sandbox_ElEternauta_CycleDurationDays_to: Total in-game days the toxic system remains active. (0 for infinite).
Sandbox_ElEternauta_DelayStartDays_toolt: Number of in-game days before the first toxic event can start. (0 for immediate start).
Sandbox_ElEternauta_DisableGearWear_tool: If enabled, masks, suits, and protected gear will not lose durability from this mod's wear system.
Sandbox_ElEternauta_EnableToxicEvents_to: If enabled, the mod will run alternating toxic-day and safe-day cycles.
Sandbox_ElEternauta_GearWearIntensity_to: Adjusts gear wear from usage. 5 = current default. 0 = much slower wear. 10 = faster wear.
Sandbox_ElectricWeapon_MalfunctionFactor:
Adjust the Malfunction Factor of Electrified Weapons.
 Higher values increase malfunction chances.
Sandbox_ElectricWeapon_PowerConsumptionF:
Adjust the battery consumption rate of electrified weapons.
 The higher the number, the faster the power drains.
Sandbox_EnableAdvancedSoundOptions_toolt: Unlock PZ's hidden per-sound volume controls in the options menu.
Sandbox_EnableAimingAmmoCursor_tooltip: Shows a floating ammo pill near your cursor while aiming. Toggle independently from the main Weapon HUD Overlay.
Sandbox_EnableAimingDensityCursor_toolti: Shows a nearby zombie count pill near your cursor while aiming. Default OFF to avoid duplicating the standalone Nearby Density HUD.
Sandbox_EnableAimingHealthCursor_tooltip: Shows a small HP pill near your cursor while aiming. Color shifts from green to violet as you take damage.
Sandbox_EnableAlternateCanOpening_toolti: Allow opening cans and jars with knives and screwdrivers instead of a can opener.
Sandbox_EnableAnimatedDuffles: Animated duffel bags on lower back
Sandbox_EnableAnimatedDuffles_tooltip: When ON (default), large duffel-class bags (Duffel, Weapon, Tool, Police, SWAT, Sheriff, Military, Medical, etc.) gain a right-click "Equip on Back > Equip on Lower Back" option that places the bag on a separate Lower Back slot using a 3D rigged model that animates with your character. This frees the upper Back slot for a backpack. Disable to remove the menu entry.
Sandbox_EnableAntibodySystem_tooltip: Adds a CSR antibody panel, survival-chance modifiers, immunity growth after surviving bites, and immune blood serum collection. Requires Enable infection resilience to be ON.
Sandbox_EnableBack2Slot_tooltip: Adds a second weapon slot on the character's back. Carry two large weapons at once -- one on each shoulder.
Sandbox_EnableBagBottomAttach_tooltip: Allow weapons like rifles, shovels, bats, and blades to visually attach to the bottom of backpacks (bedroll slots). Supports regular, big, and ALICE backpacks.
Sandbox_EnableBarrelCapFix: Fix barrel cap loss after move
Sandbox_EnableBarrelCapFix_tooltip: When a fluid barrel is picked up and replaced via Move Furniture, restore the Cap / Uncap context menu and preserve the previous capped state. Compatible with most third-party barrel mods.
Sandbox_EnableBathing_tooltip: Adds a 'Take A Bath' context option on filled bathtubs. Cleans blood and dirt, removes wetness afterward, and (optionally) clears all muscle strain.
Sandbox_EnableBinksScooper: Enable Bink's No Stinks: Pooper Scooper
Sandbox_EnableBinksScooper_tooltip: Adds a craftable shovel-class tool that scoops vanilla animal dung (chicken, cow, deer, mouse, pig, rabbit, raccoon, rat, sheep, turkey) within a configurable radius. Recipe: 1 Shovel + 1 Duct Tape + 1 Plank. Default ON.
Sandbox_EnableBoltCutter_tooltip: Cut through metal gates, security doors, and garage doors with bolt cutters.
Sandbox_EnableBulletPenetration_tooltip: Bullets can pass through killed zombies and damage zombies behind them. Auto-detects weapon stats so it works with any gun mod.
Sandbox_EnableCSRClaimsOverride_tooltip: Replace the vanilla safehouse claim flow with the CSR-owned claims registry. Required for faction and vehicle claims to share a single authoritative server-side store. Disabling this falls back to the legacy vanilla flow.
Sandbox_EnableCSRRadialMenu_tooltip: Adds a V-key CSR radial for core panels and quick actions when not interacting with vehicles. Vehicle-specific CSR actions move to the vehicle radial while enabled.
Sandbox_EnableCharacterInfoEnhancements_: Show a nutrition panel below the character screen with weight, calories, protein, carbs, and fats.
Sandbox_EnableCityStandpipes_tooltip: Use fire hydrants as water sources with a pipe wrench. Requires minimum Strength.
Sandbox_EnableClaimExpansion_tooltip: Allow owners and co-owners to expand personal and faction safehouse claims through the CSR Claims Manager.
Sandbox_EnableClaimInvites_tooltip: Officers and above may send invitations to add players to a claim. Targets receive an Accept / Decline pop-up.
Sandbox_EnableClaimRespawn_tooltip: Lets players pin a personal or faction safehouse claim as their respawn point. After death the player auto-teleports to the pinned claim. The pinned safehouse is also flagged as a vanilla map-spawn option. Vehicle claims are not eligible. Disable to fall back to vanilla respawn behaviour.
Sandbox_EnableClimbWithBags_tooltip: Keep bags in your hands when climbing through windows or over fences. Heavier bags increase climb time.
Sandbox_EnableClimbWithGenerator_tooltip: Allows climbing through windows, over fences, and up/down sheet ropes while holding a generator. Applies a heavy time penalty based on generator weight.
Sandbox_EnableClipboardQoL_tooltip: Write and read checklists on clipboard items.
Sandbox_EnableColoredToggles_tooltip: When ON, the CSR Settings panel (S button on the Utility HUD) renders ON toggles green and OFF toggles red. When OFF, falls back to vanilla button styling. Does not affect the vanilla Sandbox Options screen.
Sandbox_EnableConeVisionOutline_tooltip: Highlights zombies within your forward vision cone with a colored outline. Requires the vanilla melee outline option to be enabled in game settings.
Sandbox_EnableCorpseIgnite_tooltip: Right-click corpses to ignite them with a lighter or matches.
Sandbox_EnableCorpseTrunk_tooltip: Adds Put Corpse in Trunk when a corpse and an accessible vehicle trunk, truck bed, trailer trunk, or cargo container are nearby. Disable to remove the context option.
Sandbox_EnableDashboardHighlights_toolti: Color-tint vehicle dashboard gauges (battery, engine temp, heater) for at-a-glance status.
Sandbox_EnableDismantleAllWatches_toolti: Batch dismantle watches, clocks, hair dryers, CD players, headphones, phones, remotes, and other small electronics into electronics scrap with a screwdriver.
Sandbox_EnableDualWield_tooltip: Left-hand unarmed punch follow-up attack. Experimental feature.
Sandbox_EnableEVConversion_tooltip: Adds a Convert to Electric option on vehicles. Converted vehicles run on a charge meter instead of fuel and recharge from a Car Battery Charger placed in a Power Bar zone.
Sandbox_EnableEatAllStack_tooltip: Right-click a food stack to eat the entire stack in one action.
Sandbox_EnableEatWhileDriving_tooltip: Allows the driver to eat or smoke while in a vehicle, including while it is moving. Two-handed foods (pots, large bowls) are still blocked. Animation is suppressed since the player rig is locked to the seat. Disable for a stricter realism profile.
Sandbox_EnableEntryActions_tooltip: Master toggle for all forced-entry features: crowbar prying, door lockpicking, and bolt cutters. Turn this off to fully disable entry mechanics for the whole server.
Sandbox_EnableEquipmentPanel_tooltip: Show a side panel attached to the inventory window with all worn items rendered over a live 3D model of your character. Drag items into slots to wear, right-click slots for context options.
Sandbox_EnableEquipmentQoL_tooltip: Battery swap, lighter refill, cloth tearing, bandage crafting, and other equipment shortcuts.
Sandbox_EnableEventAirBombardment_toolti: Allows the air bombardment helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventCharacterHints_toolti: When enabled, each player's character gives brief, ambiguous warnings and survival suggestions as synchronized events develop. The active event is never named directly.
Sandbox_EnableEventDownedHeli_tooltip: Allows the downed helicopter crash event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventEMIInterference_toolt: Allows the electromagnetic interference (EMI) event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventFuelReclamation_toolt: Allows the fuel reclamation helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventHostileAttack_tooltip: Allows the hostile helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventIncendiarySweep_toolt: Allows the incendiary sweep event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventMilitaryVehicleStrike: Allows the military vehicle strike helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventPropagandaBroadcast_t: Allows the propaganda broadcast event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventSmokeCurtainEvent_too: Allows the smoke curtain event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventSniperCover_tooltip: Allows the sniper cover event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventSupportAttack_tooltip: Allows the support attack helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventSurveillanceEvent_too: Allows the surveillance event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventToxic_tooltip: Allows the toxic helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventUAVScan_tooltip: Allows the UAV scan event to run and broadcast zombie density reports by radio.
Sandbox_EnableExerciseWithGear_tooltip: Prevents the fitness system from unequipping bags and clothing when exercising. Your character keeps all gear on.
Sandbox_EnableExtendedBatteryLife_toolti: Makes vanilla battery-powered light sources drain more slowly. Applies to flashlights, angle-head flashlights, penlights, and crafted electric lanterns.
Sandbox_EnableFactionMemberLimit_tooltip: Caps the number of players a faction can have. When a faction reaches the limit the owner cannot send further invites until a member leaves.
Sandbox_EnableFactionSafehouse_tooltip: Allow faction owners to claim safehouses on behalf of their faction.
Sandbox_EnableFenceCutting_tooltip: Lets bolt cutters cut through wire-mesh and barbed-wire fence panels. Successful cuts drop wire (and barbed wire if present) at your feet. Requires Enable bolt cutter entry.
Sandbox_EnableFieldFilters_tooltip: Allows crafting makeshift respirator and gas mask filters from common materials. Also enables the filter lifespan multiplier.
Sandbox_EnableFireTrail_tooltip: Allow lighting a trail of fuel from a gas can to create a delayed ignition line. Useful for traps and crowd control.
Sandbox_EnableFirework_tooltip: Craft and throw fireworks to create a 30-second zombie confusion zone with visual effects.
Sandbox_EnableFixedDailyEventHour_toolti: When enabled, automatic HTT events ignore cooldowns and try to start once every in-game day at the fixed hour below.
Sandbox_EnableFloatingWarnings_tooltip: Shows Advanced Health character speech warnings for health changes and habit risks. Disable this to keep the sidebar attention without spoken warning spam.
Sandbox_EnableFoodExpiryTooltip: Show food expiry on item tooltips
Sandbox_EnableFoodExpiryTooltip_tooltip: Adds two extra lines to food tooltips: estimated days/hours of freshness at room temperature, and projected days inside a fridge. Uses the item's per-instance offAgeMax + your live FoodRotSpeed and FridgeFactor sandbox settings, so values match what the game will actually do. Default OFF.
Sandbox_EnableFridgeToggle_tooltip: Adds a right-click option on fridges and freezers to toggle their power draw on or off without disconnecting the whole house from the grid. Useful for conserving generator fuel.
Sandbox_EnableGarageDoorPry_tooltip: Allow crowbar prying on garage doors and roll-up doors.
Sandbox_EnableGearSling_tooltip: Adds a second equip slot for sling-style and shoulder bags, so you can carry a satchel, duffel, or chest rig alongside your main backpack.
Sandbox_EnableGeneratorInfo_tooltip: Enhanced generator info window with fuel time remaining, fuel gauge bar, and purple power range overlay when carrying or inspecting a generator.
Sandbox_EnableGradualEventCessation_tool: Gradually increases intervals and lowers event probability until one final event occurs and helicopter events stop permanently.
Sandbox_EnableGroundCleanup_tooltip: Periodic server-side removal of ground items near players. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_EnableGroundMarking_tooltip: Allow players to right-click the ground to spray directional arrows and survival symbols. Requires SprayPaint (permanent marks) or Crayons (marks degrade on next rain). MP-safe: placement is server-authoritative.
Sandbox_EnableHideInFurniture_tooltip: Right-click closets, dumpsters, and fridges to hide inside. Zombies cannot see you while hiding.
Sandbox_EnableHideInVehicles_tooltip: While seated in a stopped, quiet, enclosed vehicle, right-click the world to hide in the cabin. Moving, starting the engine, turning on lights or sirens, changing seats, or opening your cabin forces you out. Default OFF.
Sandbox_EnableHideWatermark_tooltip: Remove the version/build watermark text from the screen.
Sandbox_EnableHomeCanning_tooltip: Adds craft recipes to convert empty tin cans + a jar lid + ingredients into vanilla canned items (Canned Milk, Canned Fruit Cocktail, Tinned Soup, Water Ration). Requires Cooking 2-3. Auto-hides if a third-party canning mod is loaded.
Sandbox_EnableHydrationSense_tooltip: Automatically handles drinking from carried fluids when thirsty, or reminds players in manual mode.
Sandbox_EnableImprovisedHotwire_tooltip: Hotwire vehicles with a screwdriver when lacking Electrical/Mechanics skills or the Burglar trait.
Sandbox_EnableIncendiarySweepPlayerRisk_: If enabled, incendiary sweeps can land in a reduced but still safe range near players; players are never directly targeted.
Sandbox_EnableInfectionResilience_toolti: Gives zombie-infected players a small chance to survive the infection. The infection converts to a fever they can recover from.
Sandbox_EnableItemInsightTooltips_toolti: Show extra info on item tooltips: freshness timers, condition, nutrition, drainable %%, and duplicate warnings.
Sandbox_EnableItemRename_tooltip: Right-click any item to rename it. Names persist across saves. Use Reset Item Name to revert.
Sandbox_EnableItemWipeScheduler_tooltip: Periodically force-removes all dropped ground items near players. Countdown shown on the CSR Utility HUD. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_EnableJarCapping_tooltip: Right-click a jar in inventory while holding a Jar Lid to seal it. Sealed jars rename to 'Sealed <name>'. Uncap returns the lid.
Sandbox_EnableKnowledgeSharing_tooltip: Teach recipes and give skill XP lectures to nearby players in multiplayer.
Sandbox_EnableKnoxSyndicateBroadcast: Knox Syndicate: passive radio broadcast on 100.8 FM
Sandbox_EnableKnoxSyndicateBroadcast_too: When ON, registers a Knox Syndicate intercept loop on 100.8 FM. Tune any working radio (hand or vehicle) to 100.8 to hear the broadcast and learn how to call in support. The support call feature still works with this disabled.
Sandbox_EnableKnoxSyndicate_tooltip: Adds a fictional rescue contractor named Knox Syndicate. Right-click any working radio (inventory or vehicle) and select Call in Knox Syndicate to summon a 90-second helicopter strafing run that culls nearby zombies, but the engine noise also draws fresh horde attention. Subject to a long cooldown. Default OFF.
Sandbox_EnableLadderClimb_tooltip: Lets players climb vanilla world ladders by reusing the engine's sheet-rope state machine. Press the Interact key while standing at the foot or top of a ladder. Disable to fall back to vanilla behaviour. Cooperative no-op if another ladder mod is loaded.
Sandbox_EnableLastResortHarvest_tooltip: Adds a 'Field Dress' option on dead bodies when carrying a sharp knife. Yields corpse-flesh food (mostly past-fresh) and possibly an Animal Bone. Disabled by default. Animal corpses are skipped (use vanilla skinning).
Sandbox_EnableLightSwitchFinder_tooltip: When ON, dark rooms automatically outline nearby light switches in purple so they are easier to find. Players can toggle their local view with the LS button on the Utility HUD. Default ON.
Sandbox_EnableLighterUses_tooltip: Override the maximum number of uses for vanilla lighters and matches with the values set below.
Sandbox_EnableLogging_tooltip: This allows the user to enable logging in the game chat with a variety of information about the current/future phase timers.
Sandbox_EnableLoginProtection_tooltip: Temporarily protects players when they first log in. The player is made invisible, ghosted from zombie targeting, and outlined in purple until the timer ends. Default ON.
Sandbox_EnableLootBagCorpsesOnly: Nearby Loot: corpses only by default
Sandbox_EnableLootBagCorpsesOnly_tooltip: When on, the Nearby Loot tab defaults to aggregating only zombie / corpse inventories instead of every nearby container. Each player can still flip this on or off via right-click on the Nearby tab.
Sandbox_EnableLootBagUnwantedLast: Sort Nearby Loot unwanted items last
Sandbox_EnableLootBagUnwantedLast_toolti: Adds an enabled-by-default Unwanted Last button to the Nearby Loot controls. When on, fully unwanted rows move below wanted rows while preserving the selected name/category order. Mixed rows stay above so wanted copies are not buried.
Sandbox_EnableLootBag_tooltip: Add a single 'Nearby Loot' tab to the loot panel that aggregates items from every reachable nearby container, including bags inside loot containers. Server sandbox controls whether this feature is allowed; when allowed, each player can still toggle their own preference. Note: also requires Enable proximity loot helper to be ON.
Sandbox_EnableLootFilter_tooltip: Hide unwanted items across 15 categories. Toggle panel with Backslash key.
Sandbox_EnableLootWindowLeftRail: Move loot container rail to the left
Sandbox_EnableLootWindowLeftRail_tooltip: Moves only the loot-window container rail to the left edge. Nearby Loot and nearby container tabs populate there; the player inventory rail stays on the right. Default ON. Automatically yields to CleanUI.
Sandbox_EnableMagazineBatchActions_toolt: Load or unload all matching magazines at once.
Sandbox_EnableMaskHud_tooltip: Show a small slot next to the hotbar with the equipped (or carried) gas mask. Click to toggle wear, right-click to replace filter. Hidden when no mask is in inventory.
Sandbox_EnableMassage_tooltip: Allow players to massage another player's strained muscles using butter or cooking oil.
Sandbox_EnableMaterialBundles_tooltip: Allow tying planks, metal materials, pipes, bars, branches, and wooden rods into reduced-weight bundles. Existing CSR bundles can still be unbundled when this is disabled.
Sandbox_EnableMod_tooltip: Master switch for this mod. If disabled, HTT will not start events.
Sandbox_EnableMultipleSafehouse_tooltip: Allow players to claim more than one safehouse.
Sandbox_EnableNearbySearchContextMenu_to: Adds a world right-click option to search nearby unsearched containers around the clicked spot. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_EnableNestedContainers_tooltip: Show containers inside containers as separate buttons in the inventory sidebar. A bag inside a backpack gets its own clickable button. Supports up to 2 levels of nesting.
Sandbox_EnableNoticeBoard_tooltip: Read and write messages on paper notices and whiteboards in the world. Requires a pen or marker.
Sandbox_EnableOffhandHudOverlay_tooltip: Keeps the off-hand weapon icon visible during brief engine slot clears (primary equip, ranged swings). Requires dual wielding to be enabled.
Sandbox_EnableOffhandPersist_tooltip: Re-equips the off-hand weapon after vanilla clears the secondary hand slot during primary equip or attack actions. Requires dual wielding to be enabled.
Sandbox_EnableOutfitSets_tooltip: Right-click a wardrobe / dresser / locker / shelves / clothes stand to save and recall outfits. Best-condition match across player + wardrobe + (optionally) the rest of the room. Inspired by Yuki's Outfit Control mod, used with permission.
Sandbox_EnablePerfumeAsDisinfectant_tool: Allow small high-alcohol bottles such as cologne and perfume to be used as wound disinfectant. Vodka and rubbing alcohol still take priority when available.
Sandbox_EnablePlayerMapPrivacy: Allow players to hide map location
Sandbox_EnablePlayerMapPrivacy_tooltip: When ON, each player can right-click their character and toggle 'Hide my location on shared map'. Admins, moderators, GMs, and overseers always see hidden players. Turn OFF to force everyone visible to all (subject to the visibility mode above).
Sandbox_EnablePlayerMapTracking_tooltip: Show other players on the world map and minimap in multiplayer.
Sandbox_EnablePlayerTrading_tooltip: Enables the CSR gold-themed multiplayer player trading UI. Uses Project Zomboid's built-in secure trade transfer flow.
Sandbox_EnablePointBlank_tooltip: Massive accuracy boost when aiming a firearm at a zombie within 2 tiles. Also applies bonus damage at point-blank range.
Sandbox_EnablePourCanContents_tooltip: Right-click open containers to pour contents on the ground.
Sandbox_EnablePowerBarCable_tooltip: Right-click a Power Bar in your inventory while standing on a powered tile to plug it in. Each Electric Wire invested extends its powered zone by 1 tile (Manhattan distance).
Sandbox_EnablePowerBarRangeOverlay_toolt: Draws a translucent diamond around each placed Power Bar showing its current cable reach. Cyan = energized, grey = no power. Disable for a cleaner look.
Sandbox_EnablePowerLineBatteryPlacebo: Power Line keeps batteries topped up
Sandbox_EnablePowerLineBatteryPlacebo_to: Opt-in flavor option: while standing on a Power Line tile, supported drainable light items in your inventory are kept charged. Default OFF.
Sandbox_EnablePowerLine_tooltip: Right-click a powered tile to start a blue cord. Walk to lay cable, right-click an unpowered tile to End Power Line Here. One Power Bar is consumed and every painted tile becomes a permanently powered tile.
Sandbox_EnableProximityLootHelper_toolti: Tab key opens a searchable panel showing nearby ground items with Grab All support. Note: disabling this also removes the shared Nearby Loot tab from the loot window.
Sandbox_EnablePrySystem_tooltip: Allow crowbar prying of locked doors, windows, and garage doors. Strength-based success with noise generation. Note: disabling this also disables bolt cutters, vehicle door pry, and garage door pry. To disable all entry at once, use Enable entry actions (the master toggle).
Sandbox_EnableQuickDeviceToggle_tooltip: Turn radios and TVs on or off directly from the right-click context menu.
Sandbox_EnableQuickInventoryActions_tool: Adds optional one-item Alt+click shortcuts: grab real loot, unpack carried nested items, equip or unequip gear, eat safe food, drink safe fluids, read literature or maps, toggle portable equipment, and open CSR ammo boxes. Ctrl+Alt+click toggles vanilla's per-player unwanted mark. Excludes medication, wound treatment, bulk actions, smart appliance routing, and virtual-container destinations. Default OFF.
Sandbox_EnableQuickSit_tooltip: Sit on furniture or the ground with Numpad - key.
Sandbox_EnableRVExitRescue_tooltip: Adds a CSR emergency right-click exit inside ProjectRV interiors. The server only teleports players to validated saved non-interior coordinates from ProjectRV or CSR last-safe data.
Sandbox_EnableRadioPlugIn_tooltip: Placed radios on a powered tile run on mains power instead of draining their battery.
Sandbox_EnableRainCleanseExteriors_toolt: When ON, rain and snow may wash blood and grime from weather-exposed exterior wall surfaces near players. Uses vanilla square stain cleanup only and avoids sprite replacement. Default ON.
Sandbox_EnableRainCleanse_tooltip: Outdoor rain and snow gradually wash blood and dirt off the ground, building exteriors, your skin, your worn clothing, equipped weapons, equipped bags, and parked vehicles. Driven by the actual weather intensity and your character's wetness. Default ON.
Sandbox_EnableRallyPoints_tooltip: Allows players to pin a rally point on the world map and share it with all online players. The map shows a route line to the waypoint and auto-clears when you arrive.
Sandbox_EnableRandomEventCooldown_toolti: When enabled, each vanilla-triggered HTT event uses a random cooldown between 6 hours and the value configured in Time Between Events.
Sandbox_EnableRankings_tooltip: Persistent multiplayer scoreboard tracking zombie kills, deaths, hours survived, distance walked and XP, with a global overall score and separate current-life view. Adds a sidebar button to open the rankings window. Disabling stops all tracking and hides the button.
Sandbox_EnableReloadAllMags_tooltip: Adds a 'Reload All Mags' slice to the firearm radial menu (hold R) and a 'Reload All' option to the right-click menu of any magazine in your inventory. Reloads every not-full magazine of the matching type in sequence.
Sandbox_EnableRepairAllClothing_tooltip: Adds a 'Repair All Clothing' right-click option that restores every worn garment to full condition and removes all sewn-on patches in one action. Costs 1 thread use, 1 needle wear, and 1 fabric strip per damaged garment. Requires Enable repair extensions.
Sandbox_EnableRepairExtensions_tooltip: Right-click damaged items to repair them. Also enables alternative repair materials like duct tape and glue.
Sandbox_EnableReplaceVanillaSafehouseUI: Route vanilla Safehouse menu to CSR Claims Manager
Sandbox_EnableReplaceVanillaSafehouseUI_: When ON (default), right-clicking a tile and choosing the vanilla "View Safehouse" / "Safehouse" option opens the unified CSR Claims Manager (Personal / Faction / Vehicle tabs) instead of the vanilla safehouse window. The vanilla window remains accessible from the User Panel and from an in-window button. Turn OFF to keep the vanilla window as the default.
Sandbox_EnableRodentCuisine_tooltip: Tweaks vanilla skinned mice and rats so cooking them removes unhappiness, they slot into Mouse and Rat evolved recipes, and they count as Game food. No new items added.
Sandbox_EnableRoofClimb_tooltip: Right-click a parked vehicle and choose Climb onto roof to scramble up for a higher vantage. Right-click again on the vehicle to climb down. Auto-disabled when More Car Features (WayMoreCars) or ClimbableVehicles is loaded. Default ON.
Sandbox_EnableRoomScanner_tooltip: Right-click an interior tile or use the panel to scan the current room for items, containers, exits, and notable hazards. Useful for clearing safehouses or surveying loot before triggering noise. Requires Enable clipboard QoL to be ON.
Sandbox_EnableRopeTow_tooltip: Allow players to attach a rope between two vehicles to drag a stalled or low-fuel vehicle. Disable to remove the context option.
Sandbox_EnableRouletteSession_tooltip: Multiplayer-only feature. Right-click a loaded revolver to invite nearby players into a turn-based Russian Roulette session. The kill chamber is server-rolled and hidden. Each pull rolls 1-6; matching the kill chamber kills the firing player.
Sandbox_EnableSafeDoorPry_tooltip: Allow prying reinforced and safe doors. Requires high Strength. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_EnableSawAllDropToGround: Saw All drops planks on ground
Sandbox_EnableSawAllDropToGround_tooltip: When enabled, Saw All Logs places planks at your feet instead of inventory. Useful for players without weight-reduction mods.
Sandbox_EnableScrewdriverLockpick_toolti: Allow using screwdrivers, paperclips, credit cards, and ID cards to quietly pick building door locks. Paperclips and cards are consumed on success.
Sandbox_EnableSearchNoise_tooltip: When enabled, searching periodically creates small world sounds that can attract nearby zombies. Fast searching is much louder.
Sandbox_EnableSeatbeltProtection_tooltip: Toggle seatbelt with Numpad + for crash damage reduction while driving.
Sandbox_EnableSeatedReloadBonus_tooltip: Grants a 20%% reload-speed bonus while sitting on furniture or the ground. Mirrors the vanilla 20%% reload-speed PENALTY for seated drivers, applied as a bonus for non-vehicle sitting.
Sandbox_EnableShiftFastSearch: Hold fast-search key to search faster
Sandbox_EnableShiftFastSearch_tooltip: When enabled, holding the fast-search key during a search speeds up the progress bar.
Sandbox_EnableSkillJournal_tooltip: Pure-UI skill recovery system. A 'Journal' button on the Utility HUD opens a panel where you can save a server-side snapshot of your current perk levels (and the recipes / read magazines you know) and restore them after dying. No physical item, recipe, or animation -- the snapshot is keyed to your Steam ID and survives respawn. Disabling stops all tracking and hides the button.
Sandbox_EnableSleepAnywhere_tooltip: Allow players to sleep on the ground without a bed. Low quality sleep.
Sandbox_EnableSleepBenefits_tooltip: While sleeping, boredom decreases by 1.5 and unhappiness decreases by 0.5 every 10 in-game minutes.
Sandbox_EnableSmartVehicleKeyLabels_tool: Auto-name vehicle keys based on the vehicle and allow renaming them.
Sandbox_EnableSpeedReload_tooltip: Adds a firearm radial slice, quick Reload-key double-tap, and optional keybind that rapidly drops the current magazine to the ground and inserts the best loaded spare magazine.
Sandbox_EnableStairSense_tooltip: Show a warning icon and text when zombies are detected above you on stairs.
Sandbox_EnableStairVaultGuard_tooltip: Blocks automatic vaulting when you run into a hoppable railing beside stairs, preventing accidental stairwell falls. Manual climb/vault interactions and normal flat-ground fence auto-vaulting still work.
Sandbox_EnableStatusBar_tooltip: Show a horizontal status bar above the hotbar with health, hunger, thirst, fatigue, endurance, stress and other survival stats. Right-click any cell to customize. Affected stats glow with their warning color.
Sandbox_EnableStopDropRoll_tooltip: When on fire, a context menu option appears to drop and roll to extinguish flames. Damages clothing in the process. Lucky trait improves success, Unlucky makes it worse.
Sandbox_EnableSurvivorBond_tooltip: Players who stay near each other for an extended time gradually reduce stress, boredom, fatigue, and unhappiness together.
Sandbox_EnableSurvivorLedger_tooltip: Displays a compact strip of survival statistics on screen: days survived, zombie kills, distance traveled, character weight, session kills, and average kills per day.
Sandbox_EnableSweepAshes_tooltip: Right-click a burnt-floor / ash pile while holding a broom to sweep it away. Has a chance to drop charcoal.
Sandbox_EnableSweepTrash_tooltip: Use a broom and garbage bag to clean floor trash and debris tiles.
Sandbox_EnableTVRadial: Enable TV / VCR / Radio radial menu
Sandbox_EnableTVRadial_tooltip: Press the TV Radial hotkey (default Numpad 9, rebindable) near a TV, VCR, or radio to open a controller-friendly radial menu with Power, Volume +/-, and Insert/Eject controls.
Sandbox_EnableTearAllNearbyClothing_tool: Adds the Tear All Nearby Clothing right-click option that pulls tearable clothes from nearby loot containers before tearing them. Turn this off to keep only selected/inventory Tear All actions.
Sandbox_EnableThrowableItems_tooltip: Allows players to throw CSR-approved junk items, unopened cans, and knives from the world context menu. The server validates every item and blocks guns, ammo, bags, random weapons, keys, and containers.
Sandbox_EnableToolSet_tooltip: Craft combined tool items (tool roll, toolbox) that count as multiple tools at once. Uses engine-native tags so they work everywhere -- crafting, building, vehicle mechanics.
Sandbox_EnableTowAssist_tooltip: Adds a forward impulse boost to vehicles while towing, reducing sluggishness. Force scales with both vehicle masses. Auto-disabled when Realistic Car Physics is active (incompatible impulse stacking).
Sandbox_EnableTowelDrying_tooltip: Allow players to use towels, sheets, and rags to dry off when wet.
Sandbox_EnableTrunkSpillage_tooltip: When ON, hard crashes or rough driving can fling items from open or exposed trunks onto the ground. Closed trunks keep cargo inside. Default OFF.
Sandbox_EnableUnHotwire_tooltip: Add a 'Remove Hotwire' option to the vehicle radial menu when seated as driver with the engine off and a screwdriver in inventory.
Sandbox_EnableUsefulBarrels_tooltip: Allows uncapping vanilla barrel objects with a pipe wrench, turning them into fluid containers that collect rain and can be filled or drained.
Sandbox_EnableUtilityHud_tooltip: Draggable HUD panel with quick toggles and status info. Toggle with Numpad /.
Sandbox_EnableVanillaHelicopterHook_tool: When enabled, a vanilla helicopter activation can trigger one HTT event while the vanilla helicopter keeps running.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleCabinFilter_tooltip: Reduces corpse-sickness gain while inside a vehicle. Strength scales with how sealed the cabin is - intact windows, closed doors, intact windshield. A running heater further dampens the effect. Auto-disables if a third-party cabin sickness mod is loaded.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleClaimEnforcementStr: When ON (default), CSR blocks bypass paths on claimed vehicles you do not own: hotwire, smashing windows, installing/uninstalling parts, taking engine parts, locking/unlocking doors, and siphoning gas. Owners, admins, faction members, and allowed-listed users are unaffected. Zombie attacks are NOT blocked. Turn OFF to make claims advisory only (visible owner badge but no action gates).
Sandbox_EnableVehicleClaim_tooltip: Claim and lock vehicles to specific players. Manage allowed player access.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleClock_tooltip: Display a 12-hour clock on the vehicle dashboard.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleCraftSurfaces_toolt: Master toggle for the vehicle craft-surface system (hood + trunk). Disable to turn off both. Default ON.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleDoorPry_tooltip: Pry locked vehicle doors and hatches with a crowbar via the radial menu (V key).
Sandbox_EnableVehicleHVAC_tooltip: Show a temperature slider on the vehicle dashboard for heating and cooling. Replaces the vanilla heater popup.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleHoodCraft: Enable vehicle hood as crafting surface
Sandbox_EnableVehicleHoodCraft_tooltip: Stand next to a parked car with the hood closed and you can craft any "any-surface" recipe on the hood (cleaning weapons, repairs, splints, simple kits). Default ON. Requires Enable vehicles as crafting surfaces (master) to be ON.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleMechanicsQoL_toolti: Batch uninstall vehicle parts (all tires, lights, windows, doors).
Sandbox_EnableVehicleRadio_tooltip: Replaces the vanilla radio popup with an always-visible radio panel on the dashboard. Volume knob (left) adjusts volume or toggles power on click. Tune knob (right) changes frequency. LCD shows station name and frequency.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleSalvage_tooltip: Salvage abandoned vehicles for scrap metal and materials. Requires propane torch, welding mask, Mechanics 3+, Metal Welding 3+. Vehicle is destroyed on completion.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleTrunkCraft: Enable vehicle trunk/cargo as crafting surface
Sandbox_EnableVehicleTrunkCraft_tooltip: Stand next to a parked car or truck with a reachable trunk, truck bed, trailer, or cargo bay and you can craft any "any-surface" recipe on it. Auto-yields if a dedicated trunk-craft mod is loaded. Default ON. Requires Enable vehicles as crafting surfaces (master) to be ON.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleWeatherExposure_too: When the windshield is missing, a door is missing or open, or a window is open or shattered, rain and snow get inside the cabin. Wets your clothes first (water-resistant gear helps), then your body. Driving forward into the weather makes it worse. Default OFF.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleWeatherIngress_tool: When ON, riding in a vehicle with a missing windshield exposes you to rain (wetness) and outside cold. Open or smashed side windows let cold air in too. Default ON.
Sandbox_EnableVideoInsert_tooltip: Adds 'Insert Video' and 'Eject Video' context menu options when near a TV or VCR. Insert shows all compatible VHS tapes or DVDs in your inventory.
Sandbox_EnableVisualSoundCues_tooltip: Directional ring overlay showing nearby sounds categorized by source (zombie/vehicle/player).
Sandbox_EnableWalkingItemActions_tooltip: Continue actions while walking instead of stopping: reading books / magazines / newspapers / comics / maps, wearing and unwearing clothing, crafting, and handcrafting. Sprinting still cancels. Per-player override available in the in-game CSR Settings panel.
Sandbox_EnableWarmUp_tooltip: Adds a context menu option to warm your hands when body temperature is below 36.6C and falling. Uses the vanilla hand-warming animation.
Sandbox_EnableWashAll_tooltip: Adds a 'Wash Everything' option on water sources that washes your body, recursively cleans every dirty item in your inventory (including bag contents), and replaces dirty bandages with clean ones in a single action. Server-validated.
Sandbox_EnableWashMenuSplits_tooltip: Sort the wash context menu by water requirement for easier item selection.
Sandbox_EnableWeaponHudOverlay_tooltip: Show ammo count pills on the hotbar, equipped panel, and aiming crosshair.
Sandbox_EnableWearableSlotFix_tooltip: Moves ear muffs and ear protectors from the Hat slot to the Ears slot so they can be worn with hats, helmets, and other headwear.
Sandbox_EnableZombieDensityOverlay_toolt: Shows a colored grid of zombie density on the world map and a small movable 'Nearby Density' HUD on screen.
Sandbox_Enabled_tooltip: When enabled, nearby loot containers must be searched before their contents are shown.
Sandbox_EnduranceBase_Name_tooltip:
The base amount of stamina that is drained before the fitness calculation begins 
(Recommended to not make this higher than 0.05 as stam drains from 1 to 0 and going into a big group of zomboids can drain stam very quickly with a high base)
Sandbox_EnduranceOnSuccess_Name_tooltip: Whether stamana drain occurs when the player attempts to push over a zomboid (off), or only when a player succeeds (on).
Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_CableSpawnAm: Controls how many energy transfer cables appear together when a cable spawns in loot.
Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_ConsumerScan: How often the controller performs a periodic full consumer cache refresh. Dirty events still force an immediate refresh.
Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_ControllerVe: How many floors above and below the controller are included for energy distribution and consumer scans (0 = same floor only).
Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_DebugLogs_to: Enables verbose ERS console logging for debugging. Keep disabled on servers to avoid spam.
Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_DismantleEle: Minimum Electricity XP awarded when picking up or dismantling ERS objects and packs. Some large objects award more XP. Use 0 to disable.
Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_EconomicMode: Fixed watt requirement consumed by the economic mode while the controller is powering the building. Set 0 to allow any available ERS energy.
Radius around the controller used by economic whole-building power. Default is 20 tiles.
Makes ERS work like a vanilla generator: the controller only turns whole-building power ON/OFF and skips consumer scans.
Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_LootSpawnMul: Controls how often Energy Routing and ERS - Small Producers Pack items appear in loot (x0.25, x0.50, x0.75, x1, x2, x3, x5).
Sandbox_EnergyRouting_CableSpawnAmount_t: Controls how many energy transfer cables appear together when a cable spawns in loot.
Sandbox_EnergyRouting_ConsumerScanInterv: How often the controller performs a periodic full consumer cache refresh. Dirty events still force an immediate refresh.
Sandbox_EnergyRouting_ControllerVertical: How many floors above and below the controller are included for energy distribution and consumer scans (0 = same floor only).
Sandbox_EnergyRouting_DismantleElectrici: Minimum Electricity XP awarded when picking up or dismantling ERS objects and packs. Some large objects award more XP. Use 0 to disable.
Sandbox_EnergyRouting_EconomicModeMinimu: Fixed watt requirement consumed by the economic mode while the controller is powering the building. Set 0 to allow any available ERS energy.
Sandbox_EnergyRouting_EconomicModeRadius: Radius around the controller used by economic whole-building power. Default is 20 tiles.

Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Antimicr: Scales effective antibiotic coverage after susceptibility, exposure and pathogen resistance are considered. Higher values improve treatment. Applies only in Custom.
Scales the rate at which antibiotic exposure and misuse increase pathogen resistance. Higher values accelerate resistance. Applies only in Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_BloodMan: Enables the Advanced Medicine blood-volume, red-cell mass, blood typing, crossmatch and transfusion model. When disabled, its physiological projections are neutralized without deleting stored blood history. Only applies in Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Contagio: Scales infectious dose generated by respiratory and wound exposure. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Contamin: Scales environmental and use-related contamination gained by reusable medical equipment. Applies only in Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Critical: Enables Advanced Medicine critical-care episode tracking and ABCDE/triage escalation. When disabled, active critical-care episodes are safely closed as disabled and no new episodes are generated. Only applies in Custom.

Scales how quickly active critical-care syndromes deteriorate and converge toward worsening evidence. Higher values increase escalation pressure. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Critical Care is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.

Scales how quickly active critical-care syndromes improve when the underlying evidence and treatment support recovery. Higher values improve recovery. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Critical Care is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_CultureT: Scales the time required for wound cultures to become available. Higher values make laboratory results take longer. Applies only in Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Dependen: Scales how quickly repeated exposure builds physical dependence when Drug Dependence is enabled. Applies only in Custom. Has no effect while Drug Dependence is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Diagnost: Scales diagnostic-reasoning uncertainty. Higher values make conclusions less certain. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_DiseaseF: Scales the probability that a valid exposure establishes disease. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_DiseaseS: Scales initial disease severity and untreated worsening. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_DrugDepe: Enables or disables tolerance-driven physical dependence and withdrawal for drugs with adaptation profiles. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Expirati: Scales how quickly Advanced Medicine loot and crafted pharmaceutical batches reach expiration. Higher values shorten shelf life. It does not alter active drug effect duration. Applies only in Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Hemorrha: Scales blood-volume and red-cell loss produced by Advanced Medicine wound bleeding. Higher values cause faster blood loss. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Advanced Blood Management is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Immunity: Scales effective host resistance used by disease transmission. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_MedicalP: Selects the global medical experience. Arcade is forgiving; Balanced is the recommended baseline; Realistic increases clinical pressure; Extreme is intentionally punishing. When Custom is selected, the qualified controls below override the Balanced baseline. Difficulty profiles do not change privacy, telemetry, or bridge policy.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Medicati: Scales therapeutic drug efficacy after patient-specific response and adaptation. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Mortalit: Scales disease-defined lethality pressure when an active disease becomes severe. It constrains general condition rather than using an independent instant-death roll. Higher values are more dangerous. Applies only in Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_NaturalB: Scales natural recovery of intravascular volume and red-cell mass when major active bleeding is absent. Higher values accelerate recovery. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Advanced Blood Management is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_NaturalM: Scales the effective potency of prepared natural medicines. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Neurolog: Scales neurologic deterioration pressure used by the seizure-risk progression model. Higher values make neurologic crises more likely to progress. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Advanced Neurology is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.

Scales neurologic recovery, including the duration of postictal recovery after seizures. Higher values shorten recovery time. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Advanced Neurology is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.

Enables Advanced Medicine neurologic assessment, seizure-risk modelling and neurologic support. Disabling it clears active neurologic physiology/support while preserving historical records. Only applies in Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Nutritio: Scales nutritional losses and the metabolic burden of activity and illness. Higher values are harsher. Applies only in Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Overdose: Scales toxicity burden against drug safety thresholds. Higher values make overdose states easier to reach. Applies only in Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_OxygenTh: Scales the oxygenation benefit produced by active oxygen-support modalities. Higher values improve oxygen support. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Respiratory Support is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Procedur: Scales success and complication pressure for basic and advanced medical procedures. Higher values are harder. Applies only in Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Progress: Scales the effective time used by disease progression. Higher values make stages and untreated deterioration advance faster. Applies only in Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Respirat: Scales how long newly applied respiratory-support modalities remain active before expiring. Higher values extend support duration. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Respiratory Support is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.

Enables oxygen, ventilation and bronchodilator support effects. Disabling it safely ends active support interfaces, removes their projections and withdraws bronchodilator symptom suppression. Only applies in Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_SeizureR: Scales the probability that sufficient neurologic risk develops into an actual seizure episode. Higher values increase seizure risk. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Advanced Neurology is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_SepsisPr: Scales infection spread toward sepsis and its contribution to critical-care deterioration. Higher values are more dangerous. Applies only in Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_SideEffe: Scales patient sensitivity used when resolving medication adverse reactions. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Sterilit: Scales the penalty and contamination consequences caused by poor procedural sterility. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_SupplyAv: Scales Advanced Medicine medical-loot abundance. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_TimeScal: Scales delta-based clinical evolution such as disease, wounds, infection, blood, respiratory, neurologic and critical-care progression. It does not accelerate pharmacokinetic clocks, item expiration or server/persistence timers. Applies only in Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Toleranc: Scales how quickly repeated drug exposure builds tolerance. Higher values reduce efficacy sooner through adaptation. Applies only in Custom. Has no effect while Drug Dependence is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Transfus: Scales the probability of transfusion reactions after compatibility, crossmatch and procedure factors are considered. Higher values increase risk. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Advanced Blood Management is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Vaccinat: Scales vaccine efficacy and inversely scales vaccine-failure pressure. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Ventilat: Scales ventilation, CO2 clearance and assisted respiratory-rate effects from active ventilation support. Higher values improve support. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Respiratory Support is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.
Sandbox_FamilyZAdvancedMedicine_Withdraw: Scales the intensity of withdrawal once dependence and abstinence meet the drug-specific thresholds. Applies only in Custom. Has no effect while Drug Dependence is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.

Sandbox_GeneratorPoweredBuildings_Heatin: Multiplier for heating system fuel consumption. Higher values increase fuel costs for heating. Default: 1.0 (Range: 0.1 to 10.0)
Enable the building heating system. When disabled, generators will not heat buildings and consume no fuel for heating. Default: Enabled
Sandbox_GeneratorPoweredBuildings_MaxCon: Hard cap for tracked powered consumers in one building scan. Higher values support larger builds but increase scan cost. Default: 500 (Range: 50 to 5000)
Sandbox_GeneratorPoweredBuildings_MaxGen: Maximum number of generators that may be associated with one building or pool. Higher values support larger setups but increase state size and scan cost. Default: 10 (Range: 1 to 50)
Sandbox_GeneratorPoweredBuildings_Strain: Enable generator damage from strain when overloaded (>1000 tiles per generator). When disabled, generators won't take condition damage from strain. Fuel consumption increase from strain still applies. Default: Enabled
Sandbox_GeneratorVerticalLinkRange_toolt: Vertical floor distance used to link generators into the same shared power group. Set to 0 to use the vanilla generator sandbox height.
Sandbox_GhostSightB42.CircleSize_tooltip:
Sets the server-side limit for circle scale.
(Rec: 1.0 / Default: 3.0)
Sandbox_GhostSightB42.DetectionRadius_to:
Sets the server-side upper limit. Higher values allow players more flexibility.
(Rec: 15.0 / Default: 50.0)
Sandbox_GhostSightB42.MaxVisibleGhosts_t:
Sets the server-side limit for rendered zombies.
(Rec: 100 / Default: 500)
Sandbox_GhostSightB42.Z_Note_tooltip:
■ General Rules:
- Selecting a specific value: Forces that value on all players, overriding their personal settings.
- 'Allow Player Choice': Players can use their own settings from the Esc menu.

■ About Numeric Limits:
- Higher values allow more freedom for players. Defaults are set to the maximum allowed range.
- Players cannot exceed these limits via the Esc menu during gameplay.
Sandbox_GhostToggleRange_tooltip: If Toggle Ghosting is true, sets the zombie proximity range for auto disabling Ghost mode. Distance is in tiles.
Sandbox_GiveBuildingKey: Give Player a Key to Their Spawn Building
Sandbox_GiveBuildingKey_tooltip: If the building a player spawns in has a lock, automatically give them a matching key for it so they aren't locked in or out of their own starting building.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_AccessHysteresi: Extra tiles of tolerance before the UI closes when moving away from the terminal. 0 = strict close the moment the player leaves range. Higher values prevent flickering when the character hovers near the edge.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_AllowMarkedCont: Allows connecting vanilla boxes, wardrobes and fridges to the network. Turn OFF to restrict the network to dedicated GS storage cells only (future feature).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_AllowSafehouseI: Allows creating a storage zone that automatically covers a player's claimed safehouse area. Useful for quick base setup in multiplayer.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_AutoSortEnabled: Automatically routes deposited items to the most appropriate container based on category rules and zone configuration. Turn OFF to always deposit into the first available container.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_BulkDepositEnab: Enables the 'Store all' button, which empties the player inventory into the network in one action. Turn OFF to require manual item-by-item transfer.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatCapacit: Requires Debug mode ON. Logs the personal capacity bonus detected per container for the requesting player (e.g. the Organized trait), read live from the vanilla getEffectiveCapacity(character) API - the same one the game already uses to decide if a deposit fits.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatCompatC: Requires Debug mode ON. Logs when Better Sorting's flat category code is normalized back to the vanilla category (Food/Weapon/Accessory/Material/FirstAid/Gardening) before our own subcategory engine evaluates it. Per-item detail lives in the separate >>> DETAIL sublog.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatCraft_t: Requires Debug mode ON. Retroactive recipe grants from manuals already read, and free-crafting overrides. Low volume - useful when a recipe won't show up in the crafting menu.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatInvento: Requires Debug mode ON. Deposits, bulk redistribution jobs, and item category/subcategory tagging.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatLiterat: Requires Debug mode ON. Logs, per literature row shown in Storage, whether the recipe probe succeeded and what it returned, so the already-read checkmark can be verified against real data instead of guesses.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatNetwork: Requires Debug mode. Summarizes client/server commands, sequence and synchronization state. Full payloads remain in the separate >>> DETAIL block.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatPermiss: Requires Debug mode. Bounded traces for character UUID lifecycle, faction/online roster merging, idempotent member changes and identity invariants. Names are diagnostic only and never authorize access.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatRouter_: Requires Debug mode. Summarizes destination selection for deposits and Auto Sort. Per-node decisions remain in the separate >>> DETAIL block.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatSearch_: Requires Debug mode ON. Traces every change in the Items tab search box: byte length vs real UTF-8 character length, and the received text. Meant for diagnosing search in non-ASCII languages (Chinese, Japanese, Korean...).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatTermina: Requires Debug mode ON. Every proximity/access check against a terminal (manifest, registry, range evaluation). Fires repeatedly while trying to open a terminal - very verbose.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatTooltip: Requires Debug mode ON. The "how much do I have in my network" tooltip patch on vanilla item tooltips (render failures, fallback path used).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatUI_tool: Requires Debug mode ON. Terminal window open/reuse events and node naming. Different from "UI: clicks & widgets" above (that one traces raw clicks/widget layout; this one traces our own window's opening logic).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugDetailCapa: Requires Debug mode and Capacity bonus. High-volume sublog: one line per live container with a detected personal bonus, on every terminal refresh. Enable only for a targeted capacity diagnosis.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugDetailComp: Requires Debug mode and Category compatibility. High-volume sublog: one line per item classified via Better Sorting's normalization table. Enable only for a targeted category-mapping diagnosis.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugDetailCraf: Requires Debug mode and Crafting. High-volume sublog: records known-recipe probes, individual loan/return decisions and batch internals. Enable only for a targeted crafting diagnosis.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugDetailInve: Requires Debug mode and Inventory/transfers. Massive sublog: may print one classification line per item/type, including category, subcategory and leaf. Enable only when diagnosing filters or snapshots.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugDetailNetw: Requires Debug mode and Network traces. High-volume sublog: records full command/payload flow. A SYSTEM warning appears before DETAIL lines. Enable only for a targeted network diagnosis.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugDetailRout: Requires Debug mode and Routing. High-volume sublog: records the evaluated tier and capacity result for every candidate node. Enable only for a targeted deposit/Auto Sort diagnosis.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugModeUI_too: Requires Debug mode ON. Logs every button click, and dumps the on-screen widget tree with positions and overlaps, to console.txt with prefix [GS_UI]. Different from "Terminal window" below (that one traces our OWN window's opening logic, not raw clicks/layout).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugMode_toolt: WARNING: Any enabled debug logging can reduce game and server performance; DETAIL logs may generate massive output. Use only for targeted diagnostics, enable only the required >> blocks, and disable during normal play and on production servers.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugRelayToCli: Enabled by default. Sends enabled Core/add-on log lines from the dedicated server to subscribed client consoles in bounded batches. Lines keep [SRV]/[CLI] origin markers. Disable it to keep diagnostics only on the server.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugSkipContai: When ON, a container joins the network regardless of distance to the nearest active terminal, and a new terminal links to any existing network with no distance limit. Not recommended outside testing: defeats the purpose of a physical terminal. OFF by default: enforces 'Network reach', like in a normal game.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugSkipTermin: When ON, the network UI can be opened from anywhere, without needing a physical GS terminal nearby or being within tablet wireless range. Useful for testing or creative play. OFF by default: requires a terminal or tablet, like in a normal game.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_EnableBatteryCo: Requires 'Consume generator fuel' ON (experimental, still being tested). Tries to also include batteries from solar mods (Immersive Solar Arrays, Plysken Solar Revolution) in the consumption split, alongside regular generators. Since this relies on those mods' internal data, it's not guaranteed to keep working if they change their internal format; if it stops detecting them, the network simply won't drain that source, no errors.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_EnableFuelConsu: EXPERIMENTAL, still being tested. OFF by default out of caution: the network consumes nothing, it just requires power to be present (see 'Require electricity' above, that one is stable). If turned ON, while the network is running off a nearby active generator (never off the normal grid, before the blackout), fuel is slowly drained according to 'Base consumption' and 'Per-container consumption'.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_EnableGenerator: Requires 'Consume generator fuel' ON (experimental, still being tested). Instead of only using the nearest generator, looks for all generators/batteries inside the same building as the terminal and splits consumption across all of them.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_EnableSoldering: OFF by default: the GS Soldering Iron is the one item in this mod meant to be find-only, since it's the tool every other GS recipe needs. Turn ON if you'd rather not depend on a lucky find - the recipe still needs its own magazine read and a real Electricity skill check (see the option below), it just becomes reachable at all.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_FuelConsumption: Requires 'Consume generator fuel' ON (experimental). Fuel the network drains per in-game hour just for being active, before adding per-container consumption. Same unit the generator itself uses (like the vanilla 'Generator fuel consumption' option).
Requires 'Consume generator fuel' ON (experimental). Extra fuel the network drains per in-game hour, multiplied by the number of containers/nodes it has registered. Bigger networks consume more.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootBlankDiskWe: Relative spawn chance for the GS Blank Disk, the raw material every programmable disk is made from. 0 disables it from loot entirely.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootBooksWeight: Relative spawn chance for GS manual magazines in bookshelves, libraries and electronics stores. Set to 0 to disable GS manuals from appearing in loot entirely. Higher values increase frequency.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootDiskProgram: Relative spawn chance for the disk-programming magazines (network, uninstall and drive disks). 0 disables them from loot entirely.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootDriveDiskWe: Relative spawn chance for a pre-made GS Drive Disk. 0 disables it from loot entirely (still programmable from a blank disk).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootFloppyDiskW: Relative spawn chance for the GS Network Disk. 0 disables it from loot entirely (you'll only be able to program one instead - or rely on someone else's find).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootManualWeigh: Relative spawn chance for the GS Network Monthly and Home Computing Digest build manuals. 0 disables them from loot entirely.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootPCPartsWeig: Relative spawn chance for the individual PC and terminal reader components (tower, motherboard, casing, etc.). 0 disables them from loot entirely.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootSolderingIr: Loot weight: DIY soldering iron guide
Relative spawn chance for the magazine that teaches the Soldering Iron recipe. 0 disables it from loot entirely. Useless unless 'Allow crafting the Soldering Iron' below is also ON.
Relative spawn chance for the GS Soldering Iron, required to craft any GS part. 0 disables it from loot entirely.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootSolderingPa: Multiplier for how often the Tip, Resistance Coil and Handle spawn as loot in the world. 1.0 = normal, 0 = never spawns (craft-only).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootTerminalRea: Relative spawn chance for a fully assembled GS Floppy Drive found ready-made. 0 disables it from loot entirely (still fully craftable).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootUninstallDi: Relative spawn chance for a pre-made GS Uninstall Disk. 0 disables it from loot entirely (still programmable from a blank disk).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_MaxContainersPe: Container limit when scanning a single zone. Acts as a performance safety cap for very large zone areas; does not limit the overall network total.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_MaxItemsPerBulk: How many items are processed per game tick during a bulk 'Store all' operation. Lower values reduce server lag on busy servers; higher values speed up the operation.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_MaxNodesPerNetw: Total container limit across all zones in one network. Very high values may impact server performance during scans.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_MaxTerminalsPer: How many physical GS terminal furniture pieces can be linked to a single network. Raise for large bases; lower for challenge servers.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_MaxZonesPerNetw: How many named storage zones a single network can have (e.g. 'Kitchen', 'Garage'). The default of 8 is sufficient for most bases.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_OperationHaloFe: Shows progress and final summaries above the player during deposits, withdrawals and Auto-sort. Independent from Debug mode. Errors remain visible even when this option is disabled.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_PCAcquireCraftT: How long the 'Get a PC' window takes to assemble a desktop computer from its 4 parts.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_ReaderAcquireCr: How long (same time units as crafting recipes) the 'Build a reader' window takes to assemble the GS Floppy Drive from its 3 parts.

Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_RejectDepositIf: Reject deposit if no matching container

If an item has no matching category/filter, exact-item affinity, or canonical taxonomy affinity, keep it in the player's inventory instead of dropping it into the first available 'Any' container. OFF by default (generic containers remain available, as before).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_RemoteTransferE: Allows inserting and withdrawing items from the network via the terminal UI without physically walking to the container. Turn OFF for a more realistic experience.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_RequirePower_to: The network only operates when there's power near the controller terminal (normal grid or generator; also checks a radius around it, not just the exact tile). Turn OFF to keep the network always active regardless of electricity.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_RequireRecipeBo: Players must read GS manual magazines before seeing and crafting each GS item, mirroring how vanilla skill books work. Turn OFF to unlock all GS recipes immediately.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_RequireWorkbenc: GS recipes can only be crafted at a work surface (table, counter, etc.). Turn OFF to allow hand-crafting anywhere without a surface.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_RescanOnTermina: Updates all zone containers every time a player opens the terminal. Recommended ON. Turn OFF only if containers rarely change and you want to reduce server load.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_RespectEquipped: Worn clothing, held weapons and carried bags are never moved by 'Store all'. Recommended ON.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_RespectFavorite: Items marked as favourite in the inventory are skipped by 'Store all'. Recommended ON to protect important items from being accidentally deposited.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_TerminalContain: Maximum tile distance, measured from the nearest active terminal, within which a container can join the network AND a new terminal can link to an existing one (one single value for both). Only applies when 'Require network reach' is ON. 40 tiles comfortably covers most single houses.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_TerminalInstall: How long installing a network disk on a computer takes (reader + disk method). Shared by the core mod and any addon that installs its own disk on a terminal.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_TerminalNetwork: Maximum floor difference from the primary terminal for an additional terminal to count as within coverage. 0 = unlimited (any floor or basement counts as long as it's within the horizontal range).
Maximum horizontal distance from a network's primary terminal within which an additional terminal counts as part of that coverage and can be linked to it on install.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_TerminalProximi: How close a player must stand to a GS terminal furniture to open the network without a tablet (in tiles). Only applies when 'Require terminal' is ON.

Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_EnableSkillRequire: Enables MetalWelding and Mechanics requirements for armor grades.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_EnableStandardArmo: Allows players to install Standard armor. Existing Standard armor can still be removed or repaired unless another compatibility rule blocks it.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_GasLeakRateMultipl: Multiplies the fuel loss rate from punctured gas tank armor. Set to 0 to disable fuel leaking.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_GasTankLeakClearCo: Gas Tank condition required to clear the leak after repairing the vanilla tank.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_GasTankPunctureDam: Condition damage applied to the vanilla Gas Tank when gas tank armor is destroyed.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_MaterialCostMultip: Multiplies armor crafting and repair costs.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_MaxQueuedActions_t: Limits how many armor actions a player can queue from one batch button press. This applies to batch install, batch repair, and batch remove. Single actions are unaffected.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_MultiInstallMode_t: Controls how players can queue armor installs. Single only disables batch installing. One grade allows batch installs but clears the selection when changing grade. Full multi-install allows mixed grades in one batch.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_RandomArmorApocaly: Chance each vehicle/panel roll can spawn worn Apocalypse armor. Keep this low for rare survivor builds.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_RandomArmorMaxHeal: Maximum health for randomly spawned survivor armor panels.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_RandomArmorMaxPane: Maximum Random Armor Panels Per Vehicle
Maximum number of worn armor panels a vehicle can receive from random survivor armor spawning.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_RandomArmorMinHeal: Minimum health for randomly spawned survivor armor panels.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_RandomArmorReinfor: Chance each vehicle/panel roll can spawn worn Reinforced armor.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_RandomArmorScrapCh: Chance each vehicle/panel roll can spawn worn Scrap armor. Scrap should usually be the most common.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_RandomArmorStandar: Chance each vehicle/panel roll can spawn worn Standard armor.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_ReinforcedProtecti: Percentage of incoming damage absorbed by Reinforced armor. Higher values protect the vehicle more.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_ScrapProtectionPer: Percentage of incoming damage absorbed by Scrap armor. Higher values protect the vehicle more.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_SoundRadiusMultipl: Multiplies how far welding noise travels.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_StandardProtection: Percentage of incoming damage absorbed by Standard armor. Higher values protect the vehicle more.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_XPRewardMultiplier: Multiplies MetalWelding and Mechanics XP rewards.
Sandbox_GridInventory_EnableDevTools_too:
Adds the "[DevTool] Edit Grid Size" option to the item context menu, so you can resize item footprints and container grids without launching the game with -debug.

On: DevTools available in this save. In multiplayer, non-admin players can see the option but the server rejects applying changes.

Off: only available when the game is started with -debug.
Sandbox_GridInventory_IconRotation_toolt:
Applies the sprite rotation, scale and anchor overrides (hardcoded + GridDevTool) for all players.

On: everyone sees item sprites rotated/scaled/anchored as configured.

Off (default): the server forces the default sprite (only the footprint w/h is applied) so old saves/overrides from before rotation/scale/anchor existed are never changed out of nowhere.

Recommended: on for new saves where sprites were tuned. Server-side decision for everyone.
Sandbox_GridInventory_InventoryPlayerHei: Height (rows) of the player's main inventory grid. Fixed value (default 4). The DevTool grid override for the player inventory can override this.
Sandbox_GridInventory_InventoryPlayerWid: Width (columns) of the player's main inventory grid. Fixed value (default 3). The DevTool grid override for the player inventory can override this.
Sandbox_GridInventory_MaxContainerGridSi:
Maximum number of rows for world container grids. Grids are sized by capacity up to this cap. The DevTool grid override can exceed this cap for specific containers.

Default 15 keeps the classic behavior.
Sandbox_GridInventory_MinWorldWidthGridS:
Base width (columns) for world container grids. All world container grids use this width; the height is sized by capacity up to the general cap. The DevTool grid override can replace it for specific containers.

Default 6 keeps the classic behavior.
Sandbox_GridInventory_ReorderMoveWhileWa:
Allows the character to walk while the item reorder action is running (running still cancels it).

On: you can walk while items reorganize, like many other timed actions.

Off: the action only runs while standing still.
Sandbox_GridInventory_ReorderTimeAction_:
Moves items within the same container with a short transfer animation.

Animated: the character does the transfer animation and the move is applied ~0.5s later. In multiplayer this gives the server time to process before the next move.

Instant: items move immediately on drop, like before.
Sandbox_GridInventory_ScatterMode_toolti:
How items without a saved position are placed in containers.

Automatic (natural loot): only containers that were never looted get a natural random layout; the player inventory and explored containers fill organized.

Always scatter (messy): items land scattered everywhere, including your own inventory. Quick transfers get messy; precise drag & drop with x,y keeps things organized.

Never scatter (neat): everything auto-fills from the top-left, never random.
Sandbox_GridInventory_SearchTimePerItem_:
Time in milliseconds to reveal each stack while searching a container. Scales with the number of stacks: more items, longer search.

0 = instant (reveals everything on click).
Sandbox_GridInventory_SearchWorldContain:
Makes world containers (crates, shelves, corpses...) need to be searched before you can interact with the items inside, like Tarkov.

When on, opening a container hides unidentified items behind a dark mask. Click the grid to start searching: items are revealed one stack at a time. You can stop anytime and keep what you already found; click again to resume. Items you put in yourself are revealed immediately.

Off: containers always show their contents.

<RGB:1,1,1>The chance for each box type to drop
from a zombie you kill.

Every type you turn on is checked on
its own, and most zombies are
checked twice. With all 32 types on,
that is 64 checks per body.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>So 0.18 does not mean 0.18%% of
zombies. Many small chances add up.

body in 9.

instead. Then only 23 types are left
here, so you get a box from about 1
body in 13.

small number here is already a lot
of ammo.

Sandbox_GunsOfMarzDropRate: Guns of Marz Ammo Drop Rate
Sandbox_GunsOfMarzDropRate_tooltip:
<RGB:1,1,1>The chance for each round type to
drop from a zombie you kill.

Every type you turn on is checked on
its own, and most zombies are
checked twice. With all 32 types on,
that is 64 checks per body.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>So 1.8 does not mean 1.8%% of
zombies. Many small chances add up.
At 1.8 you get ammo from about 69%%
of bodies.

<RGB:1.000,0.700,0.200>9 of these are vanilla rounds. This
pack drops them so it can work on
its own. If Ammo Loot Drop is also
on, that mod drops them instead.
Then only 23 types are left here, so
you get ammo from about 57%% of
bodies.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>Try 6 if you want almost every
zombie to drop ammo. Raise it
slowly.

<RGB:1,1,1>Set it to 0 to stop the drop.
Sandbox_GunsOfMarzWeaponDropRate: Guns of Marz Weapon Drop Rate
Sandbox_GunsOfMarzWeaponDropRate_tooltip:
<RGB:1,1,1>The chance that a zombie you kill is
carrying a gun.

This is the total chance, not the
chance for each gun. All the guns
you turn on share it. Turning a
caliber off changes which gun you
get, not how often you get one.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>Most zombies are checked twice. At
0.1 you get a gun from about 1 body
in 500. The 90 guns share that
chance.

<RGB:1.000,0.700,0.200>The 20 vanilla guns are in that
count. This pack drops them so it
can work on its own. If Ammo Loot
Drop Weapon is also on, that mod
drops them instead, and only the 70
guns this pack adds share the chance
here.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>A gun is worth much more than a few
bullets. Raise this slowly.

<RGB:1,1,1>Set it to 0 to stop the drop.

<RGB:1,1,1>OFF: any zombie can drop a gun, even
office workers and nurses.

ON: only zombies who look like they
carried a gun drop one, and only the
kind that suits them:

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>All types - soldiers, militia (4)
Pistols, shotguns, rifles - hunters,
rangers, campers, rednecks,
survivalists, raiders (20)
Pistols, shotguns - police, guards,
bandits, bikers (10)

in the game. Every other zombie
drops nothing. In a normal town,
only about 1 zombie in 100 wears one
of these outfits.

soldiers only. Nobody else in
Kentucky carried them.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>So search where these people worked:
police stations, army bases,
prisons, farms and bars.

<RGB:1,1,1>A higher drop rate helps a little,
but you will still find very little
in the suburbs.

<RGB:1,1,1>ON: the magazine that a gun uses
drops at the same rate, so a rifle
you find is ready to use.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>49 of the 90 guns use a magazine.
