Sandbox_HephasVitamins_EnableSayings_too: If enabled, your character will say immersive/funny lines when getting healed by the vitamins intake.
Sandbox_HephasVitamins_FatigueChange_too: Adjusts how much fatigue is reduced when taking vitamins.
Sandbox_HephasVitamins_HealAmount_toolti: Determines how much health you recover when the healing effect triggers. Higher values restore more health.
Sandbox_HephasVitamins_HealPercent_toolt: Sets the chance (in %%) that taking vitamins will heal you. Higher values mean a greater chance for a health boost.
Sandbox_HephasVitamins_StressChange_tool: Adjusts how much stress is added when taking vitamins. Default is 1 means taking a pill increases stress by 0.01.
Sandbox_HephasVitamins_UseDelta_tooltip: Controls how many times each vitamin item can be used. For example, a value of 1 means the item is consumed in one use, 0.5 allows two uses, 0.25 allows four uses, and so on. Lower values increase reusability.
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableGodRays_Too: When enabled, sun rays will be visually rendered on the screen during sunrise and sunset, depending on the sun's position.
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableStormMood_T: When enabled, storms can push a cinematic desaturation + darker ambient mood (with smooth fade).
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_StormMoodPreset_T: Choose how strong the storm desaturation should be: Soft, Recommended, Night of the Living Dead (Black & White).
Sandbox_HideContainerItemTooltips: Hide container item tooltips before searching
Sandbox_HideContainerItemTooltips_toolti: When enabled, container items such as bags will not reveal their contents through tooltips before being searched.
Sandbox_HideUnseenRooms_Blackness_toolti: How dark unseen rooms become (0.0 = visible, 1.0 = completely black). Recommended: 1.0
Sandbox_HideUnseenRooms_FadeSeconds_tool: Time in seconds for rooms to fade to black (0.0 = instant, 1.0 = 1 second fade). Recommended: 0.3
Sandbox_HitCountLvls: Levels per 1 Point Increase to Max Hit Count
Sandbox_HitCountLvls_tooltip: If selected, increase max # of firearm hit targets by one every x levels
Sandbox_HomeBrewing_AgingDays_tooltip: In-game days before a damgeumju jar can be opened.
Sandbox_HomeBrewing_FermentScale_tooltip: 1.0 = base fermentation times (makgeolli 6d, beer/cider 7d, fruit wine 10d, wine/mead 14d), 0.0 = every drink ferments in a single day. Values in between scale proportionally.
Sandbox_HomeBrewing_MoonshineSickness_to: When off, drinking moonshine never causes food sickness.
Sandbox_HomeBrewing_SpoilEnabled_tooltip: When on, finished brews left uncollected for another half of their fermentation time spoil and must be dumped (like crops rotting in the field).
Sandbox_HomeInventory_CacheUpdateDistanc: Maximum distance, in tiles, from which a player's loaded home zone may update its cached inventory.
Sandbox_HomeInventory_MaxZoneSide_toolti: Maximum width or height, in tiles, of newly created home zones. Lowering this does not resize existing zones.
Sandbox_HomeInventory_MaxZonesPerPlayer_: Maximum number of home zones each player may create. Lowering this does not remove existing zones.
Sandbox_HordeDistance_tooltip: Number of tiles away from the player the hordes will form.
Sandbox_HordeRadius_tooltip: Number of tiles from the horde positions zombies will be called to.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_AttractionRadius_to: Radius of the sound that pulls zombies toward the player. Must be larger than max spawn distance. Default: 1500.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_AttractionVolume_to: Intensity of the attraction sound. Higher = more zombies attracted. Default: 1500.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_CooldownSeconds_too: Minimum time in seconds between two hordes for the SAME player. Independent from other players unless Global cooldown is enabled. 900 = 15 minutes.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_CrescendoBaseSize_t: Number of zombies in wave 1. Each following wave is multiplied by the Multiplier. Example: base=5 x2 = 5, 10, 20, 40. Default: 5.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_CrescendoChance_too: STEP 2: Chance the horde is a crescendo. Default: 10%%.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_CrescendoDistMin_to: Minimum spawn distance for each wave. Each wave arrives from a different random direction. Default: 15.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_CrescendoEnabled_to: The crescendo horde sends multiple waves of zombies at regular intervals, each larger than the last. The player cannot rest between waves — unkilled zombies stack up with each new wave.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_CrescendoMultiplier: Size multiplier between waves as a percentage. 200 = x2 (double), 150 = x1.5, 300 = x3. Example with base=5 and x2: wave 1=5, wave 2=10, wave 3=20, wave 4=40. Default: 200.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_CrescendoWaveDelayS: Real-world seconds between each new wave. 30 = 30 seconds to kill the current wave before the next arrives. Minimum: 5 seconds. Default: 30.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_CrescendoWaves_tool: Total number of waves. Wave 1 spawns immediately, subsequent waves arrive after the configured delay. Default: 4 waves.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_Debug_tooltip: Outputs technical logs to console.txt. Disable in normal play.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_EnableDebugContextM: Enables admin options in the right-click menu: force a horde, view status, reset cooldown.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_Enabled_tooltip: Enables or completely disables the mod.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_GlobalPlayerCooldow: If > 0, when a horde spawns on any player, ALL players are protected for this many seconds. Prevents two simultaneous hordes on the server. 0 = disabled. Example: 300 = nobody can get a horde for 5 minutes after any horde spawns.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_GroupSizeMax_toolti: Maximum zombies in a normal horde (before scaling). Hard limit: 500.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_GroupSizeMin_toolti: Minimum zombies in a normal horde (before scaling).
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_MPAttractionDelaySe: Seconds before sending the zombie attraction signal in MP. Too short = zombies miss the signal. Default: 10.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_MPSpawnClamp_toolti: MULTIPLAYER ONLY. Limits spawn radius to stay in the loaded zone. Reduce if zombies vanish on spawn. Default: 75.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_MerchantChance_tool: Every 15 in-game minutes, chance that a merchant spawns near a player if a valid spot is found. Default: 25%%.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_MerchantDespawnMinu: Time before an inactive merchant (no nearby player, no ongoing trade) disappears along with his vehicle. Default: 20 minutes.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_MerchantEnabled_too: A merchant NPC can appear near a road with his vehicle parked on the roadside.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_MerchantMaxDistance: Maximum distance from the player when searching for a merchant spawn spot.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_MerchantMinDistance: Minimum distance from the player when searching for a merchant spawn spot.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_NeighborNotifyRadiu: Players within this radius are warned when a horde is triggered nearby. 0 = disabled. Default: 100.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_NewPlayerGraceSecon: How long after connecting a player cannot be targeted. 0 = disabled. Default: 600 = 10 minutes.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_NightEndHour_toolti: In-game hour at which night ends. Default: 5. Midnight crossing handled automatically.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_NightOnly_tooltip: If enabled, hordes can only spawn during nighttime in-game.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_NightStartHour_tool: In-game hour at which night starts. Default: 21.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_NormalChance_toolti: STEP 2: If a horde must spawn, this %% is the chance it is a normal horde. The 6 types should ideally add up to 100. Example: Normal=35 Wandering=22 Surround=16 Pincer=12 Crescendo=10 Sprinter=5 = exactly 100%%. If the total is not 100, the game recalculates automatically.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_PincerChance_toolti: STEP 2: Chance the horde is a pincer. Ignored if pincer is disabled. The 4 types should ideally add up to 100.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_PincerDistMax_toolt: Maximum distance. Capped by MP Clamp in multiplayer. Default: 40.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_PincerDistMin_toolt: Minimum distance from the player where each group spawns. Both groups spawn at this distance in opposite directions.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_PincerEnabled_toolt: The pincer horde spawns two groups of zombies in opposite directions simultaneously (e.g. North AND South). The player is caught between them and must break through one line or flee sideways.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_PincerGroupMin_tool: Minimum total zombies across both groups. Each group gets roughly half. Default: 10.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_RewardCrateChance_t: For each horde that spawns, chance that a reward crate appears at its spawn point. Default: 35%%.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_RewardCrateEnabled_: A wooden crate is placed at the horde's spawn point, with a few useful items (ammo, medical, food, sometimes a weapon) dropped on the ground next to it - as if it had been air-dropped when the horde arrived.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_ScalingInterval_too: Days between each difficulty increase. Default: 14.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_ScalingMaxPercent_t: Maximum horde size with scaling. 250 = x2.5 max.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_ScalingMode_tooltip: Increases horde size over survival time.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_ScalingPercent_tool: Extra zombies per step. Example: 20 = +20%% every 14 days.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SpawnChance_tooltip: STEP 1: Every 15 minutes, the game rolls a die. This is the probability a horde appears at all. Example: 50 = 50%% chance. If the roll fails, nothing happens and we wait another 15 minutes. If it succeeds, we move to Step 2.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SpawnDistMax_toolti: Maximum spawn distance. Capped by MP Clamp in multiplayer.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SpawnDistMin_toolti: Minimum spawn distance. Too small = zombies in the player's field of view.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SpawnSearchAttempts: Attempts to find a valid spawn tile. Higher = more reliable. Default: 64.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SpecialZombieChance: For EACH spawned zombie, chance it wears a special outfit instead of a normal random one. With a 50-zombie horde and 6%%, roughly 3 zombies will be special. The player gets notified if any were spotted. Default: 6%%.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SpecialZombieEnable: A small percentage of zombies in each horde will spawn wearing a special outfit (military, police, doctor, fire officer, ranger, hazmat...). These zombies carry interesting lootable equipment to reward the player for searching bodies after the fight.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SprinterChance_tool: STEP 2: Chance the horde is a sprinter horde. Keep low as it is very dangerous. Default: 5%%.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SprinterDistMin_too: Minimum spawn distance. Similar to normal since sprinters close distance quickly. Default: 15.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SprinterEnabled_too: The sprinter horde spawns a SMALL group of sprinting zombies. Very rare by default as it is extremely dangerous. Uses B42 doSprinter() API to force zombie speed.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SprinterGroupMax_to: Maximum number of sprinters. Beyond 8 it becomes nearly unplayable. Default: 8.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SprinterGroupMin_to: Minimum number of sprinters. Keep small — 3 sprinters are already very dangerous. Default: 3.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SurroundChance_tool: STEP 2: Chance the horde is an encirclement (zombies in a full circle around the player). Ignored if encirclement is disabled. The 3 types should ideally add up to 100.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SurroundDistMax_too: Maximum distance. Each zombie has +-15 degree variation for a natural circle.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SurroundDistMin_too: Minimum distance of each zombie. Recommended: at least 25 tiles.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SurroundEnabled_too: Zombies spawn in a full circle around the player. No obvious escape direction.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_SurroundGroupMin_to: Minimum zombies. With 8 zombies the circle has gaps.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_WanderingAttraction: Radius of the sound that directs the wandering horde toward its exit point. Default: 900.
Volume of the attraction sound for the wandering horde. Default: 900.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_WanderingChance_too: STEP 2: Chance the horde is a wandering one (passes near the player without targeting them). Ignored if wandering horde is disabled. The 3 types should ideally add up to 100.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_WanderingDistMax_to: Maximum spawn distance for the wandering horde. Default: 120.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_WanderingDistMin_to: Minimum spawn distance for the wandering horde. Default: 80.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_WanderingEnabled_to: The wandering horde crosses the area without chasing the player. Staying silent may let it pass.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_WanderingExitDistan: Distance of the destination point. The horde walks past the player toward this point. Default: 200.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_WanderingGroupMax_t: Maximum zombies in a wandering horde. Default: 40.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_WanderingGroupMin_t: Minimum zombies in a wandering horde.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_WanderingSpread_too: Width of the 4-group formation. Larger = harder to avoid. Default: 18.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_ZombieToothChance_t: For each zombie spawned in a horde, chance it carries a zombie tooth. Default: 10%%.
Sandbox_HordeSpawner_ZombieToothEnabled_: Horde zombies have a chance to carry a zombie tooth in their inventory, lootable from their corpse after being killed.
Sandbox_HorticultureLearnedRecipe_toolti: Adds 'Make Glass Pipe' recipe to 'Magazine: Murano Glass Manual'.
Sandbox_HostileAttackHitChance_tooltip: Chance that a hostile burst lands a hit. Rolled once per burst.
Sandbox_HowRepair_option1: Get token on break, apply to duplicate
Sandbox_HowRepair_option2: Upgrade can become dull/worn, but will never break
Sandbox_HowRepair_option4: No special system - vanilla repairs only - upgrade lost on break
Sandbox_HowRepair_tooltip: How the mod manages upgrade repairs and condition loss
Sandbox_HuntingArrowRecovery_tooltip: Percent chance a Carbon Hunting Arrow survives hitting a zombie and lodges in the body, to be recovered by looting the corpse.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_AimingImpact: Impact of the aiming level on hunting [%%]
Sandbox_HuntingMod_AimingImpactMaximumAi: If your aiming is the maximum level (or more), the impact due to aiming on the hunting chance will be this value.
Maximum aiming level for maximum impact
This won't make you unable to hunt, it will simply define the level needed to reach the maximum aiming impact value to hit a target.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_AimingImpactMinimumAi: If your aiming is the minimum level required to be able to hunt, the impact due to aiming on the hunting chance will be this value.
Minimum aiming level for minimum impact and to hunt
Sandbox_HuntingMod_AimingImpact_tooltip: The user aiming skill will impact hunting conditions.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_BigGameForage_tooltip: Boost to spawns of big games tracks.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_BirdsForage_tooltip: Boost to spawns of bird tracks.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_BoostToHuntingChance_: Final chance of hunting a target will be boosted by this multiplier. 100%% won't boost the hunting chance while a lower value will reduce overall chance of hunting and a higher value will increase the chance of hunting the target.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_FogImpact_tooltip: Fog will impact hunting conditions. This can boost the hunting chance or decrease it.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_HumanAreasForage_tool: Boost to spawns of tracks in areas with human activity such as cities, farms and roads.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_LightImpact: Impact of day light on hunting [%%]
Sandbox_HuntingMod_LightImpact_tooltip: Lightness of the day will impact hunting conditions. This can boost the hunting chance or decrease it.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_MaximumBonusSizeShred: Maximum bonus prey size when shred [%%]
When shred due to a gun too powerful, preys will have their maximum food value be this percentage of their default food value.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_MaximumBonusSize_tool: Preys will have their maximum food value be this percentage of their default food value.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_MeleeImpact: Impact of the melee level on hunting [%%]
Sandbox_HuntingMod_MeleeImpactMaximumMel: If your melee is the maximum level (or more), the impact due to melee on the hunting chance will be this value.
Maximum melee level for maximum impact
This won't make you unable to hunt, it will simply define the level needed to reach the maximum melee impact value to hit a target.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_MeleeImpactMinimumMel: If your melee is the minimum level required to be able to hunt, the impact due to melee on the hunting chance will be this value.
Minimum melee level for minimum impact and to hunt
Sandbox_HuntingMod_MeleeImpact_tooltip: The user melee skill will impact hunting conditions.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_MinimumBonusSizeShred: Minimum bonus prey size when shred [%%]
When shred due to a gun too powerful, preys will have their minimum food value be this percentage of their default food value.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_MinimumBonusSize_tool: Preys will have their minimum food value be this percentage of their default food value.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_MoodleImpact_tooltip: Moodles will impact hunting conditions: cold, hypothermia. This can boost the hunting chance or decrease it.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_NatureAreasForage_too: Boost to spawns of tracks in nature areas such as forests and deep forests.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_ScopeBonus_tooltip: When having a scope on the gun used to hunt, it will boost the hunting chance by this amount.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_Separation_AimingImpa:
[THIS OPTION DOES NOT DO ANYTHING]

Sandbox_HuntingMod_Separation_ForageSpaw:
[THIS OPTION DOES NOT DO ANYTHING]
Customize the chance for tracks of animals to spawn.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_Separation_General_to:
[THIS OPTION DOES NOT DO ANYTHING]
Set the general options.

[THIS OPTION DOES NOT DO ANYTHING]
Set the impact of melee on hunting. Depends on the category of the weapon (blunt, spear, long blade...)
Sandbox_HuntingMod_Separation_OtherImpac:

Sandbox_HuntingMod_Separation_StrengthIm:

Sandbox_HuntingMod_ShowProbabilities_too: Chance to hunt a spotting will be shown in the tooltip.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_SmallGameForage_toolt: Boost to spawns of small game tracks.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_SpawnLiveAnimals_tool: If enabled, successful hunting flushes out a live, moving Build 42 animal that you must chase and kill. If disabled, the mod uses simulated rolls and directly spawns a carcass on the floor.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_StealthImpact: Impact of the stealth level on hunting [%%]
Sandbox_HuntingMod_StealthImpactMaximumS: The impact due to stealth on the hunting chance will be this value when at stealth of 10 (mean between sneaking and lightfoot).
Sandbox_HuntingMod_StealthImpactMinimumS: The impact due to stealth on the hunting chance will be this value when at stealth of 0 (mean between sneaking and lightfoot).
Sandbox_HuntingMod_StealthImpact_tooltip: The user stealth skills will impact hunting conditions.
Sandbox_HuntingMod_StrengthImpact: Impact of the strength level on hunting [%%]
Sandbox_HuntingMod_StrengthImpactMaximum: If your strength is the maximum level (or more), the impact due to strength on the hunting chance will be this value.

Sandbox_InventoryTetris_BagGridBonus_too: Added to the width AND height of every carried container: backpacks, bags, purses, cases. A 6x4 bag holds 24 at 0, 35 at 1, 48 at 2. Set to 0 for vanilla Inventory Tetris.
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_BonusGridSize_to: The base mod's option. Added on top of every setting on the 'Inventory Space' page. Leave at 0 and use that page instead.
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_DisorganizedGrid: Removed from the width AND height of everything a Disorganized character is carrying. No grid ever shrinks below 1x1. Set to 0 to make the trait not affect inventory space.
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_EncumbranceSlow_: Carrying more than 50 weight slows you down, scaling up to half speed. Turn off if you want grid space to be the only limit.
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_EnforceCarryWeig: If enabled, container weight limits are strictly enforced. (Defaults to true automatically in Multiplayer for server authority).
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_ItemTransferSpee: Multiplier for how fast items transfer between containers. (Singleplayer Only. Disabled in MP due to server limits).
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_ItemWeightMultip: The only weight setting. Every item is multiplied by it - every item, from a nail to a fridge, including items from other mods. At 0.10 things weigh a tenth of normal, so your grid fills up long before you get encumbered while heavy things stay heavier than light ones. 0.01 is near-weightless. 1.0 turns it off and gives you vanilla weights. This never changes how many slots anything takes: footprints always come from the item's original weight.
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_OrganizedGridBon: In this mod the Organized trait grants grid space instead of carry weight. Added to the width AND height of everything the character is carrying. Set to 0 to make the trait not affect inventory space.
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_PocketGridBonus_: Added to the width AND height of every pocket on worn clothing, and to your character's own body slots. Pockets are tiny 1x1 grids, so each +1 multiplies what they hold: 0 = 1 slot per pocket (base mod), 1 = 4, 2 = 9. LOWER THIS if trousers holding 16+ items feels unrealistic. Set to 0 for vanilla Inventory Tetris.
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_PreventTardisSta: Prevents placing containers inside other containers of equal or greater size.
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_StackSizeMultipl: Multiplies Inventory Tetris stack limits globally. Enter a value from 0.01 to 100.0. Default is 1.0. Items that do not stack remain non-stackable.
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_UseItemTransferT: Uses calculated timed actions for transferring items. (Singleplayer Only. Disabled in MP due to server limits).
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_WorldGridBonus_t: Added to the width AND height of crates, shelves, lockers, counters, fridges and vehicle trunks. This is the total, not an extra on top of the bag bonus. Set to 0 for vanilla Inventory Tetris.

Sandbox_J93RunningBloodPools_BloodyFoots: Walking through a sufficiently wet tracked pool can contaminate the player's trail. In multiplayer the server decides when contamination begins and where footprints are placed.
Sandbox_J93RunningBloodPools_CorpseChanc: Percentage chance that an eligible newly killed zombie creates a persistent pool record. In multiplayer this roll is made only by the server.
Sandbox_J93RunningBloodPools_DebugMode_t: Writes persistence, migration, growth, native blood fallback, and synchronization diagnostics to console.txt. Leave off during normal play.
Sandbox_J93RunningBloodPools_Enabled_too: Master switch for new persistent blood pools and their bloody footprint trails. Existing native blood remains subject to the world's normal blood rules.
Sandbox_J93RunningBloodPools_FootprintDr: In-game days for ordinary age-based wetness to fall from 1.0 to 0.0. Rain can dry exposed blood much faster. Native Blood Splat Lifespan remains the hard upper limit.
Sandbox_J93RunningBloodPools_FootstepCou: Maximum alternating marks produced by a completely fresh pool. Drying pools automatically produce fewer prints according to their calculated wetness.
Sandbox_J93RunningBloodPools_FootstepSpa: Travel distance required between server-authoritative bloody marks. Smaller values create tighter trails; larger values spread them farther apart.
Sandbox_J93RunningBloodPools_GrowthSteps: Number of deterministic outward growth steps stored with each pool. More steps create smoother growth and more native floor-blood deposits.
Sandbox_J93RunningBloodPools_MaximumRadi: Maximum distance from the pool center. The server stores the chosen radius in each persistent pool record so every client sees the same geometry.
Sandbox_J93RunningBloodPools_MinimumDrie: Time-based drying will never thin a pool below this percentage of its original deterministic deposits. Rain and vanilla cleanup can still remove more.
Sandbox_J93RunningBloodPools_PoolAgingEn: Controls world-age wetness loss. When enabled, old pools gradually stop transferring blood to shoes. Visual thinning is controlled separately.
Sandbox_J93RunningBloodPools_PoolGoreMul: Multiplies blood deposited by the deterministic core and growth steps. 1.20 is the intended default, 1.00 is baseline, and 3.00 is the experimental maximum.
Sandbox_J93RunningBloodPools_RainFootpri: How much faster footprints wash away than dense pools. Default 3.0 means footprints require about one-third as much equivalent rain exposure.
Sandbox_J93RunningBloodPools_RainWashEna: When enabled, rain physically erodes persistent pools that are outside and exposed to weather. Indoor pools remain protected. Rain also reduces pool wetness rapidly.
Sandbox_J93RunningBloodPools_RainWashHou: Heavy Rain Hours to Wash Pool
Equivalent hours of full-strength rain required to completely wash an exposed pool. Lighter rain contributes proportionally more slowly. Default: 4 hours.
Sandbox_J93RunningBloodPools_RainWashMin: Normalized rain intensity below which washing is ignored. 0.10 allows light rain; increase this value if only stronger storms should clean blood.
Sandbox_J93RunningBloodPools_RainWashesF: When enabled, persistent bloody footprints on exposed outdoor squares can be washed away by rain.
Sandbox_J93RunningBloodPools_SplatsPerSt: Base number of deterministic native blood deposits in each growth step. Higher values create denser pools and more decals.
Sandbox_J93RunningBloodPools_SpreadDurat: How long a new pool takes to finish growing while loaded. Interrupted growth progress is persisted and resumes after reload or restart.
Sandbox_J93RunningBloodPools_VisualAging: When enabled, deterministic peripheral deposits disappear first as blood ages. Disable this to keep pools visually full while wetness can still decline.
Sandbox_J93RunningBloodPools_ZombieBlood: When enabled, zombies that walk through a wet tracked pool can carry blood away in persistent footprints just like survivors. Uses the same footprint count, spacing, drying, cleaning, and rain-wash rules.

Sandbox_JG_EnableDataDisks_tooltip: Allow corrupted, damaged, and encrypted data disks to spawn in the world and be recovered at computers.
Sandbox_JG_EnableDiskViewer_tooltip: Allow players to launch the Disk Viewer app to browse and manage disk contents.
Sandbox_JG_EnableGameDisks_tooltip: Allow arcade game floppy disks (Breakout, Pong, Snake, etc.) to spawn in loot.
Sandbox_JG_EnableHacking_tooltip: Enable PDA hacking of vanilla PCs and security doors.
Sandbox_JG_EnableNotesApp_tooltip: Allow players to launch the Notes app to compose and save text documents to a Document Disk.
Sandbox_JG_EnablePDA_tooltip: Enable the Personal Digital Assistant feature. Disabling hides PDA items and context menu options.
Sandbox_JG_EnablePersonalDisks_tooltip: Allow players to record their skills onto blank floppy disks and recover them after death.
Sandbox_JG_EnablePrinter_tooltip: Allow players to craft and use the Printer peripheral. Disabling this hides print recipes and prevents the Print app from launching.
Sandbox_JG_EnableRecordedDiskJournalPrin: When JeevesJournals is also installed, allow the owner of a Recorded Disk to print it as a bound JeevesJournals journal. Owner-only; does not transfer XP between players.
Sandbox_JG_EnableTrainingDisks_tooltip: Allow skill training floppy disks to spawn in loot.
Sandbox_JG_GameDiskWeight_tooltip: Loot spawn weight for arcade game floppy disks. Higher = more common. Default: 0.5
Sandbox_JG_HackAlarmChance_tooltip: Chance that a failed security door hack triggers a zombie-attracting alarm. Default: 50
Sandbox_JG_HackAlarmRadius_tooltip: Radius in tiles that a door hack alarm attracts zombies. Default: 30
Sandbox_JG_HappinessMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplier for happiness gained at score milestones while playing arcade games. 0 = disabled. Default: 1.0
Sandbox_JG_MaxDocsPerDocumentDisk_toolti: Maximum number of notes / scanned documents stored on a single Document Disk. Default: 8
Sandbox_JG_MaxMagsPerRecipeDisk_tooltip: Maximum number of recipe magazines stored on a single Recipe Disk. Default: 10
Sandbox_JG_MaxNotesDocSize_tooltip: Maximum size in bytes for a single Notes app document. Default: 8192 (~8 KB)
Sandbox_JG_MaxSkillLevel_tooltip: Training disks stop granting XP once the player reaches this skill level. 0 = no limit. Default: 5
Sandbox_JG_PDABatteryLife_tooltip: Real-time minutes a full PDA battery lasts while the UI is open in idle mode. Default: 120
Sandbox_JG_PDAHackMaxAttempts_tooltip: Maximum hack attempts allowed on each vanilla PC before it is exhausted. Shared across all players. Default: 3
Sandbox_JG_PDAHackResetDays_tooltip: In-game days before exhausted hack attempts reset on a vanilla PC. Default: 5
Sandbox_JG_PDAHackSuccessChance_tooltip: Base chance of a successful hack before skill and profession modifiers. Default: 25
Sandbox_JG_PDAReadTimePenalty_tooltip: Time multiplier when reading a Skill Library Disk on a PDA vs a PC. 1.0 = same speed, 2.0 = twice as long. Default: 1.5
Sandbox_JG_PDAZombieRadius_tooltip: Radius in tiles that PDA sounds attract nearby zombies. 0 = no attraction. Default: 15
Sandbox_JG_PaperReemSheets_tooltip: Number of paper sheets produced when opening a Ream of Paper. Default: 100
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskCombatSkills_tool: Override recovery percentage for melee combat skills. -1 = use global setting.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskCraftingSkills_to: Override recovery percentage for crafting skills. -1 = use global setting.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskDeductRadioTVXP_t: Subtract XP earned from radio/TV skill tapes before recording to personal disks.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskFarmingSkills_too: Override recovery percentage for farming and animal care skills. -1 = use global setting.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskFirearmSkills_too: Override recovery percentage for firearm skills (Aiming, Reloading). -1 = use global setting.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskOneTimeUse_toolti: If enabled, recovering from a personal data disk empties the skill XP banked in it. Recipes and map knowledge are kept. The next character recovers only what this one records before dying. Data disks and journals share one bank, so spending it retires both.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskPassiveSkills_too: Override recovery percentage for passive/physical skills. 0 = disabled by default.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverRecipes_to: Personal data disks also record and recover known recipes.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoveryPct_toolt: Percentage of recorded XP that can be recovered from personal data disks. 100 = full recovery.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskSurvivalistSkills: Override recovery percentage for survivalist skills (First Aid, Fishing, Foraging, Trapping, Tracking). -1 = use global setting.
Sandbox_JG_PrintPaperCostMult_tooltip: Multiplier for the number of sheets consumed per print. Minimum 1 sheet enforced after scaling. Default: 1.0
Sandbox_JG_PrintSpeedMult_tooltip: Multiplier for print timed-action duration. Higher values = faster prints. Default: 1.0
Sandbox_JG_PrinterAttractsZombies_toolti: Whether the printer's page-feed sound triggers nearby zombie attention. Same audibility profile as the Book Scanner. Default: on
Sandbox_JG_PrinterCraftSkillReq_tooltip: Electrical skill level required to craft the Printer. Default: 5
Sandbox_JG_ScanAwardsXP_tooltip: Whether scanning a book awards a small amount of Electrical XP to the scanning player.
Sandbox_JG_ScannerCraftSkillReq_tooltip: Electrical skill level required to craft the Scanner. Default: 4
Sandbox_JG_ScannerSpeedMult_tooltip: Multiplier for book scanning duration. Lower values = faster scans. Default: 1.0
Sandbox_JG_Stage2XPBonus_tooltip: Extra lesson XP percentage for Stage 2 (Color) PCs. Default: 10
Sandbox_JG_Stage3XPBonus_tooltip: Extra lesson XP percentage for Stage 3 (Enhanced) PCs. Default: 20
Sandbox_JG_TrainingDiskWeight_tooltip: Loot spawn weight for skill training floppy disks. Higher = more common. Default: 0.3
Sandbox_JG_XP_Advanced_tooltip: Total XP pool available from each Advanced (Tier III) training disk. Default: 300
Sandbox_JG_XP_Beginner_tooltip: Total XP pool available from each Beginner (Tier I) training disk. Default: 75
Sandbox_JG_XP_Intermediate_tooltip: Total XP pool available from each Intermediate (Tier II) training disk. Default: 150
Sandbox_JG_ZombieDataDiskDropMult_toolti: Multiplier for data disk drops from zombie corpses. 1.0 = default.
Sandbox_JH_Enabled_tooltip: Enable or disable horde night events.
Sandbox_JH_FragranceEnabled_tooltip: Allow Fragrance A la Jeeves bottles to spawn in the world. When disabled, existing bottles still function but no new ones will appear in loot.
Sandbox_JH_FragranceSpawnRate_tooltip: Relative spawn weight (1 = extremely rare, 100 = common). Default 10. Fragrance spawns at half the vanilla Cologne weight in each location, then scaled by this value.
Sandbox_JH_FrequencyMax_tooltip: Maximum number of days between horde events. The actual interval is randomly chosen between min and max.
Sandbox_JH_FrequencyMin_tooltip: Minimum number of days between horde events. The actual interval is randomly chosen between min and max.
Sandbox_JH_HordeImmunityEnabled_tooltip: If enabled, players can consume Zombie Stew to gain immunity from the current horde event. No zombies will target them and no lure pulses will emit around them.
Sandbox_JH_LureIntervalTicks_tooltip: How often (in game ticks) a lure pulse is emitted during the horde event.
Sandbox_JH_LureRadius_tooltip: Radius of the sound lure that draws zombies toward players.
Sandbox_JH_LureVolume_tooltip: Volume of the sound lure. Higher values attract zombies from further away.
Sandbox_JH_PreventSleep_tooltip: If enabled, players cannot sleep while the warning moodle is active. Prevents skipping the horde event by sleeping through it. Disable if you want players to be able to sleep through events at their own risk.
Sandbox_JH_RottenFleshChance_tooltip: Percentage chance (0-100) that a zombie drops Rotten Flesh when killed. Default 5 means 5%% of zombie kills yield the item.
Sandbox_JH_SafeRadius_tooltip: Radius (in tiles) around each player that is checked to be clear before spawning.
Sandbox_JH_SpawnDistanceMax_tooltip: Maximum distance (in tiles) from the player where zombies can spawn.
Sandbox_JH_SpawnDistanceMin_tooltip: Minimum distance (in tiles) from the player where zombies can spawn.
Sandbox_JH_StartDay_tooltip: The first in-game day horde events can begin.
Sandbox_JH_SurvivorMultiplierMax_tooltip: Maximum zombie multiplier a player can earn from surviving hordes. Each survival adds +0.1x. Default 15.0 means up to 16x zombies at max.
Sandbox_JH_WarnPlayers_tooltip: If enabled, players receive a warning message and moodle before the horde arrives.
Sandbox_JH_ZombieCountMax_tooltip: Maximum zombies per player regardless of increment stacking.
Sandbox_JH_ZombieCount_tooltip: Base number of zombies spawned per online player during a horde event.
Sandbox_JH_ZombieIncrement_tooltip: Additional zombies added to the count after each horde event.
Sandbox_JI_Auto_10Min_tooltip: Sound played 10 minutes before an auto-restart.
Sandbox_JI_Auto_10Sec_tooltip: Sound played 10 seconds before an auto-restart.
Sandbox_JI_Auto_1Min_tooltip: Sound played 1 minute before an auto-restart.
Sandbox_JI_Auto_5Min_tooltip: Sound played 5 minutes before an auto-restart.
Sandbox_JI_Mod_10Min_tooltip: Sound played 10 minutes before a mod update restart.
Sandbox_JI_Mod_10Sec_tooltip: Sound played 10 seconds before a mod update restart.
Sandbox_JI_Mod_1Min_tooltip: Sound played 1 minute before a mod update restart.
Sandbox_JI_Mod_5Min_tooltip: Sound played 5 minutes before a mod update restart.
Sandbox_JSSevereInfection_BandageMulti_t: Multiplies the time spent in peak hours and recovery when an infected wound does not have a clean bandage.\nAdds to peak hours instead of onset when without a clean bandage during onset, as a percent of normal peak hours.
Sandbox_JSSevereInfection_BiteSeverity_t: Further multiplies fatigue, thirst, hunger, and weight loss rates when suffering a bite wound.\nThis is multiplicative with other severity multipliers.
Sandbox_JSSevereInfection_BitesLethal_to: Sets whether bites remain lethal, killing the player during peak infection.
Sandbox_JSSevereInfection_CalorieRate_to: Adds a constant calorie burn per minute.\nThis value is further modified by severity and reduced by percent infected.
Sandbox_JSSevereInfection_CriticalInfHea: The minimum health the player will be reduced to during critical infection.
Sandbox_JSSevereInfection_CriticalInfPer: Determines the percent of peak non-lethal infection considered critical.\nAt critical infection, a player loses health until at the critical infection minimum health value.
Sandbox_JSSevereInfection_FatigueRate_to:
The rate at which fatigue increases while infected.
Vanilla fatigue rates also apply and are not affected by this value.
This rate is reduced by percent infected, and multiplied by severity.
This is an hourly rate, but is updated per minute.
Sandbox_JSSevereInfection_HungerRate_too:
The rate at which hunger increases while infected.
Vanilla hunger rates also apply and are not affected by this value.
This rate is reduced by percent infected, and multiplied by severity.
This is an hourly rate, but is updated per minute.
Sandbox_JSSevereInfection_InfTimeRandom_: Determines what percent faster or slower an infection can progress, affecting onset, peak, and recovery speeds.
Sandbox_JSSevereInfection_InfectionMulti:
Increases severity over time while an infected wound is unclean,
or, in other words, has a wound infection (not a zombie infection).
This value represents a percent increase in fatigue, thirst, hunger,
and weight loss rates per hour while an infected wound is "unclean."
Sandbox_JSSevereInfection_MaxWakeFatigue: Sets a maximum fatigue at which an infected player can be woken from critical hunger or thirst.\nBy default, a player will not wake while dying of thirst or hunger.
Sandbox_JSSevereInfection_OnsetHours_too: The number of hours from infection start until peak infection.
Sandbox_JSSevereInfection_PeakHours_tool: The number of hours spent at peak non-lethal infection.
Sandbox_JSSevereInfection_RecoveryHours_: The number of hours needed to recover from peak infection to fully cured.
Sandbox_JSSevereInfection_SeverityRandom: Determines what percent more severe or mild an infection can be, affecting fatigue, thirst, hunger, and weight loss rates during infection.
Sandbox_JSSevereInfection_ThirstRate_too:
The rate at which thirst increases while infected.
Vanilla thirst rates also apply and are not affected by this value.
This rate is reduced by percent infected, and multiplied by severity.
This is an hourly rate, but is updated per minute.
Sandbox_JSSevereInfection_WeightLossRate: If applying hunger to calories, directly multiplies resulting weight loss depending on level of infection.
Sandbox_JSling_AccessoryLootMultiplier_t:
Multiplies all JSling wearable gear loot chances.
0 = Disabled.
1 = Default.
Higher values make gear more common.
Sandbox_JSling_EnableAccessoryLoot_toolt: Controls whether JSling wearable gear can spawn naturally in world containers.
Sandbox_JSling_EnableSlingLoot_tooltip: Controls whether rifle slings can spawn naturally in world containers.
Sandbox_JSling_EnableZombieSlings_toolti: Controls whether certain police and military zombies can naturally spawn wearing slings.
Sandbox_JSling_MilitaryZombieFirearmChan: Chance that an eligible military zombie with a sling also spawns with a firearm already slung.
Sandbox_JSling_MilitaryZombieSlingChance: Chance that eligible military-themed zombies spawn wearing a sling.
Sandbox_JSling_PoliceZombieSlingChance_t: Chance that eligible police-themed zombies spawn wearing a sling.
Sandbox_JSling_SlingLootMultiplier_toolt:
Multiplies all rifle sling loot chances.
0 = Disabled.
1 = Default.
Higher values make slings more common.

Sandbox_KnoxAcoustics_KnoxVoip_tooltip: Whether voice runs through Knox's own path - distance, walls and the room you are standing in - or the vanilla codec. This decides how far a voice carries, so on a roleplay server it is worth everybody being on the same answer. Player's choice by default.
Sandbox_KnoxAcoustics_RadioSim_tooltip: Whether a transmission degrades with distance and structure, or arrives clean. Two players on different answers hear different things from the same radio, so a server that cares about that should decide it here. Player's choice by default.
Sandbox_KnoxAcoustics_RangeNormal_toolti: How far ordinary speech reaches zombies. Ten tiles is across a room and a little beyond. Strict physics would put this near 2 when a shout is 30, which made talking effectively silent, so this is a gameplay number and it is yours to set.
Sandbox_KnoxAcoustics_RangeShout_tooltip: How far a shout reaches zombies. Thirty tiles is the figure this mod has always quoted. Raise it if you want shouting to be genuinely reckless.
Sandbox_KnoxAcoustics_RangeWhisper_toolt: How far a whisper reaches zombies when voices attract them. The default keeps it at your feet, which is what makes whispering worth doing.
Sandbox_KnoxAcoustics_StationAdminOnly_t: Multiplayer only. Off by default, because on most servers holding the relay station is the permission: it is a place on the map, you had to walk there, and it can be taken from you. Turn this on to make broadcasting a staff function instead.
Sandbox_KnoxAcoustics_ZombieHearing_tool: Talking becomes dangerous in proportion to how loudly you talk. A whisper stays at your feet, a shout carries about thirty tiles, and walls reduce both. This is a difficulty setting, not an audio one: it adds a noise source the base game does not have. Off by default. In multiplayer every player needs the mod for this to be consistent.

Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesMain_EnableExclusi: Master switch for every exclusion zone. Disabling it suspends all zone rules.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesMain_EnableNPCs_to: Allows Knox Chronicles NPCs to spawn in the world.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesMain_EnableNamepla: Shows or hides name labels above visible NPCs.

Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesMain_ExclusionClea: Periodically removes blood stains from active zones.

Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesMain_ExclusionLigh: Keeps zone lights on even when electrical power is unavailable.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesMain_ExclusionRemo: JSON respects each zone value; Yes or No force the behavior in every zone.
