Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesMain_MaxWaypoints_: Maximum number of private waypoints each player may keep in the survivor logbook.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesMain_NpcNameplates: Maximum distance, in tiles, at which NPC names are shown.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesQuests_MaxActiveKi: Maximum number of repeatable kill missions that each player may keep active at the same time.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesQuests_MaxRepeatab: Maximum number of repeatable missions offered by each NPC when its list refreshes.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesQuests_MinRepeatab: Minimum number of repeatable missions offered by each NPC when its list refreshes.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesQuests_OfferRefres: World hours that must pass before generating a new list of repeatable offers.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesQuests_RewardMulti: Multiplies the total value of repeatable rewards. It adjusts cash, the item budget, and reputation calculated from the result.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_BulkPackag: Multiplies content value. 0.90 applies a 10%% discount.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_Commercial: Automatically configures prices. Manual fields are only used by Custom; packages, inventory, money, and restock are unaffected.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_DemandInte: 0 disables the effect, 1 is normal, and 2 doubles it. Custom model only.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_EconomyIte: Maximum random item change; it must be equal to or above the minimum.
Minimum random change to each item during an economy update.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_EconomyMon: Maximum random monetary change; it must be equal to or above the minimum.
Minimum random monetary change during an economy update.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_EnableDema: Allows item and category demand to modify prices. Custom model only.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_EnableEcon: Allows periodic inventory and money changes between full restocks.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_EnableMerc: Applies category modifiers specific to each trader. Custom model only.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_EnableRepu: Allows effective reputation to modify prices. Only used by the Custom model.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_EnableRest: Enables full restock and economy simulation for all traders.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_EnableStoc: Allows scarcity to raise and abundance to lower prices. Custom model only.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_FullRestoc: World hours between full restocks. 168 hours equals seven days.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_MarketPric: Multiplies every base price before reputation. Only used by the Custom model.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_MaxReputat: Multiplier for prices paid by the player at maximum reputation. Custom model only.
Multiplier for money received at maximum reputation. Custom model only.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_MerchantIt: Multiplies how many different item types are generated for each trader.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_MerchantMo: Multiplies initial money and monetary limits for all traders.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_MinReputat: Multiplier for prices paid by the player at minimum reputation. Custom model only.
Multiplier for money received at minimum reputation. Custom model only.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_NestedPack: Multiplies boxes or packages contained inside another package.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_PlayerBuyP: Multiplies the final purchase price. Only used by the Custom model.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_PlayerSell: Multiplies money received when selling. Only used by the Custom model.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_StockPrice: 0 disables the effect, 1 is normal, and 2 doubles it. Custom model only.
Sandbox_KnoxChroniclesTraders_StockQuant: Multiplies initial and maximum units of each item.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_AshtrayCapacity: Scales how many butts each ashtray holds (base values of 8-14 scale by this, minimum 1).
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_AshtrayLootMult: Scales KCS ashtrays in containers and surface scenes. 0 stops natural ashtray generation without disabling ashtrays already owned or crafted.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_AshtrayPrefillC: Chance that an ashtray found as loot already holds somebody else's butts, one or two brands per ashtray. Bars, diners and break rooms fill fuller than bedrooms. Emptying one gives you those butts, so this feeds butt scavenging: 0 keeps every ashtray factory-fresh.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_AshtrayPrefillM: Most butts in a found ashtray
Upper bound on how many butts a looted ashtray can already hold. The room still decides whether it fills toward this or stays near empty.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_AshtrayVisualFi: Changes a placed ashtray's model at a few, half-full and full. Off keeps one clean model for lower visual complexity; capacity and stored branded butts still work exactly the same.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_AutoCleanButts_: Registers every KCS cigarette butt with the game's own World Item Removal List, so butts dropped where you smoked expire on your Hours For World Item Removal setting (24 by default). Bar and diner table dressing, the world-ember scene and anything you deliberately drop are exempt: the engine flags those per item. Meant for long-running servers; operators no longer need to paste item ids by hand.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_BrandEffectDura: Globally scales how long brand effects last.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_BrandEffectStre: Scales both immediate relief and the temporary slowing of stat deterioration. 0 disables brand effects completely; 1 is normal; 2 is stronger. At nonzero settings, authored costs and after-effects are unchanged.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_BrandEffectsEna: Gives each cigarette brand a mild, temporary character effect after smoking, such as easing pain, sharpening wakefulness, or slowing the worsening of fatigue and stress for a few hours. No permanent character values are changed; assorted cigarettes have no brand effect.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_BrandLoyaltyBon: Scales the loyalty bonuses. 0 keeps recording your smoking history without granting bonuses; 1 is the intended default; 2 doubles them.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_BrandLoyaltyEna: Repeatedly finishing cigarettes of the same brand gradually strengthens that brand for this character. Bonuses only ever add on top of the unchanged base effects; switching brands is never penalised.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_BrandLoyaltyPac: Scales how many smokes each loyalty tier requires. Below 1 ranks up faster, above 1 slower. At 0.5, the top commercial tier needs 100 smokes instead of 200.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_BulkPackagingMu: Scales natural spawns of full cartons and shipping cases in retail storage and scenes.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_ButtScavengingC: How many extinguished butts one scavenged cigarette costs.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_ButtScavengingE: Allows rolling one unbranded cigarette out of several extinguished cigarette butts and a rolling paper. Smoking it causes slight unhappiness and queasiness on top of its normal effects.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_ButtWorldDrop_o: Never, and no butt at all
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_ButtWorldDrop_t: Where a finished cigarette leaves its butt. Outdoors is where litter accumulates without limit on a long-running world. Never still gives you the butt - it goes into your inventory instead - so butt scavenging keeps working. The fourth setting deletes the butt outright, which also removes butt scavenging as a source of tobacco.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_EffectIndicator: Adds the active brand effect to the game's status-icon column. Hover it to see the brand, effect and remaining time; it disappears when the effect ends.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_EffectTooltipMo: How much hard data cigarette tooltips reveal. Subtle keeps flavour text only; Earned unlocks a brand's numbers once you have smoked it; Full always shows everything.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_FireDisplayLoot: Scales natural spawns of empty matchbook cases and Zeddo display racks. 0 removes the furniture finds without disabling the collections or their crafting recipes.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_FireEcosystemEn: Master switch for the fire line: Zeddo lighters, novelty lighters, new matches, lighter fluid, new ashtrays and the veteran's unique drop. Off = none of it spawns; anything already found stays.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_FireSourceMulti: Scales natural spawns of ordinary KCS matches, pocket, disposable and novelty lighters, the kitchen matchbox, stormproof matches and the permanent match. Set to 0 to remove only those ordinary ignition sources from loot. Zeddos, collectible matchbooks, fuel tins, ashtrays and display furniture have separate controls.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_FlavorTextEnabl: Shows each item family's line of flavour text on the KCS hover card. Disable for a data-only card.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_FollowGlobalAbu: Only meaningful while KCS-managed spawn rates are on. When global loot is set above normal (e.g. Abundant), tobacco goods in containers - brand packs, cartons, cases, cigars, loose tobacco, matches and lighters - scale up along with it (warehouses stock by the carton, after all). Mementos and special items do not, and the zombie smoker ratio is untouched (that is demographics, not loot). Below-normal global settings still cannot starve KCS. On by default, so players who crank the whole world up will not find KCS ignoring the party.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_ForagingTobacco: Scales extinguished butts (and rare packs or matches) found via search mode in town areas. 0 disables them.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_GlitchEffectStr: Scales that thing's gameplay benefits. 0 preserves spawning, collecting and knowledge records but disables its cure, full heal and empty-pack passive. Above 0, the cure and full heal remain binary while the empty-pack passive scales with this value.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_GlitchPackEnabl: Master switch for the one-per-save final easter egg. Turning it off stops future spawns; one already found is never taken back.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_GlitchPackOdds_: Scales the roll for the once-per-save something. 1.0 is the designed rarity; higher finds you sooner, lower makes it a longer wait. 0 disables future rolls. What it is, you will know when you see it.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_GuaranteeZombie: When a zombie receives a mod cigarette pack from the smoker-pocket check, add one Knox Pocket Lighter to the same inventory. This never changes or pairs vanilla cigarettes and fire sources.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_HiddenCigarette: At the default of 0, hidden craft-only cigarettes never spawn as loot, as designed. Raising this adds them to a few rare containers and knowingly short-circuits the manuscript hunt.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_HiddenCraftYiel: Scales the 2/3/4-cigarette skill yield of the five manuscript recipes. 0.5 makes them yield 1/2/2; 1 is the authored curve; 3 allows up to 12 cigarettes per craft.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_IllnessCoughFre: How often a character with a cold sneezes or coughs. This is vanilla behaviour and a genuine survival signal - it tells you that you are ill, and the noise attracts zombies. 100 = unchanged, 0 = never. Change it only if you know you want the game quieter and easier.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_KeepsakeEffectS: Scales the small per-minute easing of boredom and unhappiness from the carried empty pack. 0 removes the benefit, 1 is the designed value and 3 triples it. Does not affect Last Light loot or its smoking effect.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_KeepsakeEffects: Controls the passive comfort granted while carrying the empty Last Light pack. Off keeps the empty pack as a collectible but removes its stat effect.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_LastLightMultip: Scales the extremely rare Last Light pack. 0 removes it from natural loot entirely.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_LedgerEnabled_t: Enables the KCS panel, its item-menu entry and collection records display. Off hides every way to open it; smoking, discoveries and saved progress continue normally.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_LighterFluidLoo: Scales natural spawns of KCS lighter-fluid tins only. 0 removes the tins from loot while refillable lighters and refining recipes remain available.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_LighterFluidRef: The fraction of a can filled by a refining recipe. 1.0 is the designed yield; 0.25 produces a quarter can. Petrol input is unchanged, so lower settings make refining more wasteful.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_MatchbookAuraMu: Scales the radius of the placed display case and bound-album aura. 0 turns the placed bonus off while keeping the collection. At 3 the longest reach is 30 tiles; larger radii inspect more nearby tiles once per game minute.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_MatchbookCollec: Collect printed matchbooks from local businesses in their own scenes; a full set binds into an album.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_MatchbookEffect: Scales the carried album's capacity, endurance and fatigue benefits and the placed shrine's mood and rest effects. 0 keeps every matchbook, recipe, album and collection record but removes all numerical benefits. 1 is the designed value and 5 is five times as strong.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_MatchbookRarity: Scales natural spawns of the thirteen collectible matchbooks. Set to 0 to disable their natural generation.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_PackConsolidate: The right-click action that pours same-brand packs together and feeds loose cigarettes into whatever has room. Convenience only: it never creates tobacco. Off removes the menu entry.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_PackagingWeight: How much of the bulk packaging weight saving applies. 1.0 is the shipped discount (a carton weighs less than ten packs); 0.0 charges the strict weight. Anything between interpolates.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_PartialPacksMod: Where partly smoked packs appear. Each pack in dead pockets, home drawers, glove boxes and table scenes rolls independently: most keep 2-19 cigarettes (skewed low), about one in ten is still unopened - and smokers who fell near a store are likelier to carry a fresh one, fuller or outright full. Store shelves, tobacco stock, cartons and cases always stay factory-sealed.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_RecipeClueMulti: Controls how often hidden-recipe fragments and the county inspection memo appear in appropriate containers. Multiplies the original literature/other-loot settings and time/roll modifiers. Set to 0 to disable natural recipe clues; finished hidden cigarettes and manuscripts never spawn naturally.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_ReplaceVanillaF: Replace vanilla fire sources with Knox County ones

Default on. A vanilla disposable lighter, refillable lighter, box of matches, matchbox or can of lighter fluid that spawns in a container, vehicle or pocket is swapped for the Knox County equivalent: disposable lighters, a plain-finish Zeddo, Knox matches, the kitchen matchbox or a small can of Knox County lighter fluid. Fire sources KCS has no counterpart for - BBQ lighters, battery lighters, candles - are never touched, and the vanilla items stay craftable and usable.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_ReplaceVanillaT: Default on. New containers, vehicles, corpses, foraging finds, and vanilla tabletop stories use equivalent Knox County Smokes products instead of manufactured Base cigarettes, cigars, cartons, loose tobacco, and chew. Base item definitions remain as a compatibility shell for old saves and other mods. Farming tobacco, rolling papers, hand-rolled cigarettes, pipes, and all original tobacco crafting remain available.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_ResidentialLoot: [Inside containers] Adult bedrooms, dressers, desks, living-room side tables, kitchens and some bathrooms. Same math as retail: vanilla Other Loot x time x this multiplier; 1.0 follows the vanilla preset.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_RetailLootMulti: [Inside containers] Ordinary KCS tobacco and fire sources in shops, gas stations, bars, crates and glove boxes. Final chance = the game's own Other Loot setting x elapsed-time modifier x this multiplier. Leave at 1.0 to follow the vanilla preset exactly; 0 disables these drops.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_RitualKillThres: How many zombies must die within half an hour before the next cigarette counts as the after-the-fight one. Lower makes the ritual common; higher keeps it for the bad nights.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_ScavengedPenalt: Scales the unhappiness and queasiness added after finishing a scavenged cigarette. 1.0 is the default price, 0 removes it, up to 5x.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_SelfManagedLoot: When enabled, KCS spawn chances answer to the multipliers on this page: low global loot rarity cannot suppress KCS (a category explicitly set to Disabled is still respected), and whether high global settings raise it is decided by Follow Global Abundance below. Official presets set global rarity very low, which nearly erases cigarettes - hence enabled by default. Disable to have KCS follow the global loot settings entirely.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_SidebarButtonEn: The button that opens the smoking ledger. Off hides the button; the ledger is still reachable from the right-click menu on any KCS tobacco.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_SittingBonusEna: Sitting down while finishing a cigarette extends its brand effect by 10%%.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_SittingBonusPer: Extra effect bonus when smoking while seated. Default 10%%. The toggle above switches the mechanic off entirely; this slider sets how much it matters.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_SmokeCoughFrequ: How often the cough that lands the moment a cigarette is finished actually fires. The base game gives every cigarette two values: one in two for characters with the Smoker trait, and one in four to one in twelve for everybody else depending on the brand. Coughing makes noise, and noise draws zombies. 100 = unchanged, 50 = half as often, 0 = never. Does not affect illness or trait coughing.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_SmokeLightsEnab: The warm ember light on a lit cigarette and on smouldering butts. Pure atmosphere, and a light source updated every tick. Turn off on servers that would rather spend the frames elsewhere.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_SmokerCoughFreq: How often a HEALTHY character with the Smoker trait coughs. The base game runs this timer independently of illness, so a smoker coughs on a schedule even at full health, and every cough is world noise that draws zombies. 100 = unchanged, 50 = half as often, 0 = never. Does not touch coughing while ill.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_SmokerStartKitE: New characters with the Smoker trait spawn with a random brand pack in their pocket (partial-pack rules apply) plus matches or a plain lighter - what smoker leaves home without them? Granted once, new characters only. Never the Spiffo lighter.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_SmokingRitualsE: Smoking rituals (after the fight / morning / winter)
The cigarette after a hard fight hits twice as hard; the first of the morning clears the fog; a smoke in the cold takes the edge off it.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_SmokingRitualsS: Scales the payoff of the moment-based smokes: the after-the-fight cigarette, the first one of the morning, the one in the cold. 1.0 is as shipped, 0 leaves the rituals detected but worth nothing, 3.0 makes them the reason you smoke.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_SmolderingButtC: Chance that finishing a smoke without a usable ashtray leaves a smoldering butt. It cannot start a fire immediately: it smolders for one in-game hour and may be stomped or snuffed during that time. Default 6%%.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_SmolderingButtF: Chance that an untreated smoldering butt starts a small fire after one in-game hour. Each butt rolls once; a failed roll makes it go out. Default 8%%.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_SmolderingLifet: How long a dropped smoldering butt keeps burning before its single fire check.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_SpiffoCartonSte: Controls only the inconspicuous trait leased while carrying a Spiffo carton. This benefit is binary, so it has its own switch instead of a misleading strength slider. The three-piece infection mechanics and placed-case aura remain available.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_SpiffoCaseRadiu: Radius in tiles, on the same floor, around a placed Spiffo transport case. 0 disables only the placed-case infection suppression; cartons and the three-piece ritual still work. Large radii inspect more nearby tiles once per game minute, so the hard maximum is 20.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_SpiffoImmunityH: How long the three-piece Spiffo's Alibi immunity lasts. Achieving it again refreshes the timer, never stacks it.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_SpiffoMechanics: Master switch for the Spiffo three-piece infection mechanics, carton stealth and case aura. When off, the collectibles still spawn but do nothing special.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_SpiffoMementoMu: Multiplies Spiffo's Alibi cigarette, flip-top lighter, and extremely rare carton/case checks in restaurant containers, nearby corpses, and employee corpses. This stacks with the game's Memento Loot setting. Default is 1.0; set to 0 to disable these easter-egg drops.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_SurfaceSceneMul: [On surfaces, not in containers] One-shot smoking vignettes placed openly on tables, counters and floors when an unvisited building first streams in (packs, fire sources, ashtrays, cold butts). Independent from container loot; still multiplied by the vanilla loot settings. 1.0 follows the vanilla preset.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_TributeLootMult: Scales natural finds of Fable and Celestial packs in offices and classrooms. 0 removes only those natural finds; coauthoring the two packs and all items already found remain available.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_TrueSmokingEffe: When True Smoking is active, chooses when a KCS brand effect and any Spiffo combination are settled. Every puff is the intended enhanced default. This option has no effect without True Smoking.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_WishboneCaseRad: Radius in tiles, on the same floor, around a placed Wishbone transport case. 0 disables only the placed-case aura; carried packs and cartons still work. Large radii inspect more nearby tiles once per game minute, so the hard maximum is 20.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_WishboneChanceP: Chance for each partial pack to hide a lucky cigarette. Default 10.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_WishboneEffectS: Scales the per-minute calming effect from carrying Wishbone packs or cartons and from a placed case. 0 removes only the passive benefit; lucky-cigarette finds and smoking effects remain. 1 is the designed value and 5 is five times as strong.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_WishboneEnabled: Partial packs may hide one flipped lucky cigarette with doubled effects.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_WorldEmberDensi: Scales how often an abandoned room holds an ashtray and one cosmetic ember. It can glow but can never start a fire. Each scene leaves two permanent objects, so lower this on a long-running server. 0 disables the scene.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_WorldEmbersEnab: Very rarely, an abandoned room still holds an ashtray and a cigarette called Still Warm - somebody just left. Its ember and tiny glow are cosmetic: naturally generated scenery can never start a fire.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_ZeddoPetrolEnab: Allows pure petrol or petrol/lighter-fluid blends to be poured directly into a Zeddo. Off = only pure KCS lighter fluid is accepted. Petrol already inside a lighter remains and still causes fumes. Enforced by the server in multiplayer.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_ZeddoPetrolPena: How many in-game hours petrol fumes impair endurance recovery. Further exposure refreshes the duration but does not repeatedly stack immediate sickness and unhappiness while active.

Scales sickness, unhappiness and reduced endurance recovery caused by lighting a cigarette with petrol. 0 disables the penalty, 1 is the designed value and 3 is triple strength. Blends are also scaled by their petrol ratio.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_ZeddoRarityMult: Scales natural spawns of Zeddo lighters, including collectible finishes and the Veteran's Zeddo. Set to 0 to disable them; 1.0 keeps the designed rarity.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_ZeddoRefuelTime: Scales the time required to refuel a Zeddo from a fluid container. 1 is the designed time, 0.1 is faster and 5 is slower. Instant debug actions are unaffected.
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_ZombieSmokerFem: Adjusts the female zombie smoker chance relative to baseline (1.0 = about 27%%, Kentucky women in 1993).
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_ZombieSmokerMal: Adjusts the male zombie smoker chance relative to baseline (1.0 = about 33%%, Kentucky men in 1993).
Sandbox_KnoxCountySmokes_ZombieSmokerMul: Scales this mod's once-per-zombie smoker pocket check. At 1.0, about 33%% of male and 27%% of female zombies carry cigarettes - the real 1993 smoking rates of Kentucky, the heaviest-smoking state in the nation. Combined with partial packs, total cigarettes from corpses stay near the old rate but spread far more believably. 0 disables.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_aimingmaxrelief_t: Maximum percentage reduction reached at Aiming level 10. Each Aiming level grants one tenth of this benefit.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_aimingskillrelief: Higher Aiming levels reduce the arm strain and soreness caused by firearm recoil.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_bleedingseverity_: Controls the additional bleeding duration applied when a fresh wound starts bleeding.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_bloodtraildensity: Controls how closely blood marks are spaced along a moving character's path.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_bloodtrailinterva: Base delay in seconds between blood drops. Severe bleeding automatically shortens this delay.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_bloodtrails_toolt: Open, unbandaged wounds leave blood drops while standing and a continuous trail while moving.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_bloodvisuals_tool: Adds blood gradually to the body area that is actually bleeding.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_cleancasingsonres: Removes Knox Immersivity shell casings left by earlier sessions when their squares load after a world or server restart. Casings fired during the current session remain.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_coldbreath_toolti: Characters produce subtle breath vapor at zero degrees Celsius or below.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_corpsebleeding_to: Fresh human and zombie corpses gradually form a small blood pool for a short time.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_enabled_tooltip: Master switch for every Knox Immersivity system.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_groundbatterydrai: Multiplier for battery consumption while a light is active on the ground.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_groundlights: Lit Flashlights Work on the Ground
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_groundlights_tool: Dropped or placed active light items keep illuminating their surroundings.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_gunheat_tooltip: Rapid fire builds heat. Extreme heat can cause minor condition wear.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_gunsmoke_tooltip: Adds drifting muzzle smoke scaled to weapon power and suppression.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_indoorhearing_too: Unsuppressed indoor shots build panic, stress and temporary head pain.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_integrateantarcti: Uses Antarctica temperatures to intensify cold stiffness and slow recovery.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_integrateknoxboos: Automatically enables the reduced visual and scanning profile when KnoxBoost is active.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_lightscanradius_t: Maximum number of tiles checked around each player.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_maxgroundlights_t: Maximum number of nearby dropped lights rendered on each client.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_muzzleflash_toolt: Adds a very brief warm light when a firearm is discharged.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_painvoices_toolti: Characters react vocally when firearm strain becomes painful. Nearby players can hear it.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_protectzombietire: Prevents tire condition loss during direct contact with zombies and corpses. Normal driving and accident wear remains active.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_quickreload_toolt: Adds Quick Reload to the native hold-R firearm wheel. It inserts a random loaded compatible magazine and drops the current magazine when one is already engaged.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_realisticbleeding: Open wounds bleed longer while bandages and medical treatment keep their native behavior.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_recoil_tooltip: Repeated shots accumulate realistic upper-arm and shoulder strain.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_recoilseverity_to: Controls how quickly firearm strain and soreness accumulate.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_recoveryskillbonu: Maximum recovery-speed bonus reached by a character with level 10 Strength and Fitness.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_rifleslings_toolt: Enables the Sling, its loot distribution and native hotbar attachment slots.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_shellcasings_tool: Firearms eject temporary visual casings sized and selected from their declared ammunition caliber.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_skillrecovery_too: Strength and Fitness slightly accelerate recovery from firearm-related arm strain and soreness.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_smallserver_toolt: Reduces light scan distance, particle limits and secondary processing.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_vehicleclosedchan: Base percentage chance before speed, armor, window condition, Aiming and distance are applied through a closed window.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_vehiclehearingsev: Controls the strength and duration of auditory shock from firing inside a closed vehicle.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_vehicleheating_to: A running vehicle heater warms occupants and reduces Antarctica exposure. Open windows make it much less effective.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_vehicleheatstreng: Controls how quickly a heated cabin restores body warmth and reduces cold exposure.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_vehicleinteriorhe: Unsuppressed shots inside a closed vehicle cause temporary ringing, muffled hearing, stress and head pain.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_vehicleoccupanthi: Adds a server-authoritative hit check for vehicle occupants. Target speed, window condition, installed vehicle armor, shooter Aiming and distance affect every shot.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_vehicleopenchance: Open or Missing Window Hit Chance
Base percentage chance before speed, armor, Aiming and distance are applied when the side window is open, broken or missing.
Sandbox_KnoxImersivity_weatherhandling_t: Cold air, wetness and existing injuries increase shooting strain.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ActorUpdatesPerTic: Maximum survivors considered by the staggered scheduler each frame. Two is recommended for servers and large saves.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_BaseMarkerRadius_t: Visual radius in tiles for the Home Base border. This is not a safehouse claim, just a Knox Survivors command-area outline.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_BaseUpkeepHours_to: How often bases consume a small amount of food, water, and high-tier repair materials. Shorter values make settlements harder to maintain.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_CombatEngageRadius: Distance at which survivors consider nearby zombies for defend/aggressive behavior. Lower values reduce CPU and reckless chasing.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_DeprecatedCompatib: Kept only so older saves do not log unknown SandboxOption errors. This option no longer enables debug or testing features.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_DormantActorDistan: Distance from the player where non-following survivor actors can be unloaded back into lightweight world simulation.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableAutoBaseUpgr: Lets independent survivor camps spend gathered supplies to improve from wood shelter to reinforced and metal fortifications.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableBaseMarkers_: Shows a square-tile border around your active Home Base plus filled square-tile work area highlights. Client-side visual only; safe to disable on servers.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableDebugLogging: Writes throttled Knox AI, movement, action, animation, and world-state diagnostics. Leave off during normal play.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableDormantActor: Removes far-off survivor actor shells from active simulation while keeping their persistent profile alive. This is a key performance feature for long saves.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableEncounters_t: Creates persistent neutral, friendly, and territorial survivors who live in the world, scavenge, form groups, and establish homes.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableFactionMerge: Small friendly AI factions may combine into one camp when relations are high, avoiding too many tiny groups.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableFactionTrade: Friendly AI survivor factions can trade spare supplies instead of fighting, helping the world feel more human.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableFactionWars_: Allows nearby independent survivor factions to develop rivalries and raid one another. Trading and peaceful mergers remain enabled by the core living-world simulation.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableIdentityTags: Shows occasional lightweight Ally/Friendly/Wary/Territorial tags over nearby survivors so they do not feel like mystery zombies.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableOffscreenJob: Simulates settlement jobs once per in-game hour without spawning or pathfinding distant actors.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnablePrototypeCom: Allows survivors to fight nearby zombies, protect companions, become injured or exhausted, retreat when overwhelmed, and die.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableSafeZombieSu: Lets nearby zombies notice and pressure survivor shells using short safe movement checks without direct survivor-as-zombie target forcing.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableSurvivorBark: Allows rare low-spam survivor status lines about needs, stress, danger, and orders.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableZombiePursui: When enabled, vanilla zombies visually pursue and attack survivor NPCs. Verified working with zombie-shell actors in B42.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EncounterChance_to: Chance per ten in-game minutes to create an encounter while population is below its cap. Five keeps survivors uncommon but discoverable.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EncounterCooldownH: Minimum in-game hours between natural encounter spawns. The default prevents population bursts while keeping the world active.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EncounterMaxDistan: Maximum spawn distance from the player inside loaded world space.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EncounterMinDistan: Minimum spawn distance from the player. Higher values make survivors feel discovered naturally instead of popping in nearby.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FactionConflictRad: Distance between AI camps where factions can notice each other and become tense or hostile.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FactionMergeChance: Chance that two friendly nearby AI factions merge during a faction think cycle.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FactionThinkHours_: How often the coarse faction simulation checks resource pressure, nearby rivals, and raids.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FactionWarChance_t: Base chance for tense/rival factions to raid each other when they are close and low on supplies.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FollowDistance_too: Preferred spacing between recruited survivors and their owner. The default stays close without stacking everyone on one tile.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FriendlyEncounterC: Chance a new encounter begins open to conversation. Friendly survivors still require trust before recruitment.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_GroupBaseChance_to: Chance that a new survivor group claims a lightweight camp/home anchor with shared supplies and defense.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_GroupEncounterChan: Chance that a natural encounter contains a small group instead of one survivor.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_HostileEncounterCh: Chance a new encounter begins territorial. Hostile survivors may warn, pursue, fight, pressure a nearby Home Base, or steal shared supplies if its defense fails.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MaxBaseRadius_tool: Maximum command and work radius for player and survivor bases. Thirty-six supports large houses and landmarks without excessive simulation range.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MaxEncounterGroupS: Caps naturally encountered survivor groups. Three keeps houses and indoor navigation readable.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MaxIndependentSurv: Cap for non-recruited living survivors. Helps keep the world alive without runaway population or server strain.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MaxMergedFactionSi: Prevents AI faction merging from creating huge camps that would hurt performance or balance.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MaxNearbySurvivors: Maximum survivor actors kept active around the player. Six is the recommended balance for smooth pathing and combat.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MaxPersistentSurvi: Maximum living survivor profiles retained across the world, including recruited and independent survivors.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MaxSquadSize_toolt: Maximum recruited survivors per player. Four is recommended for reliable indoor formation, combat readability, and performance.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MotionUpdatesPerTi: Drives active pathfinding continuously while keeping a strict per-frame budget. Six is recommended for smooth solo movement.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ProtectHomeBaseWin: Friendly companions reroute instead of smashing windows inside your Home Base, and wait outside when no safe entrance can be found. When enabled, scripted survivor pressure cannot damage those windows either.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_RecruitTrustRequir: Minimum trust required before an independent survivor accepts an invitation.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_RetreatHealthPerce: Survivors disengage and recover below this health percentage instead of fighting until death.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowBaseOverlays_t: Displays the blue Home Base border and zone markers on the map.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowDebugActions_t: Adds troubleshooting and controlled scenario tools to the world context menu. Leave off during normal play.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowDetectionText_: Shows threat detection and awareness text. Immersion note: leave off for a more natural experience.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowOverheadNames_: Displays survivor names above their heads during gameplay.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowStatusIcons_to: Displays companion condition, threat, and command icons above survivors.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowWorkZoneOverla: Highlights mapped work zones on the map.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SpawnWithWife_tool: Optional roleplay start that creates one spouse companion near the starting location. They use a normal companion slot and require supplies and care.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SurvivorDamageMult: Scales survivor damage. The default makes armed survivors useful without replacing the player.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SurvivorDurability: Scales resistance to zombie pressure. Survivors remain mortal at the default.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ThreatRefreshMilli: How often nearby zombie pressure is indexed for active survivors and their owner. Higher values use less CPU.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ZombieAggroRadius_: Maximum distance at which the shared threat pass can redirect a zombie toward a closer survivor.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ZombieAggroUpdates: Maximum zombie-to-survivor target updates during each shared threat refresh. Lower this on very crowded saves.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ZombieSurvivorAtte: Distance where zombies may pay attention to survivors when the survivor is closer than a real player target.
Sandbox_KnoxSyndicateCooldownHours_toolt: How many in-game hours must pass between calls per player. Range 1-168. Default 24.
Sandbox_KnoxSyndicateDurationSec_tooltip: How many real seconds the helicopter stays on station after a successful call. Range 30-300. Default 90.
Sandbox_KnoxSyndicateKillIntervalSec_too: How often (in seconds) the helicopter takes a shot at the closest zombie around the protected player. Lower values = faster horde clearance. Range 1-10. Default 2.
Sandbox_KnoxSyndicateNoiseRadius_tooltip: How loud the helicopter is to zombies (world sound radius pulsed each shot). Larger values mean more zombies will path toward you during the support run. Range 5-60. Default 30.
Sandbox_KnoxSyndicateRangeTiles_tooltip: Maximum tile distance from the protected player at which the helicopter will engage zombies. Range 4-20. Default 12.
Sandbox_LBO_DropLBC: Chance of finding a legendary backpack in common places
Sandbox_LBO_DropLBC_tooltip: <RGB:0.4,1,0.4>Common places are houses, garages, cars, zombies, etc. <RGB:0.4,0.7,1> Higher value = higher probability. <RGB:1,0.35,0.35> Value 0 disables this loot. <RGB:1,1,1>
Sandbox_LBO_DropLBR: Chance of finding a legendary backpack in dangerous places
Sandbox_LBO_DropLBR_tooltip: <RGB:0,1,0>Dangerous places are Police Stations, Military Zones, etc. <RGB:0.4,0.7,1> (Higher value higher probability. <RGB:1,0.35,0.35> Value 0 disables this loot.)<RGB:1,1,1>
Sandbox_LBO_DropLB_tooltip: <RGB:0,1,0>Chance of finding Legendary Backpack, higher value higher probability
Sandbox_LBO_DropMLB: Chance of finding Legendary Backpack Magazine
Sandbox_LBO_DropMLB_tooltip: <RGB:0,1,0>Chance of finding Legendary Backpack Magazine, higher value higher probability. <RGB:1,0.35,0.35> Value 0 disables this loot.<RGB:1,1,1>
Sandbox_LBO_StartWithLBGrey_tooltip: Start with a Legendary Backpack (Grey) in your inventory.
Sandbox_LCO_ChanceToFall_tooltip: <RGB:0,1,0>Probability that the cap will fall off your head. Lower value = less chance.
Sandbox_LCO_DropFLC_tooltip: <RGB:0,1,0>Chance of finding a Legendary Flashlight in the world, higher value = higher probability.

Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_BreakerWat: How much a generator can run at once. A better generator gets more: at 225 they range from 5400 to 8100 watts. A light is 20 watts, a television 300, a fridge 800, a stove 900. Lower this for a harder game, raise it for an easier one.

The game has no watts - it rates appliances in litres of fuel an hour and nothing else - so this mod reads one litre an hour as ten kilowatts and shows you the result. On that scale a light is 20 W, a radio 100, a television 300, a fridge or a freezer 800, a microwave or a stove or a washer 900, a fridge-freezer 1300, and the generator itself burns 200 W just idling. 3600 W is 30 amps at 120 volts, a domestic ring main: three microwaves and the generator come to 2900 W and hold, a fourth makes 3800 and trips. Set 2400 W for a 20 amp circuit, where two microwaves hold and a third trips. Beware the stacked washer/dryer - it is 9000 W a half, 18000 with both running, and will trip almost anything. This is a rating for the load, NOT for the fuel: turning Generator Fuel Consumption up makes the same appliances drink faster without drawing any more current, and the breaker deliberately does not move when you change it.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_Breaker_to: Put too much on a generator and its breaker trips, taking every generator on the same buildings with it. Start them all again, then right-click one and reset. To stop it tripping, add a generator or turn something off. Needs Generator Fuel Consumption above zero.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_ChargeFuel: Charge fuel for the extra rooms
On: the extra rooms cost fuel, so a big building burns more. Off: they are free. To change the fuel rate itself, use the game's own Generator Fuel Consumption.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_Debug_tool: Writes every power change to the log file. Only useful for tracking down a problem.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_Enabled_to: A generator powers the whole building it reaches, not just the tiles around it. Every floor, the roof and the basement. Turn this off for normal generators.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_ExtendByDe: On: plug a generator in and it powers the building straight away. Off: you right-click it and pick Wire up the building first. Either way you can change your mind on any generator.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_ExtendPlay: In singleplayer this changes nothing: the game itself treats a sealed, roofed player-built structure as a building, so generators have always powered them whole. A dedicated server does not do that, which is why a base that lights up in singleplayer stays dark on a server. On, the server works the same structures out for itself, using the game's own test - enclosed, and at least half roofed. Off by default because switching it on lights bases that were dark and starts charging their appliances to somebody's generator.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_ExteriorRe: How far power reaches past the walls, so a porch light or an outdoor freezer works. Set 0 for indoors only. Some tiles reach a little further than this, so treat it as a minimum.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_FuelFromPu: Lets you pipe a fuel station pump into a generator parked next to it, so it runs off the tanks below. Off: barrels only.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_FuelLineRe: How far, in tiles, a barrel can feed a generator BELOW it with no power involved at all, and at most four floors down. This is the only distance the fuel line has: everything else is bounded by the power itself, because a pump needs electricity and the generator being fed is what supplies it.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_FuelLine_t: Lets you pipe petrol to a generator with a pipe wrench. A barrel next to it feeds it directly. With LG Extended Plumbing, a generator can also draw from the whole base's petrol barrels. Off: nothing can be connected.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_ShareLoad_: On: two generators on one building split the fuel bill instead of both paying it in full. Off: each one pays in full.
Sandbox_LGExtendedPlumbing_Debug_tooltip: Writes every plumbing change to the log file. Only useful for tracking down a problem.
Sandbox_LGExtendedPlumbing_Enabled_toolt: A rain collector plumbed into a building feeds every plumbed fixture in it, not just the one right below. Turn this off for normal plumbing.
Sandbox_LGExtendedPlumbing_FedFixtures_t: Things that can be plumbed in to be FILLED by the supply instead of feeding it. Water dispensers by default. You still have to right-click one and plumb it with a pipe wrench. Use the object's script name, separated by semicolons. Clear the box to turn this off.
Sandbox_LGExtendedPlumbing_IncludeByDefa: New collectors join the shared supply

On, every rain collector feeds the whole building unless somebody right-clicks it and excludes it. Off, collectors are ignored until somebody right-clicks and includes them, which suits a server that wants plumbing to be a deliberate act. Either way the choice made on an individual barrel always wins.
Sandbox_LGExtendedPlumbing_Reach_tooltip: How far a fixture looks for barrels when it is not in a real building, like a base you built yourself. Inside a real building the whole building is used and this does nothing. 12 covers a good sized base.
Sandbox_LGExtendedPlumbing_WasherPatch_t: Fixes two base game bugs on servers: a washing machine you cannot plumb, and one that keeps running on your screen after it runs dry. Singleplayer does not need it.

Sandbox_LaserAndGunLightUseBattery_toolt: Use AA Batteries To Power Lasers And Firearm lights.
Sandbox_LastPushTrait_CooldownRandomness:
Applies randomness to the cooldown time.
For example, 0.5 randomness means the cooldown can be 50%% longer or shorter.

Note that this setting, unlike others, is updated after a change only when a new character is created or the ability is used.

Set 0 for no randomness
Sandbox_LastPushTrait_Cooldown_tooltip:
How many ingame minutes must pass before the ability could be used again.

One day is 1440 minutes.
One week is 10080 minutes.

Set 0 for no cooldown
Sandbox_LastPushTrait_DamageChance_toolt:
The chance to damage a zombie when pushing it.

For example, 0.15 means there is a 15%% chance for a zombie to be damaged.
Set 1 to always deal damage
Sandbox_LastPushTrait_DamageMax_tooltip: Maximum damage to deal to a zombie.\n\nMaximum health of a zombie is 2.0
Sandbox_LastPushTrait_DamageMin_tooltip: Minimum damage to deal to a zombie.\n\nMaximum health of a zombie is 2.0
Sandbox_LastPushTrait_EarnIt_tooltip: Add the trait when a specified strength level is achieved.
Sandbox_LastPushTrait_EnduranceCost_tool:
How much endurance to reduce when the ability is used.

<75 is Moderate Exertion
<50 is High Exertion
<25 is Excessive Exertion
<10 is Exhausted
Sandbox_LastPushTrait_EnduranceMin_toolt:
The minimum endurance required to use the ability.

<75 is Moderate Exertion
<50 is High Exertion
<25 is Excessive Exertion
<10 is Exhausted
Sandbox_LastPushTrait_FatigueAddUp_toolt:
How much fatigue (need to sleep) to add when the ability is used.

>60 is Drowsy
>70 is Tired
>80 is Very Tired
>90 is Ridiculously Tired
Sandbox_LastPushTrait_FatigueMax_tooltip:
The maximum level of tiredness up to which the ability could be used.

>60 is Drowsy
>70 is Tired
>80 is Very Tired
>90 is Ridiculously Tired
Sandbox_LastPushTrait_HitActivationDista:
Maximum distance to count zombies on for hit activation.

Note that this is separate from Drag Down activation, which happens when zombies surround and eat you alive.
Sandbox_LastPushTrait_HitActivationZombi:
How many zombies must be nearby to activate the ability when hit.

Note that this is separate from Drag Down activation, which happens when zombies surround and eat you alive.
Sandbox_LastPushTrait_HitActivation_tool:
Activate the ability when hit if the criteria are met.

Note that this is separate from Drag Down activation, which happens when zombies surround and eat you alive.
You don't really have to enable this if Drag Down is enabled (Vanilla Zombie Lore tab)
Sandbox_LastPushTrait_PushDistance_toolt:
How close a zombie must be to get affected.

Note that the character will still be staggered from a hit, meaning other zombies might get them again, neglecting the last push.
With the default setting of 2.5 you have just the time to start moving and might still be caught again.
Sandbox_LastPushTrait_SoundRadius_toolti: The radius of a sound which is emitted when the ability is used.\n\nSet 0 to disable
Sandbox_LastPushTrait_StrengthRequiremen: The level of strength required to earn the perk if it wasn't picked during character creation.
Sandbox_LastPushTrait_UseChanceReroll_to: If the chance check failed, the next attempt will be only after this amount of real seconds.
Sandbox_LastPushTrait_UseChance_tooltip:
The chance to use the ability, avoiding death.

For example, 0.15 means there is a 15%% chance to use the ability.

Set 1 to always use
Sandbox_LastPushTrait_UsesLimit_tooltip: How many times can the character use this ability.\n\nSet 0 for no limit
Sandbox_LastPushTrait_ZombiesLimit_toolt: How many zombies will be affected.\n\nSet 0 for no limit

Sandbox_Loot_Quality_System_RenameItems_: Adds the quality tier to item names for Rare and higher.
Sandbox_Loot_Quality_System_ShowTooltips: Shows quality tier, type and bonuses in item tooltips.
Sandbox_LootboundRPG_BonusFrequency_tool: Sets the chance that a newly processed eligible item receives any XP bonus. No XP Bonus remains the normal result, especially at lower settings. This does not change bonus strength or reroll previously processed items.
Sandbox_LootboundRPG_BonusQuality_toolti: Controls the strength of bonuses on newly processed items without changing how often bonuses appear. Higher settings produce stronger bonuses more frequently and gradually make the exceptionally rare +10%% tier more attainable. Previously processed items are never rerolled.
Sandbox_LootboundRPG_EnableMythicalDisco: Somewhere among the world's belly-button jewelry, an almost impossible discovery may be waiting. Survivors who inspect every piece might someday recognize it when they see it. Disable this option to keep that secret from appearing on newly processed items; discoveries already made remain unchanged.
Sandbox_LootboundRPG_IncludeProtectiveGe: When enabled, wearable items with inherent scratch or bite protection can receive and provide XP bonuses. Disabling this preserves any bonuses already stored on protected items and restores them unchanged if the option is enabled again. Tailoring patches added by a player do not change an item's classification.
Sandbox_LootboundRPG_IncludeTenPercentBo: Controls whether newly processed items can receive the exceptionally rare +10%% XP bonus. When disabled, that tier's probability is added to +5%%, preserving the selected overall bonus frequency. Previously processed items are unaffected.
Sandbox_LootboundRPG_IncludeWeapons_tool: When enabled, conventional melee weapons and firearms can receive and provide XP bonuses. Explosives, traps, throwables, bare hands, and ambiguous improvised objects are always excluded. Disabling this preserves any bonuses already stored on weapons and restores them unchanged if the option is enabled again.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_BatchFiveDiscou: Determines what percentage of money is taken off for a batch of 5 lootboxes. Rounds down.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_BatchTenDiscoun: Determines what percentage of money is taken off for a batch of 10 lootboxes. Rounds down.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_CardIncr_toolti: After a successful clean purchase, how much more likely it is for a card to use up durability when purchasing.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_CardUses_toolti: How many uses (how much durability) a card has before it's rendered useless.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_CreditCards_too: Preserves credit cards in the regular loot tables. Credit cards can be used for one free maximum bulk purchase.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_GeneralLoot_too: When enabled, ignores the category system usually used by the mod, so any lootbox can give any item.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_KillReward_tool: Determines how much money is earned from a kill. Ignored if cost is 0.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_RandomCatImprov: Uses an improved randomization system to make it so categories will less items are less likely to show up.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_RandomCat_toolt: When enabled, randomizes the category of the lootbox during conversion. Ignored if Generalized Lootboxes is enabled.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_RandomFluid_too: Determines if liquid containers have their contents randomized.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_RandomSpoil_too: Determines if food freshness is randomized.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_SprinterBonus_t: Determines how much additional cash is rewarded if a sprinter is killed. (Still applies even while all zombies are set to Sprinters)
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_UnlockCost_tool: Determines how much money it takes to unlock a lootbox. Set to 0 for free unlocks.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_UpdateTick_tool: Determines how many tiles update per tick. Higher numbers may lag or crash the game, however lower numbers will result in slower conversions.
Sandbox_LowConPartsFall: Low durability parts have the chance to drop off cars
Sandbox_LuaDigitalWatchUI_MinuteResoluti: Controls how often the minute display updates. 'Mod Default' uses the framework or mod author's preference (1-minute by default). '1 Minute' forces the display to update every in-game minute. '10 Minutes' matches the vanilla clock behavior.
Sandbox_LubricantRarity_tooltip: Adjust the rarity of Firearm Lubricant.
Sandbox_M250_DamageMultiplier_tooltip: Percentage of base damage. 100 = normal, 50 = half, 200 = double. Default: 100
Sandbox_M250_Durability_tooltip: Maximum weapon condition. Higher = lasts longer before breaking. Default: 35
Sandbox_M250_FireRate_tooltip: Full-auto cyclic rate (value / 100). Higher = faster. 90 = 0.9x. Default: 90
Sandbox_M250_JamChance_tooltip: Chance for the weapon to jam per shot (value / 10). 8 = 0.8, 0 = never jams. Default: 8
Sandbox_M250_LootAmmo_tooltip: Spawn weight for XM1186 ammo boxes and cartons. Higher = more likely to appear. Set to 0 to disable. Default: 3
Sandbox_M250_LootAttachment_tooltip: Spawn weight for the XM157 scope. Higher = more likely to appear. Set to 0 to disable. Default: 3
Sandbox_M250_LootMagazine_tooltip: Spawn weight for the M250 magazine. Higher = more likely to appear. Set to 0 to disable. Default: 3
Sandbox_M250_LootWeapon_tooltip: Spawn weight for the M250 weapon. Higher = more likely to appear. Set to 0 to disable. Default: 3
Sandbox_M250_MagazineSize_tooltip: Number of rounds the M250 magazine holds. Default: 100
Sandbox_M250_MagazineWeight_tooltip: Weight of the M250 magazine in tenths of kg (25 = 2.5 kg). Default: 25
Sandbox_M250_RecoilDelay_tooltip: Delay between shots caused by recoil (in ticks). Lower = less recoil. Default: 18
Sandbox_M250_ScrewdriverRequired_tooltip: Require a screwdriver to attach/detach the XM157 scope.
Sandbox_M250_SingleFireOnly_tooltip: Disables full-auto mode, forcing single-fire only.
Sandbox_M250_SoundRange_tooltip: How far zombies can hear the M250 when fired. Default: 50
Sandbox_M250_SpawnGunStore_tooltip: Allow M250 items to spawn in gun stores (rifle displays, ammo shelves, accessories).
Sandbox_M250_SpawnHunting_tooltip: Allow M250 items to spawn in hunting and outdoor stores.
Sandbox_M250_SpawnMilitary_tooltip: Allow M250 items to spawn in military locations (army barracks, army storage, surplus stores).
Sandbox_M250_SpawnPawnShop_tooltip: Allow M250 items to spawn in pawn shops.
Sandbox_M250_SpawnPolice_tooltip: Allow M250 items to spawn in police stations (gun storage, ammo storage).
Sandbox_M250_StartAmmo_tooltip: Number of XM1186 ammo boxes (20 rounds each) to start with. Default: 0
Sandbox_M250_StartMags_tooltip: Number of loaded M250 magazines to start with. Default: 0
Sandbox_M250_StartWithAttachment_tooltip: Start the game with an XM157 scope. Requires 'Start with M250' to be enabled.
Sandbox_M250_StartWithWeapon_tooltip: Start the game with an M250 Light Machine Gun in your inventory.
Sandbox_M250_WeaponWeight_tooltip: Weight of the M250 in tenths of kg (66 = 6.6 kg). Default: 66
Sandbox_MBSB_CobbleRewardMaxSeconds: Cobblestone Generator: Max Seconds Per Reward
Sandbox_MBSB_CobbleRewardMaxSeconds_tool: Maximum seconds of mining between cobblestone generator rewards.
Sandbox_MBSB_CobbleRewardMinSeconds: Cobblestone Generator: Min Seconds Per Reward
Sandbox_MBSB_CobbleRewardMinSeconds_tool: Minimum seconds of mining between cobblestone generator rewards.
Sandbox_MBSB_CropGrowthSpeed_tooltip: Multiplier on farm crop growth (Skyblock uses its own crop timing of 11-18 hours per stage; the vanilla Farming speed setting does not apply). 2.0 = crops grow twice as fast, 0.5 = half speed.
Sandbox_MBSB_DespawnDistance_tooltip: Zombies farther than this from every player slowly despawn (Minecraft's 128-block rule). On the Skyblock map 128 covers nearly everything, so this only matters if players cluster far away for a long time. 0 = never despawn.
Sandbox_MBSB_GrassRegrowDays_tooltip: In-game days before cut grass regrows.
Sandbox_MBSB_HostileCapPerPlayer_tooltip: Minecraft-style population scaling: the total zombie cap is this number times the online player count (never exceeding Max Zombies). 0 = no per-player scaling, use Max Zombies only.
Sandbox_MBSB_MaxZombieCount_tooltip: No new zombies spawn while this many are already in the world. 0 disables night spawning entirely.
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnAttemptsPerPlayer_tool: How many spawn attempts each player generates per spawn cycle. Each attempt rolls the spawn chance independently and targets its own random zone, so higher values mean faster AND more spread-out spawning.
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnChance_tooltip: Each spawn attempt only proceeds this percent of the time. Lower values mean fewer, less predictable spawn waves (and fewer performance hitches at nightfall). 100 = every attempt spawns, 0 = never.
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnCycleSeconds_tooltip: How often the spawner runs, in REAL-WORLD seconds (not in-game time). 30 = a spawn wave every 30 real seconds. Lower = more frequent waves. Minimum 5.
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnDriver_tooltip: What triggers zombie spawning. Time of Day: spawns only during the configured night hours (dark tiles only). Darkness (Minecraft): no clock at all — anywhere dark enough can spawn at any hour, including unlit interiors at noon. Light your base!
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnLightThreshold_tooltip: Zombies only spawn on tiles at or below this light level (0.0 = pitch black required, 1.0 = spawns even in full light). Checked per-tile and as a 4-tile-radius area average.
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnNightEndHour_tooltip: Time of Day driver only: the hour spawning stops (24h clock, default 6 = 6 AM).
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnNightStartHour_tooltip: Time of Day driver only: the hour spawning begins (24h clock, default 20 = 8 PM).
Sandbox_MBSB_SpecialZombieOneIn: Zombie Spawn: Special Zombie Rarity (1 in N)
Sandbox_MBSB_SpecialZombieOneIn_tooltip: Chance for a spawned zombie to be a rare military, survivor, looter or ghillie zombie instead of a civilian. 150 = roughly 1 in 150. Higher = rarer. Set 0 to disable them entirely.
Sandbox_MBSB_TreeGrowthSpeed_tooltip: Multiplier for tree growth. 2.0 = trees grow twice as fast, 0.5 = half speed.
Sandbox_MBSB_VoidGraceSeconds_tooltip: How long a living player can stand at void level before the void kills them. Fall-damage deaths resolve naturally first; this only applies to survivors. Staff (any access level above None) are always exempt. 0 = instant.
Sandbox_MBSB_ZombieMaxSpawnDistance_tool: Zombies never spawn farther than this many tiles from a player.
Sandbox_MBSB_ZombieMinSpawnDistance_tool: Zombies never spawn closer than this many tiles from a player on the same floor level. Spawns one level above use half this distance.
Sandbox_MBSB_ZoneZombieCap_tooltip: The world is divided into 16x16-tile zones; each zone holds at most this many zombies. Spawning skips full zones, so zombies spread out and torch-lit zones stay clear.
Sandbox_MGsMRE_LootRarity_tooltip: Controls how often MRE items appear in loot containers across the map.
Sandbox_MGsMRE_SpawnDeepSea_tooltip: Toggle aquatic packs: HP Ration, Deep Sea Abyss, Vent Brick, Chitin Capsule, High Seas, Benthic Bio.
Sandbox_MGsMRE_SpawnDeepSpace_tooltip: Toggle orbital packs: Orbital MRE, Hyper Pack, EVA Kit, Stasis Pak, Aurora Ration, Deep Void.
Sandbox_MGsMRE_SpawnElderScrolls_tooltip: Toggle crossover packs: Falkreath Pack, Windhelm Pack, Winterhold Arcane, Dark MRE.
Sandbox_MGsMRE_SpawnElderTarkov_tooltip: Toggle crossover packs: Falkreath Pack, Windhelm Pack, Winterhold Arcane, Dark MRE, USEC Pack, Scav Special, Spetsnaz.
Sandbox_MGsMRE_SpawnMGsMRE_tooltip: If unchecked, MRE items will completely stop spawning across the map. Recipes and items added via other means are not affected.
Sandbox_MGsMRE_SpawnMedicalMRE_tooltip: Toggle the Medical MRE spawning in medical and military containers independently of other MRE groups.
Sandbox_MGsMRE_SpawnMilitary_tooltip: Toggle Combat Ration, Olive MRE, Cold Weather, Jungle, Urban, Special Forces, Maritime, Hazard, Desert Recon, Mountain Sniper, Medical MRE, and related packs.
Sandbox_MGsMRE_SpawnMisc_tooltip: Toggle miscellaneous packs: Roman Perca, Japan Ninja, Vanilla Pack.
Sandbox_MGsMRE_SpawnNature_tooltip: Toggle wilderness-style rations: Sun-Cured, Pine Barren, Alpine Crest, River Delta, Deep Cave, Sub-Tundra, Dune Runner, Oasis Nomad, Salt Flat, Orchard Hive, Tide Pool.
Sandbox_MGsMRE_SpawnNeoNoir_tooltip: Toggle cyberpunk packs: Neon Glitch, Geometric Tray, Precinct Issue, Conduit Capsule, Corp Ration Unit, Grid Sector Pack, Express Transit, Solitaire Brick, Chiba Ration, Rain Check, Alley Ration, Delta Tech, Night Market, Sub-Level, Long Haul, Black Fixer, High Rise, RepliKit.
Sandbox_MGsMRE_SpawnPostApoc_tooltip: Toggle wasteland-style packs: Scav Pak, Rusted Block, Terminal Ration, Scrapper Box, Raider Ration, Kerosene Can, Ashlander Pack, Jury-Rigged Kit, Diamond City, Glowing Sea, Cultist Harvest, Sludge Pack.
Sandbox_MGsMRE_SpawnTarkov_tooltip: Toggle Tarkov packs separately from Elder Scrolls: USEC Pack, Scav Special, Spetsnaz, Menu Seven.
Sandbox_MGsMRE_SpawnVaultStasis_tooltip: Toggle vault/stasis packs: Cryo Pod, Fossil Pouch, Stasis Survival Pack, Spider Silk Pouch, Bio-Dome Pack, Anti-Static Foil, Hermetic Tile, Safe House Kit, Bunker Tech, Vault Sec.
Sandbox_MGsMRE_SpawnWaterStraw_tooltip: Toggle the Personal Water Filtration Straw spawning in medical and hospital containers independently of other items.

Sandbox_MHFirearms_AttachedArmyZombies: Allows spawn some weapons on Army Zombies

Sandbox_MHFirearms_StenGuns_Enable: Allows spawn Sten MK2 and Sten MK6
Sandbox_MNWBActionDuration_tooltip:
How long it takes to lift or set down the wheelbarrow.
Longer means cancelling it by accident is a real risk.
Sandbox_MNWBAllowCorpses_tooltip:
Lets bodies be loaded into the wheelbarrow.
Turn off if hauling corpses makes clearing a house too easy for your taste.
Sandbox_MNWBBlockRunning_tooltip:
Pushing a loaded wheelbarrow is a walk, not a jog.
Turn off to keep running available at the reduced speed.
Sandbox_MNWBCapacity_tooltip:
How much the wheelbarrow can hold, counted the way the game counts it: heavy cargo is repacked and takes a fifth of the room, so 38 is around 21 logs or 4 generators, while light loot takes its full weight.
38 is the game's own ceiling for a container standing on the ground, so this option only makes the wheelbarrow smaller, never bigger.
Load it while it sits on the ground; the game does not allow heavy items into a container you are holding.
Sandbox_MNWBEnableCrafting_tooltip: Enables the recipe to build a wheelbarrow from scratch.
Sandbox_MNWBEnableWorldSpawn_tooltip:
Wheelbarrows can be found lying around construction sites, warehouses and tool stores.
Turn off to make them craft-only.
Sandbox_MNWBHeavyReduction_tooltip:
How much weight is taken off heavy items, in percent.
Light items are never reduced, no matter this setting.
Sandbox_MNWBHeavyThreshold_tooltip:
Items at or above this weight count as heavy and get the weight reduction.
Anything lighter gets nothing at all; the wheelbarrow is deliberately useless for small loot.
Sandbox_MNWBLightCapacity_tooltip:
A separate, much lower ceiling for items BELOW the heavy threshold.
Heavy cargo is repacked and takes a fifth of the room; light loot is not, and gets no weight relief either. This caps how much of it you can bring along.
Set to 0 to remove the light limit entirely.
Sandbox_MNWBSpawnChance_tooltip:
Percent chance of a wheelbarrow spawning at an eligible spot.
Each spot is only ever rolled once.
Sandbox_MNWBSpillOnCancel_tooltip:
Cancelling the pick up or put down animation makes the wheelbarrow tip over, dumping its contents and itself on the ground.
Turn off for a forgiving game.
Sandbox_MRE.UnhappyChange_tooltip: If true, When preparing a Ration a Random UnhappyChange between Min and Max Will be applied, Remember - Values Make you happy and + Values Unhappy.
Sandbox_MSXBow_Retrieval_tooltip:
Determines the likelihood of being able to recover fired bolts.
With default settings, recovery chance scales with maintenance level.
Sandbox_MWPWeapons_CustomSpawnMultiplier: Only used when Weapon Spawn Rate is set to Custom. 1.0 = Normal tuning, 0 = no container spawns, 10 = 2.5x the Abundant preset. For reference: Extremely Rare 0.1, Rare 0.5, Common 2, Abundant 4.
Sandbox_MWPWeapons_SpawnRate_tooltip: How often MWP melee weapons spawn in containers. Normal = the pack's default tuning. Scales all weapons equally, so rare weapons stay rare relative to common ones. Stacks with the vanilla loot rarity settings. Custom uses the multiplier below.
Sandbox_MachineOilFindMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplies how often Machine Oil is found from loot and other sources.
Sandbox_Machinery_AccidentRiskMultiplier: Multiplies the final accident chance after skill scaling. Set to 0 to disable risk without disabling the injury system.
Sandbox_Machinery_ActionTimeMultiplier_t: Higher values make machine jobs take longer; lower values make them faster.
Sandbox_Machinery_EnableFuelConsumption_: Controls whether fluid-powered machines require and consume fuel for operations.
Sandbox_Machinery_EnableIndoorExhaust_to: Gas-powered machines expose their operator to dangerous fumes when operated inside an enclosed room. Repeated exposure can become fatal.
Sandbox_Machinery_EnableInjuries_tooltip: Allows configured machine operations to injure the operator. Disable this to remove accident rolls entirely.
Sandbox_Machinery_EnablePartWear_tooltip: Controls wear on installed parts such as circular blades. Required parts must still be installed.
Sandbox_Machinery_EnableSkillScaling_too: When disabled, operations use their fixed base yield, time and XP and do not cause skill-scaled accidents.
Sandbox_Machinery_FuelUseMultiplier_tool: Multiplies fluid fuel consumed per operation. Set to 0 for no fuel usage or requirement.
Sandbox_Machinery_IndoorExhaustMultiplie: Multiplies toxic exposure from operating combustion-powered machines indoors. Set to 0 to remove exposure while retaining the warning.
Sandbox_Machinery_PartWearMultiplier_too: Multiplies blade and other installed-part wear. Set to 0 for no wear.
Sandbox_Machinery_SkillDifficulty_toolti: Adjusts the effective skill used for yield, speed, XP and accident calculations. The UI still displays the character's real skill level.
Sandbox_Machinery_XPMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplies XP awarded by machine operations. Set to 0 to disable machine XP.
Sandbox_Machinery_YieldMultiplier_toolti: Multiplies item output after skill scaling. Results are rounded to the nearest whole item, with at least one output when the operation normally produces something.
Sandbox_MagazineSpeedLoaders_LootSpawnMu: Multiplier for how often speed loaders and Loading Stations appear in loot. 1x (default) is tuned to roughly one loader per five high-tier loot containers (gun stores, pawn shops, military bases). Lower = rarer.
Sandbox_MagazineSpeedLoaders_ReloadXP_to: Multiplier applied to Reloading skill XP whenever a magazine is loaded through a handheld speed loader or the Loading Station. 50%% default. 0%% disables the XP entirely.
Sandbox_MailboxStories_EnableLetters_too: Adds readable letters, cards, notes, paperwork, and tickets to mailbox tiles supported by Mailbox Stories.
Sandbox_MailboxStories_EnableParcels_too: Adds mail bags and parcel containers to supported mailbox tiles, then fills parcels with themed loot by item display category.
Sandbox_MaintenanceEffectMultiplier_tool: Scales how strongly the Maintenance skill reduces tool wear and failure chance.
Sandbox_MaintenanceKitRarity_tooltip: Adjust the rarity of Firearm Maintenance Kits.
Sandbox_MaintenanceXpMultiplier_tooltip: Scales Maintenance XP gained from disassembly/repair/upgrade actions.
Sandbox_MakeshiftSilencerDistribution_to: Multiplies how often the Makeshift Suppressor spawns in loot. 1.0 = default rate, 0 = never spawns in loot (admin/debug spawn only), up to 5x default.

Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_ActiveSpeed_tool: Zombie speed during the active night hours. Default is 1. 1 = Sprinters, 2 = Fast Shamblers, 3 = Shamblers, 4 = Random.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_AttractEveryTick: How often the player tracking pulse fires while the event is active. Default is 180 ticks. Lower happens more often and is more intense but heavier. Higher is calmer and lighter.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_AttractRadius_to: How far the night tracking pulse reaches. Default is 250 tiles. Higher pulls zombies from farther away but can be heavier. Lower is safer for performance.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_AttractVolume_to: How strong the tracking sound is. Default is 250. Higher makes zombies respond more aggressively to the pulse. Lower makes it weaker.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_AttractZombies_t: When ON, the mod creates a timed sound pulse during active Moonlight Mayhem hours only. Default is OFF. When the night ends, the pulse stops and cleanup runs.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_DaysBetweenEvent: Controls how often Moonlight Mayhem repeats. Default is 1, meaning every night. 2 means every other night, 3 means every third night.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_DebugPrint_toolt: Shows Moonlight Mayhem messages in the console. Default is OFF. Turn this ON only when testing or troubleshooting.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_EnableNightSpawn: When ON, extra zombies can spawn near the player during Moonlight Mayhem. Default is OFF. This is separate from changing existing zombies; existing zombies are handled by the refresh settings.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_Enabled_tooltip: Turns the whole mod on or off. ON means the mod checks the chosen time window and applies the night zombie settings. OFF means it stops changing zombie behavior.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_EndHour_tooltip: The hour when Moonlight Mayhem ends, using 24-hour time. Default is 6, which means 6 AM. Zombies are restored to normal after this time.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_EndMinute_toolti: The minute when the event ends. Default is 0. Example: End Hour 6 and End Minute 30 means the event ends at 6:30 AM.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_FallbackDaySpeed: The speed zombies return to when Moonlight Mayhem ends. Default is 3, normal Shamblers. This also acts as a backup if the original speed cannot be read.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_FirstEventDay_to: The first survival day Moonlight Mayhem can happen. Default is 1, meaning it can start on the first night.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_ImmediateRefresh: How many loaded zombies are refreshed immediately when night starts or ends. Default is 300. Higher values change more zombies immediately; lower values are safer for performance.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_LoadedZombieAler: How far loaded zombies are directly pushed toward the player during Moonlight Mayhem. Default is 120 tiles. This only affects zombies already loaded nearby.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_PostRestorePasse: Extra cleanup checks after Moonlight Mayhem ends. Default is 30. Higher values do more follow-up cleanup so spawned or loaded zombies return to daytime settings after the event ends.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_RefreshTicks_too: How often the mod checks whether it should be night or day mode. Default is 300. Lower values check more often but may add stutter; higher values check less often and can be smoother.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_SpawnChance_tool: Chance that a night spawn attempt actually happens. Default is 100. Lower values make spawns less reliable and easier on performance.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_SpawnCount_toolt: How many zombies to spawn per successful night spawn. Default is 5. Higher is harder but can hurt performance.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_SpawnEveryMinute: How many in-game minutes between night spawn attempts. Default is 30. Lower means more frequent spawns. Higher means fewer spawns.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_SpawnMaxDistance: Farthest distance extra night zombies can spawn from the player. Default is 120 tiles. Higher spreads spawns farther out; lower keeps them closer.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_SpawnMinDistance: Closest distance extra night zombies can spawn from the player. Default is 45 tiles. Higher keeps spawns farther away from the player.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_StartHour_toolti: The hour when Moonlight Mayhem begins, using 24-hour time. Default is 18, which means 6 PM. Zombies switch to the night settings when this time starts.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_StartMinute_tool: The minute when the event begins. Default is 0. Example: Start Hour 20 and Start Minute 30 means the event begins at 8:30 PM.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_ZombieRefreshBat: How many loaded zombies are refreshed per tick while a transition queue is active. Default is 300. Higher values refresh more zombies per pass; lower values spread the work out more slowly.
Sandbox_MoonlightMayhem_tooltip: Timed zombie-night settings. Default is 6 PM to 6 AM. Test build uses night speed switching plus attraction pulse only; strength, hearing, sight, and memory options were removed for troubleshooting.

Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightDyn: Ideal Weight Lose Grace Period Hours Speed Multiplier

How fast you earn 'grace period' hours that later are used up before you lose the trait if you're not between 75-85 weight. Default multiplier of 1 earns you 1 grace period hour for every 12h of keeping weight 78-82 (Basically 0.0834 grace hours for each 1h). Higher multiplier = faster gain of grace hours. Lower multiplier = slower gain of grace hours.

How many days you have to keep your weight between 78 and 82 to earn the trait. Check is made every in-game hour.

After how many hours without alcohol should an alcoholic start suffering withdrawal symptoms?
