Sandbox_MoreTraits_AntiqueAnywhere_toolt: If true, Antique Collector trait will be able to find antique items anywhere, instead of only in crates and metal shelves.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_AntiqueChance_tooltip:
How rare Antique Collector items are.
This value is representative of a 1 in X roll.
Higher values mean drops happen less frequently.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_BatteringRamMartial_t: If this is enabled, knocking down zombies with Battering Ram trait will damage them if you have Martial Artist trait.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_BouncerCooldown_toolt:
How many ticks between Bouncer shoves.
60 ticks = 1 second
Reducing this value can dramatically overpower Bouncer.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_BouncerDistance_toolt:
The distance (in tile squares) from the player out to which Bouncer begins attempting to shove enemies away.
Lower values means Bouncer will take effect only at closer ranges to the player.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_BouncerEffectiveness_:
The percent chance that a player who has the Bouncer trait will trigger its effect.
This is rolled every tick, so 60 times/second for as long as the player has at least two or more zombies near them.
Increasing this value by even a small amount can dramatically overpower Bouncer.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_BurnedDistance_toolti:
Distance at which Burn Ward Patient gets activated by fire.
Keep in mind, the higher this value is, the more panic and anxiety you will get from being close.
Warning: Higher values might lead to FPS issues
Sandbox_MoreTraits_BurnedFireAversion_to: Should players with Burn Ward be forbidden from starting fires?
Sandbox_MoreTraits_BurnedPanic_tooltip:
Panic you will get from Burn Ward Patient.
Scaling works by repeatedly adding panic until max distance number is reached, starting from distance of closest fire.
What this means is, if fire is 1 tile away and max is 20, it will give 20x panic than this number. This happens every one minute in-game.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_BurnedStress_tooltip:
Stress you will get from Burn Ward Patient.
Scaling works by repeatedly adding stress until max distance number is reached, starting from distance of closest fire.
What this means is, if fire is 1 tile away and max is 20, it will give 20x stress than this number. This happens every one minute in-game.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_ButterfingersChance_t:
The chance in X how frequently a player with Butterfingers will drop an item.
The base chance is 5, so by default this value would be a 5/2000 chance calculated every in-game minute.
Lowering this value could result in players constantly dropping their items.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_EvasiveAnimation_tool: If enabled, Evasive has no "being hit" animation when it activates
Sandbox_MoreTraits_EvasiveBlocksPVP_tool: If true, Evasive can dodge attacks from other players.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_EvasiveChance_tooltip:
The percent chance that a player with the Evasive trait will dodge an attack.
Setting this to 100%% will make players with Evasive immune to zombies.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_FastRunning_tooltip: Speed modifier applied when running with the 'Fast' trait.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_FastSprint_tooltip: Speed modifier applied when sprinting with the 'Fast' trait.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_FastWalking_tooltip: Speed modifier applied when walking with the 'Fast' trait.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_ForgivingDeprived_too:
Players who take the Deprived trait will still be allowed to keep a belt.
Belts are ordinarily difficult to obtain through normal play without killing other players or mods which add them to loot tables.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_GimpRunning_tooltip: Speed reduction applied when running with the 'Gimp' trait.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_GimpSprint_tooltip: Speed reduction applied when sprinting with the 'Gimp' trait.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_GimpWalking_tooltip: Speed reduction applied when walking with the 'Gimp' trait.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_GordaniteEffectivenes:
A percent value representing how effective the Gordanite trait makes players with Crowbars.
Setting this to 200%% will make Gordanite twice as powerful.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_GraveRobberChance_too: The %% chance that a player with the Grave Robber trait will find extra loot on a zombie corpse. Chance is rounded down to nearest 0.1%%
Sandbox_MoreTraits_GraveRobberGuaranteed:
How much guaranteed extra loot will Grave Robber's find on zombie corpses?
By default, a random value is determined. Increasing this value guarantees extra loot whenever loot is rolled.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_GymGoerNoExerciseFati:
Should Gym Goer affect Exercise Fatigue?
If this option is un-checked, players with Gym Goer will suffer from exercise fatigue as normal.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_GymGoerPercent_toolti:
The percent amount extra Fitness/Strength XP a player receives from working out if they have the Gym Goer trait.
Setting this to 100%% means no extra XP is gained.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_HardyEndurance_toolti: How much extra endurance should hardy give?
Sandbox_MoreTraits_HoarderCompatibility_:
If you run both More Traits and Expended Traits, they both have perks that update carry weight.
If this is checked on, Hoarder (from Expended Traits) and carry weight from this mod (Pack Mule/Mouse) will stack. Which means that whatever carry weight you get with Pack Mule/Pack Mouse will be multiplied by 1.25.
If this is checked off, and you have both perks (Hoarder and Pack Mule/Mouse) either Hoarder or Pack Mouse/Mule will run its code first meaing I honestly don't know if your max weight will be calculated by Hoarder code or Pack Mule code
Sandbox_MoreTraits_ImmunoChance_tooltip:
Chance for a player with Immunocompromised to get infected by a zombie attack.
Setting this value to 100 will make every zombie attack infectious.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_IncomprehensiveChance:
A percent value representing the chance that a player with the Incomprehensive trait will find fewer items in any container.
Setting this to 100%% would make every container lose some items.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_IndefatigableOneUse_t:
If true, Indefatigable trait can be used only once per character.
If false, it will recharge based on the option below.
Note: If false, it will cure zombification only once.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_IndefatigableRecharge:
After how many in-game days should the indefatigable ability recharge?
Note: This option will only work if "Indefatigable One Use" option is disabled.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_IngenuitiveLimitAmoun:
What percent of unknown recipes should be learned by Ingenuitive?
This is randomly chosen out of all available recipes.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_IngenuitiveLimit_tool:
Limit the amount of free recipes granted by Ingenuitive?
By default, all recipes are taught for players who have Ingenuitive.
Turning this on allows you to limit how much they learn instead.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_InjuredBurns_tooltip:
Whether or not players who take the Injured trait can receive burns as a random injury.
Burns can be extremely debilitating especially if on the legs.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_LuckImpact_tooltip:
The percent degree to which Lucky and Unlucky traits affect traits from this mod.
0%% means lucky and unlucky have no effect on traits.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_MartialScaling_toolti:
A percent value representing how strong the scaling in damage for Martial Artist is.
Setting this to 50%% would halve all damage.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_MartialWeapons_toolti:
By default, Martial Artist will only deal damage if the player is unarmed.
If enabled, players' shoves will still deal damage even if they are wielding a weapon.
If this option is disabled, you can still benefit from Martial Artist with an item in your Secondary slot (Flashlight, Bag, etc). It only checks if the Primary slot is equipped.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_NonlethalAlcoholic_to: Players who take the alcoholic trait can never die from alcohol poisoning, but will still suffer periodic withdrawal.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_PreparedCarGasToggle_: Players who choose the Prepared: Cars trait start with a gas can.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_PreparedMedicalBandag: The amount of bandages given by the Prepare Medical trait.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_ProwessGunsAmmoRestor: If true, Prowess: Guns will have a chance to not consume ammo. Not exactly lore-wise friendly, but fun.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_QuickSuperImmune_tool:
If true, Super Immune is 6 times faster than normal.
Preferably used in multiplayer games where you can't fast forward time.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_QuickWorkerScaler_too:
Determines how much faster players with the Quick Worker trait perform actions.
Set this to 50 for a 50%% reduction in time (twice as fast).
Set to 10 for a 10%% reduction.
Default: 50.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_ScroungerChance_toolt:
A percent value representing the chance that a player with the Scrounger trait will find extra loot in any container.
100%% would make every container have extra loot.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_ScroungerItemChance_t:
A percent value representing how likely any item in a container is to be duplicated by Scrounger.
For example: Scrounger Chance is the percent chance that any given container will potentially have extra loot in it.
Once a container passes this initial check, another series of checks is run - for every single item inside that container, a die is rolled to determine if that item is duplicated.
If for instance, this value is set to 100%%, then whenever Scrounger is triggered, the entire contents of that container will be duplicated.
If Scrounger Chance, and Scrounger Item Chance are both 100%%, then anyone with the Scrounger trait will find double the loot in every container.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_ScroungerLootModifier:
A percent value representing how much extra loot players with the Scrounger trait will find when Scrounger triggers.
100%% would double the amount of extra loot players find.
This value always rounds up, so even a single item can potentially be doubled.
This effect is most noticed in stacks of items such as cigarettes or ammunition.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_SecondWindCooldown_to: After how much days should Second Wind recharge?
Sandbox_MoreTraits_SlowWorkerScaler_tool:
Determines how much slower players with the Slow Worker trait perform actions.
Set this to 50 for a 50%% increase in time (1.5x longer).
Set to 100 for a 100%% increase (twice as long).
Default: 50.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_SpecializationXPPerce:
The percent value that XP is reduced by for those who take a Specialization trait.
Set to 0%% to disable XP reduction.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_SuperImmuneFirstInfec: Super Immune Less Time After Curing

If true, any infections after the first one was cured will only last half as long.
Note: If caught multiple infections, it can still reach maximum days.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_SuperImmuneMaximum_to: Maximum days that a Super Immune character takes to heal the sickness.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_SuperImmuneMinimum_to: Minimum days that a Super Immune character takes to heal the sickness.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_SuperImmuneWeakness_t: If this setting is on, Super Immune will not be able to defend your body if it caught several infections.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_UnwaveringDamageBoost:
Determines the damage boost received when certain conditions are met. Damage scales based on the following:

Tier 1 (Default 2.0x): Endurance < 25%%, Fatigue > 80%%, or Pain > 75.
Tier 2 (Default 1.5x): Endurance < 50%%, Fatigue > 70%%, or Pain > 50.
Tier 3 (Default 1.25x): Endurance < 75%%, Fatigue > 60%%, or Pain > 20.

If multiple conditions are met, only the highest tier applies.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_VagabondChance_toolti:
A percent value representing the chance that a player with the Vagabond trait will find extra food in a garbage bin.
Setting this to 100%% would make every trash bin contain extra food.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_VagabondGuaranteedExt:
How many extra food items is a player with the Vagabond trait guaranteed to find in a garbage bin?
By default, a random value between 0 and 2 is selected. This value adds to that range.
(eg; roll a random number between 0 and 2 and then add x, where x is this value.)
Sandbox_MoreTraits_WeightDefault_tooltip:
Defines the base inventory carry capacity for players with neither Pack Mule nor Pack Mouse traits.
This is the base value before applying bonuses from Strength.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_WeightGlobalMod_toolt:
Gives bonus inventory carry capacity to all players.
You can set a negative value to reduce all player inventory capacity globally as well.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_WeightPackMouse_toolt:
Defines the base inventory carry capacity for those who take the Pack Mouse trait.
This is the base value before applying bonuses from Strength.
Sandbox_MoreTraits_WeightPackMule_toolti:
Defines the base inventory carry capacity for those who take the Pack Mule trait.
This is the base value before applying bonuses from Strength.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_AccuracyBonusXP_too: Extra Aiming XP when the round lands within a few tiles of the target.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_AmmoSpawnMult_toolt: Multiplier on the loot weight of all 60mm rounds. 0 disables shell spawning.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_BreakdownSeconds_to: Base time to pack the mortar back into the carry item.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_ChunkRadius_tooltip: Chunks around the impact pinned in memory so off-screen rounds detonate. 0 = impact chunk only.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_ConditionWearPerFir: Tube condition lost each time a round is fired.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_CrateSpawnMult_tool: Multiplier on crate loot weights AND world floor-crate chances. 0 disables crates.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_DebugMode_tooltip: Draw targeting/impact/scatter overlays and emit verbose logs. Leave off for normal play.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_EmergencyRepairChan: Success odds of an Emergency Field Repair attempt. It is DESIGNED to mostly fail (default 20%%) - free, endless retries that only cost time.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_EnvAudio_tooltip: Impacts pick urban-reverb or open-terrain-echo sound variants from the terrain around the impact.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_FireXP_tooltip: Aiming XP awarded for a successful fire.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_ForgivingStopwatch_: Rangefinder shot timer: a stop-click within 1 second of the real detonation snaps the reading to the exact travel time (millisecond precision). Off = the raw click timing stands.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_GainSkillXP_tooltip: Award Aiming XP for firing and Nimble XP for setup/breakdown. Off = the mortar never grants XP.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_GroundScorch_toolti: HE impacts char the ground (permanent at ground zero, removable further out). Off = no scorching.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_HangFireMult_toolti: Weight of the hang-fire outcome among ammunition failures. 0 = never hang, just duds/weak burns.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_HardwareSpawnMult_t: Multiplier on the loot weight of the mortar, plotting board, aiming circle and firing tables. 0 disables their spawning.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_IllumMinutes_toolti: How long an illumination flare burns before fading out.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_IllumRadius_tooltip: Lit coverage radius of illumination rounds. Default 50 turns night to day over a huge area; lower it for a dimmer, more localised flare.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_IncendiaryFireMult_: Multiplier on incendiary ignition chance per tile. 0 = incendiary rounds blast without starting fires.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_IncomingWhistle_too: The descending-round whistle near the impact point. Off = rounds arrive unannounced.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_LooseShellMult_tool: Multiplier on loose rounds in military ammo storage (crates are the primary source).
Sandbox_MortarSystem_MaxRangeTiles_toolt: Hard cap on firing range. Also stretches the dispersion distance curve.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_MaxWindMph_tooltip: Wind speed assumed at full climate intensity. Higher = storms push shells harder.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_MinRangeTiles_toolt: Targets closer than this to the tube are rejected (minimum safe distance).
Sandbox_MortarSystem_MoistureDryPerHour_: Ground shells dry at this rate while no rain falls. 0 = classic behaviour, wet rounds stay wet.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_MoistureEnabled_too: Shells left lying on outdoor ground soak up rain, degrading their consistency (wider dispersion, rounds falling short). Shells in inventories, bags, containers or under a roof never get wet. Off = propellant is always dry.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_MoistureGainMult_to: Multiplier on how fast exposed ground shells soak in the rain.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_NearBoomDistance_to: Within this distance of an impact you hear the full blast; beyond it, the distant rolling boom.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_NoToolsDispersionMu: Scales the massive range-proportional dispersion added when firing with NO fire-control equipment. 1.0 = about 8%% of the range as extra scatter radius.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_NoiseRadius_tooltip: How far the impact's world-sound event travels to attract zombies.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_NoiseVolume_tooltip: Loudness of the impact's world-sound event.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_ReliabilityScale_to: Scales BOTH malfunction sources: mechanical failures (worn tube) and ammunition failures (wet rounds). 1.0 = default, 0 disables all misfires, higher = harsher field discipline.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_RepairEffectMult_to: Multiplier on condition restored by field repairs.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_RepairSuccessMult_t: Multiplier on field repair success rolls (capped at 100%%).
Sandbox_MortarSystem_ScatterGlobalScalar: Difficulty knob multiplying ALL scatter. 1.0 = default.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_SetupSeconds_toolti: Base time to deploy the mortar before Nimble/Strength reductions.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_SmokeMinutes_toolti: How long a smoke cloud lingers.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_SpotterEllipse_tool: Show the dispersion ellipse in the rangefinder view and on the map. Off = crews estimate by eye.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_SpotterEnabled_tool: Master switch for rangefinder binding, the spotter view and the map target layer.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_SpotterMaxMapPlot_t: How far from the spotter a map-plotted target may be. Aim-based marking is not limited by this.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_ToolSpawnMult_toolt: Multiplier on the loot weight of the civilian navigation aids. 0 disables their spawning.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_UIScale_tooltip: Size of the mortar operating interface. Applies next time the HUD is opened.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_UseAimingSkill_tool: Let the operator's Aiming level tighten or widen dispersion. Off = skill has no effect on accuracy.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_UseNimbleStrength_t: Let Nimble and Strength speed up setting up and breaking down the mortar. Off = always the base time.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_WindCorrDisplay_too: Show the computed wind correction (gunner HUD row + APPLY button + rangefinder line). Off = crews judge the wind themselves.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_WindInfluence_toolt: How strongly the live wind pushes rounds downwind during flight. Drift is deterministic (same wind = same drift) and grows with range, so crews can learn to aim off for it. Disabled = shells ignore wind entirely.
Sandbox_MortarSystem_WindStrengthMult_to: Fine scale on wind drift, stacking with the Wind Influence preset. 1.0 = default.

Sandbox_MuleAttachment2_tooltip: Enables attaching welding torches to back slot.
Sandbox_MuleAttachment_tooltip: Enables lanterns to equip to belt slots, and welding torches to equip to back slot.
Sandbox_MuleBack1_tooltip: Enables dedicated slot for duffel and golf bags, can be worn with backpacks.
Sandbox_MuleBack2_tooltip: Enables dedicated cloth gun case slot, can be worn with backpacks and duffels (will overwrite 'Satchel: Sling' if both enabled).
Sandbox_MuleBags_DuffelBags_tooltip: Can be worn with Backpacks (Mutually exclusive with Golf Bags if both activated).

Sandbox_MuleBags_MilitaryWebbing_tooltip: Adds Webbing Slots to Military Backpacks.
Sandbox_MuleBags_SchoolWebbing_tooltip: Adds Webbing Slots to Small Backpacks such as Schoolbags.

Sandbox_MuleCanteen_tooltip: Enables dedicated canteen slot, can be worn with satchels.
Sandbox_MuleEarProtection_tooltip: Enables dedicated ear protection slot, cannot be worn with full helmets.
Sandbox_MuleEar_tooltip: Enables dedicated ear protector slot, cannot be worn with full helmets or suit heads.

Sandbox_MuleExclusion2_tooltip: If enabled wallets and pouches will be forced to share a slot.
Sandbox_MuleLowerBack_tooltip: Enables dedicated lower back slot for duffel and golf bags, can be worn with backpacks.
Sandbox_MulePocket_tooltip: Enables dedicated wallet slot and gives all wallets 50 weight reduction.

Sandbox_MuleRifleCase_tooltip: Enables dedicated rifle case slot, can be worn with backpacks.
Sandbox_MuleSatchel1_tooltip: Enables slings to be worn in the satchel slot.
Sandbox_MuleSatchel2_tooltip: Enables cloth gun cases to be worn in the satchel slot.
Sandbox_MuleSatchel_tooltip: Enables fishing basket and slings to equip to satchel slot.
Sandbox_MuleShoulder_tooltip: Enables dedicated shoulder slot with the ability to equip alongside backpacks and SCBA gear.
Sandbox_MuleVest1_tooltip: Enables carry capacity on all hunting vests and converts them from a clothing item to a container item. If changed mid-game any already existing vests will disappear.
Sandbox_MuleVest2_tooltip: Enables two new vest attachment slots and allows for firearm magazines/cd players to equip to them.
Sandbox_MuleVest3_tooltip: (Does not work with 'Vest: Capacity') Enables patching holes on hunting vests.

Sandbox_MuleVestAttachment_tooltip: Enables two new vest attachment slots and allows for firearm magazines/cd players to equip to them.
Sandbox_MuleVestProtection_tooltip: Disables gaining holes on all hunting vests, best used with 'Hunting Vest Capacity' as container items are non-repairable.
Sandbox_MuleVestRepair_tooltip: Enables repairing all hunting vests, does not work when 'Hunting Vest Capacity' is enabled.
Sandbox_MuleVest_tooltip: Enables carry capacity on all hunting vests and converts them from a clothing item to a container item. If changed mid-game any already existing vests will disappear.
Sandbox_MuleVests_HuntingVests_tooltip: Gives Hunting and Foreman Vests usable pockets, this changes them from protective clothing to wearable containers and thus can no longer be repaired.
Sandbox_MuleVests_VestAttachments_toolti: Adds 2 new attachments slots to all Vests that can hold Radios, Knives, Scissors, Screwdrivers, Firearm Magazines, and CD players.
Sandbox_MuleVests_VestProtection_tooltip: Makes Hunting and Foreman Vests unable to acquire holes, best used with 'Hunting Vest Capacity' option toggled ON.
Sandbox_MuleWallet2_tooltip: (Does not work with 'Slot: Wallet') Enables keyring auto-equipping behavior to wallets.
Sandbox_MuleWalletFix_tooltip: Increases wallet weight reduction from 0 to 30.
Sandbox_MuleWatch_tooltip: Enabled dedicated watch slot, can be worn with bracelets and forearm armor.

Sandbox_MuleWebbing2_tooltip: Enables webbing slots on all hiking backpacks.

Sandbox_MuleWebbingLarge_tooltip: Enables webbing slots on all military and survivor backpacks.

Sandbox_MuleWebbingSmallCrafted_tooltip: Enables webbing slots on all small crafted backpacks.

Sandbox_MuleWrist_tooltip: Enables dedicated wrist slot for watches and bracelets, can be worn with forearm protection.
Sandbox_MultiplierConfig_Lockpicking_too: Rate at which Lockpicking skill levels up. (Works only if 'Use Global Multiplier' is off)
Sandbox_Multipliers_CutDownMaterialGainM: Scales the amount of materials gain per tear apart (0.1–10.0). 1.0 = default.

Sandbox_Music_ListeningStrengthMultiplie: Controls how strong the effects of listening to music are. Higher values increase it's effectiveness on mood.
Sandbox_Music_Metabolics_tooltip: Whether or not playing music is physically taxing.
Sandbox_Music_StrengthMultiplier_tooltip: Controls how strong music related activities are for the musician. Higher values increase their effectiveness on mood and xp gains.
Sandbox_Music_tooltip: Rate at which Music skill levels up.

Sandbox_NLKNRoadAtlas_tooltip: Adds a road atlas that reveals all roads when read.
Sandbox_NLKPercentRevealed_tooltip: Percent of map cells to reveal. Looks best at 50 IMO.
Sandbox_NLKRoadRadius_tooltip: I know the roads within this range of my starting position
Sandbox_NLKStartRadius_tooltip: I know all the stuff within this range of my starting position.

Sandbox_NVFramework_BatterySystemEnabled: This integrated repair always requires an installed, charged battery. Old saves that stored this option as disabled are migrated automatically.

Sandbox_NVGOptions_WeightMultiplier_tool: This value defines by how much the spawn rate for NVG items is changed. 0.5=halved, 1=no change, 2=double, etc.
Sandbox_Naginata_SpawnRate_tooltip: Sets the extra spawn rate of Naginatas
Sandbox_NailGunMod_RecoveryChance_toolti: Determines the percentage chance for a zombie to drop a nail when hit by the Nail Gun.
Sandbox_NailGunMod_SpawnRate_tooltip: Determines how often the Nail Gun spawns in the world.

Sandbox_NaturesCall_BladderRateMult_tool: Multiplier applied to bladder filling over time.

Sandbox_NaturesCall_CategoryActivationTh: Minimum accumulated scale (servings) before a food category's per-hour effects (bowel rate, control, mood, sleepiness) start applying. Can be changed mid-game (single-player and multiplayer).
Sandbox_NaturesCall_EffectDurationMult_t: Multiplier applied to the duration of stomach effects (cramps, heartburn, diarrhea, constipation, laxative, sugar/water/caffeine highs, binge fatigue) when they are triggered or extended. Lower values let effects wear off faster.
Sandbox_NaturesCall_GutTrendMult_tooltip: Multiplier applied to how quickly gut health improves or worsens from diet.
Sandbox_NaturesCall_SmellPenaltyMult_too: Multiplier applied to discomfort and unhappiness from wearing soiled clothing. Set to 0 to disable these penalties.
Sandbox_NaturesCall_ToiletPenaltyMult_to: Multiplier applied to unhappiness from using unflushed toilets and to nearby foul-toilet smell severity. Set to 0 to disable these penalties.
Sandbox_NaturesCall_TraitIntensityMult_t: Multiplier applied to trait modifiers such as fill rates, control, soilage penalties, and accident scaling.
Sandbox_NaturesCall_WipeDurationMult_too: Multiplier applied to relief and wiping action duration.
Sandbox_NaturesCall_WipeNeedMult_tooltip: Multiplier applied to wipe supply consumption when cleaning after relief and accidents.
Sandbox_NaturesCall_ZombieSmellRangeMult: Multiplier applied to zombie attraction radius from player soilage, dropped soiled items, exposed waste, and foul toilets. Set to 0 to disable smell-based attraction.

Sandbox_PSR_AllowVanillaConnect_tooltip:
Lets you connect a building that is part of the map - not one you built - to a Battery Bank, with Connect this area to the Power Bank.
Off by default on servers: otherwise anyone could connect a neighbour's house and switch their appliances off from the Solar Computer.
Singleplayer and co-op hosts ignore this setting, it is always allowed there.
Sandbox_PSR_BackupConnectFloors_tooltip:
How many floors up or down a battery bank can reach to find its backup generator.
1 is the default and the original behaviour. Raise it if your generator sits on a roof, or several floors away from the bank.
This also widens the distance budget, so a rooftop generator is no longer penalised for being high up.
Sandbox_PSR_BackupConnectRange_tooltip:
Max distance to link a backup generator to a battery bank.
0 = use Electrician skill (default, ~10 tiles max)
1-50 = fixed range in tiles, any skill.
Sandbox_PSR_BatteryBankSpawn_tooltip: Rarity of Battery Bank spawning on the map.
Sandbox_PSR_ChargeFreq_tooltip: How often Battery Bank will charge
Sandbox_PSR_ConnectPanelMin_tooltip: Base number of in-game minutes it takes to connect one panel.
Sandbox_PSR_DIYBatteryMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplies the capacity of the battery used in the recipe. At 800%%, a wired CarBattery1 (50Ah) gives a 400Ah DIY battery, and an Improvised Battery (100Ah) gives 800Ah.
Sandbox_PSR_HardenedPanelRecipe_tooltip:
When ON, crafting solar panels needs a harder, more realistic recipe (tempered glass + aluminium frame, more components, higher Electricity skill).
OFF = the standard recipe (default).
This sets what the magazine teaches, so choose it before creating a save.
Sandbox_PSR_LRMBatteries_tooltip: Batteries spawns in random containers and pre-placed crates multiplier
Sandbox_PSR_LRMMisc_tooltip: Spawn rate multiplier for the magazine, the Inverter and the Solar Failsafe, in random containers and pre-placed crates
Sandbox_PSR_LRMSolarPanels_tooltip: Solar panel spawns in random containers and pre-placed crates multiplier
Sandbox_PSR_PanelConnectFloors_tooltip:
How many floors up or down a solar panel can reach to find its battery bank.
3 is the default and the original behaviour. Raise it if your bank sits deep in a basement or bunker, or high up a tower.
Each extra floor widens the scan above and below, which costs performance on very big buildings.
Sandbox_PSR_PanelConnectRange_tooltip:
Max horizontal distance between a solar panel and the battery bank it connects to.
20 is the default and the original behaviour. Raise it for large bases and bunkers.
Vertical reach is set separately, see Solar Panel Vertical Reach.
Larger values make the mod scan a wider area, which costs performance on very big buildings.
Sandbox_PSR_SolarCrateSpawn_tooltip:
Rarity of pre-placed solar crates spawning on the map, in sheds, garages, storage units, electronics storage and farm storage.
Crates are the best find in the mod - a whole batch of parts at once - so they stay rarer than battery banks.
Set to None to remove them entirely.
Sandbox_PSR_batteryDegradeChance_tooltip:
Batteries lose 1 point of condition per day while the bank is running.
Set to 0 to switch degradation off entirely. Any other value simply turns it on - the number itself has no effect.
Sandbox_PSR_consumptionMultiplier_toolti:
Multiplier for device power consumption, in percent.
100 = normal consumption (default)
50 = half consumption
Lower this if powering your base requires too many solar panels.
Sandbox_PSR_solarPanelEfficiency_tooltip:
Solar panel power efficiency
12%% is realistic for 1993
25%% is modern solar
default is unrealistic
Sandbox_PSR_solarPanelWorldSpawns_toolti:
How likely pre-placed solar panels and crates are to spawn at a given spawn location.
Requires external API to work.
Sandbox_PUR_AutoContinue_tooltip:
One click starts a work session: your character keeps digging until the sacks are full, endurance runs out, the square is done, or you move.
Turning this off means one click per pass.
Sandbox_PUR_BenchRange_tooltip:
Everything this mod lets you do - digging, sinking the shaft, building the ladder, laying the hatch - has to happen within this many tiles of a worksite bench.
The bench sits on the surface and covers the whole column beneath it, so you never need a second one further down.
Raise it if you want a sprawling bunker, lower it if you want a tight one.
Sandbox_PUR_ClimbEndurancePerBag: Endurance cost per sack carried up (%%)
Sandbox_PUR_ClimbEndurancePerBag_tooltip:
Hauling soil up a ladder is the hardest part of the job.
Set to 0 if you would rather not think about it.
Sandbox_PUR_ClimbMaxBags: Sacks you can carry up a ladder, bare-handed
Sandbox_PUR_ClimbMaxBagsWithPack: Sacks you can carry up a ladder, wearing a backpack
Sandbox_PUR_ClimbMaxBagsWithPack_tooltip:
With the sacks on your back your hands are free, so you can climb - and you will feel every kilo.
This is the number that really shapes the dig: it decides how many trips a gallery costs you.
Sandbox_PUR_ClimbMaxBags_tooltip:
You climb with your hands. A sack of soil in your arms leaves you one hand, and that is already one too few.
1 is realistic. Set it high to ignore the whole thing.
Sandbox_PUR_ClimbNoPackFactor: Extra effort when climbing with sacks in your arms
Sandbox_PUR_ClimbNoPackFactor_tooltip:
Multiplies the endurance cost when the sacks are not on your back.
At 4, hauling one sack bare-handed costs as much as four in a backpack - which is about right.
Sandbox_PUR_DigEndurancePerPass_tooltip:
The base game does not tire you when you dig. This mod does.
Breaking asphalt with a pickaxe costs half again as much.
Your character stops when endurance falls below the threshold above. Set to 0 to dig tirelessly.
Sandbox_PUR_DigPassTime_tooltip:
Length of a single digging pass.
180 is about the same as filling a grave in the base game.
Sandbox_PUR_DigPassesPerLevel_tooltip:
How many shovel passes it takes to open one square, one level down.
24 is realistic: a square is about 2.5 cubic metres of soil, roughly an afternoon of hand digging.
Lower it if you would rather build than dig.
Sandbox_PUR_DigSpeedMultiplier_tooltip:
Global speed multiplier for every digging pass.
Higher is faster. Set it to 500 if you only care about what you build down there.
Sandbox_PUR_DirtPerPass: Dirt per pass (%% of a sack)
Sandbox_PUR_DirtPerPass_tooltip:
How much of a sack each pass fills.
25 means four passes fill one sack, matching the base game's dirt sack.
Set to 0 and the soil simply vanishes.
Sandbox_PUR_LadderSkillLevel_tooltip: Carpentry level required to build the shaft ladder.
Sandbox_PUR_MinEndurance_tooltip:
Digging is heavy work. Below this endurance your character stops and catches their breath.
Set to 0 to dig until you drop.
Sandbox_PUR_OuvrageMaterialPercent_toolt:
Scales what the ladder and the trapdoor cost to build.
Lower it on a low-loot game where twenty nails are hard to come by.
Sandbox_PUR_OuvrageTimePercent_tooltip: Scales how long it takes to build - and to take apart - the ladder and the trapdoor.
Sandbox_PUR_RequireBags_tooltip:
The soil you dig out has to go somewhere.
When every sack you carry is full, you must empty one before you can keep digging.
Turn this off for a lighter experience.
Sandbox_PUR_RoadPasses_tooltip:
How many pickaxe passes it takes to break a road or pavement surface before you can dig the soil underneath.
A shovel will not do.
Sandbox_PUR_TrapdoorSkillLevel_tooltip: Carpentry level required to build the trapdoor that closes the shaft.
Sandbox_PUR_UndergroundTempEnabled_toolt:
A dug gallery is thermally stable: cool in summer, mild in winter.
Turn this off and your bunker follows the weather outside.
Sandbox_PWPNXB_BoltIBaseBreakChance_tool: Base chance in %% that Metal Bolts won't break
Sandbox_PWPNXB_BoltIBreakChanceScaling_t: %% Break chance increased by each maintenance level, default values at level 10 maintenance, means there's a 90%% chance that the bolt won't break
Sandbox_PWPNXB_BoltSIBaseBreakChance: Metal Short Bolt Base Break Chance
Sandbox_PWPNXB_BoltSIBaseBreakChance_too: Base chance in %% that Short Metal Bolts won't break
Sandbox_PWPNXB_BoltSIBreakChanceScaling: Metal Short Bolt Break Chance Scaling
Sandbox_PWPNXB_BoltSIBreakChanceScaling_: %% Break chance increased by each maintenance level, default values at level 10 maintenance, means there's a 95%% chance that the bolt won't break
Sandbox_PWPNXB_BoltSWBaseBreakChance: Wood Short Bolt Base Break Chance
Sandbox_PWPNXB_BoltSWBaseBreakChance_too: Base chance in %% that Short Wood Bolts won't break
Sandbox_PWPNXB_BoltSWBreakChanceScaling: Wood Short Bolt Break Chance Scaling
Sandbox_PWPNXB_BoltSWBreakChanceScaling_: %% Break chance increased by each maintenance level, default values at level 10 maintenance, means there's a 80%% chance that the bolt won't break
Sandbox_PWPNXB_BoltWBaseBreakChance_tool: Base chance in %% that Wood Bolts won't break
Sandbox_PWPNXB_BoltWBreakChanceScaling_t: %% Break chance increased by each maintenance level, default values at level 10 maintenance, means there's a 70%% chance that the bolt won't break
Sandbox_PWPNXB_CompoundCrossbowSpawnMult: Multiplier for Compound Crossbow spawn chance in loot
Sandbox_PWPNXB_CrossbowBookSpawnMult: Crossbows Recipe Book Spawn Chance Multiplier
Sandbox_PWPNXB_CrossbowBookSpawnMult_too: Multiplier for Crossbow recipe book spawn chance in loot
Sandbox_PWPNXB_CrudeCrossbowSpawnMult_to: Multiplier for Crude Crossbow spawn chance in loot
Sandbox_PWPNXB_HandCrossbowSpawnMult_too: Multiplier for Hand Crossbow spawn chance in loot
Sandbox_PWPNXB_ImprovedCrossbowSpawnMult: Multiplier for Improved Crossbow spawn chance in loot
Sandbox_PWS_ComputerRange_tooltip:
How far the desktop computer can sit from the weather station and still read it.
1 means right next to it, which is the default and the way the mod is balanced.
The station has to stand outside, so raise this if you would rather keep the computer indoors.
Sandbox_PWS_HistoryDays_tooltip:
How many past days the computer shows, up to 10.
Days when the station had no power leave gaps in the record.
Sandbox_PWS_MagazineLootMultiplier_toolt:
How often the meteorology magazine spawns in containers.
The magazine is the only way to learn the recipes, so setting this to 0 disables the mod's crafting.
Sandbox_PWS_PreciseForecastDays_tooltip:
How many days ahead the computer shows exact highs and lows.
3 days is what a real station can honestly predict. 7 is the most this mod will give you.
Set to 0 to remove precise forecasting entirely.
Sandbox_PWS_TrendForecastDays_tooltip:
How many days ahead the computer shows a rough trend - warm or cold front only, no numbers - past the precise range.
Beyond about a week, real forecasting is guesswork, so 7 is the limit here.
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_BoltSWBaseBreakChanc: Base chance that a lodged short wood bolt is recovered intact instead of broken.
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_BoltSWBreakChanceSca: Short Wood Bolt Recovery Bonus per Maintenance Level
Extra intact recovery chance added for each Maintenance level.
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_BoltWBaseBreakChance: Base chance that a lodged wood bolt is recovered intact instead of broken.
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_BoltWBreakChanceScal: Wood Bolt Recovery Bonus per Maintenance Level
Extra intact recovery chance added for each Maintenance level.
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_CompoundCrossbowSpaw: Multiplies how often compound crossbows and full-size bolts spawn in container loot and foraging.
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_CrudeCrossbowSpawnMu: Multiplies how often crude crossbows spawn in container loot and foraging.
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_DebugLogging_tooltip: Writes PZ Crossbows diagnostics to the console and log files: which side handles each shot, bolt counters and recovery rolls. Leave off unless you are reporting a bug, as it makes the logs noisy.
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_HandCrossbowSpawnMul: Multiplies how often hand crossbows and short bolts spawn in container loot and foraging.
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_ImprovedCrossbowSpaw: Multiplies how often improved crossbows spawn in container loot and foraging.
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_LootSpawnMult_toolti: Multiplies all PZ Crossbows container loot and foraging spawns, including crossbows, bolt quivers, bolts and bolt parts. This combines with each crossbow's individual multiplier.
Sandbox_PZLinux_CustomMoneyItems: Custom Money Items (ItemName, comma-separated -- treated as $1 cash for ATM/bank purposes, e.g. from a weightless-money mod)
Sandbox_PZLinux_DarkWebSharedCatalogEnab: Enabled: two server-wide offers refresh every 24 in-game hours and disappear for everyone when purchased.<LINE>Disabled: restores the original per-player Dark Web purchase catalog.
Sandbox_PZTrueMusicSandbox_AudioSilenceD: Enable verbose [TMDBG] / [HIFIDBG] logs for diagnosing vehicle/world music that toggles on but produces no sound.
Sandbox_PZTrueMusicSandbox_CDScratchClea: Chance (%%) that a loose CD spawns clean and undamaged. CDs found in CD cases are always clean. Scratched CDs are labeled and skip tracks: 25%% scratched skips every 2nd song, 50%% skips all but one song, 100%% skips everything and won't loop.
Sandbox_PZTrueMusicSandbox_CDSpawnRate_t: Spawn rate for CD albums from detected CD packs (0-100000%%). 0=Disabled, 100=Normal.
Sandbox_PZTrueMusicSandbox_CassetteSpawn: Spawn rate for cassette tapes (0-100000%%). 0=Disabled, 100=Normal. Multiplies with legacy cassette pack rates.
Sandbox_PZTrueMusicSandbox_EnableDisasse: Allow players to disassemble cassettes and electronics (walkman, boombox, vinyl player) for parts. Disable to prevent disassembly entirely.
Sandbox_PZTrueMusicSandbox_GenerateNewLo: When new music packs are added to an existing save, sprinkle their media into already-generated containers as chunks load. Off = new packs only appear in freshly-generated loot.
Sandbox_PZTrueMusicSandbox_JukeboxCapaci: How much media weight a jukebox container can hold (1 - 100, the engine maximum). Default 100 - enough for hundreds of cassettes, vinyls and CDs.
Sandbox_PZTrueMusicSandbox_MPSyncHandsha: Multiplayer only. When enabled, pressing Play on a device runs a short ready-check so every nearby player starts the song at the same moment (up to ~2 second delay before the music starts). When disabled (default), music starts almost immediately and listeners sync by joining the track mid-play.
Sandbox_PZTrueMusicSandbox_MasterCassett: Legacy spawn rate for cassette tapes (0-100000%%). 0=Disabled, 100=Normal. Multiplies with legacy cassette pack rates.
Sandbox_PZTrueMusicSandbox_MaxMediaPerCo: Caps how many TrueMoozic media items of EACH type (cassettes, vinyl, CDs) can appear in a single freshly-looted container, leaving room for other loot. 0 = no cap.
Sandbox_PZTrueMusicSandbox_MusicPlayback: Maximum real-world seconds a tape can play before timing out. Default 2100 (35 minutes).
Sandbox_PZTrueMusicSandbox_MusicTimer_to: Time between music state checks. Higher = better performance, slower updates.
Sandbox_PZTrueMusicSandbox_SkypeRingChan: Percent chance, when a player walks within 2 tiles of a base-game computer, that the Skype ringtone plays. Roll happens at most once per cooldown.
Sandbox_PZTrueMusicSandbox_SkypeRingCool: In-game days the same computer must wait before another chance roll, regardless of whether the previous roll succeeded.
Sandbox_PZTrueMusicSandbox_SkypeRingDebu: Testing only. Bypasses chance roll and per-computer cooldown so the Skype ring plays whenever you stand near a computer.
Sandbox_PZTrueMusicSandbox_SkypeRingEnab: Holiday easter egg: when enabled, walking near a base-game computer can occasionally play the Skype ringtone. Disable to silence the easter egg entirely.
Sandbox_PZTrueMusicSandbox_SpawnTrueMooz: If enabled, the TrueMoozic StepVan can spawn in vehicle parking zones. Disable to prevent it from spawning in the world.
Sandbox_PZTrueMusicSandbox_StartWithDevi: Choose a starting TrueMoozic device & one random cassette.
Sandbox_PZTrueMusicSandbox_TMSpeakerDebu: Enable periodic [TMSpeaker] debug logs for speaker sync and HiFi source detection.
Sandbox_PZTrueMusicSandbox_VinylSpawn_to: Spawn rate for vinyl media items (records/albums) (0-100000%%). 0=Disabled, 100=Normal.
Sandbox_PZTrueMusicSandbox_ZombieWalkman: Spawn rate for zombie walkman bundle (Walkman + Headphones + Cassette). 0=Disabled, 100=Normal. Default is around 1 in 100 zombies.
Sandbox_PZ_ChanceDouble_tooltip: Chance that a second event follows shortly after the first one.
Sandbox_PZ_ChanceEvent_tooltip: Probability of a paranormal event occurring during a check.
Sandbox_PZ_CheckIntervalMulti_tooltip: Adjusts the time between checks. Lower values mean more frequent hauntings.
Sandbox_PZ_ColdEffectDuration_tooltip: Determines how long the intense cold effect lasts.
Sandbox_PZ_ColdEffectOverlay_tooltip: If checked, a frost overlay will appear on the screen when the cold effect is active.
Sandbox_PZ_CorruptOnDeath_tooltip: If enabled, a player dying inside a building will immediately shatter any spiritual protection. The building will become haunted (or stay haunted) as the soul leaves the body.
Sandbox_PZ_DisableWitchingMusic_tooltip: If enabled, the intense background music that normally plays during the Witching Hour will be disabled.
Sandbox_PZ_Effect_Blackout_tooltip: All lights in the building will be forced off simultaneously.
Sandbox_PZ_Effect_Cold_tooltip: The air becomes freezing, causing your character to shiver and take cold damage.
Sandbox_PZ_Effect_Corruption_tooltip: The very presence of the entity taints the environment. Water sources become tainted and fresh food instantly rots, unless preserved.
Sandbox_PZ_Effect_Doors_tooltip: Doors can open, close, or be subject to heavy knocking and thumping.
Sandbox_PZ_Effect_Electronics_tooltip: Nearby TVs and Radios might turn on by themselves at high volume.
Sandbox_PZ_Effect_Flicker_tooltip: Light sources may start flickering rapidly before burning out.
Sandbox_PZ_Effect_GhostWalk_tooltip: The player may hear footsteps approaching or circling them, even when no one is there.
Sandbox_PZ_Effect_LightSwitch_tooltip: The spirits can flip light switches on or off near you.
Sandbox_PZ_Effect_Phrases_tooltip: Your character may utter disturbing phrases.
Sandbox_PZ_Effect_Scratch_tooltip: You might hear something scratching at the windows from the outside.
Sandbox_PZ_Effect_Shift_tooltip: Reality colapses and Shadow People hunt you down in your own home. Hide or die.
Sandbox_PZ_Effect_Smash_tooltip: A window in the building will suddenly explode or be smashed.
Sandbox_PZ_Effect_Sounds_tooltip: Enables random sounds like footsteps, crying, or voices behind you.
Sandbox_PZ_EnableGrimoireSpawn_tooltip: If enabled, non-initiated survivors can search for an Ancient Grimoire to learn the forbidden art of Exorcism.
Sandbox_PZ_EnableKitSpawn_tooltip: If enabled, Exorcism Kits will spawn in the world (Churches, Medical offices, Desks). If disabled, they can only be obtained through other means.
Sandbox_PZ_EnableMajor_tooltip: If disabled, major events will never occur.
Sandbox_PZ_EnableMinor_tooltip: If disabled, minor events will never occur.
Sandbox_PZ_EnableModerate_tooltip: If disabled, moderate events will never occur.
Sandbox_PZ_EnableOuijaSeance_tooltip: If enabled, allows players to use the Ouija board to communicate with the spirits and haunt a house.
Sandbox_PZ_ForcedHauntedIDs_tooltip: Enter the specific Building IDs you want to ALWAYS be haunted, separated by commas (e.g. 12345, 67890). These locations will bypass normal spawn rates but can still be cleansed by an Exorcist.
Sandbox_PZ_GrimoireRarity_tooltip: Determines if the book is a forbidden rarity or if it was widely distributed before the outbreak.
Sandbox_PZ_HauntedHouseRate_tooltip: The percentage chance for a building to be haunted.
Sandbox_PZ_HauntedType_tooltip: Controls which types of buildings can be haunted. 'Residential' focuses on houses, 'Commercial' on shops and offices.
Sandbox_PZ_Map_SendPlayerPositions: Send player positions to PZ Map
Sandbox_PZ_Map_SendPlayerPositions_toolt: Lets the PZ Map browser page draw other players. It does not change who may see whom - that is decided by MapRemotePlayerVisibility, and PZ Map never shows anyone the in-game world map would not. Turning this off only stops PZ Map sending positions, which cost roughly 55 bytes per visible player per second. The in-game world map is unaffected either way.
Sandbox_PZ_OuijaBoardSpawnRate_tooltip: Determines the spawn rate of Ouija Boards appearing in the world
Sandbox_PZ_OuijaOnlyOccultist_tooltip: If enabled, only players with the Occultist profession can use the Ouija Board.
Sandbox_PZ_OuijaRequiredDarkness_tooltip: If enabled, the player must stay in the darkness to commence the séance.
Sandbox_PZ_OuijaRequiredMidnight_tooltip: If enabled, séance required to be at least Midnight for the player to commence it.
Sandbox_PZ_OuijaSeanceDuration_tooltip: Determines the duration of the séance in seconds.
Sandbox_PZ_ProtectStartingHouse_tooltip: If enabled, the building where a new character spawns will be instantly cleansed of any evil presence.
Sandbox_PZ_ShiftDuration_tooltip: Determines how long The Shift event lasts before reality stabilizes.
Sandbox_PZ_ShiftRequireWitch_tooltip: If checked, The Shift event can ONLY trigger during the Witching Hour. If unchecked, it can trigger at any time.
Sandbox_PZ_ShiftShadowCount_tooltip: Determines the maximum number of Shadow People that will spawn to hunt the player during The Shift.
Sandbox_PZ_WeightMajor_tooltip: Influences the probability of major events occurring (apparitions, windows smashed, freezing air, blackouts).
Sandbox_PZ_WeightMinor_tooltip: Influences the probability of minor events occurring (random sounds, random phrases, light switching).
Sandbox_PZ_WeightModerate_tooltip: Influences the probability of moderate events occurring (door opens/closes, lights flickering, windows scratching electronics, ).
Sandbox_PZ_WitchingHourEnable_tooltip: Drastically increases paranormal activity at a specific time of night.
Sandbox_PZ_WitchingHourStart_tooltip: The hour at which paranormal activity intensifies (0-23).
Sandbox_PZ_WorldSeed_tooltip: Determines which specific buildings will be haunted. Entering the same seed will replicate the same spiritual layout across different save files.
Sandbox_PZ_WorldUpkeepDays_tooltip: Determines how long a cleansed building remains protected before evil can seep back in.
Sandbox_PZ_WorldUpkeepEnable_tooltip: If enabled, cleansed buildings will slowly lose their divine protection over time, becoming vulnerable to hauntings once again.
Sandbox_PackMule_BlowTorch_tooltip: Can be worn on Back Slot.
Sandbox_PackMule_BoilerSuits_tooltip: Coveralls and Boiler Suits can be worn with Jackets.
Sandbox_PackMule_Bracelet_tooltip: Can be worn with Watches (if Watch Slot is activated) and Forearm Armor.
Sandbox_PackMule_Lantern_tooltip: Can be attached to Belt Slots.
Sandbox_PackMule_MagazineArmor_tooltip: Can be researched from Crossword and Wordsearch Magazines.
Sandbox_PackMule_Penlight_tooltip: Can be attached to Webbing Slots.
Sandbox_PackMule_RepairVest_tooltip: Can repair holes on Foreman and Hunting Vests.
Sandbox_PackMule_WalletsAndPouches_toolt: Can be worn, also gives Wallets 50 weight reduction.
Sandbox_PackMule_Watch_tooltip: Can be worn with Bracelets (if Bracelet Slot is activated) and Forearm Armor.
Sandbox_PagerModTower: Pager Tower (Only Applies to Ultra Realistic)
Sandbox_PagerMod_AllowBlocking_tooltip: Lets players block a pager number so its pages never reach them. Useful against griefers in PvP.
Sandbox_PagerMod_AllowBroadcast_tooltip: Lets a player send one page to every pager on the network with the Broadcast button. Turn this off on busy servers to cut down on spam.
Sandbox_PagerMod_AllowSOS_tooltip: Enables the emergency SOS button, which pages everyone on the network at once and attaches the sender's location (unless location sharing is Off).
Sandbox_PagerMod_BatteryLife_tooltip: How long a fresh battery powers a pager before it dies and must be replaced. Measured in in-game time. Replace batteries from the pager's right-click menu using a Battery item.
Sandbox_PagerMod_BeepVolume_tooltip: How loud the pager's notification beep plays. Applies to every beep the pager makes.
Sandbox_PagerMod_FactionScope_tooltip:
Controls who can reach who.
Anyone: any pager can page any other (the default).
Same faction only: members of different factions cannot page each other, so rival groups can't eavesdrop or spam. Players who are not in a faction can always be reached.
Sandbox_PagerMod_GlobalChat_tooltip: Adds a town-wide GLOBAL tab to every pager: a shared channel anyone with a pager can read and post to, reaching everyone regardless of saved contacts or faction. It still obeys the signal mode, receive-only mode, send cooldown and per-person blocking.
Sandbox_PagerMod_Illiteracy_option3: Cannot use a pager at all
Sandbox_PagerMod_Illiteracy_tooltip:
What the Illiterate trait does to pagers.
No effect: illiterate characters use pagers normally.
Cannot read pages: page text and sender names appear as ??? for an illiterate character, and the pages they send can only contain digits, spaces and dashes - a numeric-code device. Their pager still beeps and shows numbers.
Cannot use a pager: an illiterate character cannot open a pager or a tower console at all. The pager still beeps in their pocket, and they can still set up or pack away a tower.
Sandbox_PagerMod_LocationSharing: Share your location on a page
Sandbox_PagerMod_LocationSharing_tooltip:
Whether a page can include where the sender is standing. The recipient then sees the coordinates plus distance and a compass bearing.
Off: location is never shared.
Ask each time: the sender ticks a box per page (the default).
Always on: every page carries the sender's location.
An SOS still shares location unless this is set to Off.
Sandbox_PagerMod_LogPages: Log pages to a server file
Sandbox_PagerMod_LogPages_tooltip: Appends every routed page (sender, recipient, text, delivered/queued/blocked) to PagerMod_PageLog.txt in the server's Zomboid folder. For admins/moderation.
Sandbox_PagerMod_MaxMessages_tooltip: How many pages a single pager keeps. Once it is full, the oldest page is dropped to make room for a new one.
Sandbox_PagerMod_MessageMaxLength_toolti: The longest message a player can put in one page, counted in characters.
Sandbox_PagerMod_NotifySound_tooltip: Play a beep and show an on-screen alert (with a preview of the message) whenever a new page comes in.
Sandbox_PagerMod_NumericOnly_tooltip: Pages may contain digits, spaces and dashes only - all letters are stripped out. Turns pagers into a numeric-code device.
Sandbox_PagerMod_PagerMode_tooltip:
What pagers can do.
Send and receive: normal two-way paging (the default).
Receive only: pagers can only receive pages - the compose, reply and group features are hidden.
Sandbox_PagerMod_Preset_tooltip:
Quick bundles of the options below.
Custom: nothing is overridden - every option on this page applies as you set it (the default).
Convenient: the relaxed defaults - map-wide signal, full two-way paging and every feature on.
Almost Realistic: a barely-functional pocket pager - 1 saved page, 16 characters, no location, no read receipts, no SOS, no blocking, no broadcast (still map-wide).
Ultra Realistic: everything in Almost Realistic, plus pagers can only receive (not send), and the network is map-wide only until the power dies, then needs a built, powered pager tower.
A preset overrides the matching options below.
Sandbox_PagerMod_ReadReceipts_tooltip: Notifies the sender once the person they paged has opened and read the message.
Sandbox_PagerMod_SendCooldown_tooltip: Minimum number of seconds a player must wait between sending pages. Helps stop spam and griefing on PvP servers. Set to 0 for no limit (the default).
Sandbox_PagerMod_SignalMode_tooltip:
How far pages travel.
Map-wide: pagers reach anywhere on the map (the default - pagers are your long-range tier, with walkie-talkies for medium range and voice chat up close).
Limited range: a page only arrives if the recipient is within the distance set below.
Powered tower only (after power dies): pages reach map-wide while the electricity grid is still on, but once the power goes out the network only works through a built, powered pager tower's coverage - so the pager network dies with the grid unless someone keeps a tower running on a generator.
Powered tower only: the network ALWAYS needs a built, powered pager tower in range, even while the grid is up.
Sandbox_PagerMod_SignalRange_tooltip: The reach distance in tiles (1 tile is about 1 metre), used by two signal modes: in Limited range it's the furthest a page can travel between sender and recipient; in Powered tower mode it's each tower's coverage radius (both ends of a page must be within it).
Sandbox_PagerMod_SpawnAbundance_tooltip:
How much pager loot the world has, as a multiplier on the weights pagers already carry in electronics, police, comms and vehicle containers - so they still turn up where they make sense, there are just more or fewer of them.
Vanilla (unchanged) is the default and touches no loot table at all. In Build 41, where the pager is not a vanilla item, the higher settings are also what puts it into electronics loot in the first place.
Only affects containers the world has not generated yet.
Sandbox_PagerMod_TowerComms_tooltip:
What the tower base station (000-0001) itself can do.
Send and receive: the tower can send pages and be paged - its console has an inbox.
Send only: the tower can only send pages; it cannot be paged.
Sandbox_PagerMod_TowerLimit_tooltip: The most pager towers a single player may have set up at once. Each tower is its own node with its own number and coverage circle. Set to 0 for no limit. Admins are exempt.
Sandbox_PagerMod_TowerPower_tooltip:
What a deployed pager tower needs to run (Powered tower mode).
Grid or generator: mains electricity OR a running generator nearby (the default).
Generator only: only a running, fuelled generator beside it (ignores the power grid).
None: towers always work, no power needed.
Sandbox_ParkOpenedDoorChance: Chance of open door in parking stall
Sandbox_ParkOpenedDoorChance_tooltip: Chance of an open door on a car that appeared in the parking stall.
Sandbox_ParkOpenedEngineDoorChance: Chance of an open hood in the parking stall
Sandbox_ParkOpenedEngineDoorChance_toolt: Chance of an open hood (engine cover) on a car that appeared in the parking stall.
Sandbox_ParkOpenedTrunkDoorChance: Chance of an open trunk in the parking stall
Sandbox_ParkOpenedTrunkDoorChance_toolti: Chance of an open trunk at a car that appeared in the parking stall.
Sandbox_ParkOpenedWindowChance: Chance of an open window in the parking stall
Sandbox_ParkOpenedWindowChance_tooltip: Chance of an open window at a car that appeared in the parking stall.
Sandbox_Parkour_ActionCostMultiplier_too: Scales the endurance consumed by manual Parkour mechanics.
Sandbox_Parkour_DebugLogging_tooltip: Writes selected vault, dodge, jump, and traversal diagnostics to console.txt.
Sandbox_Parkour_DodgeCostLevel10_tooltip: Dodge endurance cost as a percentage at Parkour level 10; intermediate levels are interpolated.
Sandbox_Parkour_DodgeCostLevel3_tooltip: Base Dodge endurance cost as a percentage at Parkour level 3.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableAntiFarm_tooltip: Blocks repeat XP from the same obstacle until 30 seconds pass and the player moves at least 20 tiles away.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableBackflipVault_tool: Allows Parkour_BackflipVault to be selected for a successful running vault over a low fence.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableBumpRecovery_toolt: Allows Parkour_BumpRecovery after it is unlocked.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnableCorkscrewVault_too: Allows Parkour_CorkscrewVault to be selected for a successful running vault over a low fence.

Sandbox_PerLevelCapType_option3: All upgrades allowed at minimum level
Sandbox_PerLevelCapType_tooltip: How to restrict upgrades on a per level basis - all upgrades allowed up to max upgrade amount can be performed at level 10
Sandbox_PerPlayerSearchState_tooltip: Experimental feature, disabled by default. In the default mode, search state is shared by the world: once one player fully searches a container, everyone sees it as searched. When enabled, fully searched containers are tracked separately for each character, so other players must search them themselves. This is not a full per-item per-player system; partial item reveal progress is only kept for the current session. It may increase modData and MP sync cost, and persistence or sync may be less reliable on some servers.
Sandbox_PersonalMachine_ChanceToDamageMa: Personal Sewing Machine: Machine Damage Chance Multiplier
Multiplies the base chance for the machine itself to lose condition on Personal machines (0.1–10.0). Lower = safer; higher = riskier.
Sandbox_PersonalMachine_ChanceToDamageNe: Personal Sewing Machine: Needle Damage Chance Multiplier
Multiplies the base chance to damage/break the needle on Personal machines (0.1–10.0). Lower = safer; higher = riskier.
Sandbox_PersonalMachine_FindMultiplier_t: Multiplies how often Personal sewing machines are found from loot and other sources (0.01–10.0). 1.0 = default; higher = more common; lower = rarer.
Sandbox_PersonalMachine_OilUseMultiplier: Personal Sewing Machine: Oil Use Multiplier
Scales oil consumed per operation on Personal machines (0.1–10.0). 1.0 = default; <1.0 saves oil; >1.0 uses more.
Sandbox_PersonalMachine_RequiredLevelToU: Personal Sewing Machine: Required Tailoring Level
Minimum Tailoring level required to operate a Personal machine (0–10).
Sandbox_PersonalMachine_T_EfficiencyMult: Scales work efficiency for Personal machines. Higher = faster throughput/shorter action time (0.1–10.0).

Counts deaths per account on this server and carries the total through the journal.
Records and restores accumulated Strength and Fitness XP like other skills.
Records recipes learned from reading or other unlocks and fully restores them after death.
Disables skill-XP recording and recovery without deleting existing journal records.
Stores the vanilla zombie kill count in the journal and restores the higher recorded value.

Sandbox_PhunCure_CureBite_tooltip: Injecting a valid cure will heal body part bite

Sandbox_PhunCure_CureScratch_tooltip: Injecting a valid cure will heal any scratch

Sandbox_PhunCure_DefSprinterDropRate_too: The chance out of 100 that the sprinter is packing a cure. eg 10 = 10%%, 5.5 = 5.5%%. Only applies if PhunSprinters is installed and rate differs from default
Sandbox_PhunCure_ExpiredChance_tooltip: The chance (out of 100) that the cure will already be rotten which can further increase rarity. Sandbox_PhunLewt_Debug_tooltip: Print verbose output into logs. Useful for... well, debugging
Sandbox_PhunMart_AllowWalletDrop_tooltip: If enabled, players can drop currency from their wallet as a pickupable item. Intentional drops are always pickupable by any player, regardless of the wallet pickup setting.
Sandbox_PhunMart_ChanceToConvert_tooltip: The chance that a vanilla vending machine will get converted to a random PhunMart machine. Set to 0 to disable

Sandbox_PhunMart_ChanceToDropChange_tool: The probability that a zombie will drop coins upon death.
Sandbox_PhunMart_ChangeCapCents_tooltip: Maximum cents a player can carry (9999 = $99.99). At cap, coins left on the ground will not be consumed.
Sandbox_PhunMart_Debug_tooltip: Adds more verbose logging for debugging purposes. Only use if you know what you're doing.
Sandbox_PhunMart_DefaultDistance_tooltip: The minimum distance between similarly grouped machines
Sandbox_PhunMart_DefaultHoursToRestock_t: The default number of hours between restocking a shop. 0 would mean that (by default) the shops are only ever stocked once
Sandbox_PhunMart_DefaultNumOfHoursToReRo: The default number of hours between changing the shop to a different one. 0 means shops will default to never changing

Sandbox_PhunMart_EnableChangePool_toolti: Show the change (coin) currency pool in the shop UI and wallet tab. Disabling hides it from players but does not delete balances.
Sandbox_PhunMart_EnableTokenPool_tooltip: Show the token currency pool in the shop UI and wallet tab. Disabling hides it from players but does not delete balances.
Sandbox_PhunMart_MaxCoinsToDrop_tooltip: The maximum number of cents a zombie can drop upon death.
Sandbox_PhunMart_MaxStickyItems_tooltip: Maximum number of items allowed in a sticky pool before a warning is logged. Sticky pools always show all their items in a shop. Keep this low to avoid cluttered shops.
Sandbox_PhunMart_MinCoinsToDrop_tooltip: The minimum number of cents a zombie can drop upon death.
Sandbox_PhunMart_TokenCap_tooltip: Maximum number of special tokens a player can carry.
Sandbox_PhunMart_WalletDropOnDeath_toolt: If enabled, players will drop their wallet upon death
Sandbox_PhunMart_WalletOnlyPickupOwn_too: If enabled, only the owner of a wallet can pick it up.
Sandbox_PhunMart_WalletReturnRate_toolti: The percentage of money that is returned to the player on death. 0 means no money is returned, 100 means all money is returned.
Sandbox_PhunServer_ColorUsernameText_too: The RGB values to use instead of the default 255,255,255 leave blank for default

Sandbox_PhunServer_PlayersOnMiniMap_tool: Show player positions on mini map. Requires client restart. If you want this feature in B42+, you should disable this and set MapRemotePlayerVisibility to 1 in your server ini

Sandbox_PhunServer_WipeKey_tooltip: Changing this value (as long as it isn't empty) will cause players to rewipe map on next login. A good rule of thumb here is to enter the version/season number. If a player comes back to the server and the season has changed... pop... there goes their map!

Sandbox_PhunServer_WipePerCharacter_tool: Wipes the map whenever the players character dies and they create a new one. A bit hardcore if you ask me, but you didn't did you?
Sandbox_PhunServer_WipeSymbols_tooltip: Turn this off to skip erasure of symbols even if the key changes
Sandbox_PhunServer_WorkshopPollingInterv: Number of minutes between checking for changes to workshop
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_AddToLoot_tooltip: If Always Show UI is disabled, tick this so that Military Issued sensor will appear in loot. Wearing these will show the UI. Requires restart. If you do not want any UI, disable this and the Always Show UI option
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_AlwaysShowElements: Always display the UI component in the upper right screen. Requires restart
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_DarknessLevel_tool: Adjusted light level where all sprinters will run
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_Debug_tooltip: Print verbosely (useful when diagnosing issues). Requires restart
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_Decorate_tooltip: Dress the sprinters up around the holidays (only works with certain additional mods active and installed)
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_DefaultRisk_toolti: Percentage chance of a zed being a sprinter. If you use PhunZones, this is the fallback risk level when no other value is specified by a zone (or its parent). Examples: 0 = no chance. 50 = 50%% chance and 100 = always
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_FrequencyOfEnvUpda: Number of seconds before recalculating enviromental changes like light and fog. Increase for improved performance
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_HoursDiscount_tool: The number of hours (across all characters) until risk level is fully applied. For example, if this value is 240 (10 game days) then on the fifth day of play (regardless of how many times they have died), the effective risk that a player is reduced by 50%%. Leave blank or 0 to ignore
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_MaxDistance_toolti: The maximum distance of player to zed must be to process the chance of being a sprinter (this is to improve performance trying to process zeds that are too far away)
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_MaxQueue_tooltip: The max number of zeds to update per tick
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_MinDistance_toolti: The minimum distance of player to zed must be to process the chance of being a sprinter (this is to prevent sudden popins)
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_Mode_option4: When its too dark around them ***
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_Mode_tooltip: This option governs when sprinters will run. ** = low performance impact, *** = med-high performance impact depending on population
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_MoonPhaseCrescent_: Adjust risk on nights with a crescent moon by this value. eg 50 would cut the risk by 50%% while 200 would be 200%% (double the risk). Leave blank or 0 for no adjustment.
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_MoonPhaseFull_tool: Adjust risk on nights with a full moon by this value. eg 50 would cut the risk by 50%% while 200 would be 200%% (double the risk). Leave blank or 0 for no adjustment.
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_MoonPhaseGibbous_t: Adjust risk on nights with a gibbous moon by this value. eg 50 would cut the risk by 50%% while 200 would be 200%% (double the risk). Leave blank or 0 for no adjustment.
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_MoonPhaseNew_toolt: Adjust risk on nights with a new moon by this value. eg 50 would cut the risk by 50%% while 200 would be 200%% (double the risk). Leave blank or 0 for no adjustment.
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_MoonPhaseQuarter_t: Adjust risk on nights with a first quarter moon by this value. eg 50 would cut the risk by 50%% while 200 would be 200%% (double the risk). Leave blank or 0 for no adjustment.
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_Skeletons_tooltip: All sprinters appear as Skeletons. CURRENTLY DISABLED AS BUG IN VANILLA CAN CAUSE A CLIENT CRASH WHEN AIMING AT A SKELETON
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_SlowInLight_toolti: If sprinter is running, light over your darkness level (eg a flashlight) can force them to walk (until its too dark again). Note that this is basically included in the tile based mode above
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_SprintingChangeNot: Volume of the sound that notifies players that sprinters are no longer running (eg day) or that they have now started to run (eg night or bad weather). Set to 0 to disable
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_Volume_tooltip: Volume of sprinter screech. 0 to disable
Sandbox_PhunZones_Debug_tooltip: Increase verbosity of logging to help diagnose issues. Best to leave off otherwise
Sandbox_PhunZones_EditorRole_tooltip: If set, only players whose role name matches this value (case-insensitive) can open the zone editor. Leave empty to allow all players that have access to admin/debug menu (or always allow in singleplayer).
Sandbox_PhunZones_MaxDifficulty_tooltip: Maximum number of difficulty. This is the max number of pips in your widget (default is 4)
Sandbox_PhunZones_ShowDifficulty_tooltip: Show difficulty level for zone as pips in widget. Requires Show Widget to be ticked.
Sandbox_PhunZones_UpdateInterval_tooltip: The number of seconds between scanning for zone changes. 1 should be more than fine
Sandbox_PhunZones_Widget_tooltip: Displays a moveable widget that displays the current zones title and subtitle. It can also show pips that signify the danger level for the current zone
Sandbox_PinyosShelfAware_RememberOnDeath: Your next character inherits tracked books, registered base containers and settings when you die. Turn off if a new survivor should start with a blank slate.
Sandbox_PivotMod_DefaultMultiplier: Nimble mode: base turn speed (no trait)
Sandbox_PivotMod_DefaultMultiplier_toolt: Nimble-based turning only. Starting turn-speed multiplier for characters with neither trait. 1 = vanilla turn speed.
Sandbox_PivotMod_DynDrunkenness_tooltip: Requires the master switch. The more intoxicated you are, the slower and clumsier your turn. Thematic partner to the 'Under the Influence' trait.
Sandbox_PivotMod_DynEncumbrance_tooltip: Requires the master switch. The heavier your carried weight relative to your max, the slower you turn - a full load turns at roughly half speed. Pairs naturally with Strength.
Sandbox_PivotMod_DynFatigue_tooltip: Requires the master switch. Being tired, or out of breath (low endurance), makes turning sluggish; well-rested and fresh turns are snappy.
Sandbox_PivotMod_DynInjury_tooltip: Requires the master switch. Wounds to the legs, feet or groin slow your turn; the worst affected part dominates, and a fracture there slows it much more.
Sandbox_PivotMod_DynPanic_tooltip: Requires the master switch. Panic makes you whip around faster - up to about +50%% turn speed at full panic (still capped to stay smooth).
Sandbox_PivotMod_DynSneak_tooltip: Requires the master switch. While sneaking you turn more slowly and deliberately (about 70%% speed).
Sandbox_PivotMod_DynamicModifiers_toolti: Master switch for the situational modifiers below. When OFF, none of them do anything and turning behaves exactly as set above. When ON, each modifier you enable adjusts your walking/aiming turn speed based on your character's current condition. Works with both the fixed-speed and Nimble-based systems. Turning is never fully locked, and never pushed past the smooth cap.
Sandbox_PivotMod_Enabled_tooltip: Master switch for the whole mod. When OFF, turning is left completely vanilla.
Sandbox_PivotMod_MovementTurnSpeed_toolt:
Only used when 'Use Nimble-based turning' is OFF.
How fast the character turns while walking (not aiming). Jogging and sprinting always turn at vanilla speed - the engine doesn't let mods change those.
The scale runs from Vanilla up to Instant; the in-between steps let you pick a gentler turn.
Sandbox_PivotMod_NimbleLvlMultiplier_too: Nimble-based turning only. A final multiplier applied on top of the computed turn speed. 1 = no extra change.
Sandbox_PivotMod_NimbleSystem_tooltip:
Switches the entire mod between two systems.
OFF: the fixed turn speeds set above - separate values for aiming and walking.
ON: turn speed instead scales with the Nimble skill and the multipliers below, applied to ALL turning.
Sandbox_PivotMod_OnYourToesInGameMultipl: Nimble mode: bonus when earning 'On Your Toes'
Nimble-based turning only. Extra turn speed gained when a character earns the 'On Your Toes' trait by reaching Nimble level 6.
Sandbox_PivotMod_OnYourToesMultiplier: Nimble mode: base turn speed ('On Your Toes')
Sandbox_PivotMod_OnYourToesMultiplier_to: Nimble-based turning only. Starting turn-speed multiplier for characters with the 'On Your Toes' trait. Higher = faster.
Sandbox_PivotMod_PivotSpeed_tooltip:
Only used when 'Use Nimble-based turning' is OFF.
How fast the character turns to the aim direction while in the combat stance.
The scale runs from Vanilla up to Instant; 'Instant' is as fast as the turn can go while staying smooth. The in-between steps let you pick a gentler, more gradual turn.
Sandbox_PivotMod_PodShofeInGameMultiplie: Nimble mode: bonus when losing 'Under the Influence'
Nimble-based turning only. Extra turn speed gained when a character loses the 'Under the Influence' trait at Nimble level 6.
Sandbox_PivotMod_PodShofeMultiplier: Nimble mode: base turn speed ('Under the Influence')
Sandbox_PivotMod_PodShofeMultiplier_tool: Nimble-based turning only. Starting turn-speed multiplier for characters with the 'Under the Influence' trait. Below 1 = slower than vanilla.
Sandbox_PivotMod_TraitVersion_tooltip:
When ON, the turning buff applies only to characters with the 'On Your Toes' or 'Under the Influence' trait; everyone else turns at vanilla speed.
When OFF, it applies to every player.
Sandbox_PlaneCrashMod_EnableFire_tooltip: If enabled, crash explosions will ignite fires on surrounding tiles. Disabling this leaves only structural debris and damage.
Sandbox_PlaneCrashMod_HelicopterCrashWei: Relative weight for the helicopter crash (police or medic, picked separately) being chosen for the Day 1-3 meta event. Weighed against the Plane and Jet weights - higher means more likely, 0 disables it entirely.
Sandbox_PlaneCrashMod_JetCrashWeight_too: Relative weight for the military jet crash being chosen for the Day 1-3 meta event. Weighed against the Plane and Helicopter weights - higher means more likely, 0 disables it entirely.
Sandbox_PlaneCrashMod_MetaCrashChance_to: Percentage chance (0-100%%) for a random plane, jet, or helicopter crash to spawn between Day 1 and Day 3.
Sandbox_PlaneCrashMod_PassengerZombies_t: The total number of passenger zombies spawned along the plane crash path.
Sandbox_PlaneCrashMod_PlaneCrashWeight_t: Relative weight for the plane crash being chosen for the Day 1-3 meta event. Weighed against the Jet and Helicopter weights below - higher means more likely, 0 disables it entirely.
Sandbox_PlayJingle_tooltip: Whether to play a short jingle on upgrade

Sandbox_PlayablePool_UnhappinessReliefPe: Optional unhappiness reduction after a valid pool shot or minigame turn. Leave at 0 to disable.

Sandbox_PocketKitten_ReduceStress_toolti: The amount of stress reduced every hour when kittens are equipped. Set to 0 to disable.

Sandbox_ProjectRVFix_EnableCabinClimateC: Respect vehicle Heater/AC for cabin temperature

When on, RV interior temperature follows the vehicle's own Heater part (if installed, switched on, and powered) instead of raw outdoor weather - so an unheated cabin in a heatwave or blizzard is NOT protected. When off, this mod applies no temperature correction at all inside RV interiors (full outdoor weather, same as vanilla PROJECT RV Interior). Wetness (rain) is always blocked either way - it isn't part of climate control, the cabin just physically has a roof.
