Sandbox_ProjectResurgence_MinimumFacilit: Approximate indoor room area required before a building can produce a carrier.
Small clinics and isolated military buildings are excluded below this value.
Sandbox_ProjectResurgence_OutdoorCarrier: New zombies spawning outdoors can become wandering hazmat carriers. The default of 5 means an average of one carrier per 2,000 outdoor zombies. Set to 10,000 for guaranteed testing.
Sandbox_ProjectResurgence_ReactionSeveri: Scales reaction duration and the serum's direct-health damage budget. Serum damage still respects its safety floor.
Sandbox_PropaneExchangeCabinet_FillWeigh: Relative weight for a tank being near-empty (0%%-20%%).
Relative weight for a tank being near-full (90%%-100%%). Weighted against the near-empty weight. Tanks are never in the 20%%-90%% range.
Sandbox_PropaneExchangeCabinet_MagazineC: Chance that a stocked propane cabinet includes the recipe-teaching magazine (Welder Special Edition). 0 = never, 100 = always -- subject to the one-per-save limit below, if enabled.
Sandbox_PropaneExchangeCabinet_MagazineO: Limit magazine to one per save

If enabled, the magazine stops dropping after the first copy is found on this save (not per player -- see mod notes for the multiplayer caveat). If disabled, it can drop repeatedly at the chance above.
Sandbox_PropaneExchangeCabinet_MaxTanks_: Upper limit on how many propane tanks a spawned cabinet is stocked with (actual count is random from 0 to this).
Sandbox_PropaneExchangeCabinet_RemoveNew: Remove [New - ultra white] cabinets from spawn list
If selected only weathered cabinets will spawn, existing cabinets are not affected.
Sandbox_PropaneExchangeCabinet_SpawnChan: Chance that a propane exchange cabinet spawns at each eligible location (Fossoil/Gas2Go gas stations, Zippee's convenience stores). Rolled ONCE per station per save - a station that rolls empty stays empty on that save. 0 = never, 100 = always.
Sandbox_PropaneRefuel_AllowBlowTorch_too:
If enabled, welding torches can be filled directly at gas pumps.
Disable to keep welding fuel loot-only, so metalworking still depends on finding propane tanks.
Sandbox_PropaneRefuel_AllowIndustrialTan:
If enabled, the large static propane tanks already on the map become working propane stores you can draw from and pour into.
Disable to leave them as scenery.
Sandbox_PropaneRefuel_AllowPropaneBottle:
If enabled, propane lantern bottles can be filled at gas pumps, making propane lanterns a renewable light source.
Disable to keep lantern fuel loot-only.
Sandbox_PropaneRefuel_AllowPropaneTruck_:
If enabled, propane tanker trucks added by other vehicle mods carry their own propane reserve you can fill from.
Has no effect unless such a mod is installed.
Sandbox_PropaneRefuel_AllowTankerRefill_:
If enabled, a tanker parked at a working pump can be filled from it, making it a mobile propane store you can drive away and refill later.
Disable to make each tanker a one-time find that never refills.
Sandbox_PropaneRefuel_BlowTorchCost_tool:
How much fuel a gas pump uses to fill an empty welding torch.
Welding torches gate most metalworking, so this decides how much building a single pump is worth.
Sandbox_PropaneRefuel_IndustrialTankCapa:
How much propane an industrial tank can hold in total, including what you pour into it.
At the default 1000 a full tank is worth fifty propane tanks.
Sandbox_PropaneRefuel_IndustrialTankSpaw:
Most propane an industrial tank can be discovered holding. Each tank gets its own amount between the two, so they are not all the same.
Capped by the tank's capacity.

Least propane an industrial tank can be discovered holding.
At 0 some tanks are found empty.
Sandbox_PropaneRefuel_PropaneBottleCost_:
How much fuel a gas pump uses to fill an empty propane lantern bottle.
A full pump holds 100.
Sandbox_PropaneRefuel_PropaneTankCost_to:
How much fuel a gas pump uses to fill an empty propane tank.
A full pump holds 100, so at the default of 20 each pump is worth five tanks. Raise it to make propane scarcer.
Sandbox_PropaneRefuel_PropaneTruckReserv:
How much propane a tanker can hold, and the most it can be found carrying. Each truck is found with a random amount up to this.
At the default 200 a full tanker is worth ten propane tanks.

Least propane a tanker can be found carrying.
At 0 some tankers are found already empty.
Sandbox_ProtectConversations_tooltip: Non-urgent one-off lines wait briefly instead of cutting off active conversations.
Sandbox_ProteinsMoodle_EnableAtMaxStreng: Even disabled, the worse moodle could be visible if your proteins are so low your recovery modifier is reduced.
Sandbox_ProteinsMoodle_EnableOutOfHealth: Even disabled, the worse moodle could be visible if your proteins are so low your recovery modifier is reduced.
Sandbox_ProteinsMoodle_ShowProteinValue_: Show protein value in the moodle tooltip.
Sandbox_PryNoiseMultiplier_tooltip: Scales noise generated by prying. Higher values attract more zombies.
Sandbox_PrySuccessMultiplier_tooltip: Scales pry success chance. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = double chance, 0.5 = half chance.
Sandbox_PseudoReflectedLight_EnableDebug: Enables the debug tuning options below. When this is off, the default values are used.
Sandbox_PseudoReflectedLight_EnableMinim: Turns the guaranteed weak fallback reflection on or off to soften dark gaps near walls.
Sandbox_PseudoReflectedLight_EnablePseud: Turn this off to disable the extra bounce light and compare against vanilla lighting.
Sandbox_PseudoReflectedLight_MinimumRefl: Sets how close to a wall the guaranteed weak reflection starts to appear. Smaller values mean you must be closer before the fallback begins.
Adjusts the guaranteed weak reflection used near walls to soften dark gaps during close-range rotation. 0.0 disables it. Higher values make the fallback much easier to notice.
Sandbox_PseudoReflectedLight_ReflectionD: Sets how many tiles ahead a wall or closed door can still generate pseudo reflected light.
Sandbox_PseudoReflectedLight_ReflectionS: Adjusts the pseudo reflected light brightness multiplier. 1.0 is the default strength.
Sandbox_PseudoReflectedLight_ReflectionW: Adjusts how much weak lights shift the pseudo reflection toward a warmer color. 0.0 disables the warmth shift. 1.0 is the default, and higher values allow much stronger tinting.
Sandbox_PuffinsPosters_EnableCars_toolti: Allows car posters to appear in automotive businesses and with a 40%% chance in residential garages. Car posters do not spawn in poster bins.
Sandbox_PuffinsPosters_EnableComics_tool: Allows comic book posters to appear in poster bins and other loot locations.
Sandbox_PuffinsPosters_EnableGames_toolt: Allows video game and arcade posters to appear in poster bins and other loot locations.
Sandbox_PuffinsPosters_EnableIconic_tool: Allows iconic cultural and historical posters to appear in poster bins and other loot locations.
Sandbox_PuffinsPosters_EnableMovies_tool: Allows movie posters to appear in poster bins and other loot locations.
Sandbox_PuffinsPosters_EnableMusic_toolt: Allows music posters to appear in poster bins and other loot locations.
Sandbox_PuffinsPosters_EnablePinUps_tool: Allows pin-up posters to appear in military locations, automotive shops, and as occasional residential-garage finds. Pin-up posters do not spawn in poster bins.
Sandbox_PuffinsPosters_EnableSports_tool: Allows sports posters to appear in Sports-only poster bins in sporting-goods stores, ordinary containers in non-store sports facilities, and rarely in bedroom containers.
Sandbox_PurgeDistance_tooltip: This is how far the decimator will, well, decimate zombies. It only runs once when you spawn.
Sandbox_PurgeOnSpawn_tooltip: Enable this so you don't immediately die because you spawned next to a zombie hidden next to the trees
Sandbox_PushBackInc_tooltip: If selected, the %% increase to melee and firearm stun ability
Sandbox_PushCar_enduranceHitValue_toolti: The lower the value, the less endurance is consumed
Sandbox_PushVehicle_AllowSidePushing_too: Allow vehicles to be turned by pushing near the front or rear section of either side. Disable this to restrict Push Vehicle to front and rear pushing only.
Sandbox_QoLC_AdrenalineBoostSpeed_toolti: How quickly panic wakes the character up. Higher sheds the Tired debuff sooner.
Sandbox_QoLC_AdrenalineCrashPenalty_tool: How much extra fatigue is paid back on top of what adrenaline borrowed.
Sandbox_QoLC_AdrenalineCrashSpeed_toolti: How quickly drowsiness returns once the character calms down.
Sandbox_QoLC_AdrenalineEnabled_tooltip: Panic temporarily takes fatigue off the character, hiding the Tired debuff until they calm down.
Sandbox_QoLC_AlarmHouseRule_tooltip: Stops a house alarm sounding for a house anyone could already have walked into. Unlocked doors covers many more houses than open ones, since vanilla leaves most exterior doors unlocked.
Sandbox_QoLC_AlarmVehiclesEnabled_toolti: Stops a car alarm sounding when a door or the trunk was left unlocked, a door or window stands open, or a window has been smashed out.
Sandbox_QoLC_BlowtorchEnabled_tooltip: A torch holds 16 uses instead of 10, and a propane tank refills it 30 times instead of about 7. Off restores the vanilla numbers.
Sandbox_QoLC_LockpickingEnabled_tooltip: Adds lockpicks, hairpins to make them from, and two manuals to learn from. Pick a locked door with a screwdriver and a pick, or force a door or window with a crowbar. The base game has no lockpicking at all.
Sandbox_QoLC_NutritionistMagEnabled_tool: Adds a magazine that teaches the Nutritionist trait, putting nutrition on the food the base game keeps quiet about: fresh produce, meat, foraged food and anything you cook. Tinned and boxed food already shows its label to anyone. It spawns wherever cooking magazines do, at half their odds.
Sandbox_QoLC_PropanePumpCost_tooltip: Fuel drawn from a pump to fill one propane tank. A jerry can holds 10, a pump holds 22000.
Sandbox_QoLC_PropanePumpEnabled_tooltip: Refill a propane tank at a working fuel pump. The base game has no other way to refill one, so turning this off restores a hard ceiling on welding.
Sandbox_QoLC_ReadingCalmEnabled_tooltip: Reading a skill book slowly eases boredom, unhappiness and stress. The base game gives skill books no morale value at all, only comics and newspapers.
Sandbox_QoLC_ReadingCalmRate_tooltip: Percentage of the effect a page of a skill book is worth. Illness weakens it, and a fast reader gets less per page because they turn more of them.
Sandbox_QoLC_SleepRecoveryEnabled_toolti: Boredom and unhappiness fall while a character sleeps. The base game freezes both instead, so a night changes neither.
Sandbox_QoLC_SleepRecoveryRate_tooltip: Percentage of what a night's sleep is worth. At the default an eight hour night clears boredom and takes a quarter off unhappiness.
Sandbox_QoLC_SlingEnabled_tooltip: Wear a rifle or other long weapon on a sling. Off stops them spawning in loot and on dead soldiers. The recipe stays available, and slings already owned keep working.
Sandbox_QoLC_TailoringCutXpEnabled_toolt: Cutting a garment into strips teaches tailoring, and cutting gets quicker as the skill rises. Vanilla pays nothing for either.
Sandbox_QoLC_TailoringCutXp_tooltip: Percentage of the experience a cut garment is worth. Denim and leather pay per strip, cotton pays nothing, uniforms pay a bonus on top.
Sandbox_QuickSawLog_SpeedMultiplier_tool: Multiplies the speed of Saw Log. Vanilla is 1x; default is 4x.
Sandbox_RANBRates: Rain's Axes & Blades Extra Spawn Rates
Sandbox_RB_SleepingBagRunSpeedModifier: Sleeping Bag Backpack run speed modifier
Sandbox_RET_LTS_AllowProne_tooltip: Enable Prone position, disable this option if you want to use another mod that implements this position (compatibility not guaranteed), Default: enabled.
Sandbox_RET_LTS_CrouchAimBonus_tooltip: Aim Bonus while in Crouching position.
Sandbox_RET_LTS_EnduraceUseWhenAccelerat: Pressing <Run/Sprint + Getting Up/Down> to get up faster will consume this energy in exchange for increasing speed, a higher value will increase energy used.
Sandbox_RET_LTS_ProneAimBonus_tooltip: Aim Bonus while in Prone position.
Sandbox_RET_LTS_VelocityPercentAccelerat: Pressing <Run/Sprint + Getting Up/Down> will increase speed in exchange for increased effort.
Sandbox_RET_LTS_VelocityPercent_tooltip: Base Speed when Getting Up/Down in Prone position, a higher value increases the speed.
Sandbox_RGM_AttachedWeaponsChanceMultipl:
For weapons attached to zombies.
Higher = bigger chance of a modifier on zombie weapons.
Sandbox_RGM_ChanceMultiplierForCraftedIt:
Applies to all crafted items: weapons, bags, clothing, footwear.
Set to 0 to disable modifiers on crafted items.
Sandbox_RGM_ClothingModifiers_tooltip:
Enable random modifiers on all wearable items and bags: clothing, shoes, boots and backpacks.
Affects: combat speed, defense, noise, run speed, bag capacity and weight reduction.
Sandbox_RGM_ClothingXPModifiers_tooltip:
Enable XP bonus modifiers on profession-themed clothing (doctor coat, military uniform, mechanic coveralls, etc.).
Legendary-only: +50%% XP for the matching skill while worn.
Requires Clothing Modifiers to be enabled for new items to receive this bonus.
Sandbox_RGM_DynamicTinkerer_tooltip: Unlocked when Maintenance + Tinkering >= 8 and 15 epic+ modifiers have been tinkered.
Sandbox_RGM_IgnoreIrrelevantWeapons_tool: Modifiers won't apply to: pens, spoons, forks, fishing rods, cooking pans, planks, metal bars, metal pipes.
Sandbox_RGM_ItemsTinkerable_tooltip:
Allow tinkering on all item types: melee weapons, ranged weapons, bags and clothing.
Disable to remove the tinkering option entirely.
Sandbox_RGM_PeakRarityTweaker_tooltip:
Lower = higher chance of better modifiers.
Higher = higher chance of bad modifiers.

WARNING: 0 = ALL modifiers are LEGENDARY rarity.
Sandbox_RGM_RangedWeaponsChanceMultiplie:
For all firearms.
Higher = bigger chance of a modifier on ranged weapons.
Sandbox_RGM_StartRarityTweaker_tooltip:
Lower = higher chance of better modifiers.
Higher = higher chance of bad modifiers.

WARNING: 0 = ALL modifiers are LEGENDARY rarity.
Sandbox_RGM_TinkerCost_tooltip: Number of items consumed per tinkering action.
Sandbox_RHCR_Use_Isometric: View Hair Preview in Isometric View
Sandbox_RHCR_Use_Isometric_tooltip: Top-down view like in Project Zomboid's game screen. <LINE>If unchecked, shows the front view of the character. <LINE>Requires the 'Open New Window' option to be checked.
Sandbox_RHCR_Use_PreviewWindow_tooltip: If checked, opening a new preview window when changing hair. <LINE>If unchecked, the preview will be shown in the status window.
Sandbox_RSWaterCistern_AllowAnyFluidInWa: Allow any fluid in water tanks
Allows water tanks to store one fluid type at a time from fluid containers. Water pump actions still only handle water.
Sandbox_RSWaterCistern_AllowDrinkFromTan: Allows players to drink directly from water tank trucks.
Sandbox_RSWaterCistern_AllowEmptyTank_to: Allows players to dump a tank's water onto the ground from the vehicle menu.
Sandbox_RSWaterCistern_FilterDamageMulti: Percent wear applied to water filters when filtering tank water. 0 disables filter wear.
Sandbox_RSWaterCistern_FuelTransferSpeed: Percent speed for refueling, filling gas cans and transferring gasoline to/from fuel tankers. 200 makes fuel tankers fill twice as fast as water tanks.
Sandbox_RSWaterCistern_PumpSpeedMultipli: Percent speed for filling, emptying and pumping water. 100 keeps the default timing.
Sandbox_RSWaterCistern_ShowDetailedToolt: Adds transfer previews, output quality and after-action amounts to water tank tooltips.
Sandbox_RVAddon_Custom3x2Caravan_tooltip: Comma-separated list of 3x2 caravan/trailer script names.
Sandbox_RVAddon_Custom3x6Caravan_tooltip: Comma-separated list of 3x6 caravan/trailer script names.
Sandbox_RVAddon_Custom3x7Empty_tooltip: Comma-separated list of 3x7 empty trailer script names.
Sandbox_RVAddon_Custom4x12colossal_toolt: Comma-separated list of 4x12 colossal vehicle script names.
Sandbox_RVAddon_CustomBusVehicles_toolti: Comma-separated list of bus vehicle script names.
Sandbox_RVAddon_CustomNormalVehicles_too: Comma-separated list of vehicle script names (e.g., Base.Van,Base.StepVan,Base.VanSpiffo).
Sandbox_RVAddon_CustomSmallVehicles_tool: Comma-separated list of small vehicle script names.
Sandbox_RVD_DealershipExclusive_tooltip: Remove motorhomes and camper/travel trailers from every non-dealership vehicle spawn zone across the whole map — the dealerships become the only camper source in the world. Utility trailers and ordinary cars are unaffected. Applies to areas generated after enabling; already-visited areas keep what they spawned. Off by default.
Sandbox_RVD_GuaranteedSpawns_tooltip: Spawn the guaranteed display and yard vehicles at each dealership. Turn off for empty-lot starts; the random lot stock below still applies.
Sandbox_RVD_MotorhomeWeight_tooltip: Relative chance of motorhomes in the random lot stock. Weights are compared against each other; 0 disables the category.
Sandbox_RVD_PlainCarWeight_tooltip: Relative chance of ordinary staff/customer cars in the random lot stock. 0 disables the category.
Sandbox_RVD_RosewoodStock_tooltip: What this dealership sells. Affects both the guaranteed vehicles and the random lot stock. Display slots without eligible stock stay empty.
Sandbox_RVD_Route144Stock_tooltip: What the Route 144 Campers lot stocks. Affects both the guaranteed vehicles and the random lot stock. Curated only limits the lot to the hand-picked curated models (no auto-detected mod vehicles).
Sandbox_RVD_TrailerWeight_tooltip: Relative chance of campers and travel trailers in the random lot stock. 0 disables the category.
Sandbox_RVD_UtilityWeight_tooltip: Relative chance of utility/flatbed trailers in the random lot stock. 0 disables the category.
Sandbox_RVD_ZoneSpawnRate_tooltip: Base chance that each dealership parking stall spawns a vehicle. Vanilla parking lots use 16. Default 40 makes the lot look stocked.
Sandbox_RVInterior_AbandonedInteriorReal: Days unvisited before abandoned RV cleanup list (real-life days)

Number of real-world calendar days since last entry before an RV interior appears in Manage abandoned interiors. Default: 21. This uses the server or host wall clock; game-time speed, sleeping and restored world clocks do not affect it.
Sandbox_RVInterior_NotWhenChased_tooltip: Zombies currently chasing the player will prevent them from entering vehicle interiors, no matter the distance.
Sandbox_RVInterior_PowerBankConsumptionM: RV Power Bank: power usage multiplier
Scales battery drain from powered RV interiors, including unloaded-interior catch-up. 0 disables drain, 0.5 halves it, 1 is normal, and 2 doubles it. Default: 1.
Sandbox_RVInterior_PowerBankElectricalSk: Electrical level required to build an RV Power Bank. Default: 5. Set to 0 to remove this skill requirement.
Sandbox_RVInterior_PowerBankElectricalWi: Electrical wire consumed by construction. Default: 25.
Sandbox_RVInterior_PowerBankGreenLightBu: RV Power Bank: green light bulbs
Green light bulbs consumed by construction. Default: 1.
Sandbox_RVInterior_PowerBankMetalBars_to: Metal bars consumed by construction. Default: 4.
Sandbox_RVInterior_PowerBankMetalPlates_: Metal plates consumed by construction. Default: 25.
Sandbox_RVInterior_PowerBankMetalworking: Metalworking level required to build an RV Power Bank. Default: 4. Set to 0 to remove this skill requirement.
Sandbox_RVInterior_PowerBankRedLightBulb: RV Power Bank: red light bulbs
Red light bulbs consumed by construction. Default: 1.
Sandbox_RVInterior_PowerBankTorchChargeU: Propane-torch charge units consumed by construction. A full torch contains 10. The physical torch is still required at 0.
Sandbox_RVInterior_SafeZombieDistance_to: Zombies this distance or closer to a player will prevent them from entering vehicle interiors (0 = disabled).
Sandbox_RVInterior_SpawnStarterPowerBank: Spawn starter Power Banks inside RVs

When enabled, newly initialized RV interiors receive their automatic starter Power Bank and battery. Disable this to prevent automatic starter banks. Existing banks, crafted banks, loot spawns and player-installed banks are unchanged. Default: enabled.
Sandbox_RadiationZones_EnableBrandenburg: Enables or disables radiation between Brandenburg and Irvington.
Enables or disables radiation in Brandenburg.
Sandbox_RadiationZones_EnableEchoCreek_t: Enables or disables radiation in Echo Creek.
Sandbox_RadiationZones_EnableLouisville_: Enables or disables radiation in Louisville.
Sandbox_RadiationZones_EnableRiverside_t: Enables or disables radiation in Riverside.
Sandbox_RadiationZones_EnableRosewood_to: Enables or disables radiation in Rosewood.
Sandbox_RadioCommands_tooltip: Adds long-range commands on matching powered radios.
Sandbox_RainCleansBlood_AlsoCleanAsh_too: Also clean ash left behind by burned corpses.
Sandbox_RainCleansBlood_AlsoCleanClothes: Also gradually clean blood and dirt from players' worn clothing.
Sandbox_RainCleansBlood_AlsoCleanDroppin: Also clean animal droppings (dung) left on the ground.
Sandbox_RainCleansBlood_AlsoCleanVehicle: Also gradually clean blood from vehicles.
Sandbox_RainCleansBlood_ClothesCleanSpee: How much blood and dirt to remove from clothing per minute.
Sandbox_RainCleansBlood_TilesPerMinute_t: How many random tiles to clean per in-game minute.
Sandbox_RainCleansBlood_VehicleCleanSpee: How much blood to remove from vehicles per minute.
Sandbox_RainCleansBlood_WeatherThreshold: How heavy the rain or snow must be before blood starts washing away. Higher = needs heavier weather.
Sandbox_RainCleanseSpeedFactor_tooltip: Global multiplier on how fast blood and dirt fade from skin, clothing, weapons, bags, and vehicles. 1.0 is the calibrated baseline. Default 1.0.
Sandbox_RainCleanseTilesPerTick: Rain Cleanse: tiles scanned per tick
Sandbox_RainCleanseTilesPerTick_tooltip: How many random outdoor ground tiles are checked for blood each game tick. Higher = a heavy storm clears blood faster but costs more CPU. Range 1-32. Default 8.
Sandbox_RainingZombies_AudioVisualPolish: If checked, falling bodies will trigger bone-breaking audio and paint the pavement with blood based on how far they fell.
Sandbox_RainingZombies_CrawlerConversion: If checked, falling zombies that survive a 2 floor impact, or more, will become crawlers.
Sandbox_RainingZombies_FallDamageReducti: How much health zombies recover after hitting the ground. 100 = completely immune to fall damage. 0 = they take full vanilla fall damage.
Sandbox_RainingZombies_HordeThrottle_too: Controls the flow of falling zombies to protect CPU performance. 15 frames is recommended. Lower numbers create a faster waterfall effect but require a stronger processor.
Sandbox_RainingZombies_InstantGlassShatt: If checked, zombies pushed against closed windows will instantly shatter the glass and fall through. If unchecked, they will get stuck until the glass is broken normally.
Sandbox_RainingZombies_PlayerDamagePerFl: Calculates how much health damage a player takes when crushed. The number is multiplied by the height of the fall. (Default 20 damage x 3 floors = 60 total damage).
Sandbox_RainingZombies_PlayerFractures_t: If checked, zombies falling from high altitudes will cause fractures to the player on impact. Drops from higher floors cause multiple fractures. Limbs are randomly selected to fracture.
Sandbox_RainingZombies_PlayerKnockdown_t: If checked, players will be knocked down if a falling zombie lands directly on their tile.
Sandbox_RainingZombies_ZombieChainReacti: If checked, falling zombies will physically crash into zombies on the street, knocking them down
Sandbox_RallyRequirePencil_tooltip: When ON, setting and sharing a rally point requires a pencil or pen in your inventory. The waypoint is auto-erased on arrival, so eraser is not separately required.
Sandbox_RandomAirdrops_AirdropConsoleDeb: Print console debugging for coordinates airdrops when spawn, disabling that you cannot know in server-console.txt when and where the airdrop spawned.
Print console debugging for cache airdrops.
Sandbox_RandomAirdrops_AirdropDisableDes: Removes the despawn in game hours system for airdrops.
Sandbox_RandomAirdrops_AirdropDisableOld: Disables the despawn all airdrops system when the server/game start.
Sandbox_RandomAirdrops_AirdropExplosionP: Power of the removal effect (1 = normal, 200 = maximum). Affects quantity and radius of spawned effects.
Sandbox_RandomAirdrops_AirdropExplosionT:
Effect when airdrop is automatically removed:
• None - no effect
• Explosion - explosion with sound
• Zombies - spawn zombies around
• Animals - spawn aggressive animals
Sandbox_RandomAirdrops_AirdropFrequency_: Chance to spawn any airdrop every in game hour. Spawns only once a day.
Sandbox_RandomAirdrops_AirdropMinHoursBe: Rate limit: 1 = at most once per hour, 24 = once per day.
Sandbox_RandomAirdrops_AirdropNearPlayer: Probability (in %%) that the airdrop will spawn near the player instead of default locations.
Maximum distance (in tiles) from the player to spawn the airdrop.
Minimal distance (in tiles) from the player to spawn the airdrop.
If enabled, the airdrop may spawn near the player at random coordinates within specified radius.
Sandbox_RandomAirdrops_AirdropProgressiv: Multiplier for changing the interval between airdrops. 0 = no progression, positive values = less frequent over time, negative = more frequent. Range: -5.0 to +5.0. Limits: minimum 1 hour, maximum 1 year.
Sandbox_RandomAirdrops_AirdropRemovalTim: In game hours until airdrop despawn
Sandbox_RandomAirdrops_AirdropTickCheck_: This is the most performance important variable, impacts in how many ticks the server will WAIT to check player in area to spawn/olddespawn the airdrop (the airdrop doesnt spawn if player is not rendering it).
Sandbox_RandomAirdrops_DefaultAirdropCoo:
If enabled - mod will use default coordinates table;
If disabled - it will use AirdropPosition.ini in lua folder of Zomboid.
How to make custom spawn locations - read in mod description.
Sandbox_RandomAirdrops_DefaultAirdropLoo:
If enabled - mod will use default loot table;
If disabled - it will use AirdropLootTable.ini in lua folder of Zomboid.
How to make custom loot table - read in mod description.
Sandbox_RandomAirdrops_EnableDropLight_t:
Visual effect at the drop site:
• None - no effect
• Fire - fire with lighting (2 hours)
• Smoke - smoke without lighting (2 hours)
• Smoke + Fire - both effects

Warning: Smoke may not work correctly in Build 42
Sandbox_RandomAirdrops_EnableDropZone_to: If enabled, draw a highlighted area around the landing site.
Sandbox_RandomAirdrops_EnableMapMarker: Show exact drop point on map
Sandbox_RandomAirdrops_EnableMapMarker_t: If enabled, draw a marker at the precise landing point.
Sandbox_RandomAirdrops_LootQuantityMulti: Multiplier for the quantity of items in airdrops (0.1 to 10.0, default 1.0). Affects both the number of items and their quantities.
Sandbox_RandomAirdrops_RadioBeaconEnable:
Enables radio beacon that beeps when player is near active airdrop.
Beep frequency increases as player gets closer.
Sandbox_RandomAirdrops_RadioFrequency_to:
Fixed radio frequency (88000-108000 kHz).
Only if Random Frequency is disabled.
Sandbox_RandomAirdrops_RadioUseRandomFre:
Radio broadcasts on random frequency 88-108 MHz.
If disabled, uses fixed frequency.
Sandbox_RandomDurationFlag_tooltip: If enabled, the different phases will be assigned a random value within the ranges below.
Sandbox_RankingsAllowAnonymousView_toolt: When ON, all players can open the rankings window. When OFF, only admins (access level Admin or Moderator) can view it.
Sandbox_RankingsHistoryGraphBuckets_tool: Number of recent days shown on the per-player kill timeline graph. Cannot exceed retention.
Sandbox_RankingsRetentionDays_tooltip: How many days of daily history to keep per player. Older buckets are pruned. Larger values use more save space.
Sandbox_RankingsTrackPvP_tooltip: When ON, player kills (PvP) are tracked separately from zombie kills. Default OFF for PvE servers.
Sandbox_RarityThreads_AllowDrawbacks_too: Common, Uncommon and Rare clothing can roll one minor drawback between -1%% and -5%%. Super Rare and higher items never roll drawbacks.
Sandbox_RarityThreads_DebugLogging_toolt: Write rarity rolls, reapplication and player-effect diagnostics to console.txt. Keep disabled for normal play.
Sandbox_RarityThreads_EnableCommonTier_t: When disabled, newly rolled clothing cannot be Common. Existing items keep their permanent tier. At least one tier should remain enabled; Common is used as a fail-safe if every tier is disabled.
Sandbox_RarityThreads_EnableLegendaryTie: When disabled, newly rolled clothing cannot be Legendary. Existing items keep their permanent tier. At least one tier should remain enabled; Common is used as a fail-safe if every tier is disabled.
Sandbox_RarityThreads_EnableMythicalTier: When disabled, newly rolled clothing cannot be Mythical. Existing items keep their permanent tier. At least one tier should remain enabled; Common is used as a fail-safe if every tier is disabled.
Sandbox_RarityThreads_EnableRareTier_too: When disabled, newly rolled clothing cannot be Rare. Existing items keep their permanent tier. At least one tier should remain enabled; Common is used as a fail-safe if every tier is disabled.
Sandbox_RarityThreads_EnableSuperRareTie: When disabled, newly rolled clothing cannot be Super Rare. Existing items keep their permanent tier. At least one tier should remain enabled; Common is used as a fail-safe if every tier is disabled.
Sandbox_RarityThreads_EnableUncommonTier: When disabled, newly rolled clothing cannot be Uncommon. Existing items keep their permanent tier. At least one tier should remain enabled; Common is used as a fail-safe if every tier is disabled.
Sandbox_RarityThreads_EnableVirtualStami: Mythical Deep Reserves can absorb endurance loss using a hidden reserve above the normal stamina bar. The reserve is capped at 50%% of normal stamina.
Sandbox_RarityThreads_RarityMultiplier_t: Multiplies the relative chance of Super Rare, Legendary and Mythical clothing. Common loot is reduced to keep the total at 100%%. Default: 1.0.
Sandbox_RarityThreads_RollExistingInvent: Give a permanent rarity roll to eligible clothing already carried by a player or later created by crafting and other mods. Disable this to affect newly generated loot and zombie clothing only.
Sandbox_RasProfessions_ModdedSpawnPoints: When enabled, all professions will spawn at locations defined by the mod. Disable to use the vanilla spawn points. In multiplayer, this option is always disabled no matter how you choose your sandbox settings.
Sandbox_RasProfessions_OverhaulVanillaPr: When disabled, the mod won't change any stats for the vanilla professions and it won't give them any starting equipment. Starting locations or clothing are not affected by the setting. Recommended to disable when playing with other mods changing vanilla professions.

Sandbox_ReactiveSEBehavior_PassiveStyleD: Days without killing zombies required to consider the player passive

Sandbox_ReactiveSERadio_EnableRadioFeatu: Enable the Knox Relay radio station that broadcasts scene locations and survival stories

Sandbox_ReactiveSEScenes_EnableGunshotSc: Generate single corpse when gunshot sounds occur
Sandbox_ReactiveSEScenes_EnableSceneSpaw: Notify the player when a scene spawns nearby
Sandbox_ReactiveSEScenes_EnableScreamSce: Generate corpse when scream sounds occur
Sandbox_ReactiveSEScenes_EnableVehicleCr: Spawn crashed vehicles when crash sounds occur
Sandbox_ReactiveSEScenes_EnableZombieSce: Spawn zombie groups when zombie sounds occur
Sandbox_ReactiveSEScenes_EventSceneChanc: Chance for a sound event to generate a scene
Sandbox_ReactiveSEScenes_SceneCleanupHou: Hours before generated scenes are automatically cleaned up (0 = disabled)
Sandbox_ReactiveSEScenes_SceneSpawnNotif: Show the directional marker when a scene spawns nearby
Player says something when a scene spawns nearby
Sandbox_ReactiveSEScenes_ScreamZombieCou: Maximum zombies that may spawn with scream scenes (0 = disabled)
Sandbox_ReactiveSEScenes_VehicleKeyChanc: Chance that a spawned vehicle contains its key
Sandbox_ReactiveSEScenes_VehicleMaxCondi: Maximum condition of vehicles spawned in scenes
Sandbox_ReactiveSEScenes_ZombieSceneMax_: Maximum number of zombies spawned in a Zombie event
Sandbox_ReactiveSEScenes_ZombieSceneMin_: Minimum number of zombies spawned in a Zombie event

Sandbox_ReactiveSE_EnableDebugMode_toolt: [DEV] Enables debug logging and visual helpers
Sandbox_ReactiveSE_EnableZombieHearing_t: Allow zombies to react to sound events
Sandbox_ReactiveSE_EventChance_tooltip: Probability of an event per 10-MINUTE CHECK after minimum cooldown
Sandbox_ReactiveSE_FarDistanceChance_too: Probability an event spawns at far range
Sandbox_ReactiveSE_FlatProbability_toolt: If enabled, probability stays flat. If disabled, probability increases until max cooldown (legacy)
Sandbox_ReactiveSE_MaxEventCooldown_tool: Maximum IN-GAME HOURS before an event is guaranteed
Sandbox_ReactiveSE_MaxSoundRange_tooltip: Maximum distance (in tiles) from the player where sound events can spawn
Sandbox_ReactiveSE_MediumDistanceChance_: Probability an event spawns at medium range

Sandbox_ReactiveSE_MinSoundRange_tooltip: Minimum distance (in tiles) from the player where sound events can spawn
Sandbox_ReactiveSE_ReactionThresholdRang: If a sound occurs within this distance, the player may panic or wake up. Sounds beyond this range will only be heard

Sandbox_ReadingReworked_AllowWalkingRead: Allows the character to continue reading while walking.
Sandbox_ReadingReworked_Debug_tooltip: Enables Reading Reworked debug output in the console.
Sandbox_ReadingReworked_FastReaderTime_t: Sets the reading time for a 220-page book when the character has the Fast Reader trait, in seconds.
Sandbox_ReadingReworked_NormalReadingTim: Sets the base reading time for a 220-page book, in seconds.
Sandbox_ReadingReworked_ReadingGlassesMu: Multiplies reading time when wearing reading glasses. Lower values make reading faster.
Sandbox_ReadingReworked_SittingMultiplie: Multiplies reading time while sitting. Lower values make reading faster.
Sandbox_ReadingReworked_SlowReaderTime_t: Sets the reading time for a 220-page book when the character has the Slow Reader trait, in seconds.
Sandbox_ReadingReworked_StopOnAim_toolti: Stops reading when the character begins aiming.
Sandbox_RealTent_ChangeTentWeight: Change All Vanilla Tent Weights to 3
Sandbox_RealTent_ChangeTentWeight_toolti: You’ll need to restart the game after applying the change.
Sandbox_RealTent_CreateCeiling1More_tool: Installing one tile lower helps prevent upper floors from being visible.
Sandbox_RealTent_CreateLight_tooltip: Adds a temporary invisible light source inside the tent. <LINE>This light disappears when the chunk unloads, <LINE>so it will be recreated when you relog, place a tent, enter the tent, or refresh rendering. <LINE>If there are other cases, please let me know.
Sandbox_RealTent_GeneratorControl_toolti: Allows you to control a generator within 20 tiles on the same floor by right-clicking the tent key inside the tent. <LINE> <LINE>You can remotely view generator info, turn it on/off, refuel, and repair it. <LINE> <LINE>You still need to manually obtain and connect the generator, and must know how to operate it to use these features.
Sandbox_RealTent_RainCollector: Install Rain Collector on Upper Floor
Sandbox_RealTent_RemoveDistanceLimit_too: Removes the tent enter distance limit, <LINE>allowing the mod to function similarly to an RV interior.
Sandbox_RealTent_RemoveWallWindow: Remove Military Tent Door Frames and Windows
Sandbox_RealTent_RemoveWallWindow_toolti: When enabled, door frames and windows will be replaced with walls.
Sandbox_RealTent_TentDir_tooltip: Sets the direction of the military tent based on the entrance.
Sandbox_RealTent_TentItems_tooltip: Enter non-vanilla tent items including module names. <LINE>Example: Hx.AIOBShelter;Hx.AIOBShelterPillow <LINE>Separate items with semicolons (;).
Sandbox_RealTent_Tent_Invincible_tooltip: After changing this setting, you must pick up and reinstall the tent.
Sandbox_RealTent_WallHealth_tooltip: After changing this setting, you must pick up and reinstall the tent. <LINE>Default value 50 is the same as windows.
Sandbox_RealisticClothes_ActionTimeMulti: Control how long check and resize actions take
Sandbox_RealisticClothes_ChanceToDegrade: Chance that clothes reduce condition when resize or recondition fails
Sandbox_RealisticClothes_CombatSpeedRedu: How much combat speed penalty loose clothes apply to players
Sandbox_RealisticClothes_DropChanceMulti: How likely loose clothes will drop if worn without a belt and player having no free hands
Sandbox_RealisticClothes_EnableClothesDe: Most clothes (excluding shoes) will degrade over time. Degrading rate depends on clothes stats (scratch/bite/bullet defense, wind/water resistance), clothes status (dirtyness, bloodiness, wetness). Tight clothes degrades faster, leveling up maintenance and tailoring helps reduce degrading rate
Sandbox_RealisticClothes_IncreaseStiffne: Gain more stiffness when doing exercises, slower stiffness recovery and can not fully recover in tight clothes
Sandbox_RealisticClothes_IncreaseTripCha: Extra trip chance when vaulting fences in loose pants and skirts
Sandbox_RealisticClothes_InsulationReduc: How much insulation loose clothes will lose, maximum to 50%%
Sandbox_RealisticClothes_ListCustomCloth: Clothing items that you think should have sizes but are not in this mod and (optionally) their corresponding difficulties (must be 1 or 2 or 3), separated by comma. <LINE> For example: Base.Clothing0,Base.Clothing1:1,Base.Clothing2:2,Base.Clothing3:3
Sandbox_RealisticClothes_MaxDaysToDegrad: Maximum days for a clothes to completely degrade (at best clothes condition)
Sandbox_RealisticClothes_MinDaysToDegrad: Minimum days for a clothes to completely degrade (at worst clothes condition)
Sandbox_RealisticClothes_NeedTailoringLe: Player will need sufficient tailoring level to perform check size and change size actions
Sandbox_RealisticClothes_OnlyDegradeRepa: This mod allows you to recondition clothes the same way you can repair weapons, but some clothes are not repairable (eg. helmet, weldermask). Enable this to not degrade those clothes if you don't want to lose your precious gears
Sandbox_RealisticClothes_ProtectionLossE: Percentage of base protection (scratch defense, bite defense, bullet defense) loss for each condition loss
Sandbox_RealisticClothes_ResistanceLossE: Percentage of base resistance (wind resistance, water resistance) loss for each condition loss
Sandbox_RealisticClothes_RipChanceMultip: How likely tight clothes will rip when player climbing wall, fence, or window
Sandbox_RealisticClothes_TailoringXpMult: Control how much exp you can earn each time checking for clothes size
Sandbox_RealisticCold_BreachWeightCurtai: How much cold leaks through a curtained-but-otherwise-open opening. 0.3 is the default - curtains help but aren't perfect.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_BreachWeightDoor_t: How much cold leaks through a closed door. 1.2 is the default. Higher = drafty doors.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_BreachWeightGap_to: How much cold pours through large structural gaps (broken walls, holes). 1.4 is the default.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_BreachWeightWindow: How much cold leaks through a closed window. 0.8 is the default. Higher = windowed rooms get colder.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_CatchColdRateMulti: How quickly the catch-a-cold meter fills once you're past the threshold. 1.75 is the default. Higher = colds catch faster.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_CatchColdThreshold: Cold stage you need to reach before you can catch a cold. 1 = Chilly (easiest, most forgiving), 2 = Cold (default), 3 = Freezing, 4 = Hypothermia (only catch a cold if literally freezing to death).
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ChillyAirThreshold: Air temperature at which the chilly warning can start firing. Below this, the moodle considers you exposed. Default 16°C.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ChillyCoolingMulti: When clothing's cooling factor exceeds this fraction, you start to feel chilly. Lower = warning fires earlier (less protection feels colder sooner). 0.9 is the default.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ChillyInsulationTh: Average clothing insulation below which the chilly warning is allowed to fire. 1.5 is the default. Set higher to make the warning fire even with moderate clothing.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ClothingInsulation: How much warmth your clothes provide. 4 is the mod's baseline; lower means clothing protects less, higher means more. Below 1, even heavy gear feels thin; above 6, light layers feel like a winter coat.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ColdMedicineDecayP: How quickly the effect of cold medicine fades. 36 is the default.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ColdRecoverPerHour: How quickly a cold improves while resting and warm. 24 is the default.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ColdSicknessMultip: Scales how badly a cold affects you (sickness moodle, infection rate). 1.0 is baseline. Higher = colds feel like the flu.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ColdWorsenPerHour_: How quickly an untreated cold gets worse, in cold-strength points per game-hour. 45 is the default.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ConvectiveBridgeSt: Smoothes the warming-rate cliff right at normal body temperature. 1.0 is baseline. 0 disables the bridge, warming up from cold to normal feels fast, but heating past normal in hot air feels much slower.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_EnableFoodFreezing: Lets food freeze inside containers when the surrounding temperature drops below freezing. Experimental - may interact unpredictably with other food mods.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_EvapCoolingStrengt: How much sweat actually cools your body as it evaporates. 1.0 is baseline. 0 disables evaporative cooling entirely (sweat still soaks clothing but provides no cooling). Wind and dry air boost the effect; rain cancels most of it.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ExposureCap_toolti: Maximum combined cold leakage allowed across all openings (windows + doors + gaps + curtains) in one room. Higher = drafty rooms can equalize to outdoor faster. 6.0 is the default.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_HeatDistanceExpone: How sharply heater warmth fades with distance. 1.0 is the default (linear). Higher = warmth stays close to the heater. Lower = heat reaches further.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_HeatTargetMaximum_: Warmest temperature any single heater will aim for in its room. 26°C is the default.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_HypothermiaDamageI: Minimum game-hours between hypothermia damage ticks. Smaller = more frequent damage. 0.2 is the default (one tick every ~12 game-minutes).
Sandbox_RealisticCold_HypothermiaDamageP: Health lost per hypothermia damage tick. 0.2 is the default.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_IndustrialHeaterSp: Percent chance an industrial heater appears in large industrial buildings. Set to 0 to disable industrial-heater spawns entirely.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_InsulationSpreadBi: Controls how strongly uneven loadouts (e.g. parka + bare legs) deviate from the simple body-wide average. 0.0 = pure average (all parts treated equally); 1.0 = always pulled toward the weakest part in cold and the most-trapping part in heat. 0.30 is the recommended middle ground.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_SealedPassiveTrans: Sealed Building - Passive Heat Transfer (1.0 = baseline)

How fast a fully sealed building (no broken windows, no open doors, no gaps) drifts toward the outside temperature through walls and ceiling. 1.0 is the mod's baseline. 0 = a sealed house holds its temperature forever; 2.0 = walls leak twice as fast even when sealed; 5.0 = even sealed homes equalize quickly. Has no effect on buildings with active leaks.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_SweatRateMultiplie: Scales how fast you produce sweat when overheating. 1.0 is the mod's baseline. Lower numbers mean less wetness from heat stress (and clothing stays drier); higher numbers mean you drench yourself faster.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_VehicleHeaterMaxDe: Vehicle Heater - Max Heat Above Outdoors (°C)
Maximum degrees above outdoor temperature that a running vehicle heater can produce. 25°C is the default.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_WarmingRateCapCPM_: Hard ceiling on how fast body temperature can rise from environmental warming (warm air, heaters, hot drinks combined). 0.5 °C/min is the default. Lower for slower recovery from cold; raise for instant warm-up at fires.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_AgingEn: Characters age over time. Affects metabolism, Strength/Fitness caps, and recovery speed as they grow older.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_AgingRa: How many in-game days equal one year of aging. 1 = realistic (365 days), 4 = fastest (45 days per year).
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_Backpac: Backpacks can block attacks from behind. Disable to remove backpack protection bonus.
Your backpack can block a bite, scratch, or cut from behind. Military and hiking packs block fully, satchels partially. The pack gets ripped off when it saves you.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_BleedDO: Allow bleed damage to finish off zombies over time. OFF by default — zombies have no circulation so bleeding them out is unrealistic.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_Bulldoz: Fat and Obese characters can sprint through and knock down zombies. Disable to remove the bulldozer ability.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_Circadi: Tiredness builds naturally over the day. About 8 hours awake to feel drowsy, 12 hours to be very tired. Carb-rich meals delay tiredness. Disable if another mod handles fatigue.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_CombatD: Enable RSF's bonus melee damage from Strength and Fitness. Disable to use vanilla damage calculations only.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_CrowdDe: Zombies packed together on the same tile slow each other down. Creates natural bottlenecks at doorways and windows. Strong zombies are not affected.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_DebugMo: Shows detailed diagnostic messages in the game console. Only useful for bug reports. Leave disabled in normal play.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_Directi: Backpedaling after a hit boosts your knockback chance. Pushing forward gives bonus crit chance and extra damage.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_DoorBre: Shows extra debug info for the door-break slip feature. Only useful for testing.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_DoorSli: Zombies near a broken door trip on debris and fall. Disable to remove the trip hazard.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_Emergen: When nearly out of breath an adrenaline burst lets you sprint for 2.5 seconds. 30-second cooldown.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_EnableB: Sharp weapons cause bleed-over-time damage and blood splatter on zombies. Disable to remove all sharp-weapon bleed effects.
Your character's body changes visually based on weight. Five tiers: Skinny, Lean, Normal, Fat, Obese. Fat and Obese use full 3D body meshes with matching clothing.
Blunt weapons cause bruise effects that briefly slow zombies. Disable to remove all blunt-weapon bruise slowing.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_EnableC: RSF overrides max carry weight based on Strength. Disable to use vanilla carry capacity or let another carry mod take full control.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_EnableD: When zombies break down a door, nearby zombies may slip on the debris and fall. Thins out the horde at chokepoints.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_EnableP: How fast you turn while aiming depends on body weight. Lean characters pivot fastest, obese slowest. Disable if you prefer the standalone PIVOT mod.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_EnableT: Automatically adds or removes weight traits (Underweight, Overweight, Obese) as your body shape changes. Updates when you wake up.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_EnableZ: Zombies use simplified body shapes: Normal, Fat, Obese. Skinny and Lean zombie visuals are folded into Normal to reduce per-zombie body-tier work.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_Enduran: RSF's full damage system. Strength and Fitness increase melee damage. Being tired no longer reduces damage, only swing speed. Disabling reverts to vanilla damage.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_GrabEsc: Press Run or Sprint during a zombie grab to force-break free. Also removes the brief movement freeze after any escape.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_Install: Shows the zombie folder install reminder after mod updates, then auto-disables after you close it. Re-enable to see it again.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_Knockdo: Knocked-down zombies take bonus damage from hitting the ground. Disable to remove all fall-damage bonuses.
Zombies take extra damage when knocked down, tripped, or trampled. Headshots on hard surfaces cause severe injuries.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_LowHeal: Zombies whose initial total health is 0.75 or lower briefly stalk-walk for about 1 second, then accelerate into sprinter-style runner locomotion with sprinter growls, bites, and footsteps.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_NM_Assi: Allows the system to tag loaded zombies with nightmare archetypes. Disable to freeze assignments — existing specials keep working but no new ones are created.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_NM_Coug: Obese zombie emitting toxic green fog that grows in potency over time. Groups of Coughers combine their fog clouds. Corpses left indoors continue spreading pathogenic fumes.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_NM_Debu: Prints nightmare module debug messages to the console. Only useful for testing and bug reports.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_NM_Enab: Master toggle for RSF Nightmare special zombie archetypes. When enabled, a percentage of zombies become special types with unique abilities, body shapes, and behaviors. OFF by default — enable to activate the nightmare.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_NM_Kami: Fit, lean zombie that charges on sight and sprints at doors. Smashes doors in a single hit but loses half its health on impact. Breaches your safe house in seconds.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_NM_Lung: Blind zombie that hunts entirely by sound. Constantly lunges at noise sources — running, fighting, or breaking objects draws them in. Stay quiet and they ignore you completely.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_NM_Necr: Multiplies each archetype's symptom gate threshold. 1 = normal pace, 2 = archetypes unlock twice as slowly, 3 = very slow progression.
Enable Necroa Mod integration. When active, Nightmare archetypes unlock progressively as Necroa's virus symptoms spread. Requires Necroa Mod to be installed — has no effect without it.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_NM_Runn: Small, fast sprinter zombie. Short and skinny with sprinter locomotion. Very fragile but hard to hit — they close distance fast and attack before you can react.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_NM_Scre: Minimum seconds between Screamer attraction pulses while actively tracking a target.
World-sound radius used by Screamer pulses. Larger values pull more distant zombies toward the fight.
Female zombie that screams when she spots you, emitting a world-sound pulse that alerts all nearby zombies. Turns small encounters into full horde fights. Kill her fast or run.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_NM_Spec: Percent chance for an eligible zombie to become a nightmare special when first processed. Higher values mean more specials in the world.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_NM_Spri: Tall, lanky sprinter zombie that towers over normal zombies. Long reach, fast, and aggressive. A nightmare version of the vanilla sprinter with exaggerated height.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_NM_Stam: Speed increase added to a Stampeder each time it takes damage. Higher values make Stampeders accelerate faster when hit.
Overweight zombie that gets faster every time you hit it. Starts as a walker but accelerates into a sprinter after enough damage. Kill it quickly or it outruns you.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_NM_Unkn: Massive obese juggernaut zombie. Cannot be knocked down, staggered, or shoved. Tramples everything in its path. Shoving it staggers YOU instead. Extremely high health — avoid or bring heavy weapons.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_PatchNo: Shows the What's New popup after mod updates, then auto-disables after you close it. Re-enable to see it again.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_QuickAc: Inventory actions like picking up, wearing, and transferring items are twice as fast. Mood, pain, and drunk penalties still apply.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_RandomS: New characters start with a random body fat and weight instead of the default. Each playthrough begins with a unique body shape that changes through diet and exercise.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_RunnerH: Sustained running builds a runner's high that improves endurance recovery and mood. Encourages cardio-heavy playstyles.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_ShowIns: Show the zombie folder install reminder after mod updates. Auto-disables after showing. Re-enable to see it again.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_ShowPat: Show the What's New popup after mod updates. Auto-disables after showing. Re-enable to see it again.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_ShowTut: Show the RSF tutorial popup on game start. Auto-disables after showing. Re-enable to see it again.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_SprintC: Fat and Obese characters can sprint through zombies and knock them down. Heavier characters hit harder.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_StrainR: Gradually reduces combat muscle stiffness and soreness over time. Higher fitness recovers faster. Resting speeds it up further.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_Trample: Crawling zombies can trip standing zombies that walk over them. Strong zombies barrel through weaker ones faster.
Crawling zombies trip standing ones that walk over them. Strong zombies bowl through weaker ones. Disable to remove these interactions.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_Tutoria: Shows the RSF tutorial popup once, then auto-disables after you close it. Re-enable to see it again.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_Vanilla: Adds extra hunger when meals are skipped, encouraging 3 meals a day. Disable if using another hunger mod.
Scales the bonus XP awarded when you sleep. 1.0 is normal, 0.5 is half, 2.0 is double. In multiplayer this is controlled by the server.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_WakeSum: Shows the RSF sleep-conversion summary window after waking up. Disable to mute the popup; XP conversion still runs immediately.
Sandbox_RealisticStrengthFitness_WeaponS: When your melee weapon breaks mid-fight, your backup weapon is auto-equipped from your off-hand or back slot. Back slot also works as a holster.
Sandbox_RechargeableBatteries.AllowOverc: DOES NOT WORK    This will allow players to charge Batteries over 100%% charge, by recharging a full Battery.

Sandbox_RedDays_tss_abx_pills_to_cure: ABX Pills Needed To Cure Stage 4

Sandbox_RedDays_tss_abx_sleep_health_cap: With active antibiotics, Stage 4 cannot drop health below this percentage. Sleeping with antibiotics restores health up to this cap and will not kill you. Without antibiotics this cap does not apply.

Sandbox_RedDays_tss_complication_chance_: When pre-TSS infection is active, this is the hourly chance for a sudden complication. Higher values mean symptoms can worsen more often, especially when you are sick, tired, thirsty, or cold/overheated.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_enabled_tooltip: Enable or disable Red Days TSS progression and treatment mechanics.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_fever_nudge_strength: Percentage multiplier for how hard TSS pushes the fever above the vanilla Stage 4 sickness plateau (~38C). 0 disables the extra heat push entirely; 100 is standard nudge intensity. Body temperature is still primarily driven by the sickness moodle.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_lethal_enabled_toolt: If enabled, untreated Stage 3 can transition into Stage 4 toxic shock.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_min_stage3_hours: TSS: Min Time in Stage 3 Before Toxic Shock (Hours)
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_min_stage3_hours_too: Minimum in-game hours that must be spent in Stage 3 severe infection before Toxic Shock Syndrome (Stage 4) becomes eligible. TSS cannot occur before this threshold.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_recovery_hours_per_s: In-game hours of healing needed (tampon/pad removed, no antibiotics) to drop one TSS stage, e.g. Stage 3 to Stage 0 takes 3x this. Antibiotics double the speed while a dose is still active.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_risk_multiplier_pct_: Scales Stage 3 to Stage 4 risk gain. Lower is safer, higher is riskier.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_stage0_duration_lowe: Minimum in-game hours before tampon exposure can begin progressing into Stage 1 infection. Lower values make infection start sooner under continuous use.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_stage0_duration_uppe: Maximum time the uninfected state (Stage 0) can persist before progression to Stage 1 is forced. Higher values delay initial infection onset.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_stage1_duration_lowe: Minimum in-game hours before early infection (Stage 1) can progress into established infection (Stage 2). Lower values accelerate worsening.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_stage1_duration_uppe: Maximum time Stage 1 infection can persist before it is forced to progress into Stage 2. Higher values allow longer mild infection periods.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_stage2_duration_lowe: Minimum in-game hours before established infection (Stage 2) can progress into severe systemic illness (Stage 3). Lower values increase danger speed.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_stage2_duration_uppe: Maximum time Stage 2 infection can persist before progressing into Stage 3. Higher values slow severe illness onset.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_stage4_hp_drain_pct: TSS Stage 4 HP Drain While Awake (%%)
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_stage4_hp_drain_pct_: Percentage multiplier for base HP drain during Stage 4 Toxic Shock Syndrome while awake. 100 = normal (0.15 HP/min base). 200 = double drain. 50 = half drain. Drain scales further with body temperature.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_stage4_sleep_hp_drai: TSS Stage 4 HP Drain While Asleep (%%)

Percentage multiplier for base Stage 4 HP drain while the player is asleep, separate from the awake drain. 0 = no HP loss during sleep. Without antibiotics you can still die in your sleep; drain scales with body temperature like the awake value.

Sandbox_RedDays_tss_warning_interval_min: How often TSS warning messages are shown while symptoms are active.

Sandbox_RestoreUtilities_AiwRL: Restore Utilities - Automatic in-world Repair Locations
Sandbox_RestoreUtilities_AiwRL_SpawnPowe: If enabled, a large area inside the substation south-east of Louisville will allow you to check the status of the power grid. You will also be able to perform repairs here if the grid is about to fail, or has already failed. <LINE> <LINE>The repair location can be found at the co-ords X:14765, Y:4085
Sandbox_RestoreUtilities_AiwRL_SpawnWate: If enabled, a small room inside the water treatment plant south of Rosewood will allow you to check the status of the water network. You will also be able to perform repairs here if the network is about to fail, or has already failed. <LINE> <LINE>The repair location can be found at the co-ords X:8046, Y:15359
Sandbox_RestoreUtilities_BaseRepairSpeed: How long, in seconds, the timed action for the repair speed should take. Higher numbers take more time, lower numbers are faster. <LINE> <LINE> This is the actual repair action with the green bar overhead, lower numbers are recommended for MP where fast-forward isn't an option. <LINE> <LINE> This time is further reduced when using a coil fuse to repair. At this setting's default of 60, a tier 2 coil halves the repair time; meaning the repair would only take 30 seconds, down from 60.
Sandbox_RestoreUtilities_FailChance_tool: The chance of a failed repair. <LINE> This chance is reduced by 8%% per level of electrical skill higher than the minimum. The chance is also reduced by half when using a Tier 1 Marked Components fuse, and fail chance is always set to 0%% when using a Tier 2 Marked Components fuse.
Sandbox_RestoreUtilities_InjuryChance_to: The chance of sustaining an injury after performing a repair, regardless of if it was a success or a fail. <LINE> <LINE> Upon a repair attempt, the mod will randomly roll a number between 0 and 100, if the rolled number is lower than the Injury Chance number, the player will suffer an injury. <LINE> If the rolled number lands above 80 then the player will suffer a burn. <LINE> If the rolled number is above 50 then the player will suffer a deep wound. <LINE> Otherwise, the player will be lacerated. <LINE> <LINE> This sandbox option only changes the base Injury Chance number, each level above the minimum required electrical skill will reduce the Injury Chance number by 10. <LINE> Similarly, the Insulated Wires fuse T1 will half the Injury Chance number (from 80 to 40, for example), and the T2 will set it to 0%%. <LINE> <LINE> Set to 0 to completely disable the chance of injury upon repair attempt.
Sandbox_RestoreUtilities_MinSkillLvl_too: The minimum level of the electrical skill you need to make repairs. <LINE> Regardless of this setting you will still need generator knowledge or a consumable Insulated Wires fuse to make repairs.
Sandbox_RestoreUtilities_RepairScaleModi: Multiplies the length of all successful repairs by this number, this modifier is the LAST thing to apply to the number of days a repair attempt will provide, meaning it also influences the effectiveness of any fuses that do the same. <LINE> <LINE> Set to a number below 1 to make your repairs last less time, and set to a higher number to make your repairs more effective. (I.E. setting this option to 2 will make all of your repairs 2x effective)
Sandbox_RestoreUtilities_ScrapNeeded_too: How much electronic scrap you need per repair, this cost will be reduced by 25%%/50%% when using a T1/T2 Spare Parts fuse, respectively.
Sandbox_RestoreUtilities_XPEarned_toolti: The amount of electrical XP earned on repair of a utility. This is the full amount, so a character with 0 starting skill in electrical will only recieve 25%% of this value, and a character with 3+ starting skill in electrical will get 150%% of this value. <LINE> <LINE> This value is multiplied by 1.1x/1.2x for the Tier 1/Tier 2 Notes fuse, respectively. <LINE> <LINE> A failed repair attempt will instead grant 10%% of this value.
