Sandbox_TheDarknessIsComing2_zombieSprin: When enabled: Zombies sprint in light and shamble in darkness. When disabled: Zombies shamble in light and sprint in darkness.
Sandbox_TheFog_Enabled_tooltip: Forces thick fog to stay locked on year-round, regardless of season or weather. Turn off if you want the rest of the mod without the forced fog (e.g. testing, or running alongside another weather mod).
Sandbox_TheFog_FogExposureEnabled_toolti: Prolonged time outdoors in the fog without a face covering gradually builds sickness (a mild fever, plus the vanilla Sick moodle) -- never fatal, but a real risk. A quick dash between nearby buildings is safe; loitering outside isn't. Stepping indoors, or wearing a mask, lets it recover.
Sandbox_TheFog_FogExposureRate_tooltip: How quickly sickness builds per hour spent outdoors fully unprotected. Scaled down by whatever mask protection you have -- a real gas mask WITH A WORKING FILTER fully negates it; an empty one barely helps; this mod's Rag Bandana only partially.
Sandbox_TheFog_FogExposureRecoveryRate_t: How quickly sickness fades per hour spent indoors. Faster than the exposure rate by default -- getting caught out should be the slow, ominous part; reaching shelter should feel like real relief.
Sandbox_TheFog_FogIntensity_tooltip: How thick the permanent fog is (0.5 = heavy haze, 1.0 = can barely see past your own hand). Locked at this value at all times -- it will not thin out, clear, or drift back in like normal weather fog.
Sandbox_TheFog_FogSpawnEnabled_tooltip: Adds "The Fog Spawn (recommended)" to the spawn location list -- a combined spawn point pulling from every vanilla town's real spawn points (and profession-specific spawns where they exist), instead of committing to one specific town. The individual towns remain selectable too. Turn off to remove this option and leave the vanilla spawn list untouched.
Sandbox_TheFog_HostileAnimalDamage_toolt: Multiplier applied on top of each species' own size-scaled base damage (small animals like rats/chickens hit far softer than a cow or bull). 1.0 = the tuned default for that species; higher/lower scales all of them up or down together.
Sandbox_TheFog_HostileAnimalDetectRange_: How many tiles away a hostile skeleton animal notices you and starts chasing. Default 20 is deliberately above vanilla's own native 'spotting distance' for these creatures (up to 19 tiles for deer) -- set it lower and some animals may notice and bolt under native flee behavior before this mod's own chase/attack system gets a chance to take over.
Sandbox_TheFog_HostileAnimalHealthLossMu: How much health a hostile skeleton animal loses per point of weapon damage -- LOWER means TOUGHER (more hits needed to kill). Default 0.01 matches vanilla's own real cow value, which takes several solid hits. Vanilla's smaller/undecorated animals (which several of these are cloned from) default to a more fragile value, which is why they could die in a single swing before this was added.
Sandbox_TheFog_HostileAnimalKnockdownCha: Chance a successful hit knocks the player down. Vanilla itself makes this unconditional (100%% every hit) for species like ram/sheep -- this mod always rolls a chance instead, for every species, rather than an all-or-nothing knockdown flag.
Sandbox_TheFog_NearAlpha_tooltip: How fogged that immediate clear-space bubble still is (0.0 = fully clear right next to you, 1.0 = just as thick as the fog further out, no special clearing at all). Default 0.30 leaves a faint hazy view of your immediate surroundings without seeing far.
Sandbox_TheFog_NearRadius_tooltip: How many tiles around you the game tries to keep relatively clear of fog (0.0 = no special clearing at all, 4.0 = the vanilla debug tool's own maximum).
Sandbox_TheFog_WildlifeEnabled_tooltip: In this mod's lore, every animal is already undead. Redirects vanilla's farm/wildlife spawns to hostile skeleton animals instead of living ones, sweeps up any living animal still found in the world (including ones from an existing save), and periodically spawns skeleton animals near the player to force encounters. Turn off to leave vanilla wildlife completely untouched.
Sandbox_TheFog_WildlifeEncounterChance_t: Chance that a skeleton animal spawned near you (via the proximity encounter system) already knows exactly where you are and charges immediately, instead of needing to notice you first.
Sandbox_TheFog_WildlifeMaxNearby_tooltip: Caps how many hostile skeleton animals the proximity encounter spawner will keep active near a single player at once, so it doesn't snowball into a horde.
Sandbox_TheFog_ZombiesAffected_tooltip: On a new game/character, forces Zombie Lore Sight/Hearing to Poor and Memory to Short, so zombies are just as hampered by the fog as you are and have to track you by sound. Only takes effect when starting fresh -- an existing save's zombies already have their lore locked in and can't be changed retroactively (a vanilla limitation, not this mod's).
Sandbox_Thiccener_AdminsCanMorphOthers_t: Allows server admins to right-click players and manually edit their body morphs.
Sandbox_Thiccener_EnableCorpses_tooltip: WARNING: This is not yet implemented properly. Can impact performance. Renders morphs on dead bodies.
Sandbox_Thiccener_EnablePlayers_tooltip: Enable dynamic body morphs for players based on stats.
Sandbox_Thiccener_EnableZombies_tooltip: Enable random body generation for zombies.
Sandbox_Thiccener_ZombieStarvationTimer_: Over time, zombies will lose their fat and become thinner to simulate starvation. Select the time it takes to reach maximum starvation.

Sandbox_ThisIsYourLife_EnableCustomProfe: Use This Is Your Life's redesigned profession and trait selection screens. Turning this off shows the vanilla profession and trait screens instead, after choosing your postcard.

Sandbox_ThisIsYourLife_EnableOriginTrait: Grant hometown map knowledge, local bonuses, skill levels, and home-ground effects. Disabling this does not remove the postcard pages or chosen spawn town.

Sandbox_ThisIsYourLife_EnableSurvivorJou: Enable the Survivor Journal, milestones, health record, diary entries, and preserved journals left on death.
Sandbox_ThisIsYourLife_EnableThisIsYourV: Enable contextual character thoughts and reactions. When disabled, the module performs no recurring background checks.
Sandbox_ThisIsYourLife_QuickStart_toolti: Skip the profession, trait, and appearance screens after choosing your postcard. You'll start as Unemployed with a randomised appearance. The postcard/map screen is never skipped.
Sandbox_ThrowableBreakChanceMultiplier_t: Scales the chance for fragile thrown items like glass and plates to break instead of landing on the ground.
Sandbox_ThrowableDamageMultiplier_toolti: Scales impact damage to zombies near the landing square. Set 0 to keep throwables as distraction-only.

Sandbox_ThugNotebookDistribution_tooltip: Multiplies how often the Thug Notebook (Makeshift Suppressor recipe) spawns in loot. 1.0 = default rate, 0 = never spawns in loot (admin/debug spawn only), up to 5x default.

Sandbox_TowAssistSportFactor_tooltip: Force multiplier for sport vehicles while towing. 0 = disabled. Default: 4.0.
Sandbox_TowAssistStandardFactor_tooltip: Force multiplier for standard vehicles while towing. 0 = disabled. Default: 5.0.

Sandbox_ToxicDamageMinPerMinute_tooltip: Minimum per-minute toxic player damage once exposure passes the damage threshold.
Sandbox_ToxicDamagePerMinuteAtFullExposu: Base player health damage per minute when toxic exposure is at 100%%.
Sandbox_ToxicDamagePerTick_tooltip: Legacy zombie toxic damage per tick. Player toxic damage uses the per-minute options below.
Sandbox_ToxicDamagePreset_tooltip: Applies preset toxic damage/exposure and tick pacing values for quick balancing.
Sandbox_ToxicEventDurationHours_tooltip: Duration in game hours used by toxic helicopter events. Other events still use Event Duration Hours.
Sandbox_ToxicExposureGainPerMin_tooltip: How fast toxic exposure builds per minute while unprotected.
Sandbox_ToxicExtraDamagePerMinuteOnMaxEx: Small extra per-minute damage when exposure is very high (>= 90%%).
Sandbox_ToxicFilterMaxWearPercentPerEven: Wear limit for the same filter during one toxic event. The default prevents one new filter from being exhausted by a single event.
Sandbox_ToxicFilterWearPercentPerHour_to: Percentage of a full gas-mask filter or air tank consumed per hour of direct gas exposure.
Sandbox_ToxicMaskMinHealth_tooltip: Toxic gas will not reduce health below this value while a recognized mask, respirator, or cloth face covering is worn.
Sandbox_ToxicMaxExposureHealthDamage_too: Legacy compatibility value. Prefer the per-minute toxic damage options below.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_AnimalDamageMultiplier_: Scales hazard damage applied to animals.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_BypassUtilitiesRequirem: If enabled, random hazards can occur before utilities are shut off.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_DiminishingSpawnsOverTi: Gradually lowers event frequency/chance as world age increases.

Sandbox_ToxicSky_EnableLightGasEvents_to: Allows random Light Gas events to spawn.

Sandbox_ToxicSky_HeavyGasDurationMinHour: Minimum duration for Heavy Gas events.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_HeavyGasIntervalHours_t: Hours between Heavy Gas event roll attempts.

Sandbox_ToxicSky_LegacyHealthDamageMulti: Multiplier applied to legacy direct health damage.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_LegacyHealthDamagePerTi: Base direct health damage dealt each legacy damage tick.

Sandbox_ToxicSky_LightGasDurationMaxHour: Maximum duration for Light Gas events.

Sandbox_TrampleSteam_JamChance_tooltip: Once a trap has used up its charges it keeps working, but every further launch has this chance to jam the mechanism. Default 20. At 0 a worn trap never jams.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_LaunchAnimals_toolt: On (default): livestock and wildlife that wander onto the pad get launched too. Whether the flight kills them and whether it wears the trap are the two options below.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_LaunchPower_tooltip: Multiplies how far and how high victims are flung. 1 (default) is the normal spring; 0.5 is a polite shove, 4 is a catapult.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_NoiseAttraction_too: On (default): the launch bang, the ready ding and the idle hum are real noise that draws nearby zombies toward the trap, so it baits its own victims. Off: the sounds are audible to you only.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_PackUpPermission: Who can pack up a trap
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_PackUpPermission_to: Who is allowed to pack up (or scrap) a deployed Trample Steam. 'Owner + allies' extends it to the owner's faction members and anyone sharing a safehouse with them; 'Owner only' limits it to whoever deployed that trap, so rivals can't steal your defenses in PvP. Admins and the build cheat always can. Default: everyone.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_PlayerFallImmunity_: Off (default): a launched survivor can take falling damage on a hard landing, especially at high Launch power. On: trap launches never deal fall damage, so pads can be chained into a launch-transit network across the map.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_PlayerLaunchDamage_: Extra health a survivor loses when the trap launches them. 0 (the default) adds nothing, though a rough landing can still hurt a little depending on the launch angle and how you come down. Raise it to make stepping on your own trap properly dangerous.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_PlayerLaunch_toolti: Who the trap will launch besides zombies. 'Everyone but the owner' uses the name of whoever deployed the trap. 'Everyone but the owner's allies' also spares the owner's faction members and anyone sharing a safehouse with them: allies walk over the pad safely, raiders fly.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_PlayerUsesCharge_to: If on, launching a survivor wears the trap down like a zombie launch does. Off (default): bouncing players is free.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_PowerMode_tooltip: What powers the trap. Gasoline: deploys empty, refuel from a gas can, sips roughly one tank per week. Generator/grid: runs while the tile has electricity (a powered building or a running generator nearby). Both (default): runs if EITHER fuel or electricity is available. None: always powered.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_Preset_tooltip: Quickly switch the trap between play styles. 'Custom' uses the individual settings below as-is. 'Co-op PvE / Singleplayer' pins the recommended cooperative values (free harmless player launches, nothing restricted, no sabotage). 'Co-op PvE / Singleplayer Casual' is that plus safe landings, deployment as global knowledge, and traps that never need fuel or power. 'PvP' makes launches hit everyone for 35 damage and use a charge, turns off the mid-flight remarks, restricts pack-up, siphoning and upgrades to the owner and their faction/safehouse allies, and enables sabotage. Settings the preset doesn't cover still come from this page. Server admins can flip this live from the Sandbox Options panel; it applies within a minute, no restart needed.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_Ragdoll_tooltip: On (default): launched victims react like they were hit by a car, ragdolling as physics ragdolls (this forces the game's 'Use Physics Hit Reaction' display option on). Every victim leaves on its own slightly-off heading with its own tumble, and touchdown is a couple of shrinking bounces and a short skid, with a fresh ragdoll kick at each impact. Note: the game disables ragdoll physics in multiplayer (just like real car hits), so multiplayer uses the regular falldown animations. Off: victims are launched in a normal pose, land once and stop.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_RecipeGlobal_toolti: Off (default): the crafting recipe must be learned from the 'How to Use: Trample Steam' magazine (spawns as rarely as the generator magazine); Engineers and Metalworkers know it from the start. On: everyone knows the recipe.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_ReinforcedCharges_t: Guaranteed launches after reinforcing a trap with extra sheet metal (context menu, needs welding gear). Set to 999 to make reinforced traps unbreakable.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_ResetSeconds_toolti: Seconds the trap needs to re-cock and re-arm after firing, and to arm itself when first deployed (used only when Instant reset is off). Default 7.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_Sabotage_tooltip: Off (default): deployed traps can't be tampered with. On: any survivor with a screwdriver and Electrical 2 can attempt to jam a deployed Trample Steam. Success quietly breaks it (repairable as usual); a botched attempt makes a loud clank that draws zombies. Higher Electrical skill improves the odds. PvP counter-play against enemy trap lines.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_SiphonPermission: Who can siphon gasoline from a trap
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_SiphonPermission_to: Who is allowed to siphon stored gasoline back out of a deployed trap into a gas can. 'Owner + allies' extends it to the owner's faction members and anyone sharing a safehouse with them; 'Owner only' stops fuel theft in PvP; 'Nobody' makes fueling a one-way trip. Admins and the build cheat always can. Default: everyone.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_SoundDistance_toolt: Scales how far every trap sound carries -- the launch bang, the re-cock ratchet, the ready ding, the idle hum and the landing thud -- and equally how far away zombies can hear them (when Noise attracts zombies is on). The sounds keep their relative loudness; only the reach changes. 1 = the default curve, 0.1 = barely past the pad, 4 = the whole neighborhood hears it.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_TriggerDelay_toolti: Short delay between something stepping on the pad and the launch, letting more zombies pile on so one charge flings the whole group. Default 0.07; set to 0 to fire instantly.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_UpgradePermission_t: Who is allowed to upgrade a deployed Trample Steam -- one setting covers all three upgrades: Reinforcing, Camouflage and Spring tuning. 'Owner + allies' extends it to the owner's faction members and anyone sharing a safehouse with them; 'Owner only' stops rivals from re-skinning or de-tuning your defenses in PvP. Admins and the build cheat always can. On top of this, upgrading always needs the deployment know-how (Mechanics 2, a technical occupation, or the magazine). Default: everyone.
Sandbox_TrampleSteam_ZombieLethal_toolti: On (default): launched zombies die when they land. Off: they survive the flight and get back up. Launch them into another trap for zombie pinball.
Sandbox_TransmogDE_DisableHeadGearFix: Disable Hat and Masks Hard Fix
Sandbox_TransmogDE_DisableHeadGearFix_to: Requires client reboot: If disabled, when transmogging a hat or mask to invisible, you hair style might appear squished. But hats and mask will now appear on the floor, and on zombies
Sandbox_TransmogDE_ImmersiveModeToggle_t: When you enable the Immersive Mode from the sandbox settings, you can transmog only to the items you have found, and if you die, don't worry! You will keep your list of found transmogs :D
Sandbox_TransmogDE_LimitTransmogToSameBo: Limit Transmog To The Same Body Location
Eg: you can only transmog hats to hats, and trousers to trousers, but not trousers to hats, or different body locations
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_CooldownMax_tool: Longest gap, in update ticks, before a zombie can roll for a trip again. Each cooldown is randomised between the minimum and maximum so trips don't fall into a rhythm. Clamped up to the minimum if set lower.
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_CooldownMin_tool: Shortest gap, in update ticks, before a zombie that already rolled for a trip can roll again. Higher values make tripping rarer. ~60 ticks is roughly a second.
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_CorpseTrip_toolt:
%% chance, rolled on the trip cooldown, that a moving zombie trips while standing on a square that has a dead body on it. Turns killzones and corpse piles into real obstacles.
0 = off.
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_CrawlerChance_to:
%% chance that a tripping zombie breaks something on the way down and gets back up as a crawler.
0 = off (default). A spicy, lethal-but-fair option for sprinter runs.
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_EnableMod_toolti: Master switch for the whole mod. Turn this off to stop zombies tripping entirely without removing the mod from the save.
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_PileUp_tooltip:
%% chance a chasing zombie trips when it bumps into another zombie that is already on the ground. Lets one trip cascade into a dogpile through a packed horde.
0 = off. Applies to all speeds - a body is a body.
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_RagdollChance_to:
%% chance a trip becomes a full physics ragdoll instead of a normal fall - the zombie flops, settles, then gets back up.
100 = always (default), 0 = off.
Single-player only. Costs performance in a big horde.
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_RequireChasing_t:
Off (default): any moving zombie can trip, including wandering and migrating hordes.
On: zombies only trip while actively chasing a target they can see - the original behaviour.
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_TripEffect_toolt:
How a trip plays out.
Stumble: a light stagger that briefly interrupts the zombie, no fall.
Trip (default): sprinters tumble forward at speed; slower zombies fall flat.
Knockdown: every tripped zombie is knocked to the ground, the longest recovery.
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_TripNoise_toolti:
Radius of the noise a trip makes as the body hits the ground, drawing other zombies the same way a thump does.
0 = silent (default).
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_TripWhileFightin:
On (default): zombies can trip even in the close-range, arms-out lunge, so a charging attacker can still pitch forward.
Off: they only trip once back in a normal chase.
Sandbox_TrueCrawl_CrawlUnderVehiclesEnab: Toggles the ability to Crawl under Vehicles. (YOU MUST BE CRAWLING!) [Default is True, Default Key is X].
Sandbox_TrueMusicRadio_ActivateTMRMTV_to: Enabling this will allow the creation of the True Music MTV channel. (Optional as it can interfere with some other TV Channel mods.)
Sandbox_TrueMusicRadio_TMRAllowSkipOnSer: Enabling this will allow players to skip a song on the radio by clicking the tune in button like in single player. (not suggested in case of players spamming the server, admins can already do this)
Sandbox_TrueMusicRadio_TMRChannel1_toolt: The frequency for the 1st True Music Radio station. (Default 92FM = 92000)
Sandbox_TrueMusicRadio_TMRChannel2_toolt: The frequency for the 2nd True Music Radio station. (Default 92.2FM = 92200)
Sandbox_TrueMusicRadio_TMRChannel3_toolt: The frequency for the 3rd True Music Radio station. (Default 92.4FM = 92400)
Sandbox_TrueMusicRadio_TMRChannel4_toolt: The frequency for the 4th True Music Radio station. (Default 92.6FM = 92600)
Sandbox_TrueMusicRadio_TMRChannel5_toolt: The frequency for the 5th True Music Radio station. (Default 92.8FM = 92800)
Sandbox_TrueMusicRadio_TMRExcludeHoliday: Enabling this will exclude only the holiday songs added by the TCCacheMP prerequisite mod from playing on the radio stations unless the media is added to the terminals.
Sandbox_TrueMusicRadio_TMRExcludeTCCache: Enabling this will exclude the songs added by the TCCacheMP prerequisite mod from playing on the radio stations unless the media is added to the terminals.
Sandbox_TrueMusicRadio_TMRExcludeThemeSo: Enabling this will exclude the vanilla theme songs from playing on the radio stations unless the media is added to the terminals.
Sandbox_TrueMusicRadio_TMRMTV_tooltip: The frequency for the True Music MTV Station. (Default: 211)
Sandbox_TrueMusicRadio_TMRMusicTerminalF: How Much Music Spawns In The True Music Radio Station Terminals
How much music media spawns in the station terminals.
Sandbox_TrueMusicRadio_TMRRadioHordeNigh: Enable True Music Radio Stations Horde Night Announcements
Enabling this will add warning announcements when Horde Night starts. (Only if the Horde Night mod is enabled)
Sandbox_TrueMusicRadio_TMRRadioMoods: Enable True Music Radio Mood Bonuses
Sandbox_TrueMusicRadio_TMRRadioMoods_too: Enabling this will give the player a bonus to happiness and boredom when music is played nearby.
Sandbox_TrueMusicRadio_TMRRadioSongAnnou: Enable True Music Radio Stations Song Announcements
Enabling this will add song announcements when new songs start.
Sandbox_TrueMusicRadio_TMRRadioWeatherBr: Enable True Music Radio Stations Weather Broadcasts
Enabling this will add weather broadcasting on the hour.
Sandbox_TrueMusicRadio_TMRRadiosAttractZ: Enable True Music Radios To Attract Zombies
Enabling this will increase the possibility of zombies being attracted to True Music Radio music. (Does not affect vanilla radio attraction.)
Sandbox_TrueMusicRadio_TMRTerminalEjects: Enable The True Music Radio Station Terminal To Eject Additional Music
Enabling this will allow the west station terminal to eject additional media. (Amounts based on filled amount settings)
Sandbox_TrueSleep_CompensateVanilla_tool: The server keeps restoring sleepers at normal speed on its own. With this on, Solo nap speed means the total rest speed instead of stacking on top of vanilla.
Sandbox_TrueSleep_NapFloorPercent_toolti: Solo naps cannot reduce fatigue below this remainder. Full rest is reserved for a proper night when everyone sleeps.
Sandbox_TrueSleep_SleepSpeed_tooltip: How much faster a solo napper rests compared to world time. 7 means a full night of rest fits into roughly one in-game hour.
Sandbox_TrueSleep_WakeWhenRested_tooltip: Automatically wake a solo napper once they hit the nap limit.
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_CoughingChanceNonSmo: Chance (%%) to cough per puff if player does NOT have the Smoker trait
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_CoughingChanceSmoker: Chance (%%) to cough per puff if player has the Smoker trait
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_Coughing_tooltip: Enable chance to cough when taking a puff
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_DaysToAddiction_tool: How many in-game days of heavy smoking until player gains the Smoker trait
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_DaysToDetox_tooltip: How many in-game days without smoking until player loses the Smoker trait
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_DaysToPeakWithdrawal: How many in-game days it takes to reach peak withdrawal symptoms after quitting
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_DebugMode_tooltip: Enable debug logging and debug UI panel (for mod developers and troubleshooting)
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_DropChanceNonSmoker_: Drop chance (%%) if player does NOT have the Smoker trait (much clumsier!)
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_DropChanceSmoker_too: Drop chance (%%) if player has the Smoker trait
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_Dropping_tooltip: Chance to drop your lit cigarette when falling, climbing, or hit by zombies
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_DynamicSmokerTrait_t: Players can gain or lose the Smoker trait based on smoking habits
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_EffectMultiplier_too:
Multiplies all effects from smoking (nicotine, stress relief, boredom relief, etc.)
50 = half effects · 100 = normal · 200 = double effects
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_FatigueReduction_too:
How much smoking reduces fatigue
0 = no fatigue reduction · 0.25 = subtle (default) · 1.0 = vanilla strength · 2.0 = double
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_HungerReduction_tool:
How much smoking reduces hunger
0 = no hunger reduction · 0.25 = subtle (default) · 1.0 = vanilla strength · 2.0 = double
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_IdleBurnOut_tooltip:
How quickly the cigarette goes out when standing still
0 = never goes out (always stays lit)
100 = goes out normally (needs relighting)
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_ManageHeadGear_toolt: Automatically lowers shemaghs, gas masks, etc. when smoking and re-equips them after
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_MovementBurn_tooltip:
How much faster the smoke burns when walking, running or sprinting
25 = barely burns while moving · 100 = normal · 200 = burns fast when active
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_OverrideSmokeLength_: Forces every cigarette, cigar, pipe, etc. to use the value below
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_PuffStrength_tooltip:
How strong each puff feels (nicotine hit + stress/boredom relief)
50 = weak puffs · 100 = normal · 200 = very strong
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_SmokeLength_tooltip:
Base length of all smokables when Override is enabled or item has no custom length
Higher = lasts longer
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_SmokeRelighting_tool: If the ember gets too weak, you can relight it instead of it dying completely
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_SmokerTraitDecayMult:
How quickly addiction and withdrawal decrease when player has the Smoker trait
Higher = faster decay
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_SmokingSpeed_tooltip:
Global burn speed for ALL smokables
25 = lasts forever · 100 = balanced · 200 = burns very fast
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_UseNewMoodle_tooltip: Enables the new smoking moodle which better reflects nicotine levels and withdrawal
Sandbox_TrueSmoking_UseNicotineSystem_to: Turns on nicotine tracking, withdrawal effects, and dynamic addiction
Sandbox_TrueWeight_GeneralMultiplier_too: Multiplies the weight of ALL items in the game. <LINE>This calculation is applied AFTER any custom lists, sandbox categories, or mod presets.
Sandbox_TrueWeight_UseModPreset_tooltip: If enabled, applies the mod creator's custom weight values. <LINE>Player custom sandbox settings above will ALWAYS override the preset if modified.
Sandbox_TrunkSpillageDriveChance_tooltip: Per-tick chance multiplier (0-200%%) that rough driving (not just full crashes) shakes items loose. 100 = baseline. 0 disables drive-shake entirely.
Sandbox_TrunkSpillageMaxItemsPerCrash: Trunk spillage: max items per crash
Sandbox_TrunkSpillageMaxItemsPerCrash_to: Hard cap on how many items can be ejected from a trunk in a single crash event. Default 15.
Sandbox_TrunkSpillageMinSpeed_tooltip: Vehicles slower than this never spill cargo, regardless of impact. Default 20 km/h.
Sandbox_TsarLib_SpawnRateMustang_tooltip: Controls how often ATA Mustang vehicles spawn in the world. 0 = no spawns, 1.0 = default, 2.0 = old x2, 4.0 = old x4.
Sandbox_Tuna_MultiVHS_CuratedQuadVisionS: Place one QuadVision by hand in the television shop of the Louisville mall, on the shop floor beside the display sets. Only ever one, and only in a world created with this option on - it is never added to an existing save.
Sandbox_Tuna_MultiVHS_DualVisionWorldSwa: How often a vanilla widescreen television standing in a shop, living room or bedroom is a Mirage AV DualVision instead. This is chosen when the world is created and cannot be changed afterwards - altering it later has no effect on a world already running. It is never applied to a save that predates this option.
Sandbox_Tuna_MultiVHS_QuadVisionContaine: How often a QuadVision appears in containers. Has no effect unless QuadVision Container Spawns is on.

Also let the QuadVision turn up as container loot, alongside the DualVision. Off by default: the two-tile flagship is meant to be found where it stands, not pulled out of a crate. The DualVision is unaffected by this option.
Sandbox_UH1BHueySpawnCount: Minimum amount of UH-1B Helicopters that will spawn in world
Sandbox_UIFramework_HideMenuBar_tooltip: Hide the floating menu bar on the right edge of the screen. Nothing behind it is disabled.
Sandbox_UIToggleKey_tooltip: Key used to open/close the Advanced Health panel.
Sandbox_USMP_OCP_Zombies: Spawn Chances of Zombies with OCP uniform - Military Zones / Secret Base / Default
Sandbox_USMP_OCP_Zombies_default: Spawn Chances of Zombies with OCP uniform - Default
Sandbox_USMP_OCP_Zombies_default_tooltip: Specifies the probability of encountering Zombies in OCP Gear across the map, no defined zone
Sandbox_USMP_OCP_Zombies_tooltip: Specifies the probability of encountering Zombies in OCP Gear at Military Bases and at the secret base
Sandbox_USMP_UCP_Zombies: Spawn Chances of Zombies with UCP uniform - Military Zones / Secret Base
Sandbox_USMP_UCP_Zombies_default: Spawn Chances of Zombies with UCP uniform - Default
Sandbox_USMP_UCP_Zombies_default_tooltip: Specifies the probability of encountering Zombies in UCP Gear across the map, no defined zone
Sandbox_USMP_UCP_Zombies_tooltip: Specifies the probability of encountering Zombies in UCP Gear at Military Bases and at the secret base
Sandbox_USMRE_SpawnRate_CivilianVehicles:

Examples:

Sandbox_USMRE_SpawnRate_Civilian_tooltip:

Sandbox_USMRE_SpawnRate_Commercial_toolt:

Sandbox_USMRE_SpawnRate_TacticalVehicles:

Sandbox_USMRE_SpawnRate_Tactical_tooltip:
Type a number to multiply the spawn rate in Military Bases, Police Stations, and Gun Stores.

1.0 = Default Balanced

Sandbox_UW_RadioForecasting_DebugLogging: If true, print broadcast text to console for verification.
Sandbox_UW_RadioForecasting_Enabled_tool: If false, all SPEC radio forecasts are disabled.
Sandbox_UW_RadioForecasting_UseNightWind: If true, schedules broadcasts between 20:00 and 23:00; otherwise between 08:00 and 11:00.
Sandbox_UW_RadioForecasting_WalkieHints_: If true, active walkies show subtle WX scanner readings (default: on).
Sandbox_UltimateMarksman_ArrowRecoveryCh: Base chance to recover an intact arrow from a struck target.
Sandbox_UltimateMarksman_BoltSWBaseBreak: Base chance that a lodged short wood bolt is recovered intact instead of broken.
Sandbox_UltimateMarksman_BoltSWBreakChan: Short Wood Bolt Recovery Bonus per Aiming Level
Extra intact recovery chance added for each Aiming level.
Sandbox_UltimateMarksman_BoltWBaseBreakC: Base chance that a lodged wood bolt is recovered intact instead of broken.
Sandbox_UltimateMarksman_BoltWBreakChanc: Wood Bolt Recovery Bonus per Aiming Level
Extra intact recovery chance added for each Aiming level.
Sandbox_UltimateMarksman_BowDrawFatigueM: Endurance drained while drawing a bow.
Sandbox_UltimateMarksman_BowHoldFatigueM: Extra endurance drained while holding a bow at full draw.
Sandbox_UltimateMarksman_CompoundCrossbo: Multiplies how often compound crossbows and full-size bolts spawn in container loot and foraging.
Sandbox_UltimateMarksman_CraftedBowDurab: Multiplies the maximum condition of newly crafted bows.
Sandbox_UltimateMarksman_CrudeCrossbowSp: Multiplies how often crude crossbows spawn in container loot and foraging.
Sandbox_UltimateMarksman_HandCrossbowSpa: Multiplies how often hand crossbows and short bolts spawn in container loot and foraging.
Sandbox_UltimateMarksman_ImprovedCrossbo: Multiplies how often improved crossbows spawn in container loot and foraging.
Sandbox_UltimateMarksman_LootSpawnMult_t: Multiplies all PZ Crossbows container loot and foraging spawns, including crossbows, bolt quivers, bolts and bolt parts. This combines with each crossbow's individual multiplier.
Sandbox_UmaBoid_LootBook_tooltip:
Adjust Uma Book spawn rate.
5 being the original default rate
Sandbox_UmaBoid_LootConsumable_tooltip:
Adjust consumable items spawn rate.
5 being the original default rate
Sandbox_UmaBoid_LootGenericWeapon_toolti:
Adjust weapons spawn rate for the generic UmaBoid weapons.
5 being the original default rate
Sandbox_UmaBoid_LootHeavyWeapon_tooltip:
Adjust weapons spawn rate for the heavy and stronger UmaBoid weapons.
5 being the original default rate
Sandbox_UmaBoid_LootMagicWeapon_tooltip:
Adjust weapons spawn rate for the magical UmaBoid weapons.
This includes Grass wonder's and Daiwa Scarlet's Staff.
5 being the original default rate
Sandbox_UnbreakableFenceOptions_DoubleGa: Required Metalworking level for both double tall gates.
Sandbox_UnbreakableFenceOptions_FenceWel: Required Metalworking level for both chainlink-fence variants.
Sandbox_UnbreakableFenceOptions_Material: Multiplies every metal pipe, wire, hinge and scrap-metal requirement. 0 = free, 1 = the mod's default costs. Fractions round up.
Sandbox_UnbreakableFenceOptions_SingleGa: Required Metalworking level for the single pole and wire gates.
Sandbox_UnbreakableFenceOptions_ToolUseM: Multiplies every blowtorch and welding-rod use requirement. 0 = free, 1 = the mod's default costs. Fractions round up.
Sandbox_UndeadSurvivor_AmazonaChance_too: <RGB:0.8,0,0> Requires a server restart to apply changes. <RGB:1,1,1> <LINE>
Sandbox_UndeadSurvivor_HeadhunterChance_: The Deadly Headhunter is 4 times rarer than a regular one. <LINE> <RGB:0.8,0,0> Requires a server restart to apply changes. <RGB:1,1,1> <LINE>
Sandbox_UndeadSurvivor_NomadChance_toolt: The Ominous Nomad is 4 times rarer than a regular one. <LINE> <RGB:0.8,0,0> Requires a server restart to apply changes. <RGB:1,1,1> <LINE>
Sandbox_UndeadSurvivor_PrepperChance_too: <RGB:0.8,0,0> Requires a server restart to apply changes. <RGB:1,1,1> <LINE>

Sandbox_UndeadWildlife_DamageMultiplier_: Scales each species' size-based attack damage.
Sandbox_UndeadWildlife_DetectRange_toolt: Maximum outdoor detection distance. Supplemental animals also spawn within this radius, outside immediate view, so they can acquire and approach a survivor.
Sandbox_UndeadWildlife_Enabled_tooltip: Master switch for undead animal spawning, conversion, and hostile behaviour.
Sandbox_UndeadWildlife_EncounterCooldown: Real-world outdoor minutes between encounter checks for each active survivor. Minimum 10 minutes. Indoor time resets the interval. Native ranch and migration spawning is unaffected.
Sandbox_UndeadWildlife_EncounterDespawnR: Supplemental encounter animals farther than this many tiles from every active survivor are removed. Natural, converted, and dead animals are never removed by this setting.
Sandbox_UndeadWildlife_EncountersEnabled: Periodically attempts to create one random non-bull undead animal near each active outdoor survivor. Indoor survivors are ineligible.
Sandbox_UndeadWildlife_HealthLossMultipl: Health lost per point of weapon damage. Lower values make undead wildlife tougher.
Sandbox_UndeadWildlife_KnockdownChance_t: Chance that an attack from a large undead animal knocks the survivor down.
Sandbox_UndeadWildlife_MaxNearby_tooltip: Maximum number of living supplemental encounter animals allowed within despawn range of each survivor. Natural and converted animals do not count.
Sandbox_UndeadWildlife_MaximumEncounterC: Upper limit for the encounter chance after weekly progression.
Sandbox_UndeadWildlife_PopulationSpawnCh: Starting chance that each scheduled encounter check creates undead wildlife.
Sandbox_UndeadWildlife_PredationDebug_to: Writes zombie-animal targeting, chase, attack, miss, damage, and release details to the console for testing. Leave disabled during normal play.
Sandbox_UndeadWildlife_PushEnabled_toolt: Allows bare-hand shoves to stagger undead wildlife and force them backward. Larger animals resist more of the movement.
Sandbox_UndeadWildlife_ReanimationDelayS: Real-world delay between a zombie-caused animal death and the corpse rising again.
Sandbox_UndeadWildlife_ReplaceExistingAn: Immediately redirects and converts living wildlife as in the original release. Disabled by default so infection can spread through zombie attacks over time.
Sandbox_UndeadWildlife_WeeklyEncounterIn: Percentage points added to the encounter chance after each completed seven-day week.
Sandbox_UndeadWildlife_ZombieAnimalDetec: Maximum distance at which an available zombie can acquire a living animal.
Sandbox_UndeadWildlife_ZombieKillReanima: Chance that an animal killed during a tracked zombie attack reanimates as infected wildlife.
Sandbox_UndeadWildlife_ZombiesHuntAnimal: Allows unoccupied zombies to pursue and visibly attack living vanilla animals. Undead wildlife is never treated as prey.
Sandbox_UndyingZombies_MaxRezTime_toolti: Maximum hours before revival when Random Revival Timer is enabled.
Sandbox_UndyingZombies_MinRezTime_toolti: Minimum hours before revival when Random Revival Timer is enabled.
Sandbox_UndyingZombies_RandomMode_toolti: When enabled, Fixed Revival Time is ignored and Min/Max Revival Time is used instead.
Sandbox_UndyingZombies_ReanimateChance_t: Chance for a zombie to revive after death.
Sandbox_UndyingZombies_RezSpeed_tooltip: Hours before revival when Random Revival Timer is disabled.

Sandbox_VanillaAgricultureFix_WaterXP_to: Actual Farming experience gained when watering a plant that started the action with no water. No XP is awarded for topping up partially watered plants.
Sandbox_VanillaBoxDropRate_tooltip:
<RGB:1,1,1>The chance for each box type to drop
from a zombie you kill.

Every type you turn on is checked on
its own, and most zombies are
checked twice. With all 9 types on,
that is 18 checks per body.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>So 0.5 does not mean 0.5%% of
zombies. Many small chances add up.
At 0.5 you get a box from about 1
body in 12.

<RGB:1.000,0.700,0.200>A gun pack's Ammo Loot Drop can be
on at the same time. This mod owns
the vanilla boxes then and the pack
mod drops only its own, so nothing
lands twice. Real Firearms is the
one that cannot be on with this.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>One box holds 20 to 50 rounds, so a
small number here is already a lot
of ammo.

<RGB:1,1,1>Set it to 0 to stop the drop.
Sandbox_VanillaBox_ArmedZombiesOnly_tool:
<RGB:1,1,1>OFF: any zombie can drop boxes. This
is the normal setting.

ON: only zombies who look like they
carried a gun drop boxes, and only
the kind that fits their gun:

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>All types - soldiers, militia (4)
Pistol, shotgun, rifle - hunters,
rangers, campers, rednecks,
survivalists, raiders (20)
Pistol, shotgun - police, guards,
bandits, bikers (10)
Shotgun, rifle - farmers, fishermen
(2)
Pistol only - detectives, agents,
truckers, mobsters (5)

<RGB:1,1,1>That is 41 of the 125 zombie outfits
in the game. Every other zombie
drops nothing. In a normal town,
only about 1 zombie in 100 wears one
of these outfits.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>So search where these people worked:
police stations, army bases,
prisons, farms and bars.

<RGB:1,1,1>A higher drop rate helps a little,
but you will still find very little
in the suburbs.

Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_CalorieBonusPr: Extra calories applied after the weight-based rebalance. 0%% uses the balanced values; 100%% doubles them and 400%% makes them x5.
Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EnableBaitQual: Insects favour small fish, fresh fish bait attracts predators, meat favours catfish, and stale or rotten bait shifts catches toward scavengers and trash.
Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EnableCastMini: Shows a blue-and-yellow 1-to-16-tile meter while aiming. Yellow marks the aimed distance and the blue cursor selects the cast.
Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EnableCatchEve: Enables escapes, exceptional catches and the event system used by line breaks, rod breaks and double catches.
Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EnableEnhanced: Awards +1 XP on a bite, +2 when control starts, +5 on capture and +10 extra for an exceptional catch.
Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EnableEquipmen: Hooks alter attraction, line quality alters break risk, and professional rods wear more slowly.
Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EnableExpanded: Adds boots, branches, cans, cordage, hooks and other vanilla junk to fishing catches.
Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EnableFatigue_: Long uninterrupted fishing sessions drain endurance and progressively slow reeling. Resting starts a fresh session.
Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EnableFishAI_t: Makes carp, trout, catfish, pike and compatible mod fish fight with different speed, force and escape risks.
Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EnableFishQual: Caught fish receive an invisible Normal, Good, Excellent or Legendary quality that affects weight, nutrition, mood and value metadata.
Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EnableFishScho: Some thirty-tile water areas are richer. Catches still deplete vanilla abundance and double catches deplete it twice.
Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EnableLineBrea: Allows high tension and heavy fish to break the fishing line. Line type and condition affect risk.
Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EnableModCompa: Automatically balances all species registered in the Build 42 Fishing.fishes table and enables dedicated support for Yumi's Fishing Expansion.
Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EnableNutritio: Recalculates fish nutrition from real caught weight and preserves the total nutrition when filleting.
Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EnableRareFish: Allows albino, mutated, gigantic, scarred and diseased catches.
Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EnableRealisti: Small fish barely wear rods; large and exceptional fish may remove substantially more condition.
Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EnableRodBreak: Allows a very rare rod failure. Heavy fish and damaged rods are more dangerous.
Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EnableStatisti: Tracks fish, total weight, species, records, escapes, breaks, junk, treasure and special catches per character.
Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EnableTimeEffe: Makes dawn and dusk best, morning good, midday poor and night less productive.
Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EnableTreasure: Allows very rare catches such as watches, rings, old coins, tools and premium line.
Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EnableWeatherE: Light rain helps, while storms, strong wind, heavy rain and fog reduce fishing success.
Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EventFrequency: Scales the probability of catch events, treasure and rare fish.
Sandbox_VanillaHookTriggerChance_tooltip: Chance (0-100) that a vanilla helicopter trigger starts an HTT event.
Sandbox_VanillaTrackingFix_DeerMeatCalor: Increases calories on vanilla meat obtained from butchering deer. 0%% keeps vanilla values; 100%% doubles, 200%% triples, and 400%% makes calories x5.
Sandbox_VanillaTrackingFix_DeerSpottingD: Spotting distance used for deer when the detection fix is enabled.
Sandbox_VanillaTrackingFix_EnableDirecti: Fresh generated clues can play an animal sound from the next clue direction.
Sandbox_VanillaTrackingFix_EnableTrackin: Vanilla animal tracks start a persistent trail with generated follow-up clues.
Sandbox_VanillaTrackingFix_LiveAnimalEnc: Successful trails reveal living vanilla animals instead of only ending the trail.
Sandbox_VanillaTrackingFix_RainDamagesTr: Rain can lower generated track quality and eventually wash tracks away.
Sandbox_VanillaTrackingFix_ReduceDeerDet: Lowers vanilla deer spotting distance so stalking and shooting are more practical.
Sandbox_VanillaTrackingFix_TrackingXPOnE: Extra Tracking XP granted when the animal is located.
Sandbox_VanillaTrackingFix_TrackingXPPer: Tracking XP granted when a clue is investigated.
Sandbox_VanillaTrackingFix_UseModTrackCh: Enabled: the mod can generate initial tracks using its internal chance. Disabled: only the vanilla Animal Tracks Chance setting is used.
Sandbox_VanillaTrappingFix_EnableTrapWar: If enabled, the character says a generic line when one of their traps needs checking.
Sandbox_VanillaWeaponDropRate_tooltip:
<RGB:1,1,1>The chance that a zombie you kill is
carrying a gun.

This is the total chance, not the
chance for each gun. All the guns
you turn on share it. Turning a
caliber off changes which gun you
get, not how often you get one.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>Most zombies are checked twice. At
0.1 you get a gun from about 1 body
in 500. The 20 guns share that
chance.

<RGB:1.000,0.700,0.200>A gun pack's Ammo Loot Drop can be
on at the same time. This mod owns
the vanilla guns then and the pack
mod drops only its own, so nothing
lands twice. Real Firearms is the
one that cannot be on with this.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>A gun is worth much more than a few
bullets. Raise this slowly.

<RGB:1,1,1>Set it to 0 to stop the drop.
Sandbox_VanillaWeapon_ArmedZombiesOnly_t:
<RGB:1,1,1>OFF: any zombie can drop a gun, even
office workers and nurses.

ON: only zombies who look like they
carried a gun drop one, and only the
kind that suits them:

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>All types - soldiers, militia (4)
Pistols, shotguns, rifles - hunters,
rangers, campers, rednecks,
survivalists, raiders (20)
Pistols, shotguns - police, guards,
bandits, bikers (10)
Shotguns, rifles - farmers,
fishermen (2)
Pistols only - detectives, agents,
truckers, mobsters (5)

<RGB:1,1,1>That is 41 of the 125 zombie outfits
in the game. Every other zombie
drops nothing. In a normal town,
only about 1 zombie in 100 wears one
of these outfits.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>So search where these people worked:
police stations, army bases,
prisons, farms and bars.

<RGB:1,1,1>A higher drop rate helps a little,
but you will still find very little
in the suburbs.
Sandbox_VanillaWeapon_DropMagazine_toolt:
<RGB:1,1,1>ON: the magazine that a gun uses
drops at the same rate, so a rifle
you find is ready to use.

It is checked on its own, so the
magazine may not drop from the same
zombie as the gun.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>7 of the 20 guns use a magazine.
They share 6 magazines between them.

<RGB:1.000,0.700,0.200>Revolvers, break action guns and
guns that load loose rounds do not
need one.

<RGB:1,1,1>OFF: guns only, no magazines.

MSR7T Tactical Rifle
M1A Rifle
Sandbox_VanillaWeapon_Guns556_tooltip:
MSR700 Rifle

JS-14 Rifle
Sandbox_VanillaWeapon_GunsShotgun_toolti:

Sawed-off Double Barrel Shotgun
JS-3T Tactical Shotgun
Sandbox_Vanilla_ArmedZombiesOnly_tooltip:
<RGB:1,1,1>OFF: any zombie can drop ammo. This
is the normal setting.

ON: only zombies who look like they
carried a gun drop ammo, and only
the kind that fits their gun:

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>All types - soldiers, militia (4)
Pistol, shotgun, rifle - hunters,
rangers, campers, rednecks,
survivalists, raiders (20)
Pistol, shotgun - police, guards,
bandits, bikers (10)
Shotgun, rifle - farmers, fishermen
(2)
Pistol only - detectives, agents,
truckers, mobsters (5)

<RGB:1,1,1>That is 41 of the 125 zombie outfits
in the game. Every other zombie
drops nothing. In a normal town,
only about 1 zombie in 100 wears one
of these outfits.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>So search where these people worked:
police stations, army bases,
prisons, farms and bars.

<RGB:1,1,1>A higher drop rate helps a little,
but you will still find very little
in the suburbs.
Sandbox_Vanilla_LooseRoundsMax_tooltip:
<RGB:1,1,1>How many rounds you get each time
ammo drops. You get between 1 and
this many.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>This does not change how often you
find ammo. Only the drop rate above
does that. It changes how much you
find each time.

Every round type gets its own
number, so a body with two calibers
gives a separate amount for each.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>At the default of 10, a body with
ammo holds about 8 rounds. That is
enough to be useful.

Set it to 1 if you want only one
round at a time, like the old
version of this mod.

<RGB:1.000,0.700,0.200>A body has limited space. If you set
a big number, the body may fill up
and you will get less than you asked
for.
Sandbox_VehicleClaimAutoLethalActions_to: When ON, hotwiring, prying or lockpicking a claimed vehicle, or opening any of its doors, trunk, or glovebox triggers an immediate Tier 4 punishment (burn + injury) regardless of the configured ceiling. When OFF, those actions fall back to the regular seated-time escalation. Default ON.
Sandbox_VehicleClaimPunishmentTier_toolt: Maximum punishment ceiling when a non-allowed player is seated in a claimed vehicle. 0 = Off (just eject). 1 = Warn. 2 = Shock. 3 = Burn (destructive). 4 = Lethal (burn + injury). Tier escalates one step every 7 seconds the player stays seated, capped at this ceiling. The 3rd offence on the same vehicle in one session is fatal regardless of the ceiling.
Sandbox_VehicleClaims4220MP_ClaimExpiryH: A claim is released after this many real-world hours without its owner entering the vehicle's 8x8 tile chunk. Default: 24 hours. A Lemon's Aid admin override can replace this value for the current world.
Sandbox_VehicleClaims4220MP_DefaultClaim: The number of active vehicle claims each multiplayer account may own. Default: 2. Administrators can set a persistent per-account override from Lemon's Aid without releasing existing claims.
Sandbox_VehicleClaims4220MP_EnableE3Obse: Default: Off. Latches at server startup. Allows current administrators to reset or capture one bounded redacted in-memory protocol aggregate and arm one exact-claim marker-handoff failure for rollback testing. Never enable on a public server.
Sandbox_VehicleClassOverhaul_FastVehicle: Specify the VehicleName, use ; as the delimiter
Sandbox_VehicleClassOverhaul_PercentRedu: Reduce the effect, 30%% sets the horse power close to vanilla
Sandbox_VehicleClassOverhaul_QuietVehicl: Specify the VehicleName, use ; as the delimiter
Sandbox_VehicleClassOverhaul_StrongVehic: Specify the VehicleName, use ; as the delimiter
Sandbox_VehicleHeaterSound_CoolingVolume: Cooling mode volume factor near neutral.
Cooling mode volume factor at max cold.
Sandbox_VehicleHeaterSound_EnableHeater_: Play heater sound with inside/outside logic.
Sandbox_VehicleHeaterSound_EnableMufflin: Muffles global volumes inside sealed vehicles based on sealing quality.
Sandbox_VehicleHeaterSound_EnablePitch_t: Allow pitch changes (e.g. colder = slightly higher pitch).
Sandbox_VehicleHeaterSound_EngineMinPct_: Minimum engine-channel volume multiplier to prevent loop dropouts when muffled.
Sandbox_VehicleHeaterSound_Gamma_tooltip: Curve exponent: >1 penalizes small leaks more.
Sandbox_VehicleHeaterSound_HeaterWeight_: Weight of heater vs engine condition in combined effect (engine = 1−weight).
Sandbox_VehicleHeaterSound_NoMuffleEps_t: Below this seal value, muffling is disabled and originals restored.
Sandbox_VehicleHeaterSound_OutsideWindow: Extra outside dampening when all windows closed.
Sandbox_VehicleHeaterSound_SealedAmbient: Ambient volume when cabin is perfectly sealed (0–1).
Sandbox_VehicleHeaterSound_SealedEngineP: Engine volume when cabin is perfectly sealed (0–1).
Sandbox_VehicleHeaterSound_SealedMasterP: Master volume when cabin is perfectly sealed (0–1).
Sandbox_VehicleHeaterSound_VolumeInside_: Base heater volume when player is inside (multiplier).
Sandbox_VehicleHeaterSound_VolumeOutside: Base heater volume when player is outside (multiplier).
Sandbox_VehicleMaintenance_AlternatorWea: Multiplier for alternator wear and degradation. Set to 0 to disable wear.
Sandbox_VehicleMaintenance_BeltWearRate_: Multiplier for transmission belt wear over distance. Set to 0 to disable wear.
Sandbox_VehicleMaintenance_CoolantLeakRa: Multiplier for coolant leak speed when the radiator is damaged. Set to 0 to disable leaks.
Sandbox_VehicleMaintenance_GearboxWearRa: Multiplier for gearbox wear and failure chance. Set to 0 to disable wear.
Sandbox_VehicleMaintenance_LootRarityMul: Multiplier for spawn chance of vehicle maintenance items (Oil, Coolant, Radiator, Belt, Alternator, Gearbox). Set to 0 to disable loot spawns or lower for extremely/insanely rare loot.
Sandbox_VehicleMaintenance_OilWearRate_t: Multiplier for engine oil consumption (1%% per X km). Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_VehicleSpawnToggle_tooltip: Disable this to prevent starting vehicles and trailers from spawning, effectively disabling the mod.
Sandbox_VehicleTuner_Thresholds_tooltip: Ensures correct vehicle behavior, disable if you target silly results
Sandbox_VehicleWeatherColdRate_tooltip: Scales body-temperature drop from open or broken windows / windshields when outside air is cold. 100 is default, 0 disables cold without disabling wetness.
Sandbox_VehicleWeatherForagePenalty: Vehicle Weather: missing windshield reduces sight
Sandbox_VehicleWeatherForagePenalty_tool: When ON, driving without a windshield (or with one shattered) lowers your foraging sight while inside the cab, simulating wind/rain in your eyes. Default ON.
Sandbox_VehicleWeatherIntensity_tooltip: Global multiplier on cabin wetness accrual. 100 = baseline. Range 0-200. Default 100.
Sandbox_VehicleWeatherTemperature_toolti: When ON, exposure to cold rain or snow inside an open or breached cabin also chills the player. Default ON.
Sandbox_VehicleWeatherWetnessRate_toolti: Scales how fast you get wet from rain blowing in through a missing windshield. 100 is default, 0 disables wetness without disabling cold.
Sandbox_VehicleWindowShatterChance_toolt: Percent chance that a vehicle window shatters when prying a locked door.
Sandbox_VeryDarkSearchTimeMultiplier_too: Search time multiplier when the container is in very dark light. Default 5.
Sandbox_VideoGameConsoles_LootRarity_too: Adjust the spawn chance of video games and consoles
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_AutoRepairOnUpgra: Fully repair a weapon each time it earns an upgrade. Off = the weapon keeps its current condition. (Vorpal Shard re-rolls always repair.) Default: On.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_BondingKillsMax_t: Most kills before a weapon reaches its final tier, Blooded. Default: 400.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_BondingKillsMin_t: Fewest kills before a weapon reaches its final tier, Blooded. Default: 200.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_DisableMagazineSy: Compatibility option. Turn on only if you use a mod that swaps magazine types on the fly and you see wrong magazine capacities. While on, magazine-size affixes will not roll. (Common gun-store mods are detected automatically.) Default: Off.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_EnableAccuracyAff: Allow firearm affixes that improve hit chance and aim speed. Default: On.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_EnableBloodedAffi: Allow the top-tier multi-stat Blooded effects (the final tier) to roll. Default: On.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_EnableCritAffixes: Allow affixes that boost critical chance and critical damage (Precise, Deadly...). Default: On.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_EnableDamageAffix: Allow affixes that increase weapon damage (Sharp, Brutal, of Harm...). Default: On.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_EnableDebugLogs_t: Troubleshooting only. With PZ debug mode active, print detailed VorpallySauced messages to the console. Default: Off.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_EnableDurabilityA: Allow affixes that raise max condition and slow down wear. Default: On.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_EnableFireAffixes: Allow affixes that set zombies on fire on hit (Smoldering, Scorching, Immolating). Fire can spread to nearby things, use PZ's own Fire Spread setting to control that. Default: On.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_EnableFireRateAff: Allow firearm affixes that increase fire rate. Turn off if another mod controls fire rate. Default: On.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_EnableFirearmAffi: Let guns earn upgrades from kills, the same way melee weapons do. Off = only melee weapons progress and guns stay vanilla. Already-upgraded guns keep their stats. Default: On.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_EnableLegendaryAf: Allow the rare multi-stat Legendary affixes to roll. To keep them but make them rarer, lower Legendary Affix Frequency instead. Default: On.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_EnableMod_tooltip: Turn the whole weapon mastery system on or off. Off = weapons behave exactly like vanilla. Default: On.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_EnableRangeAffixe: Allow affixes that extend melee reach and firearm range. Default: On.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_EnableReloadAffix: Allow firearm affixes that make reloading faster. Default: On.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_EnableStaggerAffi: Allow affixes that stagger zombies on hit (Forceful, Crushing, of Impact...). Turn off if another combat mod already handles stagger. Default: On.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_EnableTraitEffect: On = weapon personality traits (Nocturnal, Ravenous, Patient...) give real bonuses such as stamina, calm, crit, and durability, growing stronger as the weapon deepens. Off = traits are flavor only. Default: On.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_EnableUtilityAffi: Allow assorted affixes: attack speed, stamina, multi-hit, knockback, door damage, jam chance, magazine size, and noise. Default: On.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_HideFlavorText_to: Hide the atmospheric lore lines on weapon tooltips (e.g. 'Something stirs within'). Stats and upgrade info still show. Default: Off.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_LegendaryChance_t: How often legendary (multi-stat) affixes roll, compared to the other tiers. Higher = more common. Set to 0 to switch legendaries off entirely. Default: 5.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_NotifyOnUpgrade_t: Show a message when a weapon earns a new upgrade. Default: On.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_PrefixKillsMax_to: Most kills before a weapon earns its first upgrade, a Mark. Default: 29.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_PrefixKillsMin_to: Fewest kills before a weapon can earn its first upgrade, a Mark. The real number is rolled between min and max; fragile weapons need fewer. Default: 10.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_ShardOnFullBondin: Give a Vorpal Shard when a weapon becomes fully Blooded. Shards re-roll the upgrades on any weapon. Default: On.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_ShowKillProgress_: On = weapon tooltips show the exact kills left until the next upgrade. Off = tooltips show atmospheric hints instead. Default: Off.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_StirredDurability: Minimum effective durability once a weapon earns its first upgrade, so fragile weapons (screwdrivers, kitchen knives) survive long enough to keep progressing. Higher = more protection. Sturdy weapons are unaffected. Default: 5.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_SuffixKillsMax_to: Most kills before a weapon earns its second upgrade, a Bond. Default: 70.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_SuffixKillsMin_to: Fewest kills before a weapon earns its second upgrade, a Bond. Default: 30.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_Tier1Weight_toolt: How often common (Tier 1) affixes roll, compared to the other tiers. Higher = more common. The four frequency numbers are weighed against each other, they are not percentages. Default: 40.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_Tier2Weight_toolt: How often uncommon (Tier 2) affixes roll, compared to the other tiers. Higher = more common. Default: 30.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_Tier3Weight_toolt: How often rare (Tier 3) affixes roll, compared to the other tiers. Higher = more common. Default: 20.
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_TraitEffectStreng: How strong trait bonuses are: 1 = Subtle (50%%), 2 = Moderate (75%%), 3 = Full (100%%). Only used when Trait Gameplay Effects is on. Default: 3 (Full).
Sandbox_VorpallySauced_TraitNotification: Floating messages for weapon personality. 0 = off, 1 = trait changes only, 2 = traits and mood shifts. Traits always appear on tooltips regardless. Default: 2 (traits and moods).
Sandbox_WDecay_barricadePercentage_toolt: How many windows and exterior doors receive barricades. Random 1-4 wooden planks or metal sheets.
Sandbox_WDecay_batteryDamageChance_toolt: Chance that the battery is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_bushesPercentageOnRoad_to: How many bushes spawn on road tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_bushesPercentage_tooltip: How many custom bushes and hedges spawn on natural ground.
Sandbox_WDecay_customGrassPercentageOnRo: How much custom grass and debris spawns on road tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_customGrassPercentage_too: How much custom grass and ground debris (leaves, twigs, stones, logs) spawns.
Sandbox_WDecay_debugMode_tooltip: Enables detailed logging to the console. Only useful for troubleshooting or mod development.
Sandbox_WDecay_destroyedDoorsPercentage_: How many exterior doors are destroyed.
Sandbox_WDecay_dirtCrackOverlayPercentag: How many cracked overlays appear on natural ground tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_doorDamageChance_tooltip: Chance that a door is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_dryGrassPercentageOnRoad_: How much dry/wilted grass spawns on road tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_dryGrassPercentage_toolti: How much dry/wilted grass spawns on natural ground.
Sandbox_WDecay_engineDamageChance_toolti: Chance that the engine is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_fenceBendChance_tooltip: Override chance for multi-tile bendable fences (tall chainlink, metal dividers, tall wood). Set to 0 to use the base Fence Percentage.
Sandbox_WDecay_fenceBendSeverity_tooltip: How severely bent fences become. Random picks any stage equally. Light always stage 1, Medium stage 2, Heavy stage 3.
Sandbox_WDecay_fenceBreakChance_tooltip: Override chance for single-tile breakable fences (wood, metal bars, short chainlink). Set to 0 to use the base Fence Percentage.
Sandbox_WDecay_fenceDestroyWeight_toolti: When a breakable fence is damaged, the chance (weight) it gets fully destroyed vs partially damaged. Higher = more destruction.
Sandbox_WDecay_fencePercentage_tooltip: Base chance for fences to be damaged. Used as fallback when Break Chance or Bend Chance is set to 0.
Sandbox_WDecay_floorLeavesPercentageOnRo: How many dead leaves cover the ground on road tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_floorLeavesPercentage_too: How many dead leaves cover the ground on natural tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_gasTankConditionMax_toolt: Maximum gas tank condition when damaged (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_gasTankConditionMin_toolt: Minimum gas tank condition when damaged (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_gasTankDamageChance_toolt: Chance that the gas tank is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_gasTankMissingChance_tool: Chance the gas tank is missing.
Sandbox_WDecay_generalConditionChance_to: Chance per part that the general condition is applied.
Sandbox_WDecay_generalCondition_tooltip: Base condition applied to ALL parts (100 = full condition). Individual settings apply on top.
Sandbox_WDecay_gloveBoxConditionMax_tool: Maximum glove box condition when damaged (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_gloveBoxConditionMin_tool: Minimum glove box condition when damaged (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_gloveBoxDamageChance_tool: Chance that the glove box is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_gloveBoxMissingChance_too: Chance the glove box is missing.
Sandbox_WDecay_grassPercentageOnRoad_too: How much vanilla grass spawns on road tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_grassPercentage_tooltip: How much vanilla grass spawns on natural ground.
Sandbox_WDecay_groundDebrisPercentageOnR: How many sticks, logs and stones scatter on road tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_groundDebrisPercentage_to: How many sticks, logs and stones scatter on natural ground.
Sandbox_WDecay_headlightDamageChance_too: Chance that a headlight is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_heaterDamageChance_toolti: Chance that the heater is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_hoodDamageChance_tooltip: Chance that the hood is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_indoorBushesPercentage_to: How many bushes spawn inside buildings on floor tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_indoorGrassPercentage_too: How much grass and overgrowth spawns inside buildings on floor tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_jumboXLXXLPercentage_tool: Chance for generated trees to use Jumbo XL or Jumbo XXL sprites.
Sandbox_WDecay_multiFloorVines_tooltip: If enabled, vines also grow on upper floor walls. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_WDecay_priorityRadius_tooltip: Chunks within this distance from the player are processed first with high priority.
Sandbox_WDecay_progressiveDays_tooltip: Progressive mode only: in-game days until decay reaches 100%% of the configured sandbox percentages. 365 = one year.
Sandbox_WDecay_progressiveStartPercent_t: Progressive mode only: fraction of the configured percentages already present at world start. 0 = pristine world, 25 = the world starts with a quarter of the configured decay.
Sandbox_WDecay_radioDamageChance_tooltip: Chance that the radio is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_redecayEnabled_tooltip: If enabled, chunks processed long ago receive additional decay passes as the world ages, applying only the percentage gained since the last pass. Without this, decay is applied once per chunk forever.
Sandbox_WDecay_redecayThresholdDays_tool: Minimum in-game days between decay passes on the same chunk.
Sandbox_WDecay_roadCrackOverlayPercentag: How many cracked overlays appear on road tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofCustomGrassPercentage: How much custom grass and debris spawns on roof tiles (Z > 1).
Sandbox_WDecay_roofGrassPercentage_toolt: How much vanilla grass spawns on roof tiles (Z > 1).
Sandbox_WDecay_roofPercentage_tooltip: How many roofs on upper floors are destroyed, with 80%% chance of replacing with a destroyed variant.
Sandbox_WDecay_scanInterval_tooltip: How often the mod scans for new chunks around the player. Lower = more responsive but higher CPU usage. In Multiplayer, this value is automatically doubled.
Sandbox_WDecay_scanRadius_tooltip: How many chunks away from the player are scanned for processing. Higher = more area covered but more chunks queued at once.
Sandbox_WDecay_seasonalBiasEnabled_toolt: If enabled, generated vegetation follows the season: more dry grass and fewer leaves in winter, lusher grass in summer, more leaves in autumn.
Sandbox_WDecay_severityScalingEnabled_to: If enabled, world age also increases decay intensity, not just probability: vehicle parts spawn in worse condition and are missing more often, and damaged fences are destroyed more often.
Sandbox_WDecay_taillightDamageChance_too: Chance that a taillight is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeBudgetMs_tooltip: Maximum milliseconds per frame for world generation. Lower = smoother FPS but slower generation. Higher = faster generation but possible lag spikes.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingCurve_tooltip: Shape of the multiplier growth over time. Linear: steady. Logarithmic: fast early, saturates later. Quadratic: slow early, aggressive in old worlds.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingEnabled_toolti: If enabled, decay percentages increase the older the world is. Newly explored chunks in long-running worlds look more decayed.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingFollowErosion_: If enabled, the multiplier follows the vanilla Erosion Speed (days until full erosion) instead of the per-year rate: it reaches the Maximum Multiplier when vanilla erosion reaches 100%%.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingMax_tooltip: Upper cap for the world-age decay multiplier. 4.0 means decay percentages can grow up to 4x their configured values.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingMode_tooltip: Amplify: configured percentages apply fully from day one and grow up to the cap. Progressive: decay starts near zero and gradually ramps up to the configured percentages over the configured number of days, then keeps growing up to the cap. Combine Progressive with Incremental Re-Decay so already explored areas fill in over time.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingNatureFactor_t: How strongly world-age scaling affects vegetation (trees, bushes, grass, vines, ground overlays). 100 = base speed, 150 = nature reclaims 50%% faster, 0 = no scaling for nature.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingPerYear_toolti: How much all decay percentages increase per in-game year of world age. 25 means +25%% relative increase per year, capped by the Maximum Multiplier.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingUrbanFactor_to: How strongly world-age scaling affects structural decay (walls, fences, doors, windows, barricades). 100 = base speed, lower values make buildings decay slower than nature grows.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingVehiclesFactor: How strongly world-age scaling affects vehicle deterioration when Severity Scaling is enabled. 100 = base speed.
Sandbox_WDecay_tireDamageChance_tooltip: Chance that a tire is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_trashPercentageOnRoad_too: How much decorative trash appears on roads and streets.
Sandbox_WDecay_trashPercentage_tooltip: How much decorative trash (non-lootable) scatters on the ground.
Sandbox_WDecay_treePercentageOnRoad_tool: How many trees spawn on roads and pavement.
Sandbox_WDecay_treePercentage_tooltip: How many trees with random foliage spawn on natural ground.
Sandbox_WDecay_trunkDamageChance_tooltip: Chance that the trunk is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleBloodMax_tooltip: Maximum blood intensity (0-100) on vehicle exterior.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleBloodMin_tooltip: Minimum blood intensity (0-100) on vehicle exterior.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleDecayEnabled_toolt: Master switch. Disable to prevent any vehicle deterioration from this mod.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleRarity_tooltip: How often abandoned, rusted vehicles with blood stains spawn on roads.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleRustMax_tooltip: Maximum rust percentage (0-100) applied to vehicles.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleRustMin_tooltip: Minimum rust percentage (0-100) applied to vehicles.
Sandbox_WDecay_vinePercentage_tooltip: How much ivy and vines grow on exterior walls and fences.
Sandbox_WDecay_vinesExteriorOnly_tooltip: If enabled, vines only grow on exterior squares. Disable to allow vines inside buildings. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_WDecay_vinesOnFences_tooltip: If enabled, vines grow on fences and railings. Disable to prevent vines on fences.
Sandbox_WDecay_vinesOnWalls_tooltip: If enabled, vines grow on exterior walls. Disable to prevent vines on building walls.
Sandbox_WDecay_wallPercentage_tooltip: How many exterior wooden walls are replaced with burnt/damaged variants. Excludes doors and windows.
Sandbox_WDecay_windowDamageChance_toolti: Chance that a window is damaged.
Sandbox_WE_AllowDestruction_tooltip: If disabled, failed enhancements only reduce level — weapons are never destroyed.
Sandbox_WE_Difficulty_tooltip: Adjusts success and destruction rates for all enhancements.
Sandbox_WE_MaxLevel_tooltip: The highest level a weapon can be enhanced to.
Sandbox_WQS_ConfinedMode_txt_tooltip: If selected you must stay near the extraction point during the entire duration of the extraction event.
Sandbox_WQS_DeadlineDays_txt_tooltip: Maximum number of game days (after the radio becomes active) to reach the extraction point. \n 0 to disable the deadline.
Sandbox_WQS_ExtractionEventDifficulty_tx: Governs the overall difficulty of the extraction event.
Sandbox_WQS_ExtractionEventHoursDuration: Duration of the extraction event in game hours. \n Recommended 3 or 4 hours
Sandbox_WQS_GameModeExtended_txt_tooltip: If selected, the quest will NOT be active at the beginning and can only be started after crafting the antenna.
Sandbox_WQS_ItemInZombieLootMultiplier_t: Mod related item drop chance multiplier
Multiplier to the chance of finding mod related items in the loot of zombie bodies.(walkie talkie, map fragment of repeater location, etc.)
Sandbox_WQS_RepeatersModeHowMany_txt: Repeaters needed to get enough signal strength
Sandbox_WQS_RepeatersModeHowMany_txt_too: How many repeater antennas you must build in various places of the map to get enough radio signal strength.\n 0 to disable this option and have full signal strength from the start.
Sandbox_WQS_StartWithExtractionItem_txt: Start with the item needed for extraction
Sandbox_WQS_StartWithExtractionItem_txt_: Start with the item needed for extraction, you don't need to find it
Sandbox_WQS_WaitForSignalDuration_txt: Days to wait for the radio signal
Sandbox_WQS_WaitForSignalDuration_txt_to: Number of game days that must pass before the radio signal becomes active.\n 0 to disable this option and have signal already active at start.
Sandbox_WQS_ZoneMap_random_txt_tooltip: If a random extraction zone is chosen allows you to select which zones (even those of modded maps) include in the random pick list. \n If a fixed extraction zone is selected this parameter is ignored.
Sandbox_WZDirector_MigrateCooldown_toolt:
Time required to pass before the Migrate Event can trigger.
The cooldown is constantly refreshed while the number of zombies is at, or above the /AAAAFFZombie Threshold/FFFFFF.
Value is in in-game minutes.
Sandbox_WZDirector_MigrateDistance_toolt:
This value determines how large of an area to give to the world sound.
Make sure to adjust the vanilla option Zombie Follow Distance to match.
Zombies inside a 120 radius of the world sound's location ignore the sound.
/DDDD00Setting this value too high can cause performance issues/FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WZDirector_MigrateEnabled_toolti:

Sandbox_WanderingZombies_MaxTravel_toolt:
The maximum random distance that can be used.
This is used by Wandering, Homing and Fleeing.

This value is used to select a location, which is passed to the game's pathfinding.
The /DDDD00resulting path may be longer/FFFFFF than this value when needing to path around buildings, fences, etc.

High distance paired with Out Of Cell Paths results in increased local migration.
Low cooldowns with a low to mid distance results in zombies changing direction more frequently.

Sandbox_WanderingZombies_MergeCooldown_t:
When above zero, a horde is incapable of merging again until a cooldown has elapsed
Time is in milliseconds
Value is multipled by followers in a horde:
(followers in horde) * (Merge Cooldown)
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_Merge_tooltip:
Allow hordes to merge when within Rally Travel Distance
Horde merging does not respect Rally Group Size, they can grow to any size.

Sandbox_WanderingZombies_MoveCooldownRan:
The maximum random value added to /AAAAFFCooldown/FFFFFF.
This value is randomised again during the resets mentioned in Cooldown's tooltip.

/00FF00Increase this value to reduce difficulty/FFFFFF.
/FF0000Decrease this value to increase difficulty/FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_MoveCooldown_to:
The static amount of time (milliseconds) before a zombie can move.
Only applies to lone zombies and leaders of a horde, followers in a horde move when the leader does.

The cooldown is reset whenever a zombie is considered busy:
- While a zombie is moving (vanilla wandering is ignored)
- While a zombie has a target (character, dead body or thumpable)

/00FF00Increase this value to reduce difficulty/FFFFFF.
/FF0000Decrease this value to increase difficulty/FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_NumTicks_toolti: How many times the chosen counter must occur before a zombie may wander
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_RadiusDropdown_:
/AAAAFFStatic/FFFFFF: The value chosen below is the value that is always used.
/AAAAFFRandom/FFFFFF: A random value from Min to Max (inclusive) is always used. The value is randomised when the current period of activity has elapsed.

If Min is greater than Max, Max will be used as the minimum.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_RadiusInterrupt: When enabled, lone zombies that are homing in on the player have their current path interrupted as soon as they're inside the Random Radius

Min is allowed to be greater than Max, so ranges over midnight can be used.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_StartHourMax_to: This is only used when /AAAAFFStart Hour: Mode/FFFFFF is set to /AAAAFFRandom/FFFFFF.

/AAAAFFRandom/FFFFFF: A random value from Min to Max (inclusive) is used. The value is randomised when the period of activity is calculated.
